attorneys.practice_type: General Civil Litigation in both State and Federal Court Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Originally from Virginia, Ms. Cowart received her undergraduate degree from Bluefield College and relocated to Houston, Texas to attend South Texas College of Law. Ms. Cowart received her Doctor of Jurisprudence from South Texas in 2005 and was admitted to the State Bar of Texas that same year. Additionally, Ms. Cowart was admitted to the State Bar of Oklahoma in 2012. While attending South Texas, Ms. Cowart was a member of the varsity mock trial and moot court teams. Ms. Cowart received the best brief award at the J. Braxton Craven National Moot Court Tournament in 2004. Ms. Cowart is admitted to practice in the United States District Courts of Southern, Northern and Eastern Districts of Texas.

Ms. Cowart's practice primarily focuses on business litigation, including such areas as general contract disputes, employment disputes, non-compete disputes, theft of trade secrets, shareholder disputes and business acquisitions and dissolutions and all phases of litigation. Ms. Cowart also has extensive experience representing various types of medical service providers and individual practitioners on compliance with healthcare rules and regulations including, but not limited to HIPAA, Stark, Anti-Fraud and Abuse, False Claims Act, and Texas Illegal Remuneration Act. Further, Ms. Cowart has also represented and advised various medical providers on ERISA and HIPAA matters. Ms. Cowart has also represented various medical entities and practitioners in governmental investigations and proceedings for violation of healthcare rules and regulations, including but not limited to Stark, Anti-Fraud and Abuse and the False Claims Act. Ms. Cowart is committed to obtaining the best results for her clients. To that end, Ms. Cowart and the attorneys at Hendershot Cowart & Hisey, P.C. work closely with their clients to outline an aggressive, detailed strategy and course of action for the discovery phase, motion phase and trial phase of litigation.

In her free time, Ms. Cowart enjoys spending time outside with her husband and two young daughters. Her family often participates in family runs and bike rides together.

Honors

Best Brief Award at the J. Braxton Craven National Moot Court Tournament, 2004

South Texas College of Law Intramural Mock Trial Tournament, 2003

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:

After graduating from the University of Texas with High Honors, Rob received his law degree from the nationally recognized University of Texas School of Law. He then opened his own firm and later joined Chris Lewis to form the nationally recognized firm of Crain Lewis, LLP.

Rob is passionate about his community and is a leader in his profession. He serves on the Board of Directors of the North Texas Chapter of Big Brothers and Big Sisters and also serves on the Board of Directors of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association. He frequently moderates debates between political candidates and leads forums discussing important civic issues. His dedication to his clients and his community have been honored through various awards and commendations. Rob's practice is dedicated exclusively to the representation of individuals.

attorneys.name: Michael W. Cramer
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Michael W. Cramer has practiced civil litigation since 1984. He has been lead counsel in a number of major personal injury, product liability, workers' compensation, LHWCA, real estate, commercial and construction cases, including all aspects of discovery and trial. He has conducted hundreds of depositions, specializing in the depositions of physicians. Mr. Cramer has represented individuals, small companies and large corporations on both sides of the docket. Mr. Cramer is AV rated by Martindale-Hubbell and is listed in Best's Recommended Insurance Attorneys and Adjusters. Mr. Cramer is a member of the Litigation Section and Construction Law Section of the State Bar of Texas and the Houston Bar Association. He is a past Vice President of the Katy Bar Association.

Representative Jury Trials:

Serious Injury - Secured defense verdict for trucking company involving the collision of a motorcycle and an eighteen-wheeler when the truck was ticketed for making an improper right turn. (Calcote)

Death - Represented defendant trucking company and its driver in auto-truck collision wrongful death case. In a "swearing match" as to which vehicle caused the accident, gained a defense verdict through the cross-examination of the Plaintiff's accident reconstruction expert. (Parkinson)

Serious Injury - Represented defendant in nightclub negligent security case where a patron was stabbed by six assailants, causing a ruptured spleen, a collapsed lung and multiple other injuries, resulting in a lengthy hospitalization: gained a defense verdict. (Reyes)

Commercial Litigation/Construction - Represented electrical subcontractor in breach of contract case against general contractor involving numerous affirmative defenses, including faulty electrical work: verdict for client, including all attorney's fees. Post-verdict litigation included the discovery of an out of state fraudulent transfer of funds and piercing the corporate veil, resulting in a substantial recovery for the client in unlikely circumstances. (Tri-City Electric Company)

attorneys.name: Jennifer A. Crawford
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Insurance Defense Lawyers in Tyler, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jennifer primarily practices in the areas of civil insurance defense and personal injury law. Prior to joining Boyd, Boyd & Giddens, she worked as in-house counsel for a well-known insurance company and a private law firm in Houston, Texas. Jennifer enjoys meeting with clients and helping provide guidance and peace of mind while going through unexpected legal situations.

Jennifer graduated from Thurgood Marshall School of Law at Texas Southern University and was licensed by the State Bar of Texas in 2016. While in law school, she served as Chief Justice for the Board of Advocates organizing in-house dispute-resolution, mock trial and moot court competitions along with hosting legal seminars, workshops and filed trips for law students. Jennifer was also a member of the Garland R. Walker American Inns of Court.

Jennifer was born and raised in the Houston area with a short stint in Bradenton/Sarasota, Florida while attending IMG Academies-David Leadbetter Golf Academy. Prior to attending law school, Jennifer earned a Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice from Texas State University while being a member of the Texas State Women's golf team.

In her leisure time, Jennifer enjoys playing golf, spending time with family and friends, and long walks with her dog, Jack. She is also a member at South Spring Baptist Church and loves serving in the preschool ministry.

attorneys.name: Diana Angelica Crawford
attorneys.practice_type: Auto Accidents Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
"It might not be the biggest case in the world, but to one person it’s the only case in the world." This statement is her true belief and approach to her clients' cases; each of her cases is of great importance to her and she works diligently to secure the best outcome possible for her clients.

From an early age, Diana knew she wanted to become a lawyer. She double majored, receiving her Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in Sociology and Political Science in 2009 from St. Mary's University in San Antonio, TX. During her undergraduate studies, she studied abroad in Cyprus, Greece, and Turkey working with diplomats. She enjoyed being active in the community volunteering with San Antonio Metropolitan Ministries. After completing her undergraduate studies, she took a leap of faith and moved to Milwaukee, WI to attend law school. In 2012, she received her law degree with a focus in Litigation from Marquette University. During law school she interned for a federal district judge in Laredo, TX and for local and state government offices in Madison and Milwaukee, WI. She became part of a pro bono society and the Hispanic Law Student Association, for which she served as both Secretary and President. After completing Law School, she was licensed in Wisconsin in 2012 and returned to Texas and began her career assisting people who have been injured. Diana was licensed to practice in Texas in 2013. She has assisted clients throughout the State of Texas and the US in various capacities including Social Security Disability, Special Education Advocacy, and Personal Injury. She has worked on cases of motor vehicle collision, premise liability, and dog bites advocating for just resolutions for her clients from prelitigation to trial.

In addition to being a lawyer, she enjoys welding, decorating, spending time with friends and family, traveling and outdoor activities like hiking and camping.

attorneys.name: Shawn Crawford
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Bedford (Fort Worth), TX
attorneys.bio:
Shawn Crawford was born and raised in Southern California, but like the saying goes; he got to Texas as soon as he could. Shawn began his professional career by serving for six years in the United States Marine Corps, which included two overseas deployments. While serving in the Marine Corps, Shawn trained in the field of aviation and later received a B.S. degree in Aeronautics. Shawn next went to work for American Airlines while he pursued his goal of becoming an attorney. Shawn Graduated from the Texas A&M School of Law with a Juris Doctor Degree.

As an attorney, Shawn began his practice focusing on Family Law, Criminal Defense, and Probate. Shawn Joined Livens & Reed, PLLC in 2017 and focuses on Estate Planning, Probate and Elder Law. Shawn helps our clients achieve their goals by planning and drafting estate plans ranging from a standard Last Will to complex Trusts. Additionally, Shawn helps families settle the estates of their loved ones through the probate process and administering Trusts. Shawn approaches each case with extraordinary work ethic, discipline, integrity, and professionalism. Shawn gives each client his personal attention from the initial consultation, until the case is completed.

Shawn has two children, one German Shephard and has been married for over 20 years to his loving wife Voula.

Outside of Work, Shawn enjoys Mountain biking, Cycling, and taking his son to the movies.

attorneys.name: David Criss
attorneys.practice_type: Health Law & Professional Representation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
David grew up in Burkburnett, Texas, and has maintained his small town values and work ethic in representing clients. After graduation from Burkburnett High School, David stayed close to home attending Midwestern State University in Wichita Falls. While a student at Midwestern, David found himself in the middle of organizing a successful campaign for Amarillo attorney Beau Boulter, who was elected to the United States Congress during David's junior year. After graduation, David went to work managing political matters and legislation for Congressman Boulter, the late State Senator Teel Bivins and Ambassador Kay Hutchison. Additionally, David was appointed as a member the Texas State Incentive and Productivity Commission.

At age 29, David decided it was time for a change and started to SMU Law School. While at SMU, David was invited to join the SMU Law Review Association, an invitation extended to the top 10% of students. David was also a member of the Board of Advocates where he began to build his litigation skills and graduated Cum Laude. David's career has been comprised of litigation, representing clients in contract issues and professional board representation, which remains true today and has grown to wills and estate planning.

David’s primary goal in practicing law is to become a trusted advisor to his clients. During his legal career, David has obtained numerous jury verdicts for his clients throughout courtrooms across Texas. Additionally, he has successfully lobbied on behalf of his clients, assisted many businesses with complex legal matters, and represented numerous clients before professional boards. David is regularly invited to present legal information to gatherings of legal and medical professionals and has published numerous articles on a variety of legal issues. David is a member in the Texas Bar Association, Dallas Bar Association, the American Health Lawyers Association, and the Texas and Dallas Bar’s Health Law Section.

David and his wife, Ronda will celebrate 36 years of marriage this year and could not be more proud of their two daughters. David and Ronda are involved in numerous non-profit and volunteer organizations providing opportunities in the Dallas community. David is also involved in his church and organizations. When not working or volunteering, David enjoys golfing, or relaxing with his family.

attorneys.name: Ian Croall
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ian helps claimants obtain the social security benefits they rightfully deserve and secures the money and medical treatment they need to move on from what can be the most difficult period of their lives. A zealous advocate for his clients, Ian believes in treating his clients with the utmost dignity and respect.

Originally from Boston, Massachusetts Ian graduated with a Bachelor of Science degree from Florida State University in 2002 and received his Juris Doctor from Southern Methodist University in 2005. While at SMU Ian participated in the mock trial team and in the civil litigation clinic.

As an attorney, Ian has worked tirelessly on behalf of clients for over a decade. Ian has successfully represented individuals at over 2,000 administrative hearings in all fifty states, including Puerto Rico. Ian thrives on the daily interactions with his clients and excels at formulating creative and unique applications of the law to maximize the return for his clients. Having planted roots in Texas, Ian lives in Richardson with his wife Cheryl and two kids.

attorneys.name: Dearl Croft
attorneys.practice_type: Oil, Gas, and Energy Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Dearl Croft is a Partner in Ball Morse Lowe’s Oil, Gas & Energy practice, leading the firm’s Houston-based team. With 30+ years of experience as an attorney, business leader, and entrepreneur, he focuses on title ownership, curative issues, and other legal and operational challenges specific to the oil and gas industry. His background in business management, capital funding, and strategic operations gives him a clear understanding of both the legal and commercial needs of his clients.

Dearl enjoys the complexity of his work and is driven by developing solutions that bring clarity and resolution to his clients. He combines technical knowledge with a strong focus on client service and measures his success by the outcomes he helps his clients achieve.

He was drawn to oil and gas law early in his career for its mix of detailed problem-solving and strategic business impact, and he has built his practice around delivering value in a constantly evolving industry.

Dearl earned his J.D. from South Texas College of Law and was admitted to the Texas Bar in 1996. He also holds an MBA from the University of Houston and a B.S. in Biology from Southwest Texas State University.

Dearl and his wife Lisa live in Houston with their two dogs. They have two adult children, both of whom hold law degrees. Outside of work, he enjoys traveling (20 countries and 32 states so far), cooking, and spending time with his family, enjoying a good bourbon, and adding to his collection of whiskey and sports memorabilia.

attorneys.practice_type: Appellate Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jesse maintains a diverse business trial and litigation practice in the state and federal courts of Texas. He primarily focuses on legal matters concerning business and commercial litigation, professional liability, personal injury, and appellate law. He has participated in trials involving breach of contract, breach of fiduciary duty, trade secrets, medical malpractice, conspiracy, fraud and handled multiple appeals.

Representative Matters

Successfully appealed final judgment of breach of fiduciary duty, misappropriation of trade secrets, and conspiracy claims resulting in the reversal of a $600,000 award of lost profits and the lifting of a permanent injunction against client. Certiorari denied by the Texas Supreme Court.

Obtained a final judgment as second chair for client in excess of $3,000,000 on client's breach of fiduciary duty claim.

Successfully appealed trial court's granting of summary judgment against client's claim for wrongful termination following the filing of worker's compensation claim, resulting in reversal and remand.

Successfully suspended enforcement of large final judgment against client by filing net-worth affidavits and directing multiple witnesses at hearing on creditor's motion to contest debtor's net-worth

Obtained final judgment for $217,636.57 through motion for summary judgment on client's breach of fiduciary duty claim.

Settled a Defense Base Act claim for a civilian injured in Iraq for $120,000.

attorneys.name: Carole Cross
attorneys.practice_type: Military Family Law Lawyers in Hurst, TX
attorneys.bio:
At The Law Office of Carole Cross located in Hurst, Texas, our law firm serves military families throughout Northern Texas, including Dallas and Fort Worth with a range of family law matters, such as divorce, child custody and child support. Serving in the military and having a family can be difficult enough and if your family is going through a transition and you are deployed on an overseas mission, you need an experienced attorney on your side who will protect your parental rights at every step.

Military family law has its own complexities and when dealing with family law issues across state lines or when relocating, you need a focused and effective attorney on your side. Our law firm provides a range of family law services, including REDUX, BAS or BAH, military relocation or reassignments, protecting your military retirement benefits and divorce. When you are focused on your mission, consider The Law Office of Carole Cross to focus on your needs at home.

Since 1996, we have been helping military families through divorce and division of marital assets, including military pensions, child custody and visitation issues and negotiating child and spousal support agreements. We offer free initial consultations, Spanish language services and accept credit card payments. Evening and weekend appointments can be arranged and we offer a sliding scale hourly rate depending on your rank in the military.

If you need experience on your side, contact the Hurst, Texas, Law Office of Carole Cross for all your family law needs.

attorneys.name: Darlina C. Crowder
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Plano, TX
attorneys.bio:
Darlina Crowder is president of The Crowder Law Firm, P.C. in Plano, Texas, practicing primarily in criminal defense since 2000. She received her J.D. in 1998 from Texas Wesleyan University School of Law, where she was chosen by classmates to speak at their Hooding Ceremony. She received a Bachelor of Science in Psychology, with a minor in General Science, from Texas Woman’s University in 1995. Admitted to the Texas bar in 1999 and Admitted to The United States Court of Appeals for The Fifth Circuit. Ms. Crowder has also been licensed to practice law in the U.S. District Court’s Northern and Eastern Districts of Texas since 1999. Over her career, she has received over 300 acquittals. In 2004, Ms. Crowder teamed up with Robert Udashen to represent Lisa Diaz in a case that drew national attention, as Ms. Diaz was charged with capital murder for drowning her two children. However, the Udashen-Crowder team was successful and Ms. Diaz was found not guilty by reason of insanity. Ms. Crowder’s experience now also includes service behind the bench. She was appointed in 2013 as an Associate Judge in Collin County Probate Court, presiding over mental health hearings.

Ms. Crowder has also received a number of honors. She was selected for Texas Monthly’s, “Super Lawyers Rising Stars” list in March 2005, March 2006 & March 2007 and for its “Texas Super Lawyers” list in October & September 2009. In June 2007 & 2008, Ms. Crowder was also the recipient of the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association’s Presidential Award. In 2021, she was named a Top 100 Trial Lawyer in Criminal Defense by The National Trial Lawyers. She has served on the Board of Directors for the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association (as Associate Director, 2007-2008) and for the Collin County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association (2000). sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Darlina Crowder is president of The Crowder Law Firm, P.C. in Plano, Texas, practicing primarily in criminal defense since 2000. She received a Bachelor of Science in Psychology, with a minor in General Science, from Texas Woman’s University in 1995. Admitted to the Texas bar in 1999 and Admitted to The United States Court of Appeals for The Fifth Circuit. Ms. Crowder has also been licensed to practice law in the U.S. District Court’s Northern and Eastern Districts of Texas since 1999. Over her career, she has received over 300 acquittals. attorneys.name: Fernando Cruz
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Trial Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Fernando R. Cruz is a first-generation American who was born and raised in San Antonio's Southside. He graduated from Burbank High School then completed undergraduate studies at Southern Methodist University in Dallas, Texas, where he was elected by the student body to the Student Senate as Hispanic Senator and received his B.A. in Political Science. In 1998, Fernando received a Juris Doctorate degree from Drake Law School in Des Moines, Iowa, where he served as President of the Hispanic Law Student Association. For seven years, Fernando honed his trial experience as a litigator specializing in insurance defense. He has tried numerous personal injury cases to verdict, primarily in Bexar, Nueces and Maverick counties. Since then, Fernando has represented individuals and families who have been injured or have lost loved ones due to the negligence of others. Fernando's commitment to community service and dedication to the law were inspired by Mexican parents who came to the United States in pursuit of happiness through hard and honest work and civic responsibility. Fernando practices in the area of personal injury trial. He is licensed by the State Bar of Texas and is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Western District of Texas.

His legal affiliations include the Texas Trial Lawyers Association, San Antonio Trial Lawyers Association, San Antonio Bar Association, and Mexican American Bar Association.

Fernando is a strong supporter of ACTS Missions of San Antonio and has an unwavering commitment to inspiring San Antonio's under-privileged youth to reach their full potential. Fernando is sought after as a motivational speaker and has spoken to hundreds of students at numerous schools throughout San Antonio.

attorneys.name: Baltasar D. Cruz
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Baltasar D. Cruz is a highly experienced litigator who has practiced law in Texas for 34 years. A graduate of Harvard College and the University of Pennsylvania Law School, Mr. Cruz combines an elite educational background with practical, first-chair trial experience. His career includes tenure at prestigious firms such as Susman Godfrey L.L.P. and Kern and Wooley L.L.P., as well as extensive experience running a successful solo practice.

Mr. Cruz’s practice is diverse, encompassing both plaintiff and defense work in commercial litigation through trials and appeals. Additionally, he frequently serves as a guardian ad litem for minors in personal injury cases.

Beyond his courtroom advocacy, Mr. Cruz has a strong history of civic engagement and commitment to the judiciary. He was a candidate for the Texas Supreme Court in 2008, where he received nearly 900,000 votes, and has stood for election for Judge of two District Courts and one County Court in Dallas County. He is also fully fluent in written and spoken Spanish, is an Eagle Scout and played football at Harvard for four years.

Practice Areas

Commercial Litigation: Breach of contract, fraud, DTPA, and residential/commercial construction disputes.

Personal Injury: Plaintiff and defense representation, including premises liability and products liability.

Insurance Law: Coverage litigation, examinations under oath (EUOs), and insurance subrogation.

Appellate Law: Handling appeals involving complex Constitutional and conflict of law issues.

Guardian Ad Litem: Representation of minors in personal injury settlements.

Candidate for Judge of 162nd District Court (2012)

Candidate for Judge of 134th District Court (2010)

Candidate for Texas Supreme Court (2008)

Candidate for Judge of Dallas County Court at Law No. 3 (2006)

Attorney Cruz is a caring, detail-oriented and experienced immigration attorney who uses her legal knowledge and passion for social justice to guide her clients through the complex U.S. immigration system. Attorney Cruz handles a wide range of nonimmigrant and immigrant cases before the United States Immigration and Naturalization Service ("USCIS") and the Department of State such as family-based petitions, adjustment of status, naturalizations, certificates of citizenship, waivers of inadmissibility, fiancé visas, Cuban adjustments, DACA, TPS and benefits for military family members. She also has extensive experience in cases involving victims of human trafficking and other violent crimes.

Background

He attended Antonian College Preparatory where he graduated with Honors and led his team to the State Final Four his senior year, and was chosen for the 5A District Team, 5A All-State Academic Team, and 5A All-State Second Team.

sections.title: Education
content: Jacob attended Trinity University in San Antonio to play Division III Men's basketball for another three years. Trinity won its Conference for two consecutive years. Jacob earned a B.S. in Business Administration and minor in Spanish in 2014. After graduating, Jacob moved to Washington, D.C. where he attended American University Washington College of Law for his first year of law school. In D.C., Jacob clerked for the Honorable Thomas J. Motley at the Superior Court for the District of Columbia and the Honorable Gary E. Bair at the Circuit Court of Montgomery County, Maryland.

Jacob returned to Houston to finish law school at the University of Houston Law Center in 2015. During his 2L summer, Jacob worked as a student attorney at Houston’s Lone Star Legal Aid where he defended indigent clients from eviction in Justice Court after the April 2016 flood. Jacob also represented indigent clients in the UH Civil Clinic where he served as a student amicus attorney to give an ultimate recommendation to the judge about the best interests of two children. Jacob received his J.D. and graduated in the top half of his class in 2017.

After law school and upon passage of the bar, Jacob joined a distinguished Plaintiff’s products liability law firm in Houston that specializes in tire and automobile defect cases around the nation. Jacob honed his skills in briefing and research on a large docket of complex product defect cases. Thereafter, Jacob joined another reputable personal injury law firm in Houston where he worked on several large products liability cases and oilfield injury cases.

In his spare time, Jacob enjoys staying active by lifting weights, boxing and running. He loves to spend time with his beautiful wife, Serena, and their identical twins, Crew and Rhodes. He also enjoys outdoor recreation including hiking and fishing.

attorneys.bio:
Background:

Glenn W. Cunningham is an experienced trial lawyer, with the legal expertise and the passion to help victims and their families secure justice in cases involving abuse, neglect or wrongful death.

Glenn W. Cunningham began his legal career in 1990 in the internationally renowned law firm of Fulbright & Jaworski, L.L.P. (now Norton, Rose, Fulbright, L.L.P.) in Houston, Texas. In 1994, Glenn became a named-principal in the firm Boston & Cunningham, P.C., before joining Mayor, Day, Caldwell & Keeton, L.L.P. (now Andrews Kurth, L.L.P.) in Houston, Texas to strengthen the firm's professional negligence section in 1997.

In 2001, the San Antonio, Texas law firm of Maloney & Maloney, P.C. brought Glenn to San Antonio to head the firm's "nursing home negligence" section. In 2004, Glenn formed the Law Offices of Glenn W. Cunningham, where his mission to make a difference continues.

Success:

Glenn W. Cunningham has distinguished himself as a trial lawyer. He has achieved verdicts and settlements totaling tens of millions of dollars; results that not only provide relief for victims and their families, but deter future unacceptable behavior.

Glenn W. Cunningham credits much of his success as a trial lawyer to the 10 years that he spent as a defense attorney. During the years that Glenn defended doctors and hospitals, he learned the ins-and-outs of the health care system, the tricks that doctors, hospitals and their lawyers use to defend meritorious claims, where hospitals hide documents and relevant records, and how healthcare professionals cover for each other. Glenn utilizes this "inside " knowledge to advantage when prosecuting healthcare professionals for their negligence.

Professional Recognition:

Glenn W. Cunningham was selected as one of the Top 50 Super Lawyers in Central and West Texas, named one of the Top 100 Trial Lawyers in Texas by The National Trial Lawyers, and ranked as a Top Medical Malpractice Lawyer in San Antonio by S.A. Scene. Glenn has an AV Preeminent Peer Review Rating through Martindale-Hubbell, the highest rating, and a Superb "10.0" rating from AVVO, also the highest rating.

Glenn W. Cunningham is on the Executive Committee of The National Trial Lawyers and Texas is a Past President of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association as well as the San Antonio Trial Lawyers Association. Glenn is honored to serve in leadership positions of such fine organizations -- organizations that fight daily to protect the rights of Texans to access the courthouse to secure justice.

Glenn W. Cunningham is recognized by colleagues as a scholar, in addition to being a talented trial lawyer. Beginning as a student at Baylor Law School, where he was the Managing Editor of the Baylor Law Review, and continuing to the present, Glenn has published papers and articles on relevant legal topics, and is a frequent lecturer at statewide conferences.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Background:

Glenn W. Cunningham is an experienced trial lawyer, with the legal expertise and the passion to help victims and their families secure justice in cases involving abuse, neglect or wrongful death.

Glenn W. Cunningham began his legal career in 1990 in the internationally renowned law firm of Fulbright & Jaworski, L.L.P. (now Norton, Rose, Fulbright, L.L.P.) in Houston, Texas. In 1994, Glenn became a named-principal in the firm Boston & Cunningham, P.C., before joining Mayor, Day, Caldwell & Keeton, L.L.P. (now Andrews Kurth, L.L.P.) in Houston, Texas to strengthen the firm's professional negligence section in 1997.

In 2001, the San Antonio, Texas law firm of Maloney & Maloney, P.C. brought Glenn to San Antonio to head the firm's "nursing home negligence" section. In 2004, Glenn formed the Law Offices of Glenn W. Cunningham, where his mission to make a difference continues.

Success:

Glenn W. Cunningham has distinguished himself as a trial lawyer. He has achieved verdicts and settlements totaling tens of millions of dollars; results that not only provide relief for victims and their families, but deter future unacceptable behavior.

Glenn W. Cunningham credits much of his success as a trial lawyer to the 10 years that he spent as a defense attorney. During the years that Glenn defended doctors and hospitals, he learned the ins-and-outs of the health care system, the tricks that doctors, hospitals and their lawyers use to defend meritorious claims, where hospitals hide documents and relevant records, and how healthcare professionals cover for each other. Glenn utilizes this "inside " knowledge to advantage when prosecuting healthcare professionals for their negligence.

Professional Recognition:

Glenn W. Cunningham was selected as one of the Top 50 Super Lawyers in Central and West Texas, named one of the Top 100 Trial Lawyers in Texas by The National Trial Lawyers, and ranked as a Top Medical Malpractice Lawyer in San Antonio by S.A. Scene. Glenn has an AV Preeminent Peer Review Rating through Martindale-Hubbell, the highest rating, and a Superb "10.0" rating from AVVO, also the highest rating.

Glenn W. Cunningham is on the Executive Committee of The National Trial Lawyers and Texas is a Past President of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association as well as the San Antonio Trial Lawyers Association. Glenn is honored to serve in leadership positions of such fine organizations -- organizations that fight daily to protect the rights of Texans to access the courthouse to secure justice.

Glenn W. Cunningham is recognized by colleagues as a scholar, in addition to being a talented trial lawyer. Beginning as a student at Baylor Law School, where he was the Managing Editor of the Baylor Law Review, and continuing to the present, Glenn has published papers and articles on relevant legal topics, and is a frequent lecturer at statewide conferences.

attorneys.name: Ross Cunningham
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ross Cunningham will go anywhere to try a case - even a FEMA trailer. It happened in the wake of Hurricane Katrina and didn't break his stride one bit.

As one of Cunningham Swaim's more seasoned trial lawyers, Ross believes that most companies are too risk-averse to take a case all the way to trial. But all too often, this mindset puts businesses at a disadvantage. They do not allow their lawyers to do what it takes to prepare a case for trial, which weakens their position when it's time to talk settlement.

Ross doesn't have that problem. He actually looks forward to trying cases. And, by being prepared to go to trial, he often finds that settlement discussions produce better outcomes.

attorneys.name: Ryan W. Curington
attorneys.firm_name: Bryant, Colletti, Kaplan, Kinsler, & De La Reza, LLP
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ryan, a native-born Texan, likes to think that he embodies what it means to be a true Texan.

After graduating from The University of Texas at Austin, he embarked on a journey of living in New York, New York. Ryan attended Hofstra Law School on Long Island and quickly realized that sweet tea, barbeque, and southern livin’ was more of his cup-of-tea.

He could have returned to Texas as a polished, proper New York gentleman. Instead, he returned ready to roll up his sleeves and fight. He facilitates the pull ‘em up by the bootstrap’s mentality but is nurturing to people when it comes to high-conflict emotional situations. Ryan prides himself on grit and determination along with his interpersonal connections with clients.

When he is not glued to his desk chair, he enjoys fishing, fly-fishing, and just about anything else relating to fishing. He is an avid shotgun shooter, drummer, fountain pen enthusiast, outdoorsman, explorer, and looks for any excuse to get off the beaten path and sleep under the stars.

Ryan firmly believes that there is always a light at the end of every tunnel; sometimes it may just be hard to see. He happily navigates clients through uncharted turbulent waters and loves every second of it.

attorneys.name: Michael Cupero
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Based at our headquarters in Austin, Michael focuses his practice on motor vehicle accidents, dog bites, premises liability, burn injuries, and many other personal injury matters. His favorite aspect of working at Williams Caputo, however, is the opportunity he gets to build relationships with his clients.

Michael graduated with a bachelor’s degree in English and Spanish from the University of Notre Dame. As an undergraduate, he also spent time studying at Fundación Ortega y Gasset in Toledo, Spain, an experience that has given him an enhanced understanding of diverse cultures and backgrounds, which he implements into his professional life every day.

He went on to earn his juris doctorate from the prestigious Baylor Law School, which is perennially ranked as one of the top law schools for trial advocacy in the nation by U.S. News & World Report. The recipient of the Dean’s Academic Excellence Scholarship, Michael distinguished himself in law school as a member of the Student Bar Association, and he was named to the Dean’s List multiple times. Moreover, he was awarded the Strasburger & Price, L.L.P. Moot Court Award and the Norton Rose Fulbright, L.L.P. Advocacy Award after winning Baylor Law’s Strasburger & Price Moot Court Competition.

Before joining our attorney team, Michael gained valuable trial experience at other well-regarded and well-respected personal injury law firms in Austin. Active in his professional community, he is a member of the American Association for Justice and the Texas Trial Lawyers Association. His experiences have pushed him to work tirelessly toward securing the best results possible for his clients.

Beyond the office, Michael enjoys staying active with soccer, experiencing Austin’s food scene with his wife, Samantha, and exploring the city’s best dog-walking spots with his golden retriever. His love for storytelling informs his legal practice, allowing him to craft persuasive narratives for his clients.

attorneys.name: Kelly Curran
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Kelly has been challenged his entire life. Born in Austin, his mother and sister moved to Washington DC when he was 7, until his mom passed of cancer while he was 14. She worked in the Pentagon and oversaw the statistical analysis of incoming members of all branches of the US military. Kelly spent those 7 years both running around the Pentagon as well as joining his mom as she went to visit Forts country-wide.

After her passing, Kelly lived with his grandma in Houston, and left to attend Baylor 4 years later. He studied business, earning a business-related degree. He took required class - Intro to Business Law - that changed the course of his life. In his fourth year at Baylor, he decided to aim his sights higher and began applying to law schools. Only one accepted him, but that's all it took!

Upon his licensure, Kelly worked at a firm actively trying that firm's most-difficult cases. He lost count, after the 40th trial, of cases he's brought before a jury. In 2013, Kelly suffered his first seizure, and soon after, his third child (there are 5 now) was born. These events led Kelly down a path he hadn't planned - one of firm ownership and as the leader of a quality team of professionals.

Kelly built a reputation strong enough to amass cases, clients, without ever having to advertise. KTC Law Firm may not begin a case, but is often called in to bring a close to one.

In his spare time, Kelly is chasing his kids around. Whether they're playing a sport, performing in a play, conducting beautiful music, or leaving a mess in their wake for him to clean up, he's never far from those he loves.

He handles general commercial litigation in federal and state courts from collection to complex lender liability matters.

attorneys.bio:
Laura Dale is Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Her practice is concentrated in the area of family law involving high conflict divorce, high net worth property division, both domestic and foreign, property valuation, custody cases, international child abduction brought under The Hague Convention and complex multi-jurisdictional family law disputes. Ms. Dale is a Fellow of the International Academy of Family Lawyers and a USA Delegate on the Board of Governors of the organization. She also serves as Co-Chair of the USA Chapter Hague Committee, and as Chair of Hague Subcommittee on the International Protection of Children. She is fluent in French and provides support services in Spanish.

Laura is a certified mediator, a certified collaborative law attorney, and a certified parenting coordinator under the Texas parenting coordinator statute. She received her J.D. from South Texas College of Law and is licensed by the Texas Supreme Court, and admitted to practice in the Supreme Court of the United States, the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals, the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals, the Texas Eastern District Court, the Texas Northern District Court, the Texas Southern District/Bankruptcy Court, the Texas Western Bankruptcy Court, and the Texas Western District Court.

attorneys.name: Paul Damico
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in The Woodlands, TX
attorneys.bio:
After leaving the District Attorney’s Office in 2006, Damico went into private practice where he used his experience as a prosecutor to defend citizens accused of wrongdoings. Damico routinely represents clients in Montgomery County. As a criminal defense attorney, Damico represents cases ranging from a simple traffic ticket to Capital Murder. The trial skills learned as a prosecutor are vigorously used to defend his current clients. His record has proven that “experience matters” when dealing with the law and your loved one.

Paul was raised nearby and graduated from Klein High School in 1993 before earning his Criminal Justice Degree from Texas State University in 1999. He gained valuable felony court experience working as a legal intern in the Bexar County District Attorney’s Office in the 399th District Court while pursuing law at St. Mary’s University School of Law in San Antonio. He earned his law degree in 2001 and was later admitted to the Texas bar in May 2002.

Damico worked for the Harris County District Attorney for four years as an Assistant District Attorney. Beginning as a misdemeanor prosecutor, he was lead prosecutor litigating jury trials, from cases of DWI to assault, theft, and possession of a controlled substance. Later promoted to a Family Violence prosecutor, Damico pursued a specialized caseload consisting of assault-family cases and violations of a protective order. He quickly ascended to the felony courts, where he oversaw prosecuting felony cases and tried varied criminal cases including aggravated assault, burglary of a habitation, felon in possession of a firearm, possession of a controlled substance with intent to deliver, and family violence. Damico was then promoted to the Misdemeanor Chief position where he ran a misdemeanor court while simultaneously supervising and training young prosecutors.

In 2010, Paul was appointed County Magistrate by the Montgomery County Board of Judges. As Magistrate, he was the presiding officer over the probable cause docket where he reviewed probable cause statements and set bonds on anyone arrested in Montgomery County. After the probable cause docket, he ran the Office of Indigent Defense and helped create the Office of Court Administration. Damico was soon promoted to Criminal Associate Judge in Montgomery County where he ran misdemeanor and felony dockets each afternoon in addition to presiding over the probable cause docket. While running criminal dockets, Associate Judge Damico’s duties included accepting or rejecting pleas, motions to suppress, motions to revoke/adjudicate probation, and conducting juvenile detention hearings.

attorneys.name: Brendan Matthew Daly
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Houston attorney Brendan Daly developed a personal stake in the field of personal injury law when his father passed away prematurely at the young age of 56 of leukemia -- a result of the exposure to benzene and other harmful chemicals he was exposed to while working in construction at various chemical plants across the country.

Daly's father was a union iron worker who believed strongly in workers' rights, and Brendan Daly is committed to carrying on this belief in his daily law practice as he fights for the rights of each one of his clients.

His legal career began at a prominent personal injury firm in Houston, Texas, where he worked on the asbestos, welding fume, and pharmaceutical dockets and served as part of the BP trial prep team.

He later went on to experience the legal process from the prosecution's perspective as an Assistant Criminal District Attorney with the Galveston County District Attorney's Office, handling misdemeanor criminal prosecutions including DWI, drug possession, assault charges, and felony motions to revoke probation.

A graduate of Touro Law Center in Huntington, New York, Daly received his undergraduate degree from the City University of New York (Staten Island) after attending the University of Louisiana (Lafayette) on a full baseball scholarship.

attorneys.name: Harold J. Danford
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Kerrville, TX
attorneys.bio:
Harold J. Danford is the lead attorney at Danford Law Firm in Kerrville, Texas. He has proudly represented clients charged with criminal offenses across the Texas Hill Country for almost three decades, particularly in the communities of Kerrville, Boerne, Fredericksburg, and Bandera. He has successfully handled thousands of cases, represented hundreds of clients at trial, and won numerous cases on appeal.

He began his career as a local prosecutor and rose to become the Director of the Texas Department of Public Safety’s DWI/ALR Program, where he oversaw dozens of lawyers across the state. Known as “The DWI Guy” to colleagues and clients alike, he is a leading attorney in this area of criminal law.

As a former prosecutor, Harold has vast experience fighting all kinds of criminal charges. He knows what it takes to build a case and what it takes to win. Over the course of his career, he has successfully defended clients in drug, theft, assault, and even murder cases, and his work has been featured in local and national media outlets. A trial lawyer first and foremost, he has also helped many clients recover significant awards for personal injuries.

The greater legal community regularly taps Harold's knowledge and experience and he has been called on to teach tactics and strategies to other lawyers at numerous seminars. He is a former board member of the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association and was honored with The Presidential Award in 2013.

He is rated “Superb” on Avvo, 10/10 by Justia, Lead Counsel by Thomson Reuters, and Distinguished* through Martindale-Hubbell. He previously served as Municipal Judge for Ingram, Texas, and currently presides as President of the Kerr County Bar Association.

Mr. Danford is an alumnus of Angelo State University and earned his Juris Doctor from St. Mary's University School of Law in 1992, the same year he was admitted to the State Bar of Texas.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.

Timothy attended Texas Wesleyan School of Law, now known as Texas A&M School of Law, in Fort Worth, TX where he earned his Juris Doctor in May of 2005. In his time at law school, he was a member of both the Moot Court Honors Society and Phi Delta Phi Legal Fraternity. He also had four law-related internships during this time. Prior to law school, Timothy completed his Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and Business Administration at the University of Texas at Arlington in August of 2000. During his undergraduate experience, he was in the top 6% of his class and a member of three honors societies.

Prior to joining the Austin, Texas divorce and family lawyers at Stange Law Firm, Timothy most recently served as an attorney for a busy family law firm focusing on high asset divorces in Austin. In this role, he managed several kinds of family law matters and strengthened his ability to settle high-conflict cases. Before this role, Timothy worked as an attorney for another family law firm based in Round Rock, TX that focused on contested divorces and custody battles. Earlier in his career, Timothy served as an attorney for two Texas-based general practice law firms, as well as his own consumer debt law practice in Santa Fe, NM, where he gained a solid foundation in legal practices. Throughout his experiences, Timothy has communicated compassionately with clients, and he is ready to assist you with your divorce or family law matter.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.name: Jacob W. Dannen
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Buda, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jacob is a family law attorney with Key Law Office. He has successfully represented numerous clients in family law matters, including divorce, child custody, child support, CPS Administrative Review, and other matters. Jacob is a graduate of the University of St. Thomas School of Law in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

Jacob is extremely passionate about family law, as it has touched his life in personal ways. He and his siblings were all adopted as babies. Jacob is active in the Bastrop County Bar Association and has completed a number of pro bono hours through Volunteer Legal Services. He was a Pro Bono Honoree for Volunteer Legal Services in 2021 (https://www.vlsoct.org/volunteer/volunteer-awards/pro-bono-service-honorees), and he has served as an amicus attorney, fighting for the best interests of children.

Prior to practicing law, Jacob served as the President of the Family Law Society at his law school in 2014. During his second year of law school, Jacob represented his very first client as a Student Attorney for the Elder Law Practice Group at his law school. As a Student Attorney, he successfully defended his client in an eviction action at trial. During his third year of law school, he gained even more court experience as a Student Attorney for the United States Department of Homeland Security Immigration and Customs Enforcement, representing the United States Government in Removal Proceedings. Jacob also worked as an Intern for the United States Department of State at the United States Embassy in Berlin, Germany.

In his free time, Jacob loves to travel, learn languages, and spend time with his wife. Jacob is fluent in German and is currently learning Spanish and Portuguese. He enjoys representing individuals from other countries and has represented individuals from all around the world.

attorneys.name: John W. Davidson
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
John W. Davidson is Co-Senior Chairman of the Board of Directors and a shareholder of the Firm. Mr. Davidson is a member of the Firm's Public Law and Litigation Sections. He served as the Assistant City Attorney for Dallas from 1959-1961 and the City Attorney for Abilene from 1961-1964. Mr. Davidson was admitted to the Texas bar in 1954, and is licensed to practice before the U.S. Court of Military Appeals, the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Southern and Western Districts of Texas. He is also admitted to practice before the U.S. Court of Claims, the U.S. Tax Court, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th and 11th Circuits and the U.S. Supreme Court. Mr. Davidson was educated at the University of Texas (BA, 1953; LL.B., 1954).

He is a member of the San Antonio, American and Federal Bar Associations, the State Bar of Texas, the Texas Association of Defense Counsel, the Texas City Attorneys Association, the Defense Research Institute, the Texas Public Power Association, the American Public Power Association, American Water Works Association, and the Texas Bar Foundation.

Mr. Davidson maintains an active practice in transactional matters, litigation and in administrative law. His transaction practice includes acquisitions and sales of public utility and cable systems, negotiations of contracts for electric, gas, water and wastewater production and transmission facilities; settlement of contract disputes, and drafting contracts, municipal charter and ordinance provisions, utility service regulations, and legislative bills.

Mr. Davidson's litigation experience includes representation of both plaintiffs and defendants in multi-party actions. He was lead counsel in recovering $28 million damages for the City of San Antonio in plastic water pipe litigation. He has also served as counsel in antitrust and 10b5 cases, and in cases for the enforcement of rules and regulations of public entities. He has represented defendants as lead counsel in litigation involving water and wastewater pollution, environmental hazards, damages for motor vehicle, aviation, property accidents, professional negligence cases, and construction and business disputes.

His administrative law practice includes practice before the Public Utility Commission of Texas, Texas Railroad Commission, Texas Commission on Environmental Quality and other miscellaneous agencies. Subject matters have included rate and service area issues, purchases and sales of utilities, rule making, and revocation of professional licenses.

Mr. Davidson has also been active in drafting and promoting passage of or defeating proposed legislation at the State Legislature.

attorneys.name: Evan Davis
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Denton, TX
attorneys.bio:
Born and raised in the Lone Star State, Evan has excelled academically, graduating as valedictorian of his high school. His prowess earned him a full-ride scholarship with the Honors College at Texas A&M University Commerce, where he graduated summa cum laude with a Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance. During his time there, Evan showcased his leadership as President of Beta Alpha Psi International Honor Organization, the Order of Omega Honor Society, and the Sigma Chi Fraternity. Evan’s education also took him around the globe, having enriching study experiences in Beijing, Madrid, Berlin, and Barcelona.

His academic achievements continued with a full-ride scholarship to Oklahoma City University School of Law as a Hatton Sumners Scholar, where he also served as Editor in Chief of the law review. He exhibited a commitment to justice then, helping start F.I.T.E. - Fighting for Innocence Through Exoneration - an organization dedicated to helping individuals wrongfully convicted of crimes.

After graduating in the top 10 of his law school, Evan's legal career began at the Denton County District Attorney's Office, where he made a significant impact as a Misdemeanor Court Chief, Juvenile Prosecutor, and a CPS attorney. After more than 4 years of experience as an Assistant District Attorney, Evan took the experience he gained and transitioned to private practice with Lloyd & Associates. Since then, he as celebrated significant legal career milestones as well personal milestones, one of which being him marrying his best friend since college, Brianna, in May of 2024.

attorneys.name: Leah Davis
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Amarillo, TX
attorneys.bio:
Leah moved to the Texas Panhandle in the summer of 2016 after marrying a local farmer. Having grown up on a farm in Southwest Kansas, moving to the Panhandle felt a lot like moving home – friendly people, wide-open spaces, and magnificent sunsets. Leah and her husband, Wade, have two young daughters. Prior to having children, Leah enjoyed travelling, cooking, reading, and spending time with family and friends. Now, most of her time outside of the office is dedicated to caring for the immediate needs of her family, but as they gain more independence, Leah hopes to return to some of her former pursuits.

Leah focuses her practice on estate planning, probate, special needs trusts, and business succession planning. She chose this practice area because she walked through the estate planning process with friends and family, which included establishing a special needs trust for her own brother. She understands the long-term emotional and financial concerns of families who are wrestling with how best to care for their most vulnerable members. Additionally, with her personal connections to farmers, Leah has real-life insight and experience with the challenges farming and ranching families face in the estate planning context.

attorneys.name: Neal Davis
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Neal Davis is a top-rated, expert criminal defense attorney located in Houston, Texas, who handles cases across the state and country. For over 20 years, he has defended clients in all types of matters, including arguing before the Texas Criminal Court of Appeals and appearing as counsel in the U.S. Supreme Court. His superior qualifications, client service, and record of success have consistently placed him among the top criminal defense lawyers in the United States.

Neal has dedicated his career to defending people in difficult situations. He works hard to keep his practice client-focused. His clients come from all walks of life and personal situations, and face all kinds of charges. He provides the same level of service and attention to every case, from the simplest to the most complex. He handles cases from investigation through appeal, and often is able to resolve matters favorably before charges are filed or the case goes to trial. Many of his clients have been absolved of wrongdoing and able to return to their lives. Because of Neal's excellent reputation, fellow attorneys often refer clients to him, and he is frequently hired to substitute for counsel.

Neal Davis is a native Houstonian. He graduated from the University of Texas School of Law in Austin, Texas and spent a decade working with legendary criminal lawyer Dick DeGuerin. Neal is married and has two young children. When he isn't spending time with his family or defending his clients, Neal lectures on criminal law. He has published numerous legal articles, and is often called on by the media for expert commentary.

attorneys.name: Robert S Davis
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Tyler, TX
attorneys.bio:
Robert S. Davis is a partner in Flowers Davis PLLC and oversees the Business and Commercial Litigation, Insurance Defense, Defense of Governmental Entities, Employment Law, and Medical Liability Sections of the firm.

Robert has extensive experience in representing governmental entities and government officials in all types of litigation. He also has extensive experience in first party and third party litigation for major insurance carriers, drafting coverage opinions for insurance carriers, and in medical malpractice litigation for private practitioners as well as county health authorities. Since co-founding Flowers Davis in 1994, Mr. Davis has tried 99 jury trials in state and federal court to verdict, and he has handled 159 appellate cases at the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit during that same period. Since he started keeping such records in 2008, Robert has filed 93 successful Motions for Summary Judgment and Motions to Dismiss for governmental entities and has won 20 successful bench trials during the same period.

Robert began his legal career as a Briefing Attorney to the Honorable Justice Sue LaGarde, 5th Judicial District Court of Appeals in Dallas, Texas from 1988 to 1989. Afterwards, he was appointed as Law Clerk to United States District Judge William M. Steger from 1989 to 1991.

During law school, Robert served as the assistant legislative liaison for Dallas District Attorney Henry Wade and his successor, Dallas District Attorney John Vance. While working for Mr. Wade, Robert wrote a paper on recidivism and the need for increased prison capacity that was published by the Texas Governor's Office, and excerpts of the paper were published by the major news media in Texas. Through the years, Robert has written many papers for and made numerous presentations to entities such as the State Bar of Texas, Texas Sheriff's Association, Texas Association of Counties, Texas Jail Association, the Jail Management Institute of Sam Houston State University, and Texas Chief Deputies' Association.

Awards and Honors

Honors

State Bar of Texas, Three-Time Recipient of the Pro Bono Award for helping indigent citizens

attorneys.firm_name: Matthews, Shiels, Knott, Eden, Davis & Beanland, L.L.P.
attorneys.practice_type: Governmental Defense Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Robert Jacob Davis was born in upstate New York and moved to Austin, Texas , in his childhood. He was admitted to the State Bar of Texas in 1989 and subsequently admitted to the U.S. District Courts for Northern, Eastern and Western Districts in Texas , The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, and the Supreme Court of the United States . Mr. Davis received a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 1986 and a Juris Doctor degree from Baylor University Law School in 1989. While in law school, Mr. Davis was a member of Phi Delta Phi honorary legal fraternity. Mr. Davis served as an Assistant City Attorney, City of Dallas, Texas during 1989-1994. He is a member of the Dallas Bar Association and the State Bar of Texas.

Reported Cases: Shade v. City of Dallas , 819 S.W.2d 578; Board of Adjustment of the City of Dallas v. Patel, 882 S.W.2d 87; Dallas County Appraisal District, et. al. v. Funds Recovery, Inc., 887 S.W. 2d 465; Denton v. Morgan, 136 F. 3d 1038 (5th Cir. 1998); Brewer v. Collin County, 254 F. 3d 1081 (5th Cir. 2001); West v. City of Crandall, 139 S.W. 3d 784; City of Corinth v. Gladys, 916 S.W. 2d 618; Thompson v. City of Corsicana Housing Authority, 57 S.W. 3d 547; Horton v. Denny's , 128 S.W. 3d 256.

Mr. Davis practices primarily in the area of litigation and governmental defense. During his years with the Dallas City Attorney's Office and now in private practice, Mr. Davis has gained substantial litigation experience in both Federal and State Court. Mr. Davis' jury trial experience in Federal Court includes acting as lead counsel and co-counsel in excessive force cases, co-counsel in a First Amendment/ Whistle-blowers case, co-counsel in a false arrest/illegal search case, and co-counsel in a wrongful termination case. Mr. Davis' jury trial experience in State Court includes acting as lead counsel in nuisance/ flooding cases, police automobile accident cases, premise defect cases, major automobile accident cases, and a products liability case, as well as co-counsel in wrongful death cases, one of which as featured on the television show "Court T.V." Mr. Davis also prosecuted approximately 35 jury trials in the Dallas Municipal Courts where he started as a criminal prosecutor with the City of Dallas . Mr. Davis is a name Partner in the Law Firm of MATTHEWS, STEIN SHIELS, PEARCE, KNOTT, EDEN & DAVIS , L.L.P.

attorneys.name: Hon. Richard W. B. Davis
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal, Family and Personal Injury Lawyers in Bryan, TX
attorneys.bio:
Rick Davis graduated from Texas A&M University where he received a Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering. While at Texas A&M University, he was a member of the Fight'n Texas Aggie Corps of Cadets and, upon graduation, was commissioned a Second Lieutenant in the United States Army. After becoming a qualified Infantry Officer, he served for ten years in the 49th Armored Division of the Texas Army National Guard as a qualified Armor Officer. He made Company Commander of an M-1 Tank Company while still a 1st Lieutenant.

After graduation, he worked as an engineer at NASA in Houston, first in the Space Shuttle Program, then in the Space Station Program. While working in the Space Station Program, he was awarded the prestigious McDonnell Douglas General Manager's Award for his work on STS-37, the first flight after the 1986 Challenger accident when astronauts successfully achieved extravehicular activities.

During his service in the Texas Army National Guard and while raising a family and working at NASA, Rick attended the University of Houston - Bates Law Center. He sat for the Bar exam early and while still in law school, and received both his law degree and law license in May 1992. Upon becoming licensed to practice law, he initially practiced law with a prominent Bryan law firm. He then started his own law practice in 1995, and quickly established himself as an aggressive, competent lawyer.

In 1998, he ran for and was elected Judge of Brazos County Court at Law No. 2. With the encouragement of several lawyers who appreciated his hard work on the Bench, he ran for and was elected Judge of the 272nd District Court in 2000, and was re-elected to that post in 2004. As a Judge, he was known as a positive judicial force with high energy and wise decisions. Rick Davis ranked highest among the District Judges in the 2006 Brazos County Bar Association poll, the last poll conducted before he left the Bench to return to private practice. He is widely known and respected for his integrity and fairness.

In 2007, Rick published his first book, The Prison Sermons, (which you can check out at http://www.zenaspublishinghouse.com/) and is working on his second.

Rick Davis is passionate about fairness and equal justice under the law. His record as a judge proves that he is a man of integrity. His record as a lawyer proves that he is tough and competent.

attorneys.practice_type: Oil and Gas Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Board Certified in Oil, Gas and Mineral Law

Raised in Midland, Texas, Michael grew up in the thick of the oil and gas business. Michael received a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the Engineering Department at Texas Tech University (May 2000) and received his Juris Doctorate from Texas Wesleyan University School of Law (now Texas A&M School of Law)(May 2009).

Michael has been involved with nearly all aspects of the oil and gas industry including preparing Oil and Gas Title Opinions including Drilling Opinions, Division Order Title Opinions, Leasehold Opinions, Acquisition Opinions, and other opinions related to oil and gas title matters, negotiating leases, seismic agreements, exploration agreements, drilling contracts, joint operating agreements, participation agreements, oil and gas purchase and sales contracts, natural gas transportation agreements, gas processing agreements, pooling and unitization agreements.

Michael dedicates a good majority of his practice to oil and gas, but he is very versed in nearly all commercial and business law affairs. Additionally, Michael handles dozens of business formations each year and acts as counsel for individuals in their estate planning needs.

Michael was named as a 40-Under-40 Honoree by the Fort Worth Business Press. Michael was selected as a 2018 Rising Star by Texas Super Lawyers (Thomson Reuters), and he was selected as a Top Attorney in Fort Worth, Texas Magazine for Oil and Gas in 2013 and 2015 through 2018. He is a member of the Midland and Tarrant County Bar Association and their Energy Sections. Michael is licensed to practice law in the States of Texas, Oklahoma, and New Mexico.

Michael is a former big brother in the Big Brothers Big Sisters of Texas and currently is a board member of the Midland Habitat for Humanity.

attorneys.name: Malachi Daws
attorneys.practice_type: Automobile Accidents Lawyers in Beaumont, TX
attorneys.bio:
Malachi Daws is Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Less than 2% of attorneys in Texas are Board Certified in injury law. To be designated a Specialist one must show a substantial commitment to personal injury law, try many contested cases, complete advanced education, receive recommendations from local attorneys and judges, and pass a difficult test. This designation shows his special competence in handling a wide variety of personal injury cases. Because of his specialization and experience, Malachi is able to quickly and effectively help those who have been injured by the negligence of others.

Originally from the Beaumont area, Malachi is familiar with the heritage of Southeast Texas. He is dedicated to providing the people of this community with personalized legal care and advocacy. Malachi has seen how the momentary actions of others can bring about consequences that forever change the lives of those injured and their families. Many times, these injuries leave behind more than physical scars, often causing mental anguish and emotional heartache. He is committed to helping his clients repair all aspects of their lives touched by personal tragedy.

Malachi has tried multiple cases resulting in multi-million dollar jury verdicts, including a verdict of $10.2 million dollars. His ability to personally relate to jurors has helped in his success. He has a proven ability of reducing complex issues into easy-to-understand concepts at trial. His personal appeal, trial innovation, and preparedness are hallmarks of his success.

He has also handled all types of family law cases throughout Southeast Texas. Matters of divorce, custody, support, adoption, enforcement, modification, and termination of rights are serious and sensitive matters. Family law matters are not cookie-cutter legal issues. They require an attorney capable of representing people who are in a range of circumstances, whether they are in agreement, hotly contested disagreement, and all ranges in-between. Malachi will customize his representation to fit the specific circumstances and needs of each individual client.

Malachi earned a BBA in Finance from Lamar University. He earned his law degree from Texas Tech School of Law where he graduated summa cum laude and was inducted into the Order of the Coif. During law school, he was honored with numerous academic awards and scholarships and was a member of TTU Law's National Mock Trial Team.

Malachi is the father of three wonderful daughters and lives in Beaumont with his wife, Andrea.

attorneys.name: David Deaderick
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
David was born in Odessa, Texas; graduated from Permian High School; is an honors graduate of the University of Texas at Austin (1972) and the University of Texas School of Law (1976); and has practiced law since 1976. David served as an Assistant Attorney General of Texas from November 1976 until September of 1979, when he joined the law firm then named Gibbins & Wash. David was a general partner in that firm doing primarily insurance defense litigation for several years before leaving to form Tulk & Deaderick, L.L.P. David was a partner in Tulk & Deaderick, L.L.P. for 15 years. After Richard Tulk retired in 2000, David became a partner in the litigation firm of Grove, Ehlinger & Deaderick, which after the retirement of Bob Grove, became Ehlinger & Deaderick until Ross Ehlinger's death in 2013. David then practiced as the Law Office of David Deaderick until joining Wright & Greenhill, P.C. in 2016.

David is licensed to practice in all state courts in Texas; the United States Supreme Court; the U.S. Courts of Appeals for the Fifth and Eleventh Circuits; and the U.S. District Courts for the Northern and Western Districts of Texas. He is a member of the State Bar of Texas, the Travis County Bar Association, and the Texas Association of Defense Counsel. David served for three years as a member of the State Bar of Texas Administration of the Rules of Evidence Committee.

David's practice is limited to litigation, primarily insurance defense or insurance-related trial work. Some of the insurance companies for which David has handled cases are the American International Group, Crum & Forster, Firemen's Fund, the Great American Insurance companies, Gulf Insurance Group, mercury Insurance Group, the Texas Farm Bureau Insurance Companies and Germania Insurance.

The types of litigation David has handled through the years include all forms of personal injury litigation, products liability litigation, professional liability (insurance agents, lawyers, doctors, hospitals, nurses, dentists, engineers, psychologists, social workers, and real estate agents), construction litigation, deceptive trade practices litigation, insurance litigation (including "bad faith" cases) and defamation cases. David has been selected to Texas Super Lawyers® magazine, an Internet Brands publication from 2019-2024.

attorneys.name: Gregory L. Deans
attorneys.practice_type: Business Disputes & Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Gregory L. Deans brings his clients over two decades of experience as a tenacious, creative trial attorney. His reputation and successes have earned the respect of his peers, as he has been recognized by ]Super Lawyers® (2013-2026), D Magazine, and others for his professional achievements.

Deans has tried cases for plaintiffs and defendants in courtrooms and arbitrations both in and out of Texas. For more than three decades, he has served as "national counsel" for a large corporation, overseeing its complex litigation docket across the entire United States. He has recovered millions of dollars for plaintiffs and has obtained defense verdicts when his clients faced the possibility of multi-million-dollar judgments.

Deans is routinely called upon to handle "bet the company cases" involving complex issues, largely due to his innate ability to pare down a complicated case so that a judge or jury can understand his clients' story. As a trial lawyer, he tackles cases of all kinds, but usually handles cases involving complex business disputes, construction defects, catastrophic personal injury, negligence, and product liability.

attorneys.name: J. Christopher Dean
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury -- Plaintiff Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Christopher is about helping people. In court with juries and out of court with settlements, all over our great nation. He knows his clients, who they are, where they have been and where they want to go, and their need for a helping hand. His clients get to know him, too.

Many people have wanted Christopher’s help when their husband was killed at work in a refinery explosion, when their family was destroyed by a reckless and overweight 18 wheeler, when a bad doctor (probably one they did not choose) hurt their daughter through medical malpractice, when insurance companies chose fraud instead of honoring claims, when the life of their small business was threatened by fraud and broken promises, and when their son was burned or maimed on a job site.

"Helping people in need seems to be a root in my family tree,” says Christopher. “My dad was a surgeon, my four older brothers are surgeons, and my sister is a physical therapist.” Being a trial lawyer and the youngest in a family of doctors can be tough, however. “You can imagine how popular I am at family picnics.”

Outside of his faith and family, Christopher’s passion is the fight that comes with the job. He has been blessed by many successes:

Fellow lawyers believe in Christopher’s ethics and skill by rating him AV, the highest ranking available. (AV Peer Review Rating)

The 212th Judicial District Court of Galveston County, Texas appointed Christopher as Liaison Counsel in the BP Texas City Explosion case;

Christopher has won jury verdicts for patients who were victims of medical malpractice;

His peers voted him Super Lawyer in 2005 and 2007;

Christopher has won jury verdicts for those killed or horribly injured by truck accidents and car wrecks;

He is an invited speaker to his colleagues’ continuing education programs; and

Christopher has reached hundreds of out-of-court settlements for his clients.

Christopher's professional pride stems from his experience to see his clients'case through. "I have fought all phases of the war: the pretrial, the trial, and the appeal."

attorneys.name: Anthony Dee
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Defense Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Anthony is a skilled commercial litigation defense attorney, licensed to practice in both Texas and California. He brings a strong business and entrepreneurial background to his legal practice and perspective that he refined while studying Business Administration at Rice University. This combination allows him to approach each case with a strategic mindset and a client-first focus. From complex disputes to everyday matters—whether involving construction sites, premises liability, insurance claims, negligence, employer liability, trucking, or automobile accidents—Anthony is committed to achieving the best possible outcome for his clients even while balancing business considerations.

Known for his sharp courtroom presence and presentation, Anthony thrives in litigation and has earned high praise for his legal acumen. During law school, he served as a judicial intern for both District Judge Richard Ogden and Federal Magistrate Judge Suzanne Mitchell, who commended him for his excellent work product and diligence while serving in their chambers.

Outside the courtroom, Anthony is a devoted father who treasures time with his son, Judah, whether that is splashing around at the pool, flying a drone together, or exploring a science museum. Anthony also enjoys serving in the community and is an active member of his church, hosts Bible studies, and volunteers in Sunday school.

attorneys.name: Joseph Deeb
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
With over 10 years of experience as a prosecutor, the criminal justice system is very familiar territory for Joseph. He’s handled felonies for the Travis County District Attorney‘s office, and misdemeanors for both the Travis County Attorney’s Office, and the City of Cedar Park as the city prosecutor.

He has handled many different felony offenses including Aggravated Assault, Intoxication Manslaughter, Intoxication Assault, Sexual Assault, various drug offenses, and gun possession charges. He has substantial jury trial experience trying many blood and breath DWI’s, as well as trying other offenses such as Indecent Exposure, Deadly Conduct, Assault, and Theft.

Originally from Tallahassee, Florida, Joseph has lived in Austin since 1994. When not advocating for his clients, Joseph enjoys spending time with his family and playing his guitar.
