attorneys.name: Sarah Naomi Garcia
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Sarah is a bankruptcy attorney at Weston Legal who specializes in chapter 7 and chapter 13 bankruptcies. Sarah is admitted to practice in Texas and files bankrupcies in all four bankruptcy districts in Texas.

Sarah graduated from South Texas College of Law Houston in the top five percent of her graduating class. Sarah made the Dean’s List every year she was enrolled and graduated 6th out of 193 graduates. She was awarded the CALI Award for receiving the highest grade in Business Bankruptcy. Sarah was also the Senior Note & Comment Editor on the South Texas Law Review Journal and while in law school interned for the Honorable Marcia A. Crone in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Texas.

Sarah has a bachelor’s and master’s degree in vocal performance. She received her bachelor’s degree from McNeese State University and her master’s degree from Brigham Young University. She has performed in leading roles such as (1) Marcellina in Mozart’s "Le nozze di Figaro" (sung in Italian), (2) the Duchess of Plaza-Toro in Gilbert & Sullivan’s "The Gondoliers", (3) Genovieffa in Puccini’s "Suor Angelica" (sung in Italian), and (4) Guinevere in the musical "Camelot". Sarah won first place in the classical vocal division of the National Association of Teachers of Singing (NATS) in Louisiana.

Bankruptcy has two major powers--(1) stop creditor harrassment including lawsuits, wage garnishment, phone calls, letters, etc. and (2) eliminate debt once and for all. Sarah will go the extra mile to ensure that her clients have the support they need to get a fresh start.

To find out more about the firm, please visit the firm's website and delve deeper into our services, history, and philosophy as legal advocates and counselors at law.

attorneys.name: Melissa Garcia
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Stafford, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Melissa Garcia-Martin has extensive experience in the areas of Commercial Litigation, Products Liability, Personal Injury, Insurance Defense, Employment Law, and Breach of Contract.

She has successfully represented numerous Fortune 500 companies in Texas and throughout the United States. Additionally, she represents small to medium-sized businesses in various litigation matters, including employment law, breach of contract, and commercial disputes.

Mrs. Garcia-Martin has been recognized in Marquis’ Who’s Who in American Law and was selected as a Fellow of the Texas Bar Foundation, an honor based on an attorney’s outstanding record in the legal profession as well as a commitment to support the community at large. In addition, she is a member of The College of The State Bar of Texas, an honorary society of lawyers who continue to exceed the State’s requirements for continuing legal education to become the best trained in the profession.

Prior to obtaining her law license, Ms. Garcia-Martin spent almost 10 years working for Harris County as a Court Clerk, Court Coordinator and Law Clerk for one of the Civil District Courts. This experience also afforded her the unique opportunity to observe numerous trials and participate in the decision-making process of countless motions and other proceedings held in a vast array of civil disputes. This unique experience continues to provide her with an advantage in all aspects of her daily law practice.

Ms. Garcia-Martin is licensed to practice in all Texas State Courts and the United States District Courts for the Southern and Northern Districts of Texas.

attorneys.name: Barbara J. Gardner
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Matters Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Gardner graduated first in her class from South Texas College of Law in 1981, and she has built a career as a leading employment law attorney. Ms. Gardner was a partner of Mandell & Wright in the 1980's and 1990's before moving to Kansas City where she was a member of the Popham Law Firm, a nationally known employment law firm. Ms. Gardner also taught trial advocacy to third-year law students at the University of Houston Law School 1991- 1994 before moving to Kansas City. Ms. Gardner rejoined Mandell & Wright in January 2004, and in July 2004 she was one of the founding principals of TUCKER, VAUGHAN, GARDNER & BARNES, P.C.

AREAS OF EXPERTISE:

Ms. Gardner is primarily a trial lawyer, having tried numerous cases to juries as well as judges in state and federal courts with outstanding success. When it comes to attention to detail, work ethic and a passion for diligently representing clients, Ms. Gardner has no equal. She represents both employees and employers in employment matters, and she also represents injured victims in personal injury claims. Ms. Gardner's work in employment disputes includes all types of discrimination, sexual harassment, fraud and misrepresentation, breach of contract, covenants not to compete, federal and state statutory claims, and other similar employment claims. She also represents corporations in commercial disputes. Ms. Gardner's unique experience of litigating cases from both sides of the courtroom gives her a broad perspective of problems and solutions.

Further, Ms. Gardner negotiates and drafts employment contracts, severance agreements, and incentive compensation arrangements for executives. Ms. Gardner is also an accomplished appellate lawyer and mediator. Additionally, Ms. Gardner provides consulting on employment issues for individuals and companies, in-house training, and speaking engagements for professional organizations. She is a frequent speaker for the Texas Bar Association's continuing legal education program.

attorneys.name: Gary Gardner
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Gary is a graduate of the United States Naval Academy (1982) and a former Navy Pilot. He is the managing partner of the newly-established New York office of Cunningham Swaim.

He has 25+ years of experience as a seasoned trial attorney with extensive experience managing, coordinating, prosecuting, and defending complex, multi-jurisdictional mass casualty and commercial claims all over the country. He specializes in aviation, transportation, product liability, maritime, and construction litigation. He has extensive experience with the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) investigation process and with the Aviation Disaster Family Assistance Act. He has advised countless clients, including air carriers and aircraft engine manufacturers, on how to prepare for and what to expect during NTSB investigations.

Gary is a fierce advocate for his clients. He has never settled a case that should be tried and has never tried a case that should have been settled. Indeed, Gary's reputation as a claims resolution expert is undisputed in insurance markets around the world. He is known for his knack for resolving difficult, high stakes claims efficiently and with excellent results.

Gary also has the unique experience of having managed a 20-member aviation claims team in North American for a major lead insurance carrier, responsible for claims resolution and litigation management of claims with the values in excess of hundreds of millions of dollars. Additionally, he simultaneously managed an 18-member Coverage Counsel team responsible for determining coverage positions in multiple lines of business including but not limited to Aviation, Marine, Financial Services, Professional Liability, Personal Lines, Liability, Exposure, Entertainment, and Property. Gary's experience allows him to seamlessly shift from managing a team engaged in "bet the company" litigation to settling a dispute that can and should be resolved by simply placing a phone call to find middle ground.

attorneys.name: Reilly Garrett
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Bryan, TX
attorneys.bio:
Reilly Garrett joins Shane Phelps Law with an exceptional history of service to both country and community. Prior to graduating from Sam Houston State University with a Bachelor of Science degree in criminal justice, Reilly enlisted in the United States Army as an Airborne Infantryman in 2005 and would go on to serve two combat deployments in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom. During his military service Reilly achieved the rank of Staff Sergeant and was awarded the Bronze Star among other numerous awards and medals.

FORMER LAW ENFORCEMENT

Upon leaving the Army in 2010, Reilly became a Police Officer and served the College Station community for more than seven years. During this time Reilly distinguished himself as a Patrol Officer, Field Training Officer, Intoxilyzer Operator, Detective, Special Investigator, and member of the Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) team.

While serving as a Detective with the College Station Police Department, Reilly recognized the importance of the service defense attorneys provide in our criminal justice system. With a goal of continuing service to his community, Reilly went on to receive his Doctorate of Jurisprudence degree from Texas A&M University School of Law, one of the fastest rising law schools in the country.

After passing the Texas bar exam Reilly began working at Shane Phelps Law, where his military and law enforcement experience have set him apart from other criminal defense attorneys. Reilly’s background provides the clients of Shane Phelps Law with a unique perspective and approach to defending against criminal allegations. In seeking the best outcome for his clients, Reilly approaches each case with an eye for detail – particularly when it comes to cases involving DWI, Search and Seizure, or other offenses involving complex investigations.

PERSONAL LIFE

When he is not zealously representing his clients, Reilly is a dedicated husband and father, as well as an avid golfer and fisherman. Reilly’s wife Danielle is a former dental hygienist who now works as a real estate agent for the Wendy Flynn Real Estate Team with Keller Williams Brazos Valley. Together, Reilly and Danielle have three young sons and enjoy spending their time in the outdoors.

sections.content:
Reilly Garrett joins Shane Phelps Law with an exceptional history of service to both country and community. Prior to graduating from Sam Houston State University with a Bachelor of Science degree in criminal justice, Reilly enlisted in the United States Army as an Airborne Infantryman in 2005 and would go on to serve two combat deployments in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom. During his military service Reilly achieved the rank of Staff Sergeant and was awarded the Bronze Star among other numerous awards and medals.

FORMER LAW ENFORCEMENT

Upon leaving the Army in 2010, Reilly became a Police Officer and served the College Station community for more than seven years. During this time Reilly distinguished himself as a Patrol Officer, Field Training Officer, Intoxilyzer Operator, Detective, Special Investigator, and member of the Special Weapons and Tactics (SWAT) team.

While serving as a Detective with the College Station Police Department, Reilly recognized the importance of the service defense attorneys provide in our criminal justice system. With a goal of continuing service to his community, Reilly went on to receive his Doctorate of Jurisprudence degree from Texas A&M University School of Law, one of the fastest rising law schools in the country.

After passing the Texas bar exam Reilly began working at Shane Phelps Law, where his military and law enforcement experience have set him apart from other criminal defense attorneys. Reilly’s background provides the clients of Shane Phelps Law with a unique perspective and approach to defending against criminal allegations. In seeking the best outcome for his clients, Reilly approaches each case with an eye for detail – particularly when it comes to cases involving DWI, Search and Seizure, or other offenses involving complex investigations.

PERSONAL LIFE

When he is not zealously representing his clients, Reilly is a dedicated husband and father, as well as an avid golfer and fisherman. Reilly’s wife Danielle is a former dental hygienist who now works as a real estate agent for the Wendy Flynn Real Estate Team with Keller Williams Brazos Valley. Together, Reilly and Danielle have three young sons and enjoy spending their time in the outdoors.

attorneys.name: Frank J. Garza
attorneys.practice_type: Public Law Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Frank Garza is a shareholder of the firm, Chair of the Firm's Practice Management Committee and a member of the Firm's Shareholder Compensation Committee. He is Head of the Public Law, Utility and Environmental Section. He was educated at Trinity University (BA, 1983) and Catholic University Law School in Washington, D.C. (JD 1986).

He is licensed to practice before the United States Supreme Court, Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, Western District of Texas, Northern District of Texas and has been licensed by the State Bar of Texas since 1987. He is a member of the International Municipal Lawyers Association, and has taught over ten Continuing Legal Education Courses in the areas of municipal law as well as employment law. Mr. Garza is an adjunct professor of Graduate studies classes at St. Mary's University entitled, "Ethics and Public Officials" and "Basics of Municipal Law".

Mr. Garza is a highly respected attorney who brings a wealth of experience especially in the areas of public law and employment law. He currently serves as City Attorney for the cities of Balcones Heights, Bulverde, Poteet, Sabinal, Terrell Hills and Karnes City. He serves as general counsel to various other governmental entities including Brooks Development Authority, City of San Antonio Civil Service Commission and City of San Antonio Police and Fire Civil Service Commission. He currently provides legal guidance to the cities of Tyler, Laredo, Leon Valley and Pearsall. As an Assistant City Attorney for the City of Dallas he provided legal representation to all city departments in the employee grievance and disciplinary process, as well as provided legal advice to all city departments in responding to claims and lawsuits involving labor and employment matters. During his tenure with the City of Dallas, Mr. Garza developed the sexual harassment policy, drug testing policy and related policies. He also provided training to City supervisors on the ADA, Sexual Harassment and FMLA and was lead counsel in over ten employment and civil rights jury trials. During this time, he argued on six occasions to the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals and twice to the State Court of Appeals, writing two Briefs in Opposition for Writ of Certiorari to the United States Supreme Court. He was responsible for briefing City Council on complicated employment matters.

In October of 1995, Mr. Garza joined the City Attorney's Office in San Antonio, Texas as First Assistant City Attorney. His primary responsibility was to assist the City Attorney in the overall management of the City Attorney's Office. He represented the City in litigation and legal proceedings and providing legal advice to the City Council, City Manager, department heads, boards and commissions and other City staff.

From April of 1997 to January 2002, Mr. Garza was named City Attorney to the City of San Antonio. As City Attorney, he managed the entire City's Legal Department, which included 125 employees, 54 being attorneys. He was directly responsible for advising the City Manager, City Council, staff members and other City officials concerning the legal duties relevant to their office. He prepared and administered the budget for the Legal Department, directly supervised six Division Chiefs in the management of the office, and was lead attorney on the city's most recent redistricting plan.

attorneys.name: Luis Garza
attorneys.practice_type: All Criminal- State and Federal Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Luis Garza was born and raised in the vibrant city of Brownsville, Texas. His upbringing in this border town inspired a deep passion for justice and zealous representation. Subsequently, Luis made his way to Houston, Texas, where he earned his Doctor of Jurisprudence Degree from the University of Houston Law Center. His legal education was further enriched by becoming a graduate of the esteemed Trial Lawyers College.

As a former police officer, Luis possesses intimate insight into the complexities of criminal justice. His unique perspective allows him to empathize with clients navigating the legal system and brings a wealth of experience to the legal arena.

Luis served as an Assistant Public Defender for three years, zealously advocating for the rights of the accused. Throughout his career, Luis has handled a diverse array of cases. From minor misdemeanors to high-stakes felony matters such as Aggravated Assault and Murders. Luis’ expertise extends beyond state boundaries. He has successfully represented clients in Federal Court, tackling complex issues such as human trafficking and drug offenses.

Luis Garza possesses fluency in both English and Spanish. His cultural background and diverse experiences influence his unique approach to client representation. His commitment to understanding each client’s individual needs ensures a personalized and effective legal strategy.

attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Dax Ian Garvin attended Austin College as an undergraduate from 1995-1997 and graduated from the University of Texas at Tyler in May, 1999 (B.S. with honors). He obtained his J.D. from Texas Tech School of Law in May, 2002. Dax distinguished himself in law school as a member of the Board of Barristers (recognizes those students who excelled in the art of oral and written advocacy through competitions).

After graduating from law school, Dax began his legal practice with the Travis County Attorney's Office and moved into County Court at Law No. 3 as a misdemeanor prosecutor within a short time. In this position, Dax prosecuted eight to ten jury trials in a seven month period.

Dax joined Wright & Greenhill, P.C. in October 2003 as a trial attorney. His trial practice is now concentrated on the civil side of the docket defending multiple types of claims. Dax is a member of the firm's insurance defense section and holds memberships with the Austin Young Lawyers Association, Texas Young Lawyers Association, Travis County Bar Association, and the Texas Association of Defense Counsel.

Dax was born in Tyler, Texas, in 1976, and reared in the Henderson area. He currently resides in Austin.

attorneys.name: Madeline Garza
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Madeline Garza is a strong and dedicated advocate for employee rights. With a strong academic foundation, she is well equipped to passionately represent her clients. Her ability to communicate and empathize with her clients is shown by her caring nature. Ms. Garza will always give her best efforts to a case to provide a client with the best outcome available.

Ms. Garza completed her undergraduate degree at the University of Houston, earning a Bachelor of Science in Political Science and minoring in Morals, Politics, and Law. After Hurricane Harvey made landfall in 2017, Madeline spent her freshman year helping neighbors rebuild their lives. This pushed her to focus on a community oriented career.

Ms. Garza went on to pursue her Juris Doctorate at South Texas College of Law Houston (STCL). At STCL, She continued to help her community and worked as a Student Attorney with the Randall O. Sorrels Legal Clinic to offer free legal services to underserved populations. During her time in law school, Ms. Garza also participated in many student organizations. Notably, she was one of the founding directors for the Lawtina Network chapter at STCL, focusing on empowering first-generation Latinas in the legal field. Ms. Garza also had the opportunity to work as a Langdell Scholar to provide guidance in mastering the framework of legal analysis regarding Constitutional law.

Awards and Honors

Honors

South Texas College of Law Houston, Dean Merit Scholarship

South Texas College of Law Houston, CALI Excellence Award in Federal Income Tax and State Constitutional Law Seminar

South Texas College of Law Houston, Cum Laude

attorneys.name: Veronica Garza
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of Veronica Garza, PLLC
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Law Lawyers in Arlington, TX
attorneys.bio:
Veronica Garza earned her Doctor of Jurisprudence from Texas Wesleyan School of Law. She did her undergraduate studies at Texas State University where she earned a Bachelor of Arts with a major in Political Science and a minor in Psychology. Ms. Garza, a US citizen born in Mexico, to a Mexican mother and an American father, has experienced first-hand the complexities of the US immigration system and is always able to relate to her clients' plight.

Her passion for immigration law started in her law school years, when she was awarded a coveted fellowship that allowed her to spend an intensive summer immersed in the practice of immigration law. After graduation, Ms. Garza was hired by a large local nonprofit organization to be their immigration attorney on staff. Ms. Garza spent over six years being an essential piece in the development and growth of the immigration department at that agency. Ms. Garza's passion and devotion to her work took the small immigration program to flourish into a robust immigration department.

Ms. Garza has taken her passion of immigration law to her own practice, The Law Offices of Veronica Garza, PLLC, where she focuses in all areas of immigration law including family and employment based, humanitarian relief, citizenship, and removal defense. Her work on Waivers of inadmissibility has taken her to national conferences to teach on the subject, and to have some samples of her work published as a guide for newer practitioners. Her thoroughness in preparing her court cases has earned her the appreciation and respect of the courts where she practices.

Ms. Garza is Board Certified in Immigration and Nationality Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. She is a member of the Texas State Bar and is admitted to practice before the United States Supreme Court. She is also a member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association, The San Antonio Bar Association, and the Tarrant County Bar Association, where she served as Chair of the International and Immigration Law Section for six years and Chair of the Diversity Committee for two years. She has provided countless presentations in all areas of immigration law and has been part of immigration panels and discussions for the general public as well as in legal and academic settings. Ms. Garza has a background in education and enjoyed teaching as an Adjunct Professor at Texas A&M School of Law for three years.

When Ms. Garza is not spending time at her Arlington and New Braunfels offices, she is volunteering her time with her son at community organizations like CASA of Tarrant County, the YMCA, Meals on Wheels, the Humane Society, and Tarrant Area Food Bank.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Larry Margolies Memorial Fellowship, 2008 - Present

Top Latino Lawyer 2022 by Latino Leaders Magazine

Top Attorney 2021 and 2022 by 360 West Magazine

Texas Super Lawyers Rising Star, 2022

attorneys.name: Anthony "Tony" Garza
attorneys.practice_type: Motor Vehicle Accidents Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Anthony "Tony" Garza-Vale, a San Antonio native, completed his early education at Central Catholic High School before earning his bachelor's degree in government and politics from the University of Maryland. After college, Tony returned to San Antonio to pursue a law degree at St. Mary's University School of Law.

During his second year at law school, Tony interned at a local San Antonio personal injury firm which led to his career specializing in representing individuals harmed by the negligence of others.

Since joining Gamez Law Firm, Tony has successfully achieved multiple seven figure settlements and verdicts. During his career, he has helped his clients obtain verdicts that have been recognized among the Top 100 Verdicts in Texas across all civil practice areas. attorneys.bio:
Miriam Garza-Lee is a proud Texan and first generation Mexican-American, which exposed her to the strife immigrant families face. She speaks English and Spanish fluently.

Mrs. Garza-Lee received a Bachelor of Arts in History from The University of Texas at Arlington. She graduated magna cum laude from Texas A&M University School of Law. Mrs. Garza-Lee lives in Duncanville with her husband and puppy. In her spare time, she enjoys diving into various arts and crafts projects, including painting and home décor.

attorneys.name: Kristen Gavigan
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Frisco, TX
attorneys.bio:
Kristen Gavigan is a Senior Trial Attorney at Barbieri Law Firm, where she focuses exclusively on criminal defense for individuals facing serious charges across North Texas, including Dallas County, Collin County, and the greater Dallas–Fort Worth area. She represents clients accused of felony and misdemeanor offenses, including drug crimes, assault and domestic violence charges, and complex sex offense allegations.

Ms. Gavigan’s commitment to criminal defense was shaped early in her legal career. While in law school, she worked with the Innocence Project of Texas, where she saw firsthand how wrongful convictions occur and the profound impact they have on individuals and families. That experience led her to devote her career to defending the accused and ensuring that every client receives a thorough and fair defense.

Before entering private practice, Ms. Gavigan gained valuable insight into the criminal justice system through internships with the Tarrant County and Dallas County District Attorney’s Offices. Her prosecutorial experience allows her to anticipate how the State builds cases and to identify weaknesses that can be challenged on behalf of the defense. She now applies that knowledge to developing strategic, evidence-focused defenses tailored to each client’s circumstances.

Clients often seek Ms. Gavigan’s counsel during some of the most stressful moments of their lives. She is known for taking the time to understand not only the facts of a case, but also the personal impact a criminal charge can have on a client’s future. She emphasizes open communication, careful preparation, and advocacy grounded in both the law and the individual details of each case.

Ms. Gavigan’s work in criminal defense has earned professional recognition, including selection to The National Trial Lawyers Top 40 Under 40, an honor awarded to attorneys demonstrating skill and dedication in criminal defense practice.

She earned her Juris Doctor from Texas Tech University School of Law in 2018, where she was a five-time national, regional, and state advocacy champion and was named Best Oral Advocate in Texas by the Texas Young Lawyers Association. She graduated summa cum laude from Texas A&M University, earning a Bachelor of Science degree in Agricultural Leadership and Development.

Ms. Gavigan is licensed to practice law in Texas and is an active member of the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, the Dallas Bar Association, the Collin County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, and the Dallas County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association.

attorneys.name: Andrew Gendi
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Andrew Gendi was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, but was raised in the Clear Lake area of Houston, Texas. He graduated from Clear Brook High School in 2013 where he played football and track, and received one of three Outstanding Students Awards for his class. He went on to attend Ouachita Baptist University (OBU) in Arkansas on football and academic scholarships. As a student at OBU, Andrew was a member of the President’s List, and Dean’s List. He was a charter member and Vice President of OBU’s Pre-Law Society, and was the Vice President of the Sigma Tau Delta English Honor Society. On the football field, Andrew started at Noseguard as a true freshman and started in over 40 games. He helped OBU make a run at the Division II National Playoffs, win a conference championship, and he received multiple Academic All-Conference awards for his efforts in the classroom.

After college, Andrew attended the Texas Tech School of Law in Lubbock, Texas where he quickly realized his passion for criminal defense and trial work. At Tech Law, Andrew was a member of the Dean’s List, he was a 1L Mock Trial quarter-finalist, an Advanced Moot Court semi-finalist, Vice President of the Criminal Law Association, and he was a student attorney in Texas Tech’s very selective Criminal Defense Clinic.

After graduating law school and passing the Bar, Andrew moved back home to Houston, Texas where he was an associate for Thiessen Law Firm, gaining experience valuable in defending DWI cases and misdemeanors. Andrew’s passion to grow and learn as a trial lawyer soon brought him to the Felony Trial Division of the Harris County Public Defender’s Office. In just over a year as a public defender, Andrew represented 72 clients from start to finish on over 100 felony charges, with 47% of his cases resulting in a dismissal.

Andrew understands that his clients are often going through the most difficult times of their lives. Andrew prides himself on his attention to detail and advocacy skills. He listens to his clients, communicates with them every step of the way, and fights to achieve the best possible outcome on every case.

attorneys.name: Ryan C. Gentry
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Commercial Disputes Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ryan joined the firm in 2010 and was promoted to Partner in 2015. Ryan is a trial lawyer focused on litigating complex disputes. His practice involves representing plaintiffs in medical malpractice, legal malpractice, and catastrophic injury cases, as well as handling litigation and non-litigation matters for businesses of all sizes and their owners. Ryan has represented developers, general contractors, sub-contractors, real estate holding entities, builders, physicians, hoteliers, technology companies, and two of the largest automobile dealerships in Central Texas.

Prior to the practice of law, Ryan worked for more than a decade representing a major health insurance carrier in its contract negotiations. He takes pride in his commitment to listening to his clients, gaining an understanding of their unique challenges, and then providing them with "real world" solutions to their problems. He has successfully recovered money for his clients who were wronged and successfully defended his clients who were wrongly accused.

For his undergraduate studies, Ryan attended McMurry University in Abilene, where he graduated second in his class. In pursuit of his law degree, he attended Baylor University and graduated with a Juris Doctorate, cum laude. While in law school, Ryan was a member of the Baylor Law Review and was Managing Editor of the school's online law journal. He also completed Baylor's rigorous Practice Court Program, sharing the top grade with one other student. In his free time, he enjoys cooking and, more importantly, eating.

attorneys.name: Sheba George
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denton, TX
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Sheba George is a member of Coker, Robb & Cannon, Family Lawyers and works in our Frisco office. In each of her cases, Sheba tailors her strengths to best aid her clients’ goals in navigating through the legal system. Sheba strives to provide individualized attention to each client’s needs, working towards an outcome that is satisfactory to her clients and their children.

Sheba has assisted individuals in resolving a wide range of complex family law issues including but not limited to property division, spousal support, child support, child custody, and conservatorship. Sheba represents clients in both contested and uncontested matters, whether that involves court intervention or resolving the matter through collaborative measures.

In addition to obtaining her licensure with the State Bar of Texas, Sheba is a certified mediator through the Frank R. Evans Conflict Resolution Center. This additional certification allows her to professionally mediate difficult and complex family law disputes in order to resolve a case outside of court.

Sheba takes pride in her roles as a dedicated wife and mother. In her free time, Sheba enjoys trying new cuisines, traveling abroad, and spending quality time with her family and friends.

While in law school, Sheba aided underrepresented populations through the school’s Advanced Family Law clinic, representing clients in cases involving contested property, custody agreements, and other complex issues. Prior to joining the team, Sheba gained experience assisting on cases involving child welfare in Midland, Fort Bend, and Denton County, as well as policy drafting within non-profit organizations such as Children At Risk, She worked under the Honorable Juli A Mathew for Fort Bend County Court at Law 3, observing cases involving probate, family, criminal, and juvenile court issues. Sheba is now a proud member of Coker, Robb & Cannon, Family Lawyers, where she supports, guides, and represents our clients in many different family law cases.

attorneys.name: Eric K. Gerard
attorneys.practice_type: Catastrophic Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Eric Gerard is a former federal prosecutor and accomplished trial lawyer fiercely committed to protecting our community and making big companies do right by the people they’ve harmed. He has recovered over $200 million for victims of negligence and fraud in the last 5 years alone.

Eric brings endless energy and a drive for excellence to everything he does. He graduated in the top 10% of his class from the prestigious University of Virginia School of Law, concurrently earning a master’s degree with highest honors from Johns Hopkins University’s top-ranked foreign policy program. When he took the Texas Bar Exam, he got the top score in the country.

He began his career in the Trial Division of the storied Manhattan District Attorney’s Office in New York City. Later, he served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney at the U.S. Department of Justice. His trials spanned a range of complex offenses, from international money laundering and wire fraud conspiracy to murder-for-hire, identity theft, and foreign child exploitation. He won them all. After leaving public service, Eric was named partner at one of Benchmark Litigation’s “10 Best Plaintiff Firms in the United States,” winning recoveries of $105 million, $40 million, and $16 million in courts across the country.

Since returning to Texas and joining Sorrels Law as its first partner, Eric has won millions more. He brings an aggressive prosecutor’s mindset and years of experience handling tough, complex cases from investigation through trial to the fight for injured victims. Recent victories include $5.88 million and $4.5 million in commercial vehicle crashes, $2.2 million in an invasion of privacy matter, and $2 million at trial in an electrocution case.

Eric has been recognized as a Texas Super Lawyer, one of “Houston’s Top Personal Injury Lawyers,” a member of the Texas Bar College, a Fellow of both the Texas Bar and Houston Bar Foundations, and a member of the Million Dollar and Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forums. He has also served as an instructor for the National Institute of Trial Advocacy; given talks to bar associations and other groups on topics ranging from trial techniques to investigating complex cases to working with trauma victims; and published peer-reviewed articles on presenting damages evidence at trial, the admissibility of neuroimaging evidence, and legal ethics. Outside of the law, he helped establish a boxing program for at-risk youth and actively supports charities serving families of fallen law enforcement officers and our nation’s veterans. He lives in Houston with his wife and two boys and is a member of St. Martin’s Episcopal Church.

At Sorrels Law, Eric fights for victims in catastrophic injury cases in Texas, Louisiana, and across the country. He welcomes the opportunity to partner with other like-minded lawyers committed to protecting our community and serving those who need it most.

attorneys.name: Ryan W. Gertz
attorneys.practice_type: Federal & State Criminal Defense Lawyers in Beaumont, TX
attorneys.bio:
When the government wants to take your freedom, only a serious lawyer can protect you. Ryan Gertz is the only lawyer in Southeast Texas that is Board Certified in Criminal Law, recognized as one of the Best Lawyers in America for Criminal Defense, a Texas Super Lawyer, and a Top 100 Trial Lawyer in Texas. In fact, less than two dozen lawyers in Texas were recognized this year as Best Lawyers in America for Criminal Defense and Ryan was one of them.

Clients describe Ryan as a “silky smooth criminal trial attorney, who knows how to handle prosecutors” and “brilliant attorney.” A capital murder client notes: “He told my family he would walk me out the front door of county jail and I'll never go to prison and that's exactly what he did.” A parent of a client writes: “I can never repay Ryan for his efforts, but I can give him the biggest thumbs up ever!”

Importantly, though, former judges agree. One endorses Ryan writing: “I have been a prosecutor against him, a defense attorney working with him, and a Judge that he was practicing in front of, and he never ceases to impress.” Another states: “As Judge, Ryan tried numerous DWI cases in my court. Ryan is perhaps the best trial lawyer I have seen in Beaumont.”

Ryan has tried more than 125 criminal jury trials and has obtained not guilty verdicts more than sixty times. This includes successful outcomes in six capital murder cases and numerous sex abuse cases. He has won dozens of DWI and intoxication related jury trials and had others thrown out for constitutional reasons. Ryan has the skills, experience, and know-how to defend even the most complex criminal cases.

attorneys.name: Jerry Gibson
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
I have been blessed to have a first chair trial practice for 46 years. In that time I have tried over 100 cases to verdict and I have settled countless cases. In recent years, most cases have settled as part of the mediation process. Generally, my cases tended to involve personal injury or property damage. Defamation and professional negligence claims formed a substantial subset to my case load. I think I have a unique perspective on litigation and the rightful role of mediation.

I remain a strong supporter of the right to a jury trial in civil cases. I also have come to believe that the mediation process is a necessary and salutary part of a litigation system. There is no dishonor in a compromise based upon a sober and realistic assessment of risk.

I think Abe Lincoln got it right: "Discourage litigation, Encourage your neighbors to compromise whenever you can. As a peacemaker, the lawyer has a superior opportunity of being a good man. There will be business enough."

attorneys.name: Ethan Gibson
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ethan Gibson was born and raised just outside of Kansas City, Missouri. The son of a trial lawyer, Ethan grew up in the back pews of the local courthouse watching his father try cases.

After high school, Ethan embarked on a career in computer technology. By the time he was 20, Ethan was maintaining a large mainframe network for the University of Missouri and later taught network integration to I.T. specialists for large corporations across the country. These professionals were often resistant to change, and Ethan learned to employ many of the same persuasion techniques that he had seen in the courtroom to win over his audience. attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Areyana Gilbert is a trial lawyer with the Houston office of Wiley Wheeler, P.C. She understands that one size does not fit all and that each client’s legal needs and goals are unique. Driven by her commitment to an equitable workplace, she approaches each issue strategically and ensures that her relationship with clients resembles a true partnership.

Ms. Gilbert represents employees with claims regarding Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Age Discrimination and Employment Act, the Family Medical Leave Act, and the Fair Labor Standards Act. Ms. Gilbert's forum of practice ranges from state court to federal court to administrative proceedings before the Texas Workforce Commission and the United States Equal Employment Opportunity Commission.

Ms. Gilbert's passion for law ignited during her undergraduate years at Texas State University where she pursued a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science. Here, she served on the Student Judicial Hearing Board and was a member of the San Marcos, TX chapter of the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People. She went on to earn her Juris Doctor from Tulane University Law School where her comment was selected for publication in The Sports Lawyers Journal, Vol. 29 (April 2022). Ms. Gilbert enjoys being on the water and nature walks when she is not practicing law.

Whether representing clients before an administrative agency or in the courtroom, she always aims to make a tangible difference.

attorneys.name: Jeff Gilbert
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Angleton, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jeff Gilbert is a trial attorney. His practice is focused on representation of individuals facing problems in family law and criminal defense. He also has an active general and family law mediation practice and serves as the Presiding Judge for the City of Angleton.

Jeff is AV® Preeminent™ Peer Review by Martindale-Hubbell*, demonstrating recognition by his peers that he has earned the highest rating available for his legal ability and professional ethics for over ten consecutive years. He has been recognized as a Texas Super Lawyer®, part of Thomson Reuters in family law for eight consecutive years 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024. Only 5% of the members of the Texas bar have attained the Super Lawyer designation which is based on peer review and independent research. He is admitted to practice before the courts of the State of Texas and the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas. He is also admitted to the bar of the United States Supreme Court.

A native of Brazoria County, Texas, Jeff Gilbert maintains his office in the same building where his father practiced law when Jeff was a child. A 1978 graduate of Angleton High School. Jeff attended Baylor University graduating in 1982 with a Bachelor of Business Administration and in 1984 with a Master of Business Administration. Jeff attended the South Texas College of Law in Houston, Texas receiving his Doctor of Jurisprudence in 1989. While in law school, Jeff tried and won his first criminal jury trial while an intern with the Harris County District Attorney's office.

Following law school, Jeff accepted a position in the Trial Bureau of the Harris County District Attorney's office in Houston, where he tried multiple jury and nonjury cases as a juvenile, misdemeanor, and felony prosecutor. Jeff eventually left the District Attorney's office to join a prestigious Houston-based civil litigation firm. Since that time, his practice has concentrated on litigation with firms in Houston, Brazoria County, and Dallas, Texas. In January 2006, Jeff opened Jeff Gilbert Law Office. He regularly represents individuals in Family and Criminal Court proceedings and often serves as an Amicus Attorney representing children in litigation between their parents. Jeff also handles Wills and Probate matters and is qualified in Guardianship Proceedings.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories — legal ability and general ethical standards.

attorneys.name: Meagan M. Gillette
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Litigation and Arbitration Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
From the beginning, Meagan's legal career has been guided by a passion for fairness, and a skill for organizing data and reducing complex legal problems to their essence. Meagan, a native Texan, graduated from Brown University in 2002, and earned her law degree from Tulane Law School in 2005. At Tulane, she served as the Senior Managing Editor of the Environmental Law Journal.

After law school, Meagan joined Cox Smith Matthews, the largest local firm in San Antonio, where she benefitted from big-firm training and resources to hone her litigation skills. In 2011, recognizing both her skill and enjoyment of research and writing, Meagan took advantage of a unique opportunity to serve as Law Clerk for United States Magistrate Judge Pamela Mathy. While with the Court, Meagan gained particular experience in federal practice and procedure, and complex disputes involving patent infringement, commercial contracts, and employment matters.

Today, with the firm, Meagan's practice focuses on representing property owners, developers, and contractors in construction disputes. She assists clients' in pursuing claims for delays, construction defects, design defects, manufacturing defects, and wrongful termination. Her clients include commercial developers in the multi-family and mixed-use markets and the hospitality industry, as well as public road and utility contractors.

Clients rely on Meagan to provide detailed analysis of their case, superior legal research and drafting, powerful advocacy, and guidance through the litigation process. Meagan regularly handles complex pleadings, case-dispositive motions, jury charges and questions, and post-trial briefing. In her practice, Meagan also routinely consults with engineers and design professionals throughout the litigation process, from the initial stages of preparation of Certificates of Merit through trial preparation.

Meagan also advises and assists individuals and business clients with contract disputes, consumer protection claims, disputes with insurance companies, negligence claims, breach of fiduciary duty claims, and employment termination and discrimination claims. Meagan represents clients in state and federal court, as well as arbitration.

Meagan was admitted to the State Bar of Texas in 2005, and is licensed to practice in the State Courts of Texas, the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, the Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals, and all United States District Courts in Texas.

attorneys.name: Matthew Gilpin
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Matthew Gilpin is an Of Counsel attorney at the McCathern law firm whose practice primarily focuses on probate matters, estate administrations, and inheritance issues.

Matthew's probate experience involves managing all aspects of cases - legal and administrative - from start to finish. This includes helping his clients find the most efficient and cost-effective solutions to settling estate matters. Additionally, Matthew advises clients regarding estate planning and asset protection and he drafts trusts, wills, directives, releases, and other estate planning documents.

Matthew firmly believes that to create the most effective estate plan, it must be tailored to fit the individual's unique goals and circumstances. This is precisely where his deep experience building strong, lasting relationships with his estate plan clients becomes so valuable.

Throughout his career, Matthew has developed an extensive understanding of probate and estate concerns. By never treating his probate and estate clients as just another case number and always maintaining open and timely communications, he has built strong relationships with his clients and embodies McCathern's motto of Improving People's Lives. Customer satisfaction is Matthew's ultimate goal.

Matthew is a board member for the City of Keller's Zoning Board of Adjustment, which considers appeals and adjustments to the City of Keller's zoning ordinances, and he enjoys volunteering in city government as well as other civic groups and organizations.

Before he practiced law, Matthew attended the Texas Wesleyan University School of Law (now known as Texas A&M University School of Law), where he obtained his law degree in 2010. During law school, Matthew was an active member on the Board of Trial Advocates, Moot Court Honor Society, Mock Trial competition teams, and the Phi Delta Phi legal fraternity. Upon graduating, Matthew was inducted into the Order of Barristers for outstanding accomplishments in oral advocacy. Previously, he attended Texas State University where he graduated cum laude with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree in 2003.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Katelin attended Utah State University, where she studied history and political science with the goal of pursuing a law degree. She used her political science minor to focus on constitutional application and legal theory, which solidified her decision to dedicate her career to the law.

Katelin attended Drake University Law School as a first-generation law student, gradating summa cum laude. She was extremely passionate about advocating for others throughout law school. Notably, Katelin served as the president of Drake Law Women, helping grow the organization’s philanthropic endeavors and outreach into the wider community to help fellow law students when unexpected expenses arose. Katelin was also a Junior Editor on the Drake Journal of Agricultural Law and served on the Drake Journal of Agricultural Law Editorial Board as the Projects Editor.

During law school, Katelin focused her studies on litigation and how to vigorously advocate for clients. She honed her litigation skills through various clinics where she represented clients charged with misdemeanors. Katelin clerked for a civil litigation law firm and participated in multiple jury trials, getting favorable verdicts for her clients.

attorneys.name: Leslie Giron Kirby
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Leslie founded the Giron Kirby Law Group with the goal of providing personalized, effective, and efficient representation to businesses and individuals in relation to their immigration needs. She has dedicated her career to the practice of immigration law and is committed to providing her clients with the highest quality representation available.

Prior to starting her own firm, Leslie was an attorney at one of the nation's largest immigration law firms, where she represented businesses and individuals in all types of immigration matters. Her expertise in and dedication to the practice of immigration law is informed not only by her prior employment, but also by her life experiences dealing with the immigration system on a personal level.

Leslie was born in Guatemala City, Guatemala. She immigrated to the United States when she was young and has since become a United States citizen. Having gone through the immigration and naturalization process herself, Leslie is aware of how difficult the procedure can be and how challenging it is to wait for a determination to be made. However, she is also cognizant of how wonderful it feels to be awarded legal status and citizenship. Leslie relies on these experiences to guide her clients through the process with compassion and endeavors to bring her clients the same wonderful feeling she experienced by successfully resolving their immigration issues.

In her spare time, Leslie enjoys spending time with her amazing husband, son, and daughter. She is also active in her local church.

attorneys.name: Dan Gividen
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Law Lawyers in Allen, TX
attorneys.bio:
For over a decade, attorney Dan Gividen has been lauded by the legal community throughout Texas for his tenacity and unparalleled understanding of criminal law and immigration proceedings, and how they apply to the complexities of crimmigration. His career began as law clerk to the Honorable Jorge Solis, United States District Judge for the Northern District of Texas. Following his clerkship, attorney Gividen authored several briefs supporting post-conviction relief for a well-known criminal defense firm. He was then appointed Assistant Chief Counsel for the Office of Chief Counsel, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in 2011. In 2014, he was detailed as a Special Assistant United States Attorney in the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Northern District of Texas. In this role, he served as the lead prosecutor on nearly 200 cases and he first and second chaired multiple jury trials. Between Spring 2016 and the Spring of 2021, attorney Gividen used his experience as a lawyer to empower and educate students as an adjunct professor at UNT Dallas College of Law, teaching immigration law.

Today, attorney Gividen represents a wide variety of clients in criminal and immigration cases at his firm, Gividen Law, PLLC. Few attorneys in the Dallas Fort Worth area contain both the same level of knowledge and the comprehension of complex crimmigration issues as Dan Gividen. He has authored hundreds of briefs on appeal before the Board of Immigration Appeals and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit. He is also the only attorney in recent history to secure pretrial release for a client charged with illegal entry (8 U.S.C. § 1326) in the Northern District of Texas who had no legal status in the United States.

Attorney Gividen is Board Certified in Immigration and Nationality Law. He has spent his career tirelessly pursuing justice. He is recognized among his peers for his strength of character, comprehensive legal knowledge and his persistence on behalf of his clients.

attorneys.name: Greg Gladden
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal law - state and federal Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Greg Gladden Attorney at Law is a board certified criminal defense lawyer who has represented over 2,500 clients in federal and state criminal trials across 14 different states. His law firm represents clients charged with a crime throughout the Houston metropolitan area and across Texas. Mr. Gladden has over 35 years of criminal defense experience and works to get every client the best possible outcome for his or her case. He has received many recognitions over his long career, including the American Jurisprudence Excellency in Constitutional Law and Evidence Award and the Patrick Wiseman Award from the State Bar of Texas. Mr. Gladden has an extensive knowledge of federal civil forfeitures and has taught educational seminars on sponsored by national, state and local criminal law organizations.

Mr. Gladden is a tenacious and determined criminal defense lawyer who can defend clients charged with:

DWIs, particularly those who have had multiple cases

Drug violations for use and distribution

Domestic violence and neglect

Sex offenses

Murder, assault and other violent crimes

Greg Gladden Attorney at Law has defended many high-profile clients and worked to get them favorable outcomes. He won a life sentence for Roger Leroy “Animal” Degarmo who threatened to kill the jurors and their families if they did not sentence him to death. Mr. Gladden has a 97 percent not guilty verdict rate for DWI jury trials and has never lost a client to the executioners.

Many people consider Mr. Gladden both a seasoned criminal defense attorney and a practiced civil rights lawyer. He fights to protect his client’s civil rights in the course of a criminal case and has a thorough knowledge of state and federal law. For seven years he was the president of the ACLU of Texas and is a current member.

Mr. Gladden can practice the law in:

The State Courts of Texas and Tennessee (inactive)

The United States District Courts of Texas, Tennessee and Arizona

The 5th and 11th U.S. Circuit Courts of Appeals

The Supreme Court of the United States

Mr. Gladden prefers talking in person with his clients in a free consultation. In the first meeting, he reviews his clients’ cases and answers their questions. His Houston office is in the shadow of downtown and has Spanish translation services available for clients. Hablamos Español.

attorneys.name: Troy Glander
attorneys.practice_type: Exposure Property/Facilities Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Troy Glander was born in 1970. He has lived in San Antonio, Texas since moving here to attend law school in 1993. During his 20 year career as a trial attorney, his cases have included a wide variety of areas such as insurance defense, employment law, construction law, deceptive trade practices, shareholder disputes, business torts, trade secret, personal injury, patent disputes, and both simple and complex contract disputes.

Mr. Glander started with the law firm of Davis, Cedillo & Mendoza, Inc in San Antonio, Texas after graduating from St. Mary's University School of Law, and became a Shareholder in 2004. He, along with Alex Nava, left Davis, Cedillo & Mendoza, Inc. at the end of 2011 to create ANG (now doing business as A Nava & Glander Law Firm) and open their doors to the public January 1, 2012.

Over the course of his career, he has handled cases throughout the United States. He has played a significant role in numerous lawsuits involving any where from $100,000 to over $1 Billion and has had significant first and second chair trial experience with over a dozen first-chair cases tried to a judgement. His practice now focuses on aggressively pursuing large exposure property/facilities and personal injury claims for companies (including a leading fortune 500 company) and individuals.

Mr. Glander received a B.B.A, from the University of Texas at Austin in 1992, majoring in Finance. He is admitted to practice in the state of Texas and is admitted in the Western, Southern, and Northern U.S. Federal District Courts of Texas. Mr. Glander is a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum, Texas Bar Foundation (Fellow), State Bar of Texas, San Antonio Bar Associations, and the Texas Association of Defense Counsel. From 2007 through 2011 he served as a Director of the Texas Association of Defense Counsel and during that time held positions as Area Director and Regional Vice President.

He was recognized by Texas Monthly as a "Rising Star" in the legal profession in 2006 and starting in 2012 and every year since then he has been recognized as a "Top Lawyer" in the S A Scene, a "Top Attorney in Texas" by Texas Monhtly, and "Super Lawyer" by Texas monthly (a recognition earned by less than 2.5% of lawyers).

He also has been honored by his clients including his receipt of the "Peacemaker" award by Brown & Brown in 2006 and 2008 and the "In the Trenches" award by AT&T in 2014.

Outside of the law profession, Mr. Glander helped start up Third Coast Bank, SSB (a state savings bank based out of Humble, Texas) in 2008 and he has been a Director of that organization since then. He has helped to guide the bank to grow approximately $15 M in start-up capital into over $750M in assets and offices in Humble, Houston, Beaumont, Port Arthur, Dallas, Plano, and Ft. Worth. Since the bank's inception, he has served as the Chair of the Compensation Committee and he now also serves as Chair of the Audit Committee.

Mr. Glander has also been actively involved in the Texas Exes (the ex-Student's Association of the University of Texas) where he served as a Director of the organization and Chair of the Chapter Advisory Board from 2007 through 2009. Moreover, from 2001 through 2006 he served in various capacities (including, ultimately, President) for the San Antonio Chapter of the organization. He has served as a Director of the San Antonio Longhorn Foundation from 2001 to the present and served as the President of that organization in 2008. In his free time Mr. Glander enjoys spending time with his wife and their two children.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Gold was admitted to the Texas Bar in 1977. He is a trial attorney and is Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law, is a member of the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Civil Trial Advocate, and National Board of Trial Advocacy.

Mr. Gold has previously practiced with or been a partner with the following firms: The Law Offices of Frank Branson, P.C.; Friedman McKernan & Gold; Morgan and Weisbrod; Houssiere, Durant, Houssiere & Gold; and Perry and Haas.

Mr. Gold has extensive trial experience representing Plaintiffs in virtually all areas of Personal Injury law and has done so with tremendous success. He brings with him an aggressive attitude, a proactive approach, and a strong work ethic in order to achieve our collective goal of providing the best representation possible for our injury clients.

Mr. Gold is a current Director of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association, Director of the Houston Trial Lawyers Association, and is a member of the Continuing Legal Education Committee, as well as the Litigation Section for the State Bar of Texas. He is a former President of the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association and former Chairman of the State Bar of Texas Litigation Section.

Mr. Gold is a recognized authority on Discovery in Texas, and he has written and taught on the subject extensively. He served on the Supreme Court Advisory Subcommittee on Discovery Reform with respect to the 1999 amendments to the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.

Mr. Gold has a state-wide practice and travels between our Houston and Bedford offices.

attorneys.name: Cassandra Golder
attorneys.practice_type: Admiralty & Maritime Law Lawyers in Killeen, TX
attorneys.bio:
Cassandra Golder is a Killeen-based family law attorney dedicated to helping families move through the family law court system with ease. She joined The Carlson Law Firm in April 2017.

Experience on your side

A seventh-generation Texan, Cassandra was born and raised in Bell County. She set her sights on becoming an attorney when she was a child. Cassandra takes pride in helping families going through difficult times navigate the complexities of family law. She represents families in Bell County, Coryell County, and Lampasas County. She is a graduate of Texas Tech University Law School (2015) and earned her B.S. in Liberal Studies from Texas A&M University-Central Texas in 2010. Cassandra was admitted to the Texas State Bar in November 2015. She is a member of the State Bar of Texas, Texas Bar College, Bell County Bar Association, and is a member and has held numerous leadership positions with Bell County Young Lawyers Association.

Cassandra takes immense pride in finding creative and workable solutions to family issues for each of her clients. She knows how important family is to her clients and she believes that practicing family law is the best way for her to serve the community she adores. Cassandra takes her time to know the details and facts of her cases. She works hard to help her clients understand the entire legal process and empowers them to make decisions. Additionally, she values and includes her clients' input when building case strategies. She is always available to answer questions and explain the how's and why's so that her clients never feel in the dark about their cases. Cassandra considers all sides of an argument to deliver the best possible legal representation for her clients. In addition to helping families transition through divorce and custody arrangements, Cassandra helps families expand by assisting with adoption, gestational agreements, and other means of assisted reproduction.

Her commitment to practicing law comes from her desire to serve her community and help others. In her free time, she enjoys spending time with her husband, son, and 100-pound lap dog. Her hobbies also include DIY projects, lifting weights, and hiking.

attorneys.name: Robert E. Golden
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Litigation Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
I was born January 20, 1952 in San Antonio, Texas and attended the University of Texas at Austin, obtaining a Bachelor of Business Administration degree with highest honors in December 1973. I then attended law school in Austin and graduated with a Juris Doctor degree with honors in 1977.

After law school, I moved to El Paso, Texas, where I was a partner in a small firm and had a trial practice consisting of criminal law, personal injury, consumer law, and domestic relations. The Texas Board of Legal Specialization in the area of Family Law certified me in 1983. In 1984, I moved back to San Antonio and joined the firm of Davis and Smith, which later became Smith, Barshop, Stoffer & Millsap, a twenty-five-person firm, where I was head of the Litigation Section. Since 1984, my practice has been concentrated in the area of civil litigation, primarily in general business litigation.

I obtained certification by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in the area of Civil Trial Law in 1989 and have maintained that certification since then.

In June 1991, I opened my solo practice, again concentrating in the area of civil litigation, which has continued to the present. My practice continues to mainly involve general business litigation, although I do other general civil litigation matters, as well as some general representation of business clients. I have also been extensively involved in contested litigation in the probate court, both representing guardians and trustees and attacking them. One significant case in which I was involved was a suit in which my clients, as beneficiaries of a large family trust, were suing the trustee, who was their brother, for breach of fiduciary duty. This case resulted in a judgment against the brother for approximately $9 million, and collection efforts in several states are still ongoing. Additionally, in 1998, I conducted a trial of a legal malpractice case in which I represented the executrix of an estate against her former attorney for negligence and breach of fiduciary duty, which we claimed resulted in the unnecessary payment of a large amount of death-related taxes and excessive attorney’s fees. We were successful in recovering a judgment against the attorney for reimbursement to the estate.

After having participated in several mediations as a litigant in various civil matters, I took mediator training in March 1994, and subsequently completed all requirements to be a qualified mediator by the Attorney-Mediator Institute. I continue to actively practice law, representing civil litigants generally, but I also conduct mediations and arbitrations in most civil matters, as well as contested probate, estate, and trust matters.

I am admitted to practice before the courts of Texas, the United States District Courts for the Western, Southern, and Northern Districts of Texas, and the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Qualified Mediator, Attorney Mediators Institute, 1993 - Present

attorneys.name: Jennifer S. Goldman
attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Jennifer S. Goldman, P.L.L.C.
attorneys.practice_type: Child Welfare Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
I have worked for many years directly in the courtroom setting, either as an assistant district attorney, a lawyer appointed by the courts to represent parents and children embroiled in courtroom battles, or as a lawyer representing individuals in divorces and custody disputes.

Because I see that the court process is almost always traumatic for all parties, with costs that mount ridiculously high and emotions that escalate out of control, I embrace all dispute resolution processes that allow people to exercise control over their own case. In line with this philosophy, I mediate custody, family and CPS cases on a regular basis, and I wholeheartedly endorse the collaborative/cooperative law process. I also previously served as a City of Dallas associate municipal court judge, where I endeavored to resolve all disputes as efficiently as possible within the confines of the law.

My goal with the Law Offices of Jennifer S. Goldman, P.L.L.C. is to use this experience to help people resolve family conflicts in the most streamlined, respectful and financially responsible way possible. Because my clients believe that the welfare of their children necessitates them being civil to their spouse/significant other/relative, they tend to value communication, creativity and flexibility. Ultimately, they believe that their future, as well as the child's future, is more important than the past.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Cardozo Society's 2011 Young Leader of the Year

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Maribell Gomez is a family law attorney at Deyerle Silva Smith, PLLC, providing concierge-level legal services to clients throughout Austin and central Texas. Maribell’s experience includes complex divorces, contested child custody proceedings, marital property division, and other areas of family law.

As a trial attorney who also has extensive prior experience as a paralegal in family law, Maribell has a keen understanding of working with clients and helping strategize and achieve favorable outcomes through her counsel and the litigation process. She believes effective communication and detailed preparation can offer clients peace of mind and leads to better outcomes for clients and families.

Maribell was born and raised in Texas where she has accumulated extensive experience in the nuances of the state’s family code and its application in family law matters through negotiation, dispute resolution, and trial work. Originally from Houston, she earned her Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice at Sam Houston State University and Doctor of Jurisprudence from Thurgood Marshall School of Law.

Maribell enjoys spending time with her family, values her Mexican-American heritage and Spanish fluency, and takes pride in how her advice and legal work provides guidance, understanding, and support to people throughout her community.

Maribell Gomez provides concierge-level legal services to clients across Texas and most often the following areas: Travis County, Williamson County, Hays County, Bastrop County, Bell County, Austin, Westlake, Lakeway, Round Rock, Georgetown, Leander, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Lago Vista, Bee Cave, Buda, Kyle, and San Marcos.

attorneys.name: Manuel Gonzales
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Manuel has been representing people who have been injured or families of loved ones who have been killed on the job or as the result of the negligent actions of individuals, corporations, and others for 20 years. Manuel believes that people deserved tough, fierce representation when dealing with insurance companies.

Prior to becoming an attorney, Manuel enlisted in the United States Army and, after completing training at the United States Army Intelligence School in Fort Devens, Massachusetts, served the majority of his four years in Fulda, Germany. After being honorably discharged from the Army, Manuel went on to graduate from the University of Houston. During his time at UH, Manuel worked a variety of jobs in the hospitality and restaurant industry. After graduation and prior to law school Manuel worked as a construction manager building homes in one of the fastest growing suburbs of Houston, Texas. As a construction manager, he was responsible for all aspects of building a home and dealing with contractors, insurance companies, banks, homebuyers, and others in completing the construction of the houses.

Manuel earned his law degree from the University of Cincinnati School of Law in Cincinnati, Ohio. Manuel worked at GE Aircraft Engines in Ohio and returned to Houston in 2001. Manuel started his own firm in 2005 representing people who have been injured and families of loved ones killed. Manuel's broad background and work experience in a variety of fields allows Manuel to connect with his clients and provides him insight to his clients' experiences.

Manuel is originally from San Antonio, Texas and is married to Maritza Gonzales and together raised 4 children. Maritza and Manuel contribute time or money to a variety of organizations including the University of Houston, Latin Women's Organization, the Association for the Advancement of Mexican Americans, American Civil Liberties Union, Legacy Community Health, Houston Rodeo and other organizations. When Manuel is not practicing law, he enjoys spending time with his family and traveling.

attorneys.name: Xalli Gonzales
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Xalli Veniece Gonzales is a Texas attorney with over a decade of courtroom experience, now focusing her practice on family law matters.

Licensed to practice law in Texas since 2011, Ms. Gonzales has represented clients in both criminal and family law cases throughout her legal career. While in private practice, she focused on family law matters and criminal defense, representing clients in divorce, child custody and visitation disputes, child support issues, modifications, and cases involving protective orders and allegations of family violence.

Ms. Gonzales most recently served as an Assistant District Attorney with the Bee County District Attorney’s Office, where she prosecuted complex criminal cases involving detailed investigations, evidentiary hearings, and contested court proceedings. Her prosecutorial background provides valuable insight in family law cases—particularly those involving protective orders, enforcement issues, and matters intersecting with the criminal justice system. She brings a disciplined, detail-oriented approach to litigation and a strong command of courtroom procedure.

Earlier in her career, Ms. Gonzales operated her own law practice, where she developed a practical, client-focused approach to legal representation. Her experience on both the prosecution and defense sides of the courtroom allows her to assess cases strategically and advocate effectively for her clients’ interests.

Ms. Gonzales earned her Juris Doctor from St. Mary’s University School of Law and is licensed to practice in the State of Texas. She is known for her professionalism, clear communication, and commitment to guiding clients through complex and emotionally challenging legal matters with honesty and care.

Outside of her legal practice, Ms. Gonzales enjoys traveling internationally and values experiencing different cultures. She is also an avid animal lover and shares her home with four dogs, two cats, and a parrot.

attorneys.name: Javier Gonzalez
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Gonzalez is a Mexican born immigrant who moved to the United States at the young age of 7 years old. Despite growing up in the United States, he was brought up by his Mexican immigrant parents with Mexican values that inspired him to pursue a legal career and help the Hispanic community attain the American Dream. As an immigrant himself, Attorney Gonzalez navigated the intricate and complex immigration laws with his family until they all attained their U.S. Citizenship. Living the complex immigration battle firsthand has made immigration law personal to him.

Attorney Gonzalez earned his Bachelor’s Degree in Political Science from the University of Houston where he graduated Cum Laude. Wasting no time, he pursued his legal education and graduated from Thurgood Marshall School of Law where he graduated Magna Cum Laude and in the top 10% of his class.

Attorney Gonzalez is well-versed in many areas of immigration law, ranging from affirmative applications before the United States Immigration and Naturalization Service ("USCIS"), to removal defense before the Immigration Court. He also helps immigrants who have been victims of abuse, crimes, or human trafficking within the United States. Attorney Gonzalez is ready to help anyone and everyone he can, always expanding his legal knowledge to further his assistance to the Hispanic community.

attorneys.name: Paul M Gonzalez
attorneys.practice_type: Municipal Law Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Paul M. González is a member of the Firm's Public Law Section. He has been advising municipalities on public law issues for more than 13 years. Mr. González joined the firm as Of Counsel in 2008 after working in-house with a large municipally-owned utility for six years. Educated at the University of Pennsylvania (B.A. 1989) and St. Mary's University School of Law (J.D. 1996), Mr. González was admitted to practice law in Texas in 1996.

Mr. González has advised various local governments on parliamentary procedure, open meetings and open records issues, ethics/conflicts issues, as well as on procurement, contract, and other general public law issues. He has significant experience with regulatory matters, including land use regulation, the exercise of eminent domain, and compliance. Much of his extensive utility experience relates to the electric, natural gas and water industries. Mr. González has advised clients on high-profile projects and supervised related litigation involving both state and federal cases, including the coordination of legal advice among aligned parties and counsel and the review and approval of attorney budgets. He has testified and submitted comments on draft legislation and proposed agency rules, briefed and argued matters before the state court of appeals, and has litigated contested cases before the Public Utility Commission of Texas. Prior to entering private practice in 1997, Mr. González’ legal experience includes judicial internships in state and federal courts, a judicial clerkship with a federal magistrate judge, and work touching upon personal injury, family law and probate matters.
