attorneys.name: Rebecca Anne Gonzalez
attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of Rebecca Gonzalez, P.C.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
As a San Antonio lawyer, I extend personal care and understanding to families undergoing some of the most traumatic moments in their personal lives. My family law firm offers mediation and trial services for family law, matrimonial law and divorce law disputes.

As a San Antonio lawyer, I am dedicated to protecting my client’s rights and interests - both in and out of court. I offer mediation, coaching and counseling services and generally advise against litigating divorce and family matters unless absolutely necessary. Most San Antonio family law attorneys recommend a non-adversarial approach because (1) litigation is expensive and (2) mediation is generally more effective:

Counseling and mediation - I believe that peaceful resolution of home-based conflict through counseling and mediation often leads to more fulfilling and holistic outcomes at faster and more affordable rates. There are many other benefits associated with mediation. A recent divorce mediation study showed that parties involved in mediation are likely to comply with the agreement because each party pro actively voiced their concerns and negotiated the terms of the outcome. Furthermore, the study has demonstrated a high degree of correlation between mediated resolutions and non-custodial parent involvement in child rearing. My family law firm makes it a priority to put the family's best interests first - sometimes going so far as to recommend the services of church counseling and therapists to diffuse a brewing crisis.

Litigation - Adversarial courtroom proceedings allow a judge to settle the conflict when the litigants themselves cannot find middle ground. The court sets the time line for appearances and makes the final determination as to the outcome. An attorney serves - in this setting - to communicate the facts effectively so as to compel the judge to rule in his client’s favor. I have honed my trial skills in family court & bring substantive legal knowledge and expansive trial skill to the practice of family law litigation.

The Law Office of Rebecca Anne Gonzalez extends a helping hand to husbands, wives, parents, children, exes, grandparents, stepparents and new parents in need of legal services. My family law firm stands ready to fight in trial court when mediation fails to produce a just outcome. Our practice envelopes a broad range of practice areas, including contested divorce, uncontested divorce, paternity, modifications, alimony, child support and prenuptial agreements.

My fees are meant to be affordable and extended payment plans are available, if necessary. As your San Antonio attorney and staff we are committed to helping clients obtain swift and just resolutions to mediated and litigated matters. We strive to help you avoid expensive and messy family or divorce battles, but we are prepared to fight for you if litigation is the only option. From offices located in San Antonio Texas, I proudly represent clients throughout Bexar County.

attorneys.name: Catherine Chesley Goodgion
attorneys.practice_type: Patent Prosecutor (Intellectual Property) Lawyers in Tyler, TX
attorneys.bio:
Catherine Chesley Goodgion is a Patent Prosecutor, licensed to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). To qualify as a Patent Prosecutor, an attorney must meet legal, scientific and technical qualifications and demonstrate a good moral character and reputation. In addition to earning a technical science degree and a law degree, they must apply for registration with the USPTO and pass a separate bar examination. Fewer than 1% of the attorneys in Smith County have met these requirements.

As a Patent Prosecutor, Catherine can represent inventors and entrepreneurs in protecting intellectual property such as inventions, design or processes. She researches patentability, prepares and files patent applications, negotiates with and responds to the USPTO, and files appeals. She can also help business clients develop patent protection development plans and comprehensive design patents, including trademarks and copyrights.

Catherine is a Fellow in the College of the State Bar of Texas, an honorary society of lawyers who are among the best trained attorneys in Texas, having completed at least double the Continuing Legal Education (CLE) required by the State Bar of Texas. She also practices in the areas of Real Estate Transactions, Acquisitions & Development, Document Preparation and Curative. She has represented clients in the acquisition and divestiture of assets including drafting assignments, purchase and sale agreements, right-of-way agreements, easements, boundary line agreements, affidavits of heirship, numerous real estate and commercial loan documents in addition to closing documents. Catherine has drafted and reviewed purchase and sale agreements for residential and commercial transactions. Catherine understands the complicated curative issues involved in real estate transactions.

Prior to passing the bar, Catherine worked as an Independent Petroleum Landman for Flowers Davis running title, preparing runsheets and completing ownership reports. Before attending law school and after earning her Masters in Business Administration, Catherine worked for several years as a Pharmaceutical Sales Specialist exceeding her sales targets for the sale of antidepressant and hormone therapy products, and insulin products, respectively. Catherine's experience and education in the pharmaceutical, medical, and oil and gas fields brings a business person's perspective to her legal work.

Outside of work, Catherine enjoys CrossFit, running, water sports, spending time with family and friends, spoiling her two dogs and traveling with her husband, Sam. She and her husband, Sam attend Green Acres Baptist Church.

attorneys.name: Robert E. Goodman Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Bob Goodman joined Kilgore Law in 2010, after 30 years of law practice, 11 in the fields of bankruptcy, creditor rights, and general business litigation, and 19 in the fields of employment law and employment benefits law, including discrimination, compensation and whistleblower claims. In many of these employment law areas, Bob Goodman has pursued multiple plaintiff and class or representative actions involving a large number of actual or potential individual plaintiffs, and has successfully settled a number of such claims and class actions.

"I want to thank Bob Goodman and his staff for great service. He took the time to listen to my issue, got straight to the point, and kept me grounded. I received a realistic, acceptable settlement. Bob's strength is in the way he treats friends and foes. He is very careful to state a point clearly, to ensure that the point made cannot be miscommunicated. I have already referred Bob to a friend, and will continue to do so. In my opinion, anyone looking for integrity in an attorney must consider Robert Goodman." Mitch G., Religious Discrimination Matter, 2012

His employment benefits practice includes severance claims and disability benefits claims including disability discrimination, short-term disability claims, long-term disability claims and employee injury claims governed by the federal Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) and non-ERISA disability and employee injury, related insurance and non-subscriber employee injury claims. He is currently involved in class action litigation under ERISA on behalf of former registered representatives of a major securities broker.

Bob Goodman also has an arbitration practice on behalf of broker-dealer employees and securities customers pursuing claims through the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) and is currently involved in class action litigation under ERISA on behalf of former registered representatives of major securities brokers.

His employment law cases include minimum wage and overtime claims under the federal Fair-Labor Standards Act (FLSA); employment discrimination, age discrimination, sex discrimination, sexual harassment, denial of accommodations, and retaliation claims under federal and state discrimination statutes. Other employment law cases he has pursued include employment discrimination and retaliation claims for whistleblowing in violation of the federal and state statutes.

Robert Goodman has also pursued claims for denial of reemployment, discrimination and retaliation against military service members under the federal Uniformed Servicemembers Employment Rights and Reemployment Act (USERRA). His work on these cases has garnered attention from national and local press.

He has also pursued qui tam cases to seek recoveries on behalf of governmental entities for false claims by healthcare providers and other federal and state funding beneficiaries and related wrongful termination claims under the False Claims Act.

attorneys.name: Thomas P. Goranson
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Recognizing that divorce is a difficult time and often involves the division of an estate, Thomas Goranson applies a keen understanding to marital assets and how they can be valued and divided to achieve maximum benefit to the client. Befitting the founder of the firm, Tom also brings a certain stature to his cases that supports the client’s goals in the proceedings.

With an eye toward preserving assets rather than destroying them, Tom offers clients a thorough analysis and creative but realistic plan to accomplish their objectives.

Tom began his law practice in 1971 as an associate with the law firm of Akin, Gump, Strauss, Hauer & Feld. Early on, he was assigned an estate case and quickly became familiar with community and separate property concepts, cases and law in Texas. Then, Tom assisted in a divorce case involving a jury trial. In a rather short period of time, Tom was placed in charge of the divorce practice at Akin, Gump. In 1987, he founded a law firm devoted exclusively to divorce and family law, known today as Goranson, Bain, PLLC.

Tom's current divorce practice emphasizes significant property cases. He is Board Certified in Family Law, by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization since 1980, a graduate of SMU School of Law (1971), and a frequent lecturer on family law matters. He is also a member of two separate American Inns of Court. The William "Mac" Taylor Inn is a general litigation organization. The membership of the Annette Stewart Inn is limited to family law attorneys. Tom was a founding member of the Annette Stewart Inn and was Education Vice-President for 2003 - 2004. Inns of Court were established in the United States for the purpose of fostering excellence in professionalism, ethics, civility, and legal skills. He has been a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers since 1982. Tom has been selected for inclusion in the list of Best Lawyers in America", by Woodward/White, Inc., for over twenty years. He was selected by for inclusion in the list of "The Top Lawyers" in family law in the May, 1995, 2000, 2003, 2005, 2007, 2008 and 2009 issues of D Magazine. Thomson Reuters has selected him for inclusion in the list of "Super Lawyers" in family law in its November 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012 and 2013 issues (including a selection of one of the top 100 lawyers in Texas in 2004 and 2005). Tom was one of the founding members of, and is currently an active member in, a local Toastmasters International Club - Counselors (#5918). He is especially proud of establishing a law firm that developed a great reputation among judges, mediators, other professionals and clients.

attorneys.name: George Gore
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
George W. Gore is an attorney at The Alfred Firm, focusing his practice on complex briefing and appellate briefing in the Firm’s workplace injury, refinery explosion, construction accident, catastrophic personal injury, rideshare injury, and 18-wheeler crash cases. With over twenty-four years of practice, George has handled a wide range of personal injury matters, as well as commercial, corporate, contract, and major bankruptcy cases. Although he has represented major corporations, small businesses, and insurance companies, his primary focus is on helping and protecting individuals. George has logged hundreds of hours in courthouses throughout Texas, representing over a thousand clients in litigation and negotiating numerous six and seven-figure settlements.

George graduated from North Shore High School in Houston and attended the University of Houston, where he received a BBA in Finance. While pursuing his undergraduate degree, he worked as a mechanic and bank teller. He later managed multiple stores while he and his wife obtained their law degrees. He earned his J.D. from the University of Houston Law Center and became licensed to practice in 2001.During law school, George clerked with the Internal Revenue Service and the First Court of Appeals, gaining experience in multiple appellate matters. attorneys.practice_type: FELA Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Steve Gordon is a highly respected attorney at the Houston-based Gordon & Elias, LLP, where he specializes in personal injury cases, with a particular focus on maritime law, the Federal Employers' Liability Act (FELA), and truck accidents. Steve is well-known for his work representing injured railroad workers and offshore employees, as well as those hurt in commercial trucking accidents.

“In my years of practice, I have been honored to represent people who, without my help, would have been devastated by the lack of concern from companies to the needs of working families that have been affected by an injury. The greed of companies, be they railroad companies, maritime companies, or insurance companies inevitably overrides their sense of justice that should be present when someone gets hurt. At Gordon & Elias, LLP, we understand what it is like to lose the income of the "bread winner" in the family, or, even worse, to lose the life of a loved one at the hands of a negligent party. We will be "like family" throughout the entire process. You can trust us.”

Steve earned his law degree from South Texas College of Law in 1985 and has since built a distinguished legal career. He has been recognized by Super Lawyers for his expertise in personal injury law, being selected in multiple years, including 2011, 2012, 2017, and 2018. His dedication to clients and legal acumen has earned him a reputation as a leading attorney in Houston, Texas.

Steven J. Gordon is licensed to practice law in Texas and the District of Columbia. He is also admitted to practice in multiple U.S. District Courts, including those in Texas. His firm's focus on maritime injuries, trucking accidents, and FELA-related litigation has made him a trusted figure for clients seeking legal recourse in the face of devastating injuries.

Steve's practice areas extend to wrongful death cases, workplace injuries, and a wide array of personal injury claims, including slip and fall accidents, motorcycle accidents, and product liability cases.

attorneys.name: Andrew Gould
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Andrew Gould leads Arnold & Itkin's appellate practice. He oversees the firm's cases on appeal, while providing complex legal support to the firm's trial lawyers at all phases of trial.

An experienced appellate advocate, Andrew has served as lead counsel in approximately 225 appeals before various federal and state appellate courts, including the U.S. and Texas Supreme Courts. He has conducted over 35 oral arguments, including 25 before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit. His extensive experience has led to his recognition by Chambers & Partners as one of the top appellate lawyers in Texas. The publication describes him as having cultivated “a rising profile for his sterling appellate practice, which features particular expertise in handling high-stakes personal injury, product liability and negligence disputes on behalf of plaintiffs.”

At Arnold & Itkin, Andrew's mission is to ensure that that the firm’s clients have the highest level of legal representation, both at trial and on appeal. He believes that individuals harmed by the wrongdoing of others deserve the same sophisticated appellate support that corporations get. To that end, as one person has noted, Andrew “has helped even the playing field in disputes against big companies.” His written and oral advocacy has resulted in numerous victories in appellate courts, including upholding successful jury verdicts and reversing erroneous trial-level rulings. And in trial courts, Andrew has provided substantial assistance with crafting jury charges, preserving error, and complex motion practice.

Before joining Arnold & Itkin, Andrew began his legal career as a law clerk to two federal judges: first to the Honorable Raymond M. Kethledge of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, and then to the Honorable Lee H. Rosenthal of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Texas. He then practiced complex commercial litigation at a large corporate law firm in Washington, D.C. before returning to Houston, where he entered public service by serving in the U.S. Attorney's Office. As a federal appellate prosecutor for nearly seven years, Andrew was honored to win awards for his work on cases at all stages of prosecution: trial, appeal, and postconviction.

Andrew is dedicated to service in the legal community in Houston and beyond. He serves as President-Elect of the Federal Bar Association’s Southern District of Texas Chapter, on the Executive Committee of the Garland Walker American Inn of Court, and on the Houston Nominating Committee of the Texas Bar Foundation. He is a Fellow of both the Texas and Houston Bar Foundations, as well as a member of the Appellate Sections for the Houston Bar Association and the State Bar of Texas. Outside of Texas, Andrew has served on the Vanderbilt Law Review’s Alumni Advisory Committee since its foundation in 2014.

Andrew regularly writes and speaks outside of his day-to-day work. His written works appear in the Vanderbilt Law Review and Duke Law Journal Online. He also serves on the editorial board for Bearings’ Texas Civil Litigation: Rules & Commentaries. And he has given numerous CLE presentations on various topics, ranging from appellate litigation to the Fourth Amendment.

Andrew graduated with the highest honors from the University of Michigan and Vanderbilt University Law School, where he served as Executive Editor of the Vanderbilt Law Review and was selected to Order of the Coif. His undergraduate thesis at Michigan received the History Department's Arthur Fondiler Award, while his student note at Vanderbilt received the Law Review's Morgan Prize.

Andrew and his wife, Rebecca, are proud supporters of Rice University and the Houston Symphony. When Andrew isn’t reading or writing a legal brief, you can usually find him cooking, running or spinning, watching college football or basketball, or chasing one of his two young sons.

Laura J. Grabouski is a native Texan who grew up in San Antonio. She graduated from the University of Texas at Austin in 1998 and the University of Texas School of Law in 2001. She clerked on the Third Court of Appeals in Austin before joining the commercial litigation section of Hughes & Luce (now K&L Gates). Laura was asked to join an insurance coverage litigation boutique in 2002 and has continued to litigate coverage and commercial disputes throughout Texas for over eighteen years. Laura currently serves as a Partner in Holden Litigation's Texas offices.

An English major in college, Laura loves to write. Her articles frequently appear in Coverage and The Journal of Texas Insurance Law. She also enjoys speaking on the intersection of technology and the law, cybercrime coverage, and significant new trends and cases. She has been featured as a speaker in webinars presented by AM Best and Strafford.

Laura has been AV-rated (Martindale Hubbell) since 2015. She is a member of the Texas Bar College, Women in Cyber Leadership, and CLM. She is a prior director of the Austin Bar Association Board of Directors. She has volunteered with the Austin Diocese Red Mass Committee which commemorates the start of the judicial year.

Laura is married to Jeff and has two school-age children with whom she enjoys cooking, reading, and having fun.

Benjamin E. Grant practices primarily in the areas of real property, energy, public utility, and regulatory law representing public utility companies and electric transmission companies. In connection with such representation, Mr. Grant has assisted clients in the sale and transfer of electric transmission infrastructure and equipment as well as the assignment and licensure of appurtenant real property interests, interconnection and facility-sharing agreements and issues, federal and state regulatory and environmental liability and compliance issues, and the acquisition of necessary easement, right-of-way, fee, and other real property interests through negotiation and, when necessary, eminent domain proceedings. Mr. Grant received his Bachelor of Science in Sociology/Criminal Justice from Abilene Christian University and his Juris Doctorate from the Walter F. George School of Law at Mercer University. While in law school, Mr. Grant was a law clerk for a consumer bankruptcy attorney and a summer clerk for Wagstaff, Alvis, Stubbeman, Seamster, & Longacre, L.L.P.

sections.content:
Benjamin E. Grant practices primarily in the areas of real property, energy, public utility, and regulatory law representing public utility companies and electric transmission companies. In connection with such representation, Mr. Grant has assisted clients in the sale and transfer of electric transmission infrastructure and equipment as well as the assignment and licensure of appurtenant real property interests, interconnection and facility-sharing agreements and issues, federal and state regulatory and environmental liability and compliance issues, and the acquisition of necessary easement, right-of-way, fee, and other real property interests through negotiation and, when necessary, eminent domain proceedings. Mr. Grant also represents clients in various transactional real property matters, in business entity formation and governance, in landlord/tenant disputes, including lease negotiation and interpretation, rent collection, and forcible detainer, as well as in the areas of general civil litigation, creditor’s rights, appellate litigation, and wills and estate planning.

Mr. Grant received his Bachelor of Science in Sociology/Criminal Justice from Abilene Christian University and his Juris Doctorate from the Walter F. George School of Law at Mercer University. While in law school, Mr. Grant was a law clerk for a consumer bankruptcy attorney and a summer clerk for Wagstaff, Alvis, Stubbeman, Seamster, & Longacre, L.L.P.

attorneys.name: Ellen Tyler Gray
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ellen Gray was born and raised in San Antonio, Texas, where she currently still resides. Ellen attended the University of Texas at San Antonio, where she obtained her undergraduate degree in Criminal Justice. After graduation, she attended law school at St. Mary’s University School of Law. While in law school, Ellen interned with the U.S. Department of Justice in the civil division. Ellen graduated law school in 2019 and was admitted to the Texas bar in 2020.

Upon graduation, Ellen began her legal career in personal injury law. Ellen has represented clients in personal injury accidents, such as auto and truck accidents, pedestrian accidents, motorcycle crashes, general negligence, and premises liability cases. Ellen understands that winning the case is only part of the battle. For Ellen, it’s also about helping people rebuild their lives after unexpected hardships. With a deep belief in compassion and empathy, Ellen continues to build her career, standing up for individuals and families who’ve been injured due to someone else’s negligence

Outside of the office, Ellen enjoys spending time with her family, her dogs, and spending time outside gardening.

attorneys.name: Kelly Gray
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Kelly Gray joined FVF in January of 2020. Kelly was born in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, but moved to Austin going into her fifth-grade year. After Kelly graduated from Lake Travis High School, she attended Trinity University in San Antonio, where she graduated magna cum laude with a degree in English. Kelly returned to Austin as soon as she graduated college and worked in lobbying for a little over a year. Ultimately, Kelly decided to pursue her lifelong goal of becoming a lawyer and started law school at Baylor Law School.

As a law student, Kelly received the Dean’s Academic Excellence scholarship award and was on the Dean’s List. She also interned with the Dallas Public Defender’s Office as well as the McClennan County District Attorney’s Office and volunteered for the Mission Waco legal clinic.

After law school, Kelly began practicing personal injury law in San Antonio, Texas. She made her way back to Austin after a year in San Antonio and continued to practice personal injury law in the city where she grew up.

Kelly lives in South Austin and enjoys playing with her dog, Susie, spending time with friends and family, and hiking Austin’s many beautiful trails and greenbelts.

attorneys.name: Bret C. Green
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
Bret C. Green received his Bachelor of Arts Degree in Political Science from Texas A&M University. From there, he interned at the Brazos County District Attorneys Office which eventually led him to St. Mary's University School of Law where he earned his Law Degree in 2000. In law school, Mr. Green tutored several classes within the Office of Academic Excellence, was President of Phi Delta Phi Honors Fraternity, won several mock trial competitions including the American Trial Lawyers Association Mock Trial Competition in Florida and was awarded Best Speaker in well over 20 rounds of competition. Mr. Green received the distinguished Judge Jack B. Miller Educating for Justice Award, an award given to one student in the graduating class for excellence in both academics and trial advocacy, and was one of only ten students selected into the prestigious Order of Barristers.

Mr. Green is recognized as a keynote panelist and speaker, sharing his message of positivity, growth and overcoming extreme adversity to small groups of twenty to large crowds of over 10,000 people. Mr. Green co-hosts a weekly conference call focused on positive self-talk and will be releasing his book, The Three Rings and The Y of Life, in December of 2022. Mr. Green is the owner of Green Legal, P.C., and serves as Of Counsel for Black & Skaggs, P.C., where he assists in insurance defense litigation. During his 20 year career, Mr. Green has represented individual clients, small business owners and larger businesses such as HEB and Midas. Mr. Green is a member of the State Bar's Texas Lawyers Assistance Program, the Texas Criminal Defense Association and the San Antonio Criminal Defense Association. Mr. Green is also certified guardian by and through the State Bar of Texas.

Mr. Green and his wife Cindy have two children and two awesome grandchildren. Mr. Green enjoys competing in Ironman Triathlons, spending time with God and his family, fighting zealously for his clients, and breathing positivity and life into all he meets. Mr. Green has coined the phrase "You are Loved and You Matter", and he strives to convince everyone he meets of that absolute truth.

attorneys.name: Thomas A. Greenwald
attorneys.practice_type: Adoption Lawyers in Plano, TX
attorneys.bio:
Clients concerned about the uncertainties of the divorce process find assurance in the careful attention Tom Greenwald gives to creating a plan for each individual. Tom's efficient, direct and organized approach keeps the divorce moving forward and helps clients realize that divorce need not be a protracted matter.

A partner at Goranson Bain, Tom is known for his approachable manner. His reputation for honesty and integrity serves clients well in skillfully negotiating with opposing counsel to resolve cases. He manages complex divorces with expertise, and has successfully litigated child custody and complex property issues in jury and non-jury cases. He also practices collaborative law and conducts mediation.

Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Tom has more than 18 years of family law experience. He has been selected for inclusion in the list of "Best Lawyers in Dallas" 2002, 2003, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2011 and 2012 by D Magazine, "Best Lawyers in America" 2005-2013 by Woodward White Press, "Top 100 Lawyers in the State of Texas" in 2009, 2011 & 2012 by Thomson Reuters and "Texas Super Lawyers" 2003-2012 by Thomson Reuters. Tom also holds an AV Rating from Martindale-Hubbell which is the organization's highest rating. He is a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers.

Tom currently serves on the Texas Board of Legal Specialization Family Law Advisory Commission and has served on the Dallas Bar Association Family Law Section Board of Directors, the Collin County Bench Bar Foundation Board of Trustees, and the State Bar of Texas District 6A Grievance Committee. He is a Fellow of the Texas Bar Foundation, the Dallas Bar Foundation and the Collin County Bar Bench Foundation. He has also authored and presented numerous articles on family issues, including legislative updates, discovery rule changes, and a commentary on custody and property issues. He received his B.B.A. degree in finance from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee and his J.D. from Texas Tech University Law School.

''I retained Tom Greenwald to represent me in a significant divorce matter. From the outset, Tom's attention to detail, knowledge of the applicable law regarding the assets involved, and his ability to take control of the legal proceedings without polarizing the other side was extremely impressive. Tom's knowledge and skill resulted in a very favorable and early resolution to my case. I would recommend Tom to anyone who desires the best result in the shortest time." – B.W. former client

''All family lawyers are not the same-believe me. As a practicing attorney of over 25 years, I know how lawyers operate. Tom Greenwald is a godsend and helped me through a very contentious divorce. Tom is practical, attentive, patient, strategic, measured, efficient, and ethical. If you think all family law/divorce lawyers are alike then choice will not matter. However, if you want an experienced lawyer who looks for solutions and resolution, not big legal fees, then Tom Greenwald is the lawyer to represent you in what will be most certainly one of the most difficult times in your life." – M.T. former client

''It was my great fortune to select an attorney as dedicated, committed and as professional as Tom Greenwald. Tom provided clear, advantageous counsel and was truly able to assess potential negative and positive ramifications resulting from our decision making process. Divorce is certainly not a lot of fun. Having Tom in my corner relieved a great part of my concerns." – C.W. former client

''Last December, my wife of 17 years and mother of my two children surprised me by filing for divorce. I was despondent. Not only was the person that I loved and trusted the most wanting me out of her life, I was left with a document containing legal language which I did not understand. Numerous questions filled my mind: Who would get the children? What were my rights? What steps are involved in the divorce process? I contacted Mr. Greenwald, and he responded immediately. He patiently and compassionately answered all of my questions and explained the legal language in terms which I could understand. Mr. Greenwald's expert explanations comforted my anxiety and made me feel much better about what to expect. While I do not wish for any married couples to experience a divorce, I highly recommend Mr. Greenwald to anyone who needs a great family lawyer." – A.K. former client

attorneys.practice_type: State, Local & Municipal Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Dick Gregg, III has a wide range of Governmental law experience. He serves as the Presiding Municipal Court Judge for the cities of Dickinson, Seabrook and Morgan's Point. As an Associate Judge, he is the primary backup performing judicial services for the Cities of League City and La Porte. In 2020, he was awarded the Judge of the Year from the Texas Municipal Court Association.

He serves as the city attorney for the City of Clear Lake Shores, the City of Brookside Village and the City of Bayou Vista. Gregg & Gregg contracts with numerous cities to provide prosecutorial services where he serves as the lead prosecutor, including but not limited to, the cities of Kemah, Webster, Nassau Bay, Brookside Village, Bayou Vista and Manvel. attorneys.name: Dick H. Gregg Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Public Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Dick Gregg, Jr. has a wide range of governmental and quasi-governmental law experience. He is currently the City Attorney for the City of Nassau Bay, City of Kemah, City of Webster, City of South Houston and the City of South Houston Economic Development Corporation. He has acted as the City Attorney for the Cities of League City, Arcola, Pearland, and Seabrook. He has served as Special Counsel for the City of Arcola and has in the past been Special Counsel for the League City Economic Development Corporation. Mr. Gregg was Special Counsel for the Incorporators of the Cities of Nassau Bay and Simonton (i.e. incorporation of these two cities). He has represented Brazoria County Conservation and Reclamation District No. 3, in Alvin, Texas and Brazoria Drainage District, No. 4, in Pearland, Texas for special litigation. He has been Special Counsel for Real Estate Sale or Acquisition for the Clear Creek Independent School District. At this time he is acting as counsel to Bay Area Houston Convention & Visitor's Bureau, the Clear Lake Area Chamber of Commerce, Bay Area Houston Economic Partnership, Bay Area Assistance League and Armand Bayou Nature Center. Mr. Gregg began his career as Assistant Attorney General of Texas in 1964-1965.

He received his Bachelor of Arts Degree in Government and his Doctorate of Jurisprudence from the University of Texas at Austin in the years 1961 and 1964 respectively. He has been licensed since 1964 in the State of Texas and in the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas. Mr. Gregg has practiced law continuously for over 50 years in Harris, Galveston and Brazoria counties. His practice includes representation of public law entities, employment law and personnel matters, the drafting of corporate documents and contracts, establishment of for profit and not for profit corporations, the law of associations, parliamentary procedure, the drafting of public law ordinances, resolutions and agreements, interlocal agreements, franchises, real estate documents and of contracts for many forms of business endeavors. His trial experience includes the trial of matters relating to zoning, elections, annexation, usury, telephone and water supply service agreements and telephone service rate regulation, challenges to rule making authority of a public body, regular and inverse condemnation, removal from office of a public officer, nuisance, intellectual property, real estate, contract, consumer and deceptive trade practice issues.

Mr. Gregg is or has been a member of the board of directors and officer, if in parentheses, for League City Chamber of Commerce, Armand Bayou Nature Center (Former President), Armand Bayou Foundation, Bay Area Houston Ballet & Theatre (Former Chairman), Space Center Rotary Club (Former President), Bay Area Alliance for the Arts (Former Co-Chairman), Lunar Rendezvous Foundation, Bay Area Transportation Partnership (Former Board Member), Clear Lake Area Chamber of Commerce (Former Chairman), Clear Creek Education Foundation (Former Board Member), and Bay Area Houston Economic Partnership. He has also served as a member and past chairman of the University of Houston-Clear Lake Development and Advisory Council as well as well as the President's Council at University of Houston Clear Lake and the University of Texas Medical Branch President's Cabinet. Mr. Gregg is Parliamentarian for many of these entities and other organizations. He has extensive experience with Parliamentary Procedure and Robert's Rules of Order.

attorneys.firm_name: McCarn, Weir, & Sherwood Attorneys at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Amarillo, TX
attorneys.bio:
Bryce is a long-time Texas resident who moved to Waco, Texas in 2016 to begin his studies at Baylor University. A recipient of the Baylor 2 Baylor Law Scholarship, Bryce knew from an early age that he wanted to practice law. Bryce graduated magna cum laude from Baylor with his Bachelor's degree in Philosophy and Political Science in 2020 as a Phi Beta Kappa Honor Student.

Bryce stayed in Waco and started his journey in law the following year at Baylor University School of Law on a full-ride scholarship. During his time at Baylor, Bryce completed the heralded Practice Court Program, preparing him for all modes and manners of litigation. However, it was the field of oil and gas that truly grabbed his attention and interest. He is a recent graduate of the Class of 2023 and was licensed to practice law in the state of Texas that same year. Bryce is the newest member of the McCarn, Weir, & Sherwood Attorneys at Law team, and his practice focuses on oil and gas title examinations, oil and gas transactions, and oil and gas property issues.

When not practicing law, Bryce enjoys spending time with his wife and their first child. He also spends a good amount of time reading and writing, playing board games, and solving crossword puzzles (in pen, of course).

attorneys.name: Andrew Griffin
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Arlington, TX
attorneys.bio:
Andrew Griffin is a family law attorney with over 15 years of experience practicing in Texas. He currently works as an attorney at the firm of Bailey and Galyen, where he specializes in divorce, child custody, and other family related issues.

Prior to joining Bailey and Galyen, Griffin owned and operated his own family law practice for 11 years. Before striking out on his own, he worked under the guidance of veteran attorney J. Steven King for the first 5 years of his legal career.

Griffin grew up in Everman, Texas before attending Dallas Baptist University for his undergraduate degree. After college, he worked as a financial analyst for Xerox Corporation for several years. He then decided to pursue a law degree, graduating from Texas Tech University School of Law in 2007.

Since becoming a licensed attorney, Griffin has handled thousands of family law cases and has argued several appeals. He is known for his compassionate, client-focused approach, as well as his extensive knowledge of Texas family law statutes.

In addition to his legal work, Griffin is a member of the Eldon B. Mahon Inns of Court, an organization dedicated to promoting professionalism, ethics, and excellence in the practice of law.

attorneys.name: Samuel S Griffin III
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Samuel S. Griffin, III, 58, is co-founder of Griffin & Matthews, attorneys-at-law formed in 1979 with concentrations in litigation and transactional matters. In his over thirty-two (32) years of practice, Sam has engaged in a general civil practice focusing on business related matters, insurance defense litigation, and commercial litigation. He has represented a wide variety of clients with issues related to personal injury, real estate, corporate law, commercial litigation, estate planning and probate, and insurance defense litigation. His client base is made up of publicly traded and privately held businesses and their owners; developers; and, entrepreneurs in a multitude of disciplines. Representative clients include E&P/drilling/downhole technology companies, construction/plumbing/electrical contractors, hotels and hospitality providers, manufacturing/industrial processing companies, commercial/residential development companies, ranching/commercial grower enterprises, technology developers, financial institutions, service companies of multiple types including CPAs, physicians, business/marketing consultants, sales/distribution representatives, etc. Additionally, for over 25 years, he has represented multiple insurance companies and their policy holders by defending claims ranging from wrongful death to property loss.

A licensed real estate broker since 1980, Mr. Griffin co-founded Griffin Development, LLC a real estate development firm with projects in Houston, Austin, and the Rio Grande Valley. He serves as a Director of Valves Unlimited, Inc., a specialty valve company catering to the oil & gas refining industry; a Director of Impact Guidance Systems, Inc., a developer of high quality intelligent downhole tools for the drilling/completions and data acquisition aspects for the oil & gas industry; a Director of ResTech, Inc., a multiple disciplinary reservoir evaluation services company specializing in the integration and interrogation of subsurface data used in the upstream oil and gas industry; and a Director of Caymus Energy Fund Offshore, Ltd., a market-neutral equity fund focusing on domestic companies in the energy industry engaged in the exploration and production of oil and gas and other natural resources.

attorneys.name: Robert S. Griffin
attorneys.firm_name: Griffin & Cain Attorneys at Law, PC
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Conroe, TX
attorneys.bio:
Robert ‘Bob' Griffin is a trial attorney based in the Conroe and Greater Houston Area. He advocates for individuals, businesses, beneficiaries, and administrators who seek an efficient and effective solution to difficult problems. When it comes to your case, his courtroom experience is utilized from the start; and if the unthinkable happens, Bob is right there to be your proponent to the Court.

Bob's practice focuses on start-ups, small businesses, construction litigation, automotive issues, and medical technology, as well as estate planning and probate litigation. In his personal life, he ensures that these subjects are part of his every day. On some nights and weekends, you will find him restoring an old bungalow with friends and family - and professionals when necessary; his wife still is not so sure about his electrical work. Other times, he is building an auto racing team, working for as a Judge in the 24 Hours of Lemons, importing ridiculous Japanese cars, or rebuilding even more atypical cars. On rainy evenings, or when parts are still in transit, he's developing dynasty, technology, and firearms trusts, for fun. The issues you face are issues Bob strives to understand thoroughly. He apologizes in advance for the occasionally cut up and greasy hands.

In addition to his devotion to racing cars, old homes and his law practice, Bob is happily married to his wife Carrie and has been for many wonderful years since they went to the University of Houston together. (It's important to say wonderful, trust me). They likely would have been high school sweethearts, but Carrie did not attend St. Pius X High School in Houston, Texas. They are a devoted aunt and uncle to a growing set of niblings, with a couple fluffy rescue dogs.

To end with the stuffy lawyer stuff; Bob has been practicing law for over a decade, holds certificates from the A.A. White Dispute Resolution Center at the University of Houston Law Center in both international commercial arbitration and mediation, graduated cum laude from the University of Houston Law Center, magna cum laude from the Honors College at the University of Houston with a double major in economics and political science, is a member of the Texas Bar College and he regularly lectures on firearms law and negotiation.

attorneys.name: Wade Griffin
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Wade Griffin, Jr. is a partner at Varghese Summersett Family Law Group, where he specializes in complex family law cases, including high-conflict divorce, contentious child custody, and intricate property division. With more than 25 years of experience and extensive knowledge in family law, Wade is highly regarded by his clients for his strategic thinking, compassion, and unwavering dedication to their interests.

A Navy veteran and former law firm owner, Wade is highly respected in the North Texas legal community and has built a reputation for tenaciously advocating for his clients while upholding the highest level of professionalism and integrity.

In addition to being a skilled litigator, Wade is also a certified family law mediator and highly experienced in alternate dispute resolution methods. He understands that not all family law cases require an aggressive courtroom battle, and he strives to find amicable solutions for his clients whenever possible.

Beyond the courtroom, Wade’s background and personal life reflect his hard work and dedication. After graduating from A&M Consolidated High School in College Station, he enlisted in the U.S. Navy. During his tenure, he served aboard the USS Tarawa and in Operation Desert Storm in the Persian Gulf. After the military, he obtained a criminal justice degree from Sam Houston State University and a law degree from Texas Tech University School of Law.

His ambition led him to North Texas, where he worked in the Child Support Division of the Attorney General’s Office for many years. In 2010, he opened his own family law practice, The Griffin Firm, in Keller, where he helped countless families successfully navigate some of the most challenging times of their lives.

Today, as a partner at Varghese Summersett Family Law Group, Wade continues to provide exceptional legal representation to clients in the North Texas area. When he is not practicing law, he enjoys spending time with his wife, Sarah, who is a legal assistant at Varghese Summersett, and their three children and four grandchildren.

Fun Fact: Wade and his wife love to scuba dive and go off-shore fishing on jet skis.

attorneys.name: R. Gaines Griffin
attorneys.practice_type: Public Law Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
R. Gaines Griffin is Co-Senior Chairman of the Board of Directors. He is Head of the Firm's Litigation Section. He was educated at the University of Texas (BA, 1968, JD, 1971) and was a member of Phi Delta Phi honorary legal fraternity. He was admitted to the Texas bar in 1972 and is licensed to practice before the U.S. Courts of Appeals for the 5th and 11th Circuits and the U.S. District Court for the Western, Southern and Northern Districts of Texas. Mr. Griffin is a member of the State Bar of Texas, The Bar Association of the Federal Fifth Circuit, the American Bar Association and the San Antonio Bar Association.

Mr. Griffin initially served as an Assistant District and County Attorney after graduation from the University of Texas School of Law. Mr. Griffin entered the private practice of law in 1974 and, since that time, has practiced extensively in general civil litigation, including complex construction cases and multi-party and international commercial litigation. Mr. Griffin also regularly represents business owners before state and federal administrative agencies and in state and federal court in labor and employment disputes.

Mr. Griffin has also represented municipalities, schools and their elected and appointed officials in tort litigation involving areas such as civil rights claims, construction claims and employment litigation. His courtroom experience includes the representation of public bodies in both federal and state court.

attorneys.name: Ross P. Griffith
attorneys.practice_type: Probate & Estate Administration Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ross Griffith concentrates his practice on probate, guardianship, estate planning, business and increasingly in contested matters in these areas.

Probate & Guardianship. Mr. Griffith spends a good deal of time working with the estates resulting from death and incapacity. This includes heirship determinations, muniments of title, estate administrations including independent administrations and dependent administrations, temporary guardianships and permanent guardianships of the person and estate. As a result, Mr. Griffith represents independent and dependent executors, independent and dependent administrators, temporary administrators, temporary guardians, permanent guardians of the person and estate, trustees, and agents under powers of attorney.

Mr. Griffith’s previous litigation experience, along with his partners, has lead to an increasing involvement in contested matters including Fiduciary Suits (involving trustees, executors, guardians and agents under powers of attorney), Will Contests, and Guardianship Contests, Contested Administrations, Contested Heirship Determination, Accountings and Removal Actions.

Mr. Griffith is frequently appointed by courts as a Guardian Ad Litem or Attorney Ad Litem in probate and guardianship matters. He has also been appointed to serve in fiduciary capacities as a Temporary Guardian, Permanent Guardian of the Estate, Temporary Administrator, Dependent Administrator, and Independent Executor.

Mr. Griffith’s was elected as President of the Tarrant County Probate Bar Association in 2001-2002 and Guardianship Services, Inc. in 2005-2006.

Estate Planning. Mr. Griffith’s extensive practical experience in the probate, guardianship, and business areas has led to a substantial estate planning practice. He has worked with multiple individuals and families to develop a plan that is best suited for their situation. Whether you need a will, trust, power of attorney, medical directive, etc., Mr. Griffith will work with you to determine a plan that will best fit your needs.

Business. Throughout his practice Mr. Griffith has represented business owners with creating, maintaining, buying, and selling companies. Mr. Griffith also has significant experience in dealing with nonprofit organizations, corporations, limited liability companies, general partnerships, limited liability partnerships, and limited partnerships (including family limited partnerships).

Background. Ross Griffith was raised and attended school in Fort Worth through high school and returned there after earning a degree from Texas A & M University in 1985 and a law degree from Texas Tech University School of Law in 1988. He practices law in Tarrant and surrounding counties.

attorneys.firm_name: Danielle M. Campbell, Attorney at Law, PLLC
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in The Woodlands, TX
attorneys.bio:
Shawn Grisham has built a successful practice focusing on family law cases in and around Montgomery County, Texas. After graduating from St. Mary’s University School of Law in San Antonio, Texas, she raised a beautiful family and made her way to The Woodlands. With a strong commitment to guiding families through some of the most challenging times in their lives, and having personally navigated a divorce herself, Shawn brings not only professional expertise but also deep empathy to her clients, understanding firsthand the emotional and practical complexities of family law matters.

Ms. Grisham’s practice focuses on divorce, child custody, child support, modifications, and other family law-related issues. She is known for her client-centered approach, always striving to achieve the best possible outcomes by advocating for her clients with both compassion and determination. Ms. Grisham is dedicated to ensuring her clients feel informed, heard, and supported at every step of the process, providing honest, transparent, and straightforward legal guidance. Her goal is to help families navigate these sensitive situations with dignity and clarity.

A strong communicator and advocate, Shawn is passionate about empowering her clients to make decisions that are in the best interests of their families. She approaches each case with a tailored strategy to address the unique needs and circumstances of her clients, ensuring they have the information and support they need to move forward confidently.

Outside of her legal career, Shawn is deeply devoted to her family. She is married to Anthony Noravong and is the proud mother of three children - two high school boys and a daughter in college who works as a legal assistant in family law. When she’s not attending her sons' numerous sporting events, Shawn enjoys working out at the gym, attending yoga classes, and unwinding at home with her family. Shawn’s other family members include three dogs, two cats, and a green iguana named Yoshi.

In addition to her professional work, Shawn is active in the community and remains committed to furthering her legal education. She is a member of the Texas Bar Association, the Montgomery County Bar Association, The Woodlands Bar Association, and regularly participates in continuing education programs to stay current on the latest developments in family law.

Whether guiding clients through a complex divorce or helping them make informed decisions about child custody, Shawn is committed to providing compassionate and effective legal representation that supports families in finding resolution and peace of mind during difficult times.

attorneys.name: John Grinnan
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
John grew up in Dallas and attended Jesuit College Preparatory School. He eventually moved to Austin, where he studied government at the University of Texas. After graduating from the University of Texas, John moved to Houston to attend law school at South Texas College of Law.

During law school, John became a varsity advocate for the law school’s nationally-ranked moot court program under the late Thomas Gerald Treece. John received two awards for his performance in the classroom, including one for obtaining the highest grade in the law school's Advanced Products Liability course. Additionally, John was listed on the Dean’s List for four consecutive semesters.

John graduated from law school cum laude in the top fifteen percent of his law school class. He received two graduating honors as he was admitted into the Order of Lytae and received an Academic Merit Scholarship.

John spent nearly a decade litigating product liability and mass tort cases prior to joining Arnold & Itkin. During this time, he took on some of the largest companies in the world and won time and again. John’s work in litigating the first three transvaginal mesh trials in Federal Court against Boston Scientific Corporation pressured the defendant into resolving thousands of individual cases around the United States. In the first two trials, juries returned verdicts against Boston Scientific for $26.7 million and $18.5 million. The day before closing arguments in the third trial, Boston Scientific agreed to settle the case.

John has a track record of obtaining seven-figure settlements in single-plaintiff personal injury litigation as well. One of his proudest victories was on behalf of a worker catastrophically injured while building a new pipeline. The defendants refused to take responsibility and used their extensive resources to defend the suit. John did not back down. He aggressively litigated the case and secured a multi-million dollar settlement for his client.

When John isn’t working, he is spending time with his wife Sarah and his daughter Clare. He enjoys golfing and rooting for his favorite football, basketball, and baseball teams.

The day before closing arguments in the third trial, Boston Scientific agreed to settle the case.

John has a track record of obtaining seven-figure settlements in single-plaintiff personal injury litigation as well. One of his proudest victories was on behalf of a worker catastrophically injured while building a new pipeline. The defendants refused to take responsibility and used their extensive resources to defend the suit. John did not back down. He aggressively litigated the case and secured a multi-million dollar settlement for his client.

When John isn’t working, he is spending time with his wife Sarah and his daughter Clare. He enjoys golfing and rooting for his favorite football, basketball, and baseball teams.

attorneys.name: Hope Guardia
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Hope Guardia joined FVF Law in 2018. Originally a native of Tallahassee, Florida, Hope first moved to Austin in 2009. After working as a Personal Injury Paralegal and Insurance Adjuster, she moved to New Orleans to attend law school. Hope could not wait go get back to the Lone Star State, moving back to Austin just three days after graduating from Loyola University New Orleans College of Law in May 2018. In 2020, she helped us up open an FVF office in Orlando, Florida and she continues to oversee that location. Hope works with both Florida and Texas personal injury clients. Hope handles both pre-litigation and litigation cases. Her prior adjuster experience allows her to analyze cases through multiple lenses and present her clients with an adept analysis of their case.

As law student, Hope worked as a student practitioner for the Orleans Parish District Attorney’s Office. Completing a Tax Certificate in conjunction with her Juris Doctorate, Hope worked in Loyola’s Volunteer Income Tax Assistance clinic, preparing tax returns for underserved members of the New Orleans community.

While at Loyola, Hope served as Vice-Justice of Phi Alpha Delta legal fraternity, Social Chair for the Association of Women Law Students, and Student Bar Association Representative for the Criminal Law Society. During her time at Loyola, Hope received the Clem H. and Norris Shert Tricon Public Interest Scholarship, the Anna and Sarah Shaw Texas Scholarship in Law, and the Law Dean’s Scholarship. Hope was awarded the highest grade in Corporate Taxation, Lawyering III (Professional Ethics), and Trademark and Unfair Competition.

Hope lives in south Austin with her long-time boyfriend and three fur children; a tuxedo cat named Gatsby, an American shorthair named Bruja, and a silly mutt named Izzy. Hope enjoys traveling to new places, trying new restaurants, live music, and trivia. She aspires to one day become a Jeopardy contestant, but fully recognizes she does not know nearly enough about eighteenth-century poetry and Norse mythology to ever be a worthy contestant.

attorneys.name: Michael J. Guerra
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense and Litigation Lawyers in Brownsville, TX
attorneys.bio:
Michael J. Guerra was born and raised in Brownsville, Texas. He attended Texas State University in San Marcos, Texas and earned a Bachelor's Degree in Science with a focus on Criminal Justice in 2007. Shortly after, he attended Thurgood Marshall School of Law in Houston, Texas, where he earned his Juris Doctor in 2011.

Upon passing the Texas Bar, Mr. Guerra returned home to Brownsville to serve the people of his community as an Assistant District Attorney at the Cameron County District Attorney's Office. During his tenure at the District Attorney's Office, Mr. Guerra handled, prepared, and tried various criminal matters ranging from Class C Misdemeanors up to Capital Felonies. Mr. Guerra ultimately became the Chief Felony Prosecutor for Judge Janet Leal of the 103rd Judicial District Court in Cameron County.

Mr. Guerra joined Lawler & Leandro, P.C. in June 2018. Since joining Lawler & Leandro, P.C., he has become an effective and respected advocate, managing a docket of approximately 70 cases. Mr. Guerra handles motor vehicle accidents, premises liability cases, trucking cases, construction defect lawsuits and medical malpractice lawsuits.

Mr. Guerra has been a member of the Cameron County Young Lawyers Association as well as a Board Member of the Cameron County Bar Association. Mr. Guerra is admitted to practice law in the State of Texas, as well as the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Texas. Mr. Guerra is also fluent in Spanish.

attorneys.name: Charlie Gustin
attorneys.practice_type: Car Crashes Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Charlie Gustin is an experienced and well-respected trial attorney with a proven track record of success in cases involving severe injuries and high-stakes insurance disputes. Charlie filed his first lawsuit as a teenager, drawing nationwide press coverage by representing himself in federal court against the local school board over Constitutional issues. The University of Texas awarded Charlie an academic scholarship, which allowed him to become the first in his family to attend college, graduating with a double major.

At South Texas College of Law, Charlie received the Dean’s Scholar Award and was inducted into the Phi Delta Phi Legal Honors Society. Charlie excelled in the school’s advocacy program – being named “Top Speaker” (out of 82 peers) in the Leroy Jeffers Memorial Moot Court Tournament and later leading a varsity team to a championship at the National Health Law Moot Court Competition sponsored by the American College of Legal Medicine. Throughout law school, Charlie worked as head law clerk for renowned Houston trial attorney Rusty Hardin.

In his law practice, Charlie has earned a reputation as a tough, smart litigator who goes the extra mile to make his clients whole. Prior to opening Gustin Law Firm, Charlie gained valuable experience working in some of the top plaintiffs’ personal injury and first-party insurance law firms in Texas. Although he has recovered tens of millions of dollars on behalf of hundreds of his clients, Charlie is especially proud of one case where he helped shut down a dangerous trampoline park, and another case where he helped a hurricane-displaced family build a new home even though their insurance company had initially denied the claim.

Charlie Gustin is licensed to practice in all Texas state and federal courts. He is a member of the State Bar of Texas, the American Association of Justice, the North American Brain Injury Society, the Texas Trial Lawyers Association and serves on the Board of Directors of the Houston Trial Lawyers Association. Charlie was named Super Lawyers “Rising Star” for five (5) years in a row, a recognition given to less than 2.5% of the attorneys in Texas. Since 2022, Charlie has been selected as a “Super Lawyer” based on independent research and evaluations from his fellow Texas attorneys. Houstonia Magazine calls Charlie one of Houston’s “Top Lawyers.” Charlie served as co-counsel on a trial that resulted in a “Top 50 Texas Verdict” (2016), and secured both a “ Top 100 Texas Settlement” (2022), and the #1 Drunk Driving Settlement in Harris County (2023). Charlie’s advocacy on behalf of his clients has been reported by numerous media outlets, including The Dallas Morning News, The Austin American-Statesman, and Texas Lawyer.

Throughout law school, Charlie worked as head law clerk for renowned Houston trial attorney Rusty Hardin.

In his law practice, Charlie has earned a reputation as a tough, smart litigator who goes the extra mile to make his clients whole. Prior to opening Gustin Law Firm, Charlie gained valuable experience working in some of the top plaintiffs’ personal injury and first-party insurance law firms in Texas. Although he has recovered tens of millions of dollars on behalf of hundreds of his clients, Charlie is especially proud of one case where he helped shut down a dangerous trampoline park, and another case where he helped a hurricane-displaced family build a new home even though their insurance company had initially denied the claim.

Charlie Gustin is licensed to practice in all Texas state and federal courts. He is a member of the State Bar of Texas, the American Association of Justice, the North American Brain Injury Society, the Texas Trial Lawyers Association and serves on the Board of Directors of the Houston Trial Lawyers Association. Charlie was named Super Lawyers “Rising Star” for five (5) years in a row, a recognition given to less than 2.5% of the attorneys in Texas. Since 2022, Charlie has been selected as a “Super Lawyer” based on independent research and evaluations from his fellow Texas attorneys. Houstonia Magazine calls Charlie one of Houston’s “Top Lawyers.” Charlie served as co-counsel on a trial that resulted in a “Top 50 Texas Verdict” (2016), and secured both a “ Top 100 Texas Settlement” (2022), and the #1 Drunk Driving Settlement in Harris County (2023). Charlie’s advocacy on behalf of his clients has been reported by numerous media outlets, including The Dallas Morning News, The Austin American-Statesman, and Texas Lawyer.

attorneys.name: Patrick H. Gurski
attorneys.practice_type: Mass Tort Lawyers in Galveston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Patrick was born and raised in Beaumont, Texas. After graduating from Lamar University in 2004, Patrick moved to Austin where he served as a Journal Clerk in the Texas House of Representatives during the 79th Regular Session. He then served as Chief of Staff to State Rep. Dwayne Bohac of Houston during the 79th Special Sessions and the 80th Regular Session.

While attending South Texas College of Law in Houston, Patrick interned for the Eiland Law Firm helping to manage the firm’s Vaginal Mesh MDL cases as well as other commercial and personal injury cases. During law school, Patrick was mobilized and deployed with the Texas Army National Guard to Afghanistan where he served as an advisor to the Afghanistan Uniformed Police.

After passing the bar, Patrick moved to Victoria, TX where he served as a misdemeanor and felony prosecutor for the Victoria County Criminal District Attorney’s Office. Patrick left the DA’s office to join the law firm of Walker Keeling LLP, focusing primarily on insurance and civil defense as well as some criminal defense. In 2017, Patrick moved back to Galveston where he worked as a Senior Assistant District Attorney in the Galveston County Criminal District Attorney’s Office trying all types of cases from DWI’s to Murder and handling the office’s Human Trafficking caseload. Since becoming an attorney in 2015, Patrick has been the lead attorney or assisted in the trial of more than 50 criminal cases as both a prosecutor and defense attorney.

The Gurski Law Firm are able to handle all ranges of adult and juvenile criminal cases. Whether you are charged with Driving While Intoxicated, Assault, Possession of a Controlled Substance, or any other crime, our offices can handle any kind of criminal matter you have in front of you.

Patrick also works on several of the firm’s Mass Tort cases as well as handling the firm’s general civil litigation. Patrick is experienced in all forms of litigation including breaches of contract, breach of fiduciary duty, negligence, and first and third-party insurance claims.

attorneys.name: Victoria Haddad
attorneys.firm_name: Abraham, Watkins, Nichols, Agosto, Aziz & Stogner
attorneys.practice_type: Workplace Accidents Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Victoria Haddad is a native of Houston, Texas. Prior to attending law school, Victoria earned Bachelor of Arts degrees in Political Science and Criminology, Law & Society at the University of St. Thomas, where she received a full ride scholarship. Victoria graduated with Honors and was a member of the pre-law and mock trial programs. During her time at the University of St. Thomas, she was also a keynote speaker at various engagements aimed at fundraising for greater access to education.

At South Texas College of Law Houston, Victoria was a recipient of the Dean’s Merit Scholarship and worked as a law clerk while completing her studies. She was the Philanthropy Chair of the South Texas Women’s Law Society and a member of the Garland Walker Inn of Court. Prior to joining Abraham Watkins, Victoria’s passion for the law led her to spend five years in the legal field, gaining invaluable experience as an intern and law clerk focused on civil litigation.

Victoria’s journey at Abraham Watkins commenced with her participation in a significant case involving a chemical plant fire and explosion alongside Partner Benny Agosto. The team achieved a remarkable $28,591,000 verdict on behalf of five clients injured in the 2019 ExxonMobil Baytown Olefins Plant Explosion.

With her impressive academic background, experience, and relentless drive for justice, Victoria continues to be a formidable asset to the firm and a beacon of advocacy for her clients.

attorneys.name: Callie Haley
attorneys.practice_type: Civil and Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Callie Haley concentrates her practice in civil and commercial litigation including personal injury, wrongful death, premises liability, insurance defense, employment disputes, and construction defect litigation. She manages each case she is assigned with a strategic eye and her client's best interest in mind and is regularly called upon to evaluate challenging legal issues and develop litigation strategies for her clients.

Ms. Haley joined Wright & Greenhill, P.C. in 2018 after practicing for nearly two years with a national product liability defense firm. She brings with her experience drafting and managing motions practice for individual and complex litigation matters and in handling discovery and document production efforts for a large pharmaceutical mass tort litigation. Ms. Haley's hard work since joining Wright & Greenhill was recognized by Austin Monthly Magazine where she was named a Rising Star in Civil Litigation on the magazine's 2020 and 2021 Top Attorneys List. Ms. Haley has received the Rising Star selection through Texas Super Lawyers® magazine, an Internet Brands publication, for 2024 – 2025.

Ms. Haley was born and raised in Brenham, Texas and followed in her father's footsteps in becoming a lawyer. She moved to Austin after graduating from Tulane University Law School, where she served as the Interschool Appellate Moot Court Chairman and received a "Best Brief Award" for her work on the International Criminal Court Appellate Moot Court Team. While at Tulane, Ms. Haley clerked for the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of Louisiana and had the opportunity to serve as the second chair for a Fifth Circuit oral argument.

Ms. Haley is also active in her local community. She volunteers for Lone Star Legal Aid, Dress for Success, and the Junior League of Austin.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Richardson, TX
attorneys.bio:
In the heart of Dallas-Fort Worth, I stands as a beacon of unwavering commitment to justice. With over 50 trials under my belt, I have established a formidable reputation as a trial lawyer, passionately representing clients in the fields of personal injury, civil litigation, and family law.

From the moment I first stepped into the courtroom, I knew that the pursuit of justice would be my life's calling. With a Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from South Texas College of Law, I equipped myself with the knowledge, skills, and determination needed to navigate the intricate world of law.

I approach each case with meticulous preparation, unwavering determination, and a commitment to securing the best possible outcome for my clients.

In the realm of personal injury, I have zealously represented countless individuals who have suffered due to the negligence of others. Whether it's a car accident, slip and fall, or a catastrophic injury, I fiercely advocate for those who have been wronged, ensuring they receive the compensation they deserve.

In civil litigation, I am the advocate you want on your side in any legal dispute. My dedication to the pursuit of justice extends to a wide range of civil matters, from contract disputes to partnership disputes. I leave no stone unturned to protect the rights and interests of my clients.

In family law, I approach cases with a compassionate touch, recognizing the emotional turmoil that often accompanies such matters. Whether it's divorce, child custody, or spousal support, I provide not only legal guidance but also a strong shoulder to lean on during these trying times.

attorneys.name: Matthew D. Hamilton
attorneys.practice_type: Assault Lawyers in Sherman, TX
attorneys.bio:
Matt Hamilton joined the Robert T. Jarvis Law Firm in August, 2012, after more than two years as an assistant district attorney prosecuting cases in Grayson County and Collin County. He is a 2010 graduate of Creighton University Law School in Omaha, Nebraska, where he won the Moot Court Competition and was voted best orator. With an undergraduate degree in Accounting and an MBA in Finance, Matt is well equipped to handle any case involving money or finances.

Prior to entering law school, Matt earned a Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting at the University of Iowa. After graduation, he was hired by a Fortune 500 Company as an accountant overseeing and managing multi-million-dollar accounts. Experience in the financial world combined with business and law degrees gives Matt a unique perspective in his ability to evaluate and defend complex financial cases.

While prosecuting in the district attorney's office, Matt personally tried numerous cases to juries. In less than two years, he was chosen to assist in a capital murder trial, and was one of the youngest assistant district attorneys to successfully try a capital murder case. As a prosecutor, his responsibilities included reviewing and processing or rejecting cases filed by police agencies; conducting plea bargain negotiations; and preparing cases for jury and bench trials. The experience he gained as a prosecutor gives him a distinct advantage in defending persons charged with criminal conduct.

As a defense lawyer, Matt has represented clients charged with a wide range of misdemeanor, felony, and federal crimes. With an educational background in accounting and finance, he is uniquely qualified to handle fraud, embezzlement, and other cases involving mishandling of money. His experience as both prosecutor and defense lawyer gives him a distinct advantage in defending DWI, assault, drug cases, and many other criminal charges.

A fearless, forceful and innovative defense lawyer, Matt Hamilton is committed to fighting for his clients and finding the best resolution for a positive outcome.

attorneys.bio:
Cameron Hansen is a Trial Attorney in Rob Wiley P.C.’s Austin office, where he specializes in representing employees wrongfully terminated by their employer. Specifically, Mr. Hanson has a strong record in representing individuals who were discriminated against based on their disability, sex, sexuality, age or retaliated against for reporting wrongdoing. He prides himself on his work ethic, attention to detail, honesty, and effective communication.

Mr. Hanson has a passion for representing employees seeking redress of workplace wrongs. He takes satisfaction in giving a true voice to those who have been overlooked, mistreated, and discarded by holding employers responsible for their actions.

Prior to joining Rob Wiley P.C., Mr. Hanson represented employees against companies big and small in Minneapolis, Minnesota. He graduated from the University of Minnesota Law School with a Concentration in Labor and Employment Law. He was also the President of the Student Employment and Labor Association and was awarded the Award of Excellence in Labor Law by the Minnesota State Bar Association. Mr. Hanson also graduated from the University of Texas' College of Liberal Arts and is a proud longhorn. At the University of Texas, he studied Economics, focusing on labor economics.

attorneys.name: Mahmood Haque
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mahmood Haque is the Managing Attorney of Haque Law, PLLC, a healthcare and injury law firm based in Houston, Texas, with a dedicated team of over 18 staff members. With a decade of experience in healthcare operations, he represents clients in both the healthcare and personal injury sectors.

As both a legal professional and former healthcare executive, Mr. Haque brings a unique, insider perspective to the intersection of healthcare and personal injury law. His deep understanding of the industry allows him and his team to navigate the complexities of injuries, medical expenses, and healthcare-related challenges with unparalleled insight. At Haque Law, PLLC, we don’t just represent our clients—we truly understand what they are going through.

Before transitioning into traditional law, Mr. Haque spent five years in hospital executive management, serving as Chief Executive Officer of Woodlands Specialty Hospital, Interim Chief Executive Officer of Providence Hospital, and Executive Chief Operating Officer of Emergency Hospital Systems, LLC. In these leadership roles, he oversaw cost control, physician and employee relations, facility operations, and policy administration.

Prior to his hospital management roles, he played a key role in the development and operations of 14 multi-specialty clinics for US Pain and Spine, assisting in revenue growth and the establishment of policies, procedures, and protocols. His extensive background in healthcare operations shapes the strategic legal approaches he now employs for his personal injury clients.

Mr. Haque earned a Bachelor of Science in Political Science and Sociology from the University of Houston – Main Campus (2011) and a Doctor of Jurisprudence from South Texas College of Law (2015). He is licensed to practice law in Texas. His career began in pharmacy management before expanding into consulting for clinics and urgent care centers, where he also managed the full construction cycle of new medical facilities.

Born and raised in Dallas, Texas, David met his wife Janice, a San Marcos native, while attending class together at The University of Arkansas School of Law in Fayetteville. After graduating (and with a few stops along the way) Janice finally persuaded David that her hometown was the right place to open a new law firm in 2010. As with most things, it turned out Janice was right.

David is licensed to practice in all Texas courts, as well as the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas. He is a member of the National College for DUI Defense, the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, and the DUI Defense Lawyers Association. He is also a proud member of the College of the State Bar of Texas, an honor bestowed on less than 10% of Texas attorneys reflecting his firm commitment to continuing legal education, and has won numerous awards that reflect his ongoing commitment to earn the trust his clients' place in him every single day.

When not hard at work on his clients' cases, he enjoys playing and watching Razorback football and Jayhawk basketball, volunteering in the community, participating in recreational sports, and most of all spending time with his wife and beautiful daughters Adelaide and Willa.
