attorneys.name: Edward A. Mallett
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Edward Mallett is a native Houstonian and a seventh generation Texan. He is a graduate of Lamar High School, Dartmouth College, and the University of Texas, School of Law. His jobs and scholarships paid for his complete college and law school educations. He has served as President of the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, President of the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers and President of the Harris County Criminal Lawyers Association and, on June 17, 2016, was inducted into the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association’s Hall of Fame. Ed has served as a Special Prosecutor, appointed by the President of the State Bar of Texas. He is Board Certified in Criminal Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.

Ed is a Lamar H.S. graduate and returned to Houston after taking the Bar Examination, and has been in private practice ever since. His career in criminal defense started with court appointments. His early successes quickly led to retained cases, including serious felonies in state and federal courts. He is admitted to practice law in all courts in the State of Texas, the State of New York, many Federal Courts of Appeal and the United States Supreme Court.

Ed's academic career also includes attending the Graduate School of Business at the University of Chicago, ten years on the faculty of the University of Houston School of Law, fifteen years teaching at the National Criminal Defense College and more than 150 publications and presentations on criminal law to bar associations and law students throughout the United States.

attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Wimberley, TX
attorneys.bio:
Joe Malone is one of the founding members of Stevens & Malone, PLLC. As the son of a Naval Commander, Joe learned the value of service at an early age and is pleased to be able to serve his community both through legal services and pro-bono activities.

Joe attended Wheaton College, in Wheaton Illinois, where he obtained a Bachelor of Arts degree and majored in Political Science. Joe also started on the offensive line for the Wheaton Crusaders for three years. Joe went on to receive his law degree from Loyola University of Chicago. While in law school, Joe focused his studies on property law, estate planning and litigation.

Joe began his law career in the Chicago area working for two boutique civil litigation law firms. He was then invited by Mike Stevens and his partners to join the transactional practice here in Hays County. While Joe enjoyed the challenge and excitement of litigation, his easy-going personality made him a more natural fit for transactional work. Joe Malone and Mike Stevens co-founded the law firm of Stevens & Malone in 2007.

He is also a fee attorney for Independence Title Company with offices in Wimberley and Canyon Lake. attorneys.name: Michelle M. Maloney
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
As an attorney, Michelle works tirelessly to remedy wrongs caused by corporate greed, inattention to detail and the tragic tendency to place profits over patients. Michelle views every case as a chance to make our community safer; by drawing attention to basic patient safety violations that occur every day and claim lives across the United States, her goal is to prevent these horrific occurrences from happening to anyone else, and to get just compensation for her clients.

The first member of the next generation of Maloney attorneys, Michelle graduated cum laude from the University of San Francisco School of Law before moving back to San Antonio to practice with her mother, Marynell Maloney, a renowned advocate for the disenfranchised. Michelle has spearheaded sexual abuse cases that provided the means for the survivors to attend college and birth injury cases that provided for medical care and specialized therapies for the rest of the injured children's lives. Michelle's passion projects are cases involving the mistreatment and neglect of our elderly neighbors in San Antonio nursing homes. Though many attorneys will not take these cases because they are not seen as "profitable," Michelle believes that the nursing homes and the companies who staff doctors in nursing homes should and must be held accountable for negligent acts that maim, injure or kill vulnerable, elderly residents.

Michelle is licensed in Texas, and handles medical malpractice, nursing home negligence and wrongful death cases. Since joining the Marynell Maloney Law Firm, Michelle has achieved compensation for her clients and punished Defendants for their bad conduct to the tune of millions of dollars. Michelle has successfully represented clients in high stakes settlement negotiations and mediations and is honored that her clients have put their trust and futures in her hands. As Michelle works primarily with families who have been devastated by horrific injuries or the deaths of loved ones, she understands how difficult the lengthy, litigation process can be and she strongly believes that a lawyer's duty to her client is to listen first, advise second, and advocate always.

A passionate advocate for animals in her spare time, Michelle also handles some noteworthy animal law cases including the "Marley" and "Buddy" cases, which were striking victory for dogs and their owners in San Antonio. Michelle's eighteen-year-old Chihuahua, Arlo, can often be found napping under her desk.

attorneys.name: Brett Mangrum
attorneys.practice_type: Intellectual Property Lawyers in Waco, TX
attorneys.bio:
Brett Mangrum has over two decades of intellectual property experience derived from all sides of the table. He is a named inventor on eight issued U.S. patents, several of which he wrote personally. While attending law school at night, Brett continued to work fulltime as an engineer developing cutting-edge nanoelectromechanical systems. Before graduating within the top 10% of his J.D. class, Brett served as an editor of the law review, he was published twice, and he retired from his successful engineering position to join a respected national law firm, where he continued to work fulltime focusing primarily on patent prosecution and patent litigation.

In 2012, Brett transitioned to an in-house position as senior vice-president. His in-house responsibilities included overseeing monetization of the company’s extensive patent portfolio. This involved managing a team of in-house and external experts and working closely with external counsel on licensing and litigation efforts. While working in this complex role, Brett was named by DCEO Magazine as A Top Corporate Lawyer in Dallas-Fort Worth.

Dovetailing his diverse engineering and legal experiences together, Brett opened up a private legal practice in 2015 that he continued to grow for nearly a decade based largely on client referrals.

Brett’s present practice focuses primarily on helping clients to develop and monetize patent portfolios (including through litigation when necessary) and to defend the validity of their issued patents in post-grant review matters. In 2022, Brett ranked first nationally (by Patexia.com) as the most active inter parties review (IPR) attorney and, notwithstanding that volume, he also ranked eighth nationally that same year in achieving successful outcomes for patent owners. Brett’s extensive background enables him to efficiently recognize and master the complex technological and legal issues that matter most to a case.

attorneys.name: Molly A. Manning
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial & Business Litigation Lawyers in Lubbock, TX
attorneys.bio:
Molly Ann Manning is a partner in the firm's Lubbock office. Molly graduated from Colorado State University in 1996 with her B.A. in Business Administration and a minor in Agricultural Economics. Molly obtained her J.D. from Texas Tech School of Law in May of 1999. While at Texas Tech School of Law Molly was a member and of the Board of Barristers and was a repeat finalist and named best oralist in the Board of Barristers Moot Court Competitions, she was a Member and Casenote / Comment Editor of the Texas Tech Law Review, a Student Writer for the Texas Tech Law School Legal Research Board, and served as a volunteer mediator.

Prior to her joining the firm in February of 2004, Molly worked extensively in civil litigation including insurance defense, civil rights claim defense, municipality defense and employment litigation, wherein she gained a great deal of experience in both state and federal courts as well as extensive jury trial experience. Molly practices in the areas of employment, civil litigation, bankruptcy and adoption. Molly is a certified mediator.

Molly is a member of the Lubbock County Young Lawyers Association-for which she served as president (2006-07); president elect (2005-06), treasurer (2004-05) and secretary (2003-04), the Lubbock County Bar Association, the State Bar of Texas, the American Bar Association, and the Texas Association of Defense Counsel.

Molly is admitted to practice in the State of Texas, the State of Colorado and the U.S. District Courts of the Northern and the Western Districts of Texas .

For 2005 & 2006, Molly was named by the publishers of Texas Monthly as a "Texas Rising Star," recognizing her as one of the state's top lawyers under the age of 40. Molly was named the Outstanding Young Lawyer for Lubbock County for 2007.

Molly is an active member of the community and serves on various community boards and committees including the Ronald McDonald Charities of the Southwest. Molly and her husband are also very involved in their church.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Nikki Maples has been an active member of the family law community in Austin for over two decades. Her practice is exclusively dedicated to family law matters related to divorces and custody disputes. Her hallmark is her ability to take a creative and thoughtful approach when dividing marital assets in cases involving complex property matters such as businesses and high-net worth estates, but her experience is applicable to all family law matters.

Nikki is a passionate practitioner who is dedicated to helping families concerned about life beyond divorce or the result that divorce may have on children. Not every family law matter has to be a heartbreaking event. With that in mind, Nikki pursues divorce cases and all family law matters with creativity, compassion and sincerity, and her credo is rooted in authenticity.

When not with clients, Nikki is a dog lover, a foodie, a sailor, a snowboarder and an athlete who enjoys staying active and spending time with her family and others on the Greenbelt, supporting local businesses, and participating in local events. She is also longstanding member of the Austin Bar Lawyer Wellness program who has authored many monthly articles on issues related to health and wellness.

FUN FACT: Nikki is known (and teased) by her friends and family as being prone to unique and odd accidents, many of which result in hospital visits. Go ahead, ask her, she has a book of stories about her accidents, which she describes as “adventures.”

Her practice is exclusively dedicated to family law matters related to divorces and custody disputes. Her hallmark is her ability to take a creative and thoughtful approach when dividing marital assets in cases involving complex property matters such as businesses and high-net worth estates, but her experience is applicable to all family law matters.

Nikki is a passionate practitioner who is dedicated to helping families concerned about life beyond divorce or the result that divorce may have on children. Not every family law matter has to be a heartbreaking event. With that in mind, Nikki pursues divorce cases and all family law matters with creativity, compassion and sincerity, and her credo is rooted in authenticity.

When not with clients, Nikki is a dog lover, a foodie, a sailor, a snowboarder and an athlete who enjoys staying active and spending time with her family and others on the Greenbelt, supporting local businesses, and participating in local events. She is also longstanding member of the Austin Bar Lawyer Wellness program who has authored many monthly articles on issues related to health and wellness.

FUN FACT: Nikki is known (and teased) by her friends and family as being prone to unique and odd accidents, many of which result in hospital visits. Go ahead, ask her, she has a book of stories about her accidents, which she describes as “adventures.”

attorneys.firm_name: Abraham, Watkins, Nichols, Agosto, Aziz & Stogner
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Imrana Manzanares has been with Abraham Watkins since December 2009 and serves as the firm's Nurse Attorney. As both a nurse and a lawyer, Mrs. Manzanares not only litigates personal injury claims, but also reviews all of the firm's potential medical malpractice cases. To that end, she has reviewed in excess of 1,500 cases.

As the firm's Nurse Attorney, Mrs. Manzanares is well-versed in the elements that make a medical malpractice allegation viable in light of tort reform instituted in 2003. Once a case is accepted, Mrs. Manzanares is involved in both the pre-litigation and litigation process, seeing a case all the way through trial or settlement.

Mrs. Manzanares earned her Bachelors of Nursing from the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) in 2002. Passionate about caring for those most ill, she worked in the Texas Medical Center's Intensive Care Units. In 2004, Mrs. Manzanares began attending law school at the Thurgood Marshall School of Law. She found she could combine her nursing training with her legal training to assist patients and those most injured as a result of the negligence of another.

Married in 2004, Mrs. Manzanares spends her free time enjoying her two children, Amira and Rehan.

attorneys.name: Jane Mapes
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Bedford, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jane Mapes has been practicing law for 36 years and has devoted her practice to Family Law for the past 26 years, in Texas. Prior to relocating to Texas in 1996, she concentrated on real estate and personal injury law in the State of Florida, where she went to law school, and was admitted to the Bar in 1988. Upon moving to Texas, Ms. Mapes was admitted to the State Bar of Texas, and began practicing with a general practice law firm in Grand Prairie, where she familiarized herself with the courts in Tarrant and Dallas Counties. Jane then joined Bailey and Galyen in July, 1999, devoting herself to the exclusive practice of Family Law in the firm’s Irving office.

Jane’s commitment to accomplishing her client’s goals, with the primary purpose of ensuring the best interest of their children, has made her a fierce advocate in the courtroom, as well as a respected colleague in the dispute resolution forum. Jane has participated in almost daily court appearances throughout her tenure at Bailey & Galyen, and has mediated countless family law cases.

Her practice includes, but is not limited to assisting clients with issues such as pre- and post-marital agreements, adoptions, paternity determinations, divorce, child support and child custody modification and enforcement; grandparents’ access, name changes, post-divorce property matters, termination of parental rights, same-sex partnership agreements, CPS matters, annulment and any other matter affecting the family over which the State has jurisdiction.

Ms. Mapes has also been employed as an Assistant Attorney General for the State of Texas Child Support Division, concentrating on establishment, modification and enforcement of all child support issues.

In March, 2008, Jane participated as an Attorney Ad Litem in the State of Texas vs. YFZ, in San Angelo, Schleicher County, Texas, the largest and most notorious CPS removal of children from polygamous fundamentalist families in the State of Texas.

Jane has been a Board Member of the Dallas Bar Association Family Law Section, an Associate in the Annette Stewart Inns of Court, a member of both the Tarrant County and Dallas County Bar Associations, a member of the College of the State Bar of Texas, a “Top Attorney” in Fort Worth Magazine, and is currently a member of the Association of Family and Conciliatory Courts and the State Bar of Texas Family Law Section.

Jane has co-authored papers presented at both the State Bar of Texas 33rd Annual Marriage Dissolution Institute (May, 2010) and the State Bar of Texas 39th Annual Advanced Family Law Seminar (August, 2013).

Jane returned to practice in the Bedford Office of Bailey & Galyen in August, 2024, where she is the Managing Family Law Attorney in that location. Jane has been a resident of Grapevine for over 25 years, and enjoys the lake, hiking and biking trails and spending time with family and friends when not practicing law.

attorneys.name: Emily Marlowe
attorneys.practice_type: Mass Torts Lawyers in Round Rock, TX
attorneys.bio:
Emily Marlowe is a tenacious, results-driven trial attorney with years of complex commercial litigation, product liability, and mass tort experience. She is based in Round Rock, TX.

Experience on your side

Emily has obtained multi-million-dollar trial verdicts as second-chair trial counsel against some of the nation's largest companies, including 3M. She has litigated cases in state and federal courts across the country involving mass torts, high stakes product liability disputes, complex commercial litigation, complex first-party property insurance disputes, and RICO matters. She has helped her clients obtain more than $250 million in recoveries stemming from both trial verdicts and settlements.

Emily takes a proactive approach to every case in order to obtain the most efficient and beneficial result for her clients as possible. She has broad experience at all stages of litigation, including significant written and oral advocacy, as well as handling over 150 depositions as first-chair counsel. Most recently, Emily's practice has focused on the representation of thousands of U.S. Military service members suing 3M Company for its defective Combat Arms Earplugs sold to the U.S. Military for upwards of 15-years. She has been co-counsel and an integral part of the trial teams responsible for obtaining recent verdicts against 3M Company, including:

$55 million verdict - Ronald E. Sloan v. 3M, et. al., 7:20-cv-0001 (N.D. Fla.).

$1.8 million verdict - Lloyd E. Baker v. 3M, et. al., 7:20-cv-0039 (N.D. Fla.).

$7.1 million combined verdict - consolidated trial of Luke Estes (7:20-cv-0137), Stephen Hacker (7:20-cv-0131), and Lewis Keefer (7:20-cv-0104) v. 3M, et. al., (N.D. Fla.).

Emily's background also includes significant experience in complex commercial and insurance litigation. Representing both individuals and corporations in a variety of civil, property, and tax matters. Notable victories include but are not limited to:

Confidential $10+ million pre-litigation settlement of Hurricane Harvey first-party insurance dispute on behalf of YPI Properties.

$10 million settlement obtained on behalf of Brownsville Independent School District in a complex insurance dispute against Texas Windstorm Insurance Association, et. al.

Confidential multi-million dollar settlement on behalf of Cameron County Housing Authority in a complex insurance dispute against Texas Windstorm Insurance Association, et. al.

Obtained National Flood Insurance Policy limits of $126,000.00 on behalf of Clydine Morgan, in the matter of Morgan v. Texas Farmers Insurance Company (covered by multiple news media outlets).

Emily graduated from the University of Texas at Austin, where she obtained a Bachelor of Science, was a Dean's Honor Student, and a proud member of Alpha Epsilon Phi Sorority. She thereafter attended South Texas College of Law in Houston, Texas, where she was a Dean's Honor student and an award-winning member of the school's nationally-ranked Trial Advocacy program.

attorneys.practice_type: Will Contests Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Joe Marrs is a trial lawyer. He has represented clients in jury trials, arbitration, and bench trials throughout Texas. Mr. Marrs earned his law degree at the University of Texas, where he worked on the editorial board of the Texas Law Review. After graduation, he served as law clerk to the Honorable Guy Herman in the Travis County Probate Court Number One.

Since entering private practice, Mr. Marrs has tried multiple cases to jury verdict as lead counsel. He has won many types of cases for his clients, predominantly in trust and will contests, disputes involving fiduciaries, and probate procedure. Mr. Marrs believes in the idea that a trial lawyer should be prepared for any challenge, and he has cultivated a depth of experience in many areas of commercial litigation, representing Fortune 100 clients as well as individuals in business and tort disputes. He is a skilled, insightful, and aggressive advocate with the rare ability to master complex subjects and then translate them into clear language for juries and judges.

Mr. Marrs is admitted to practice in the United States District Courts for the Northern, Southern, Eastern, and Western Districts of Texas. He is also a member of the American Bar Association, the Houston Bar Association, the Austin Bar Association, and the Probate and Estate Planning section of the Houston Bar Association. He currently serves on the board of directors for the Estate Planning and Probate section of the Austin Bar Association.

In 2012, Mr. Marrs was rated "AV-Preeminent" by Martindale-Hubbell, the highest peer-review rating category.

attorneys.name: Sarah E. Marrone
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Frisco, TX
attorneys.bio:
Sarah E. Marrone is a Senior Attorney at Grinke Stewart Law. Sarah is an experienced family law attorney and facilitative mediator. Sarah strives to bring compassion to stressful and difficult situations and works with her clients to help them achieve their specific goals. Sarah understands how difficult family law matters can be. She has focused her practice on assisting her clients with obtaining their goals without needlessly tearing families apart. Sarah has always had a passion for helping others. As an attorney, Sarah prides herself on understanding her clients’ unique concerns and overall objectives.

As a mediator, Sarah’s goal is to create an environment that fosters communication, encourages creativity, and helps parties find a way to get what they really want out of a settlement. Sarah’s compassion and understanding help parties to feel heard so a mutually beneficial settlement can be obtained.

Sarah has experience litigating a wide range of family law cases, including experience handling complex divorces, high conflict child custody cases, high net worth property division, adoptions, terminations of parental rights, cases involving Child Protective Services, and family law appeals.

Sarah received her business degree from Texas Tech University and earned her law degree from Michigan State University College of Law. Sarah is licensed to practice law in Texas. She is a Director of the Collin County Bar Association (CCBA) Young Lawyers Section and a member of the Dallas Association of Young Lawyers (DAYL). She was selected to DAYL’s Leadership Class in 2017. Sarah was also selected to D Magazine’s Best Lawyers Under 40 list for 2022, 2023, and 2024, and the Thomson Reuters’ Super Lawyers Texas Rising Stars list for 2022, 2023, and 2024. In her free time, Sarah enjoys spending time with her three children, husband, and goldendoodle. Sarah also enjoys attending spin and Orangetheory classes.

attorneys.name: Fred Marsh
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal & Juvenile Law Lawyers in Denton, TX
attorneys.bio:
Fred is a partner with Marsh & Paine, P.C., and has more than 40 years of legal experience. He is Board Certified in Criminal Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.

Born in Pritchett Texas, a small community in East Texas, Fred attended high school in Gladewater, Texas. He attended Kilgore Junior College , and after a tour in the U.S. Air Force received his Associate degree. He received his Bachelor of Science Degree from the University of Houston, and his Juris Doctorate degree from the University of Houston, Bates College of Law.

When in law school, Fred clerked for Judge Barron on the 14th Court of Appeals. Upon graduating from law school Fred began his legal career as a solo practitioner in Houston. He was associated with Chuck Brink in Houston; was as Assistant City Attorney in Corpus Christi, Texas, an Assistant D.A. in Hidalgo County, Texas , where he rose to Chief Prosecutor. He served for almost 12 years as Chief Felony Prosecutor in Denton and several Texas Counties.

In 1987 Fred returned to practice as a solo practitioner until 2001, when he formed the law firm of Marsh & Odom L.L.P. In 2002 founded Marsh, Odom & Hansen, engaging in the general practice of law with an emphasis on criminal law, probate and civil litigation. Fred has represented clients in more than 3,000 cases, which included alleged crimes regarding:

White- Collar Crimes

Forgery

Credit Card Abuse

Computer Crimes

Capital Murder

DWI

Sexual Assault

Probation Revocation

Theft

Appeals

attorneys.name: Roxanne Martin
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Temple, TX
attorneys.bio:
Roxanne Martin is a family law attorney based out of The Carlson Law Firm's Temple office. Roxanne has a passion for representing people from all walks of life who seek legal guidance during difficult moments in their lives.

Experience on your side

The daughter of Jamaican immigrants, Roxanne was born in Detroit, Michigan, but raised in Decatur, Georgia. She decided to pursue a legal career because she has a heart for people dealing with difficult situations. Clients can count on her to fill the gaps that exist between the average person and the court system. Her ability to explain the law to clients to help them make decisions is why they choose Roxanne as their attorney.

Like many of her clients, Roxanne came to the Killeen area because of the military. While her husband is now retired, she and her husband fell in love with the community and decided to make it their permanent home. Because of her proximity to the military, she understands firsthand the challenges that many military families face as they navigate complex family law matters such as dealing with custody across state lines, asset division and more.

Roxanne graduated summa cum laude from the prestigious Howard University in 2013 with a Bachelor of Science in Psychology. She went on to receive her J.D. from Emory University School of Law in 2017. She is licensed to practice law in Georgia and Texas.

Prior to coming to The Carlson Law Firm, Roxanne worked for a small boutique firm in Georgia. Now, she handles all things family law at The Carlson Law Firm including divorce, adoption, child custody, child support, CPS, enforcements, modifications, name changes, pre and post-nuptial arrangements, and more.

She values her life experiences that have allowed her to mentor and uplift clients and her community. For example, before marrying her husband, Roxanne was a single mother while working her way through law school. Despite speed bumps along the way, she was able to accomplish her goals and uses her story to remind others that they can do the same. Through her practice, she hopes to be the beacon of hope that her clients need.

Roxanne believes that some of her biggest blessings come from working with her team to get positive results for her clients. She prides herself in the work that she and her coworkers are able to do for clients who come in with very little hope about their situations.

As a mother and wife, she understands the value of family and the importance of getting favorable and fair resolutions for all parties in family law matters.

When she is not representing clients, Roxanne loves her family more than anything. You can find her spending quality time with her husband, three daughters and son. Her family and devotion to her faith motivate her every day. She enjoys watching movies and is active in her church. She has plans to participate in more Central Texas community outreach programs.

attorneys.name: Chasity D. Martinez
attorneys.practice_type: Personal injury Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Chasity D. Martinez was born and raised in Dallas, Texas, and currently resides in Dallas, Texas. Chasity obtained an academic scholarship to attend Southern Methodist University where she obtained her undergraduate degree in Psychology. After graduation, she worked in the class action litigation department at a global law firm and soon decided to attend law school at The University of Oklahoma College of Law. While in law school, Chasity served as the President of the Board of Advocates and oversaw the administration of moot court competitions as well as mentored moot court competitors. Chasity graduated from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2012.

Upon graduation, Chasity began her legal career in the real estate industry but decided to transition to personal injury to have the opportunity to truly make a difference in her clients’ lives. Chasity has successfully litigated personal injury cases in state and federal court and has also represented clients on a national level in mass tort cases.

Adding color to her litigation pallete, Chasity joined the Dallas County District Attorney’s Office where she worked as a prosecutor and gained invaluable trial experience fighting for justice for Dallas County citizens. After a few years as a prosecutor, Chasity realized she wanted to utilize her trial skills in the personal injury arena to help those who have been injured due to the wrongful actions of others.

Outside of the office, Chasity enjoys spending time with family and friends, attending concerts, and traveling.

attorneys.name: Alejandro Martinez
attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of Alejandro Martinez, PLLC
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
FOUNDER

Alejandro Martinez

Upon earning his law license, Alejandro Martinez worked as a prosecutor for the Dallas City Attorney’s Office and Williamson County Attorney’s Office for 4 years before deciding to open his own criminal defense practice.

As a prosecutor, Alejandro handled thousands of criminal cases, honing his skills in case evaluation, negotiation, trial preparation, and trial. Further, he is extremely well-versed in the techniques and thought processes of the prosecution.

Alejandro utilizes his comprehensive understanding of Texas criminal prosecutions to fight for his clients. His background is your strength; if there is a legal problem with your case, Alejandro will find it.

BIO

Alejandro is a lifelong Texan. He was born and raised in San Antonio, attended college at the University of Texas at Austin and law school at Southern Methodist University in Dallas.

During law school, Alejandro developed a passion for criminal law and trial. Upon passing the bar, he initially pursued these passions by working as a prosecutor for the Dallas City Attorney’s Office. There he worked to develop his trial skills and learn as much as possible about being a successful advocate in the courtroom. In 2015, Alejandro began working as a prosecutor for the Williamson County Attorney's Office, often carrying more than 1000 cases at a time, including DWI, drug possession, family violence, theft, assault and more.

Now, Alejandro is an Austin criminal defense attorney. He is proud to defend clients throughout Travis, Williamson and Hays counties. This includes the cities of Austin, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander, San Marcos and more. He believes that everyone is entitled to a zealous defense and he uses his knowledge and experience to make sure that's exactly what his clients get.

In his free time, Alejandro enjoys playing basketball and spending time with his friends and family, including his pup “Bella.”

attorneys.name: Benigno Martinez
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Brownsville, TX
attorneys.bio:
Trey Martinez was born and raised in Brownsville, Texas. After completing high school at St. Joseph’s Academy in Brownsville, Texas, he had the good fortune of attending Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island. He received two majors, one in political science and one in psychology. He came back to Texas to go to law school at the University of Texas in Austin. While in law school, he was elected as class president. After graduation, he went on to be a law clerk to Judge Reynaldo G. Garza on the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals. Upon completing his clerkship, he became an Assistant United States Attorney. At the age of 25, besides being one of the youngest prosecutors the United States Government had ever hired, he successfully tried a number of cases to juries. He left the U.S. Attorney’s Office in 2000 and has since been a lawyer in private practice doing what he loves best; argue cases to juries, although now he concentrates on civil cases. He has been very successful in his practice and has now dedicated a lot of time to improving both the practice of law as well as defending the rights of those who cannot defend themselves. He serves on several statewide legal boards and is actively involved in the community. He loves spending time with his kids in their various activities and cooking for his family.

attorneys.name: Leticia Martinez
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Leticia "Letty" Martinez is a Board Certified Criminal Law specialist who has extensive experience handling state and federal criminal cases, including allegations of sexual abuse, intoxication-related offenses and violent crimes. Prior to becoming a partner at the Fort Worth criminal defense firm of Varghese Summerett, Letty established a name for herself as both a state and federal prosecutor. She began her service as a misdemeanor prosecutor at the Tarrant County District Attorney's Office, but quickly moved up the prosecutorial ladder. Over the next decade, she served in almost every unit and division within the District Attorney's Office, including Juvenile, Crimes Against Children, Gang and Family Violence. Above all else, Letty Martinez is a seasoned trial attorney who has tried more than 100 cases before Texas juries, including capital murders, murders, robberies, assaults, sexual assaults, and other aggravated felonies. attorneys.practice_type: Architect & Engineer Defense/E&O Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ramona Martinez is passionate about protecting the interest of her clients. As a founding member, she brings over 20 years of trial experience to address her clients legal needs. Due to her experience, she is called upon to represent clients in a variety of legal mater including employment litigation, tort litigation, transportation litigation, premises and product liability, construction defect and injury litigation and hospitality litigation. One of Texas Monthly's and Law & Politics magazine's "Texas Super Lawyers" for the past ten years; in 2008 she was also named one of the Top 50 Female Lawyers in the State of Texas and one of the Top 100 Lawyers in the State of Texas. Ms. Martinez is the 2007-2008 recipient of the State Bar of Texas President Award in recognition of her work as a founding member of the Dallas Diversity Task Force.

Representative Matters

Obtained defense verdict in a highly publicized jury trial of wrongful death/survival and negligence claims against a retailer that had sold a semi-automatic handgun to a man who later used it in a shooting rampage at the Tarrant County courthouse. The plaintiff victims sought over $30 million in damages.

Successfully obtained summary judgment on behalf of major airline involving claims of wrongful termination, ADA and FMLA (affirmed by U.S. Supreme Court).

Handled the defense of a trucking company and truck driver in one of Texas' deadliest crashes.

Obtained a nominal settlement in a dram shop claim involving a major sports and arena vendor for injuries resulting from an altercation on the premises.

Obtained numerous dismissals – no settlement paid – on products liability claims against a major automatic door manufactures.

Handled the defense of over 800 premises case.

Handled the defense of over 200 transportation cases including automobile and truck accidents.

Represented pharmacists in mass tort/pharmaceutical litigation involving VIOXX and Baycol.

attorneys.name: Blair Maslowski
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Blair C. Maslowski is an employment and civil litigation attorney at Coane and Associates. She received a Bachelor of Arts Degree from Saint Louis University with a double major in Philosophy and Fine Arts, then relocated to Southern California to attend law school at Western State University in Irvine. Ms. Maslowski also studied abroad twice, earning certificates in Mediation and International Law from Tulane University in Berlin, Germany, and in Italian Language in Florence, Italy.

Ms. Maslowski grew up in Illinois. Her previous work experience includes plaintiff employment and wage cases in California before relocating to Texas with her family in late 2018. She has served as a non-profit director for multiple organizations, at the Fort Bend County Attorney’s Office, and is a former Texas Assistant Attorney General. Ms. Maslowski has successfully handled a variety of civil matters ranging from employment, wage cases, family law, consumer/DTPA, personal injury, tort, contract, and property cases.

Ms. Maslowski is dedicated to providing her clients with compassionate and thorough representation, illustrated by dozens of 5-star client reviews and hundreds of settled cases. In her free time, she enjoys spending time with family and friends, swimming, yoga, traveling, reading copious amounts of non-fiction and playing outside.

attorneys.name: Blake Matthys
attorneys.practice_type: Admiralty & Maritime Law Lawyers in Killeen, TX
attorneys.bio:
Blake Matthys is a personal injury lawyer in Killeen, Texas who primarily focuses on car accident cases. He says his number one priority is that his clients know that they're being heard and that he's there for them. Although Blake has experience in other kinds of law, his passion for helping people made his choice to practice personal injury law an easy one.

Experience on your side

Before he came to The Carlson Law Firm, Blake worked at The Law Office of Larry A. Matthys, P.C. in San Antonio, where he practiced Subrogation, Insurance Defense, Contractual Litigation, and more. Blake feels that his experience, particularly in Insurance Defense, gives him an advantage over other attorneys because he knows how the defense thinks and works in personal injury cases.

Blake has practiced in District, County, Probate, and Justice of the Peace Courts all around the state of Texas. In addition, Blake was admitted to the Texas State Bar in November of 2017. With experience from Amarillo to Brownsville and Texarkana to El Paso, Blake is ready for any and all civil matters.

According to Blake, his favorite part of his job is representing actual people and helping them when they have been wronged. Blake says he feels most proud of his work when clients thank him for helping them. In fact, a genuine expression of gratitude was the factor that helped Blake solidify his passion for helping people and choose to work at The Carlson Law Firm.

Currently, Blake lives in Georgetown, where he says he wants to stay for a very long time. In his free time, Blake likes to golf and play with his dog, Spike.

attorneys.name: Eric Mauro
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Mesquite, TX
attorneys.bio:
Eric Mauro’s path to becoming an attorney began with a commitment to service. He joined the U.S. Army as a Cavalry Scout in 2004, and while the military brought him to Texas, it was the community that made him stay. That same sense of service continues to guide him today as he helps families and small business owners plan for the future with clarity and confidence.

Eric’s practice focuses on estate planning, probate, and business law. He was drawn to these areas because they allow him to support people through meaningful life transitions, whether that’s preparing a will, navigating the probate process, or starting and protecting a business. His approach is educational and thorough; he takes the time to explain every step so clients never leave feeling uncertain or overwhelmed.

Eric earned his Bachelor of Science in Communication Sciences and Disorders from Texas Woman’s University, where he focused on Deaf Education and connecting with underserved communities. He later earned his law degree from Baylor Law School, receiving a distinction in Estate Planning, and went on to complete an LL.M. in Taxation at the University of Denver Sturm College of Law.

His years in the Army taught him the importance of preparation, adaptability, and follow-through, values that shape how he practices law today. That military discipline carries into his everyday life as well, whether he’s spending time outdoors with his dogs, traveling with his wife, or smoking barbecue on the weekends.

For Eric, the law isn’t just about documents — it’s about helping people protect what matters most and empowering them to move forward with confidence.

attorneys.name: Larry "Max" Maxwell
attorneys.practice_type: Hospital Law Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Larry "Max" Maxwell is a member of the State Bar of Texas and is Board Certified in Health Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, and has maintained this certification since 2002. He has practiced exclusively in health law, primarily representing the provider community. This practice has spanned more than three decades focused on the interests of individual physicians and physician groups, hospitals, and other licensed facilities including independent diagnostic testing facilities, nursing homes, home health agencies, and durable medical equipment suppliers. He is currently retained general counsel for Texas hospitals operated by a national hospital system. His non-hospital practice counsels an array of health service professionals in their practice settings and enterprises that serve health service professionals.

Hospital Law Practice

For-profit, non-profit tax exempt and governmental facilities and related foundations, and affiliated physician groups

Professional service agreements

Medical office space leases

Medical equipment leases

Medical staff bylaws and rules and regulations

Medical staff credentialing and peer review actions (including hearing officer role); Health Care Quality Improvement Act;

Hospital-physician joint venture development and offerings

Development of non-profit health corporations for physician employment and employment agreements including restrictive covenant issues (Texas

Business & Commerce Code)

Physician practice acquisition agreements

Patient rights including consent, advance directives, durable power of attorney for health care decisions

Federal Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act ("EMTALA") and Texas Indigent Care and Treatment Act; Patient transfers

Physician Law Practice

Counseling solo and group physician practices

Preparation of documents for professional associations, professional limited liability companies and partnerships and professional corporations

Development of ownership interest documents (shareholder agreements, PLLC membership interest agreements, buy-sell agreements)

Employment agreements for senior and junior group physicians

Physician Recruitment and Income Guarantee Assistance agreements

Professional Service and Medical Director agreements with facilities (hospitals, surgery centers, nursing homes, home health agencies and other licensed facilities)

Texas Occupations Code

Imaging Centers and Ambulatory Surgery Centers

Development of startup ventures including entity formation, joint venture offerings, private placement memorandums

Review joint venture investment opportunities

Prepare professional service agreements

Compliance

Regulatory compliance review for Stark, Anti-Kickback, False Claims and Civil Monetary Penalty statute (Safe Harbors, OIG Advisory Opinions, Special Fraud Alerts, Physician Referral Law Exceptions, Federal Elements and Guidance for Compliance Programs, Federal Sentencing Guidelines)

Adherence to state corporate practice of medicine requirements

Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act ("HIPAA") and Health Information Technology and For Economic and Clinical Health Act" ("HITECH") privacy review and review and preparation of business associate agreements

State and federal antitrust review (Statements of Antitrust Enforcement Policy in Health Care)

State licensure (Texas Health & Safety Code, Texas Administrative Code), Joint Commission accreditation and Medicare Conditions of Participation

attorneys.name: Taylor Mauro
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Mesquite, TX
attorneys.bio:
Taylor Mauro is a passionate and trial-tested attorney who focuses her practice on family law and civil litigation. A former prosecutor with extensive courtroom experience, Taylor thrives in high-stakes situations and brings a calm, steady hand to clients facing some of the most challenging moments in their lives.

Taylor became a lawyer out of a deep interest in government and a personal calling to help people. Today, she’s driven by that same purpose—helping individuals and families navigate the legal system with clarity, confidence, and compassion. Whether advocating in a custody dispute or litigating a complex civil matter, she combines sharp legal skills with a genuine willingness to listen.

Before entering private practice, Taylor served as an Assistant District Attorney in Dallas and Tarrant Counties, where she prosecuted cases at all levels—from misdemeanor offenses to the most serious felony charges. That experience taught her how to manage intense pressure, prepare thoroughly, and make compelling arguments when it matters most—all skills she now uses to fight for her clients.

Taylor earned her law degree from Baylor University School of Law, where she was recognized as a Public Interest Fellow for her extensive volunteer work. She holds a B.A. in Political Science, cum laude, from the University of North Texas, and is licensed to practice in Texas.

Outside of the courtroom, Taylor enjoys spending time with her husband and their two dogs, reading, traveling to new places, and cooking with her family.

attorneys.name: Stephen C. Maxwell
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Steve Maxwell is a native Texan, born in Amarillo and raised in Midland. He attended Trinity University where he received his Bachelor of Arts Degree in 1972. He then received his law degree from the University of Texas of Austin in 1975. He moved to Fort Worth upon his graduation from law school.

He served as an Assistant City Attorney for the City of Fort Worth from 1976 to 1977. After leaving the City Attorney's office, he has been in private practice ever since. He currently is a partner with the Bailey & Galyen Law Firm, where he specializes in civil litigation with an emphasis on personal injury litigation. He has been board-certified in personal injury trial law since 1984.

Steve has served as President of the Fort Worth Jaycees (1979-1980), President of the Tarrant County Trial Lawyers Association (1989-1990), and President of the Tarrant County Bar Association (1999-2000). He has also served as an elected director of the State Bar of Texas (2001-2004). He has been recognized as an "Attorney of Excellence" by the Fort Worth Business Press from 2003 to 2005, and has also been recognized as a "Fort Worth Texas Top Attorney" by Fort Worth, Texas Magazine from 2016 to 2017. Texas Monthly Magazine has recognized Steve as a "Texas Super Lawyer" every year since 2004. He has been listed in the Fort Worth Business Press "Who's Who" for 2001, and in the "Who's Who in Texas" for 1990. He was recognized as an "Outstanding Young Man of America" in 1980. In 2012, he was honored by the Tarrant County Bar Association with the "Professionalism Award."

Steve served as the Chairman of the Tarrant County Democratic Party for five years, a post to which he was elected in 2008. He was re-elected twice to that position. He attended the Democratic National Convention in 2008, and serves as a delegate to the Texas Democratic Convention.

Steve's trial practice has included over one hundred jury trials, including Consumer and Deceptive Trade Practice Act cases, medical malpractice cases, and commercial litigation. He has also served as a mediator for more than twenty years. Steve has successfully mediated more than five hundred cases. He has previously served as a Board Member, and as Vice President, of Dispute Resolution of Tarrant County.

He and his wife, Ivy, have three children, two grandchildren and a menagerie of pets.

attorneys.name: Dakota Mayr
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Frisco, TX
attorneys.bio:
Dakota Mayr is the newest associate attorney at Pfister Family Law. Although new as an attorney, she’s been working with the PFL family for over a year helping John Pfister and Phillip Moore with all aspects of their cases from drafting, preparing arguments, and shadowing them in court.

Her fierce competitiveness and compassion for others give her a unique advantage in approaching her client’s cases.

A graduate of The University of North Texas Dallas College of Law, Dakota was active within the student body as Vice President of the Women in Law Student Society and the Junior Representative for TYLA. She spent over 300 hours in the university’s clinic where she helped indigent families gain access to fair justice in the courtroom.

Dakota completed her undergraduate degree at Stephen F. Austin State University where she was a college pole vaulter. Her history as a collegiate athlete gives her an edge in high-pressure situations, which in turn allows for the best results for her clients, no matter what the obstacle.

In understanding how taxing family law cases can be, Dakota understands the importance of having someone in your corner willing to fight for the most important things in your life. “I know that life happens and sometimes life takes unexpected turns when it comes to family matters. My goal is to approach each client with the compassion and competitiveness as I would if they were my own family.”

attorneys.name: Michael A. McCabe
attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Michael A. McCabe is a Partner at Munck Wilson Mandala, and is a member of the Firm's Labor and Employment Section. He has been Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in Labor and Employment Law since 2004. Mr. McCabe has been repeatedly recognized as a Texas Super Lawyer Rising Star, and has been voted by D Magazine as one of the Best Lawyers in Dallas.

Mr. McCabe concentrates his practice on the defense of businesses in complex business and employment litigation matters. He frequently prosecutes and defends claims alleging theft of trade secrets, breach of non-competition agreements, confidentiality agreements, non-solicitation agreements and fiduciary duty. As part of his practice, Mr. McCabe also represents employers in all aspects of discrimination, wrongful termination, tort, contract, defamation and class action lawsuits.

Mr. McCabe has successfully defended a number of large companies in Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) collective action lawsuits and Department of Labor investigations alleging failure to pay overtime wages to hundreds of employees.

Mr. McCabe frequently negotiates and prepares executive employment agreements and covenants not to compete for employers. He also counsels clients on labor and employment issues inherent to mergers and acquisitions. On a daily basis, he advises the firm's clients on employment practices with an eye toward deterring or preventing employment-related disputes, litigation and unionization. He also conducts strategy sessions and communication planning relating to workplace change (i.e. layoffs, shutdowns, reorganizations, changes in benefits and policies, etc.).

Mr. McCabe is a frequent speaker on labor and employment topics, having lectured at numerous continuing legal education seminars, meetings of organizations, and management training courses. Mr. McCabe has served on the Planning Committee for the Texas State Bar's Advanced Employment Law Course, and also has authored publications on various employment-related topics appearing in nationally recognized legal publications, including those published by the American Health Lawyers Association and the American Bar Association. He is a frequent commentator on legal issues inherent to electronic discovery and document retention.

Upon graduation from law school, Mr. McCabe clerked for Federal District Judge John H. McBryde in Fort Worth, Texas. Immediately prior to joining Munck Wilson Mandala, Mr. McCabe worked for six years in the Labor and Employment practice group of Haynes and Boone, LLP in Dallas, Texas.

attorneys.name: Ron C. McCallum
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury - Plaintiff Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ron was born in Dallas, Texas, and attended high school at Missouri Military Academy. After completing majors in sociology and professional aviation at the University of Oklahoma and graduating in 1997, Ron began his career as a professional pilot. While maintaining his career as a pilot, he earned his J.D. from South Texas College of Law in 2001, where he was a member of the International Law Journal.

Ron’s original practice consisted of representing aviation entities and pilots, while maintaining his aviation career as a full-time pilot instructor and charter captain. He then broadened his practice to include catastrophic personal injury law and wrongful death, including truck and bus accidents, oil field explosions, aviation disasters, and workplace injuries. Ron continues to exercise his pilot privileges and maintains his Airline Transport Permit and pilot instructor ratings.

Throughout his career, Ron has tried numerous catastrophic injury cases with success. This is reflected by Ron being awarded the highest possible rating in both legal ability and ethics by Martindale-Hubbell (AV Preeminent), as well as being selected as a Texas Super Lawyer for four consecutive years. Ron has also been selected as a Texas Rising Star by Super Lawyers in 2011, 2012 and 2013. Most recently, Ron was selected as one of the top trial lawyers in Texas by The National Trial Lawyers Association.

Ron is a member of the American Bar Association and Dallas Bar Association. He is also an active member of the American Association of Justice, the Texas Trial Lawyers Association and serves as a Board Member of the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association.

attorneys.name: Jeffery A. McCarn
attorneys.firm_name: McCarn, Weir, & Sherwood Attorneys at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Oil and Gas Litigation Lawyers in Amarillo, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jeffery A. McCarn, a distinguished attorney certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in the field of oil, gas and mineral law, is a dedicated professional at McCarn, Weir, & Sherwood Attorneys at Law located in Amarillo, Texas. With a focus on oil and gas-related transactions and litigation, he extends his legal service across multiple states, including Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, and North Dakota.

Mr. McCarn possesses extensive experience in providing legal representation to oil and gas enterprises across a spectrum of transactional and litigation matters within the oil and gas sector. His portfolio includes the adept management of numerous oil and gas matters pertaining to exploration and production operations, encompassing an array of issues from initial lease acquisitions to the divestiture of producing assets. While a substantial portion of these oil and gas matters primarily pertain to transactions, he has also capably navigated intricate oil and gas litigation, spanning lease and title disputes to tort-related claims.

In recent endeavors, Mr. McCarn successfully facilitated a company's divestment of both operated and non-operated oil and gas interests spanning 53 counties in New Mexico, Texas, and Oklahoma. Preceding this achievement, he spearheaded a comprehensive due diligence project for a company's acquisition of approximately 47,000 net acres situated in five counties in Oklahoma. Additionally, he played a pivotal role in a three-year project focused on acquiring 400,000 acres in the Texas Panhandle and several other resource-rich regions, including Oklahoma, Mississippi, Alabama and upstate New York. Furthermore, he adeptly handled and supervised a spectrum of challenges, including claims, regulatory matters and litigation arising from each of these resource plays.

Mr. McCarn holds a Bachelor of Arts degree in business, with a particular emphasis on management. His collegiate journey was distinguished by a continuous pursuit of academic excellence, as evidenced by the numerous honors he received. During his time at the university, he actively engaged in various community initiatives, underscoring his profound commitment to societal involvement.

Subsequent to completing his undergraduate studies, Mr. McCarn pursued legal studies at St. Mary's University School of Law, culminating in the attainment of his J.D. cum laude in 2006. His scholastic prowess consistently merited his inclusion on the dean's list, attesting to his unwavering dedication to legal studies. Furthermore, his exceptional achievements led to his induction into the prestigious John M. Harlan Society.

Mr. McCarn holds licenses to practice law in the states of Texas, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and North Dakota. Beyond his legal practice, he maintains an active membership with the State Bar of Texas, the Oklahoma Bar Association, the State Bar of New Mexico, the State Bar Association of North Dakota, the Amarillo Area Bar Association, the Panhandle Association of Petroleum Landmen, and the Panhandle Producers & Royalty Owners Association.

attorneys.name: Levi G. McCathern II
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Levi G. McCathern, II is recognized as one of the premier litigation lawyers in Texas. He is Board Certified in both Civil Trial Law and Labor and Employment Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization – a double certification held by only 26 of the 87,000 attorneys in Texas.

He specializes in catastrophic damage litigation and is frequently summoned to defend specialized, high-damage claims, including all types of commercial litigation. In addition, he has served as lead counsel for numerous jury trials and is regularly called upon to provide legal consultation to companies throughout the country. Levi serves as primary trial counsel for the Dallas Cowboys Football Club, Ltd., the Jerry Jones Family and their related entities, and is panel counsel for some of the world's largest companies in the specialty areas of Business Litigation, Directors & Officers Liability, Employment Law, Advertising Injury, and more.

He has been named to Super Lawyers' coveted group of elite practitioners in Texas for more than 15 years. He achieved this milestone in 2003 and 2004 and every year from 2008 through 2019. Levi has been selected as one of the Best Lawyers in Dallas by D Magazine for Business/Commercial Litigation in 2016 & 2014 and for General Corporate Law in 2012. He is also listed as one of America's Top 100 Best -The Company Litigators.

In 1993, Levi was licensed to practice law in Texas. He started as an associate with Godwin & Carlton, P.C. and, in less than 5 years, was named as the youngest shareholder in the firm's history. On October 1, 1998, Levi founded McCathern Wadlington Mooty, LLP. He is licensed to practice in Texas and New York, and is admitted for practice in all Texas state and federal district courts, the U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, all state courts in New York, and all federal district courts of Arkansas.

Levi was born in the small town of Perryton, Texas and obtained a Bachelor of Arts magna cum laude from Baylor University in 1990, where he was selected Phi Beta Kappa. In 1993, he earned a Juris Doctorate from Baylor University, where he became a member of the Order of Barristers. While in school, Levi served as Pastor of the First Baptist Church of Travis, Texas. Levi brings an “everyman”perspective to his vibrant practice that juries love and is seldom found in Texas litigation. His strength is the same both in and out of the courtroom — relating to all people, from blue collar workers to CEOs, on their level.

Levi has been interviewed and quoted by many leading media organizations, including CNN, ABC, NBC, CBS, Fox News, The Today Show, The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, The Dallas Morning News, Dallas Business Journal, Fort Worth Star-Telegram, Austin American-Statesmen, and The Houston Chronicle.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Levi G. McCathern, II is recognized as one of the premier litigation lawyers in Texas. He is Board Certified in both Civil Trial Law and Labor and Employment Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization – a double certification held by only 26 of the 87,000 attorneys in Texas.

He specializes in catastrophic damage litigation and is frequently summoned to defend specialized, high-damage claims, including all types of commercial litigation. In addition, he has served as lead counsel for numerous jury trials and is regularly called upon to provide legal consultation to companies throughout the country. Levi serves as primary trial counsel for the Dallas Cowboys Football Club, Ltd., the Jerry Jones Family and their related entities, and is panel counsel for some of the world's largest companies in the specialty areas of Business Litigation, Directors & Officers Liability, Employment Law, Advertising Injury, and more.

He has been named to Super Lawyers' coveted group of elite practitioners in Texas for more than 15 years. He achieved this milestone in 2003 and 2004 and every year from 2008 through 2019. Levi has been selected as one of the Best Lawyers in Dallas by D Magazine for Business/Commercial Litigation in 2016 & 2014 and for General Corporate Law in 2012. He is also listed as one of America's Top 100 Best -The Company Litigators.

In 1993, Levi was licensed to practice law in Texas. He started as an associate with Godwin & Carlton, P.C. and, in less than 5 years, was named as the youngest shareholder in the firm's history. On October 1, 1998, Levi founded McCathern Wadlington Mooty, LLP. He is licensed to practice in Texas and New York, and is admitted for practice in all Texas state and federal district courts, the U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, all state courts in New York, and all federal district courts of Arkansas.

Levi was born in the small town of Perryton, Texas and obtained a Bachelor of Arts magna cum laude from Baylor University in 1990, where he was selected Phi Beta Kappa. In 1993, he earned a Juris Doctorate from Baylor University, where he became a member of the Order of Barristers. While in school, Levi served as Pastor of the First Baptist Church of Travis, Texas. Levi brings an “everyman”perspective to his vibrant practice that juries love and is seldom found in Texas litigation. His strength is the same both in and out of the courtroom — relating to all people, from blue collar workers to CEOs, on their level.

Levi has been interviewed and quoted by many leading media organizations, including CNN, ABC, NBC, CBS, Fox News, The Today Show, The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, The Dallas Morning News, Dallas Business Journal, Fort Worth Star-Telegram, Austin American-Statesmen, and The Houston Chronicle.

attorneys.bio:
Elizabeth is a graduate of Fordham University in New York, where she earned her Bachelor of Arts in Economics. After graduation, she began her career as a Portfolio Administrator with State Street Bank.

She later attended Suffolk University Law School in Boston, Massachusetts, where she gained practical experience through the Spanish-language landlord/tenant clinic, Su Clínica Legal. Following law school, Elizabeth worked in New York and Washington, D.C., focusing on FCPA investigations, Second Request matters, and antitrust litigation.

While in Washington, D.C., Elizabeth met and married an active-duty Army soldier stationed at the Pentagon. Her experience as a military spouse gave her valuable insight into the unique challenges faced by military families—insight she now brings to her work handling military divorces and child custody disputes.

Since 2017, Elizabeth has dedicated her practice to family law. Known for her compassionate approach, she strives to make clients feel supported and at ease during what can be one of the most difficult times in their lives.

“Justice consists not in being neutral between right and wrong, but in finding out the right and upholding it, wherever found, against the wrong.”

— Theodore Roosevelt

Shane McClelland is the founder of the Law Office of Shane McClelland, based in Katy, Texas.

Shane represents clients throughout Katy, Harris and Ford Bend Counties, the greater Houston metropolitan area, and throughout Texas, Colorado, and Nebraska in personal injury cases.

His practice focuses primarily on personal injury litigation. Shane advocates on behalf of his clients, where the negligence of others has caused them harm. He serves his clients by giving them the personalized representation they deserve.

Shane represents people injured in motor vehicle crashes, truck collisions, construction site injuries, oil field disasters, and premises liability matters.

Shane has obtained significant compensation for his clients. And throughout his career, Shane has earned considerable recognition from his colleagues, including being chosen as a Super Lawyer, Super Lawyer Rising Star, having a 10.0 review rating on Avvo.com, and being chosen as one of the best lawyers in Houston by Houstonia Magazine.

Shane received his legal education at South Texas College of Law Houston, where he served as an editor of the South Texas Law Review before earning his Juris Doctor in 2004. During law school, Shane interned for United States District Court Judge George Hanks. And after law school, Shane clerked for United States District Court Judge Marcia Crone. He is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the Southern, Eastern, Western, and Northern Districts of Texas, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit, and state courts in Colorado and Nebraska.

Shane has written and co-authored numerous articles and given several speeches.

Should you have any questions, please contact Shane via telephone 713-242-1302.

attorneys.name: Caroline A. McClimon
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Bastrop, TX
attorneys.bio:
Caroline A. McClimon, was admitted to practice law by the State Bar of Texas in 2009 and is Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. In addition to being an active litigator, Ms. McClimon presides as the Judge for the City of Bastrop and is the President of the Bastrop County Bar Association.

Ms. McClimon received her B.A. degree in Political Science from Southern Methodist University in 2005. While pursuing her undergraduate degree, Ms. McClimon was the recipient of academic and athletic scholarships and lettered in Women's Varsity Crew. Ms. McClimon received her J.D. from the University of Oklahoma College of Law.

While in law school, Ms. McClimon served as assistant editor of Oklahoma Law Review, received an American Jurisprudence (Am. Jur.) Award for Agricultural Environmental Law and served as President of the Christian Legal Society and Secretary of the Oklahoma International Law Society. Ms. McClimon was also a member of the Jessup Moot Court Team from 2007 to 2008. Ms. McClimon has previously worked for United States Senator John Cornyn and on several grassroots campaigns.

Prior to founding McClimon Family Law and merging law practices with Joe Grady Tuck to form Tuck McClimon, Ms. McClimon worked at a firm in Dallas where she obtained invaluable experience representing several thousand plaintiffs in litigation involving mass tort, breach of contract, and antitrust claims. Ms. McClimon also represented HOAs and landowners in several administrative hearings before the Texas Railroad Commission and helped in negotiating and drafting mineral leases that were favorable to landowners.

Since relocating to Bastrop County in 2011 where her husband was born and raised, Ms. McClimon began to focus her practice on family law, estate planning, and probate matters. Ms. McClimon has more than 15 years’ experience in the courtroom and maintains a strong professional reputation for her litigation and courtroom skills. Ms. McClimon has extensive experience with jury trials involving family law matters (ranging from divorce to child custody) and had a jury award her client $1,000,000.00 in punitive damages in a suit to terminate the other parent's parental rights.

Ms. McClimon's philosophy on the practice of Family Law, whether it is a divorce or child custody matter, is that utilizing creative and practical solutions will afford the client the best results as each situation is unique to their personal situation. Specifically, Ms. McClimon truly believes that due to the emotional and complex nature of divorce and child custody that in order to be an effective and zealous advocate it is important to understand each client's particular circumstances instead of attempting to apply a "one-size fits all" approach to resolving their case, whether it is a complex property division or managing high-conflict custody disputes dealing with significant issues; family violence, child support enforcement actions, modifications of previous orders, grandparent rights, termination and paternity issues.

In addition to her zealous representation of her clients, Ms. McClimon is passionate about giving back to the community, and she is active in many local, regional, and national non-profit organizations, giving both her time and talent to further their missions. She served as President (2021-2023, 2025, & 2016-2018) and Vice President (2019-2020, 2024) of the Bastrop County Bar Association and has been a member of that organization since 2014. Ms. McClimon has also dedicated time to the Smithville community by serving as Treasurer of the Smithville Chamber of Commerce (2016–2018) and as a Commissioner on the City of Smithville Planning & Zoning Commission (2015-2018). Ms. McClimon is also a member of the Smithville Noon Lions Club (and has served on its Board of Directors) and is an active member of the Family Law Section of the Texas State Bar Association, Austin Bar Association, Williamson County Bar Association, and the American Bar Association.

In 2019, she was selected as a Rising Star by Texas Super Lawyers, Thomson Reuters, and in 2020 as one of the Top Texas Women Attorneys, published in both Super Lawyers Magazine and Texas Monthly Magazine. Ms. McClimon was again selected as a Rising Star by Texas Super Lawyers in 2020 through 2022 and has continued to receive that accolade in subsequent years. In 2024, Ms. McClimon was selected as a Super Lawyer. Ms. McClimon also maintains a 10.0 Rating with Avvo.

In April 2019, Ms. McClimon was appointed to Associate Judge for the City of Bastrop and then made Presiding Judge in March 2023.

In her free time, Ms. McClimon enjoys spending time with her three children and husband around Central Texas and hiking at different state parks throughout Texas.

Kaye McCollum is an associate attorney at The Cole Law Firm. She is dedicated to serving injured people and their families and is very responsive to her clients. She is passionate about holding people and companies responsible for negligence, which brings attention to safety issues and creates safer conditions for us all. She became a personal injury attorney because she feels it is very meaningful work. She is interested in people, their families, and their stories, and enjoys working closely with her clients. She will fight to protect her clients during a very difficult time in their lives.

Outside of work, Kaye enjoys spending time with her three wonderful children, family, and friends. She also enjoys cooking healthy, Pilates, traveling, and hiking.

attorneys.name: Sean A. McConnell
attorneys.practice_type: Birth Injuries Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
“All of my clients have suffered a tragedy, but none of them ever give up. I channel that bravery and grit and fight hard to get my clients justice.”

Heart is the word that describes Sean’s approach to his clients’ cases. Sean is sensitive to the personal struggles and inspired by the resilience of those who have been seriously injured or lost a loved one due to negligence. He is compassionate to the challenges his clients face and channels their determination when advocating in the courtroom.

Sean comes to us by way of New York City, where he was born and raised. He received his JD from Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law in 2009 and his Bachelor of Arts degree from Catholic University of America in 2006, where he graduated Magna Cum Laude. In law school, Sean was named a Public Interest Fellow and interned at the Manhattan District Attorney’s Office.

After law school, Sean worked for a well-respected New York Supreme Court Judge and then joined a premier plaintiff’s personal injury firm in Manhattan. There, he focused on medical malpractice cases and second-chaired two high profile trials – one of which resulted in one of the largest personal injury verdicts in New York history.

Sean is admitted to the Texas and New York State Bars, and has handled all types of personal injury cases, including medical malpractice, wrongful death, products liability, and car and 18-wheeler truck accidents. He has recovered substantial settlements and verdicts for his clients.

Sean was named a “Top 40 Under 40” by the National Trial Lawyers Association and has been named a Rising Star by Super Lawyers. Super Lawyers is a rating service of outstanding lawyers from more than 70 practice areas who have attained a high degree of peer recognition and professional achievement. The selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and peer evaluations. The “rising star” designation is awarded to those under the age of forty.

Outside of the office, Sean enjoys traveling the world with his wife and is an avid fan and player of basketball.

attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate (Commercial and Residential) Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio: Paul McConnell has been trying real estate, other business lawsuits and handling real estate transactions for 40 years. He has handled cases in the Texas Supreme Court, a majority of the Courts of Appeals in the state of Texas, and state district courts in various counties around Texas, as well as throughout the federal court system, including the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, the Western, Eastern, Northern and Southern Districts of Texas and numerous bankruptcy courts. Mr. McConnell has handled a number of significant real estate transactions and lawsuits on both sides of the docket, and has represented both the sellers of businesses and the purchasers of those businesses. He has handled condemnation, zoning, and platting matters, and has represented landlords and tenants in commercial lease disputes. He has represented numerous lenders in workouts, foreclosures, and related matters. He is a member of the Texas Land Title Association, is a frequent lecturer on various real estate issues, and has served on several TLTA committees. Mr. McConnell also serves as a mediator, utilizing the knowledge and experience he has gained and his mediation training to help parties find a solution to their disputes.

attorneys.name: Will McCoy
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Will McCoy is an associate at Bollier Ciccone Stinson LLP, focusing his practice on construction and real estate law.

Will earned his J.D. from Baylor Law School in 2023, where he was a member of the Baylor Barrister Society. Prior to law school, he received his B.S. in Renewable Natural Resource Management from Texas A&M University in 2018.

His experience in litigation and on-site investigations translates effectively to construction and real estate matters.

Will’s legal acumen was further honed during his time as an SEC Honors Intern and as a clerk for Judge Mark Pittman at the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas. These experiences provided him with invaluable insights into court procedures and litigation strategies.

During law school, Will conducted an independent study under Jim Wren, the Leon Jaworski Chair of Practice and Procedure at Baylor Law, authoring a guide on specific personal jurisdiction in Texas.

Will is committed to providing exceptional legal services to his clients and to staying abreast of developments in construction and real estate law.
