attorneys.name: Dan White McCrary
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
I am Dan W. McCrary, a native Houstonian and graduate of Lamar High School. I am a direct descendent of a long line of attorneys, including my father who was admitted to the State Bar of Texas the day after the bombing of Pearl Harbor. I also had a great uncle who served for twenty-five (25) years as General Counsel for the Gulf Companies in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and another great uncle who was Justice John Sharp of the Supreme Court of the State of Texas. Furthermore, my father, having been in the banking business prior to World War II, was a co-founder of the mortgage lending department of Houstons largest home office life insurance company. Therefore, my legal training in the banking and financial industries began at an early age. With my excitement and interest developed in these areas, there was no doubt after graduation from college that I would begin the study of law.

By the time I was seventeen years of age, I had obtained a private pilots license and by graduation from college, I had earned a commercial pilots license and an instrument rating, having flown charter aircraft for well over 1000 hours. I began the formal study of law in 1971 at South Texas College of Law where I diligently pursued my favorite courses, especially real estate law. I felt honored to be able to advise my dad on certain real property matters prior to his death in 1983. I graduated with the degree of Doctor of Jurisprudence in January of 1974, passed the January 1974 bar exam thereby becoming licensed to practice law by the Supreme Court of the State of Texas in April of that year. After a number of years representing one of Houstons largest commercial developers building discount department stores, shopping centers and malls throughout almost every state in the country, I became Board Certified in Commercial Real Estate Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in 1983. This was the first occasion that the specialization examination was given in the area of real estate.

In the mid 1980s I met Jeffrey William Clark, at that time a law student, who shared my enthusiasm in real estate. Our similar interests resulted in the formation of the partnership of McCrary & Clark, L.L.P. in 1996.

My partner and I are avid motorcyclists. I enjoy riding my Harley Davidson Shovelhead Sportster whenever work allows. I also love ocean racing style power boats and enjoy my Scarab with my family over many summer weekends.

For all most twenty-five (25) years I have used my best efforts to assist my clients, including bank and non-bank lending institutions, small to medium size business owners, and title companies with prompt and accurate attention to their needs through competent advice and documentation. My vast experience in commercial transactions and lender representation has made McCrary & Clark, L.L.P. one of Houstons premier law firms practicing in these areas.

attorneys.firm_name: Stubbeman, McRae, Sealy, Laughlin & Browder, Inc.
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning and Probate Lawyers in Midland, TX
attorneys.bio:
Cory McDowell is a shareholder who practices in the firm’s Estate Planning and Probate Section. He is board-certified in Estate Planning and Probate Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and is licensed to practice law in Texas and New Mexico.

Cory's practice focuses primarily on estate planning for individuals, special needs planning, and helping clients dealing with probate matters following the death of a loved one. He also regularly assists attorneys in other states seeking an ancillary probate in Texas and New Mexico.

Cory’s practice has served everyone from the young couple needing to name guardians for their first child to clients who would be considered to be extremely wealthy by any measure. His clients have included various business owners, doctors, ranchers, executors, trustees, banks, veterinarians, relatives of individuals with special needs, educators, ministers, other attorneys, accountants, executives and other professionals in the oil industry, including engineers, etc.

Cory grew up in the Permian Basin and as a teenager and young adult spent time working in the oil fields surrounding Imperial, Texas. He is active in the community and enjoys volunteering with local entities such as his church, Midland Independent School District, Midland College, Teen Court and Legal Aid. Cory is often asked to speak on Estate Planning and Probate Issues.

Cory’s practice has served everyone from the young couple needing to name guardians for their first child to clients who would be considered to be extremely wealthy by any measure. His clients have included various business owners, doctors, ranchers, executors, trustees, banks, veterinarians, relatives of individuals with special needs, educators, ministers, other attorneys, accountants, executives and other professionals in the oil industry, including engineers, etc.

Cory grew up in the Permian Basin and as a teenager and young adult spent time working in the oil fields surrounding Imperial, Texas. He is active in the community and enjoys volunteering with local entities such as his church, Midland Independent School District, Midland College, Teen Court and Legal Aid. Cory is often asked to speak on Estate Planning and Probate Issues.

attorneys.name: Cary McDougal
attorneys.practice_type: Premises Liability Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Over the nearly two decades that he has practiced law, Cary McDougal has proven to be a formidable trial lawyer with unflinching resolve to serve his clients. Cary has been lead attorney in over 75 jury trials in state and federal court. He has tried cases involving such diverse areas of the law as premises liability, product liability, general personal injury, medical malpractice, insurance litigation, and environmental litigation.

The first 14 years of his legal career, Cary handled the defense of matters involving complex litigation throughout Texas and Oklahoma as a partner at two Dallas firms. He focused his practice on civil litigation, and he managed and tried all litigation for several North Texas health care agencies. He co-founded the law firm Aldous and McDougal, which gained recognition for its trial successes on behalf of plaintiffs in medical malpractice, contractual disputes, and other matters. Cary joined Baron & Budd in 2005.

A shareholder and manager of Baron & Budd's groundwater contamination litigation practice, Cary currently represents over 200 municipalities and water providers across the country that are seeking clean-up costs for the contamination of their water supplies. His practice includes management of Baron & Budd's cases in the Multi-District (MDL) MTBE water contamination litigation, which is considered one of the most complex pieces of litigation in the country. He also manages other environmental contamination cases involving chemicals such as TCP, TCE and dioxin.

Cary completed his law degree at the University of Texas School of Law and attained a Master of Public Policy degree from the University of Texas LBJ School of Public Affairs. He continues to serve as a consultant to the LBJ school on issues concerning public policy. He has authored numerous legal papers on civil litigation and trial practice and has spoken at seminars before health care professionals, consumer groups, the insurance industry and attorneys on issues relative to civil litigation.

Cary has been inducted into the prestigious American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA), a recognition by his peers for his jury trial experience, commitment to the jury process, and ethics. He also holds the top rating from the Martindale-Hubbell Law Directory and was named a "Texas Super Lawyer" in 2005 and 2006.

attorneys.bio:
Meghan McElvy represents corporate clients in a range of complex civil litigation matters, including energy litigation, regulatory and administrative proceedings, commercial disputes and personal injury litigation. She also handles a wide range of matters involving indemnity, insurance and contractual disputes.

In the area of energy litigation, Ms. McElvy represents and routinely counsels clients on a variety of disputes arising from oil and gas leases, surface disputes, joint operating agreements and unit designations. Prior to law school, she worked as a distribution analyst for Motiva Enterprises, LLC (a joint venture between Shell Oil Company and Saudi Refining) in Port Everglades, Florida.

attorneys.name: Charles B. McFarland
attorneys.practice_type: Eminent Domain/Condemnation Cases Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Charles McFarland is board certified in civil trial law by the Texas board of legal specialization and, uniquely, achieved this certification by trying condemnation cases. Charles has tried several dozen condemnation jury trials and handled several hundred administrative hearings before special commissioners. He has represented property owners across the state of Texas in significant condemnation cases against the state, the Texas department of transportation, and various other local governmental and public-use entities.

Charles is a Counselor of Real Estate (CRE) and has been recognized as an expert in real estate valuation matters. He has several published articles and lectures, both in Texas and nationally, on eminent domain, condemnation, and real estate valuation issues.

For over ten years, Charles has been selected by his peers for inclusion in the publications Best Lawyers in America and by Texas Super Lawyers for his expertise in the areas of eminent domain and condemnation law. He additionally holds the AV preeminent rating, Martindale-Hubbell's highest possible rating for ethical standards and legal ability, and serves as the Texas member of the Owners' Counsel of America, a network of the nation's leading eminent domain and property rights attorneys. Candidates for membership in Owners' Counsel are thoroughly-vetted based upon their ability, experience, results, and dedication to representing private property owners in eminent domain. Membership is by invitation-only and restricted to only one attorney from each member state.

Charles is the past president of the Texas Association of Civil Trial and Appellate Specialists, established in 1986 to promote the availability, accessibility and quality of the services of civil trial and appellate lawyers to the public. He is a Lifetime Fellow of both the Texas Bar Foundation and the Houston Bar Foundation, dedicated to providing legal representation to the indigent, promote community understanding of our legal system and foster the administration of justice. He is a Keeton Fellow to the University of Texas School of Law. He is also the past chair of the damages subcommittee of the condemnation, zoning and land use litigation committee of the section of litigation for the American Bar Association.

Charles is a frequent speaker and panelist on the topic of condemnation and eminent domain law and is a long-time contributing author to the American Bar Association, the American Law Institute, and other publications.

attorneys.bio:
Preston McGee is Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in the areas of Civil Trial Law and Personal Injury Trial Law. He has spent the majority of his career defending large and small business clients in Commercial and Personal Injury Litigation. He has successfully tried numerous oil and gas cases including both injury and condemnation cases on behalf of several major oil and gas companies. He has also represented individuals and businesses in various Medical Liability, Professional Liability, and Employment Law cases. Preston regularly serves as local and trial counsel for both individuals and large corporations in Intellectual Property and other Litigation pending in the Eastern District of Texas.

After graduating from Baylor University Law School, Preston began private practice with the Potter Law Firm in Tyler, winning accolades as the Smith County Bar Association Outstanding Young Lawyer in 1996. He founded his own firm in 1998 and after joining Flowers Davis in 2001 has continued the work he loves by serving his clients in trial practice.

Preston is a native of East Texas and is a sixth-generation Texan. He and wife Liz have made Tyler, Texas home since 1986. The McGees are a close-knit family, including son Peyton and his wife Katelaine and daughters Emily and Abby. He is very involved in his local church, serving as a Deacon and Sunday School teacher. In his free time, Preston enjoys playing golf, closely following his favorite football and basketball teams, and most of all, spending time with his family.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Preston McGee is Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in the areas of Civil Trial Law and Personal Injury Trial Law. He has spent the majority of his career defending large and small business clients in Commercial and Personal Injury Litigation. He has successfully tried numerous oil and gas cases including both injury and condemnation cases on behalf of several major oil and gas companies. He has also represented individuals and businesses in various Medical Liability, Professional Liability, and Employment Law cases. Preston regularly serves as local and trial counsel for both individuals and large corporations in Intellectual Property and other Litigation pending in the Eastern District of Texas.

After graduating from Baylor University Law School, Preston began private practice with the Potter Law Firm in Tyler, winning accolades as the Smith County Bar Association Outstanding Young Lawyer in 1996. He founded his own firm in 1998 and after joining Flowers Davis in 2001 has continued the work he loves by serving his clients in trial practice.

Preston is a native of East Texas and is a sixth-generation Texan. He and wife Liz have made Tyler, Texas home since 1986. The McGees are a close-knit family, including son Peyton and his wife Katelaine and daughters Emily and Abby. He is very involved in his local church, serving as a Deacon and Sunday School teacher. In his free time, Preston enjoys playing golf, closely following his favorite football and basketball teams, and most of all, spending time with his family.

attorneys.name: Diane McGehee
attorneys.practice_type: Professional Malpractice Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
The pursuit for equality has driven Diane since she was a young girl, clinging to her father’s hand as they watched the Ku Klux Klan burn a cross on their front yard in Milledgeville, Georgia, because of her father’s involvement in the civil rights movement. That pursuit carried Diane through law school and a distinguished legal career. It now drives her as a United Methodist pastor and founder of the non-profit Together in Hope.

Today Diane focuses her limitless energy on Together in Hope www.togetherinhope.org, a charity she founded with her husband Jack. That call to justice that originally stirred her spirit continues as she works to help communities around the world.

Diane McGehee received her J.D. Cum Laude from Harvard Law School in 1987. She also holds a Masters of Divinity degree from the Perkins School of Theology at SMU. As a United Methodist pastor, Diane currently serves as the Senior Pastor for Bering Memorial United Methodist Church. She has spent her adult life serving the underserved.

attorneys.name: Lindsey McGuire Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Facing a divorce or family law issue can feel overwhelming, leaving you uncertain about what lies ahead. The emotional and legal complexities involved often make it difficult to know where to begin. In these moments, having compassionate and experienced legal support can bring clarity. Lindsey McGuire is a dedicated Senior Associate Attorney based in our Houston, Texas family law office. She is committed to guiding clients through challenging times and represents individuals throughout Harris County and surrounding areas.

Lindsey earned her Juris Doctorate from DePaul University College of Law in Chicago, Illinois. Before attending law school, she completed her Bachelor of Arts in English at Northwestern University in Evanston, Illinois. She also holds an Associate of Arts in General Studies from New York University in New York City. Lindsey has a well-rounded academic background and is ready to help clients in the state of Texas.

Lindsey brings diverse professional experience to her role with the Houston, Texas family lawyers at Stange Law Firm. Before joining our team, Lindsey built a strong foundation in family and education law, serving clients as an attorney in Chicago, Illinois since 2013. During this time, Lindsey spent over 12 years working for her own practice where she gained experience in domestic relations motions and litigating matters including divorce, child support, and child custody. She also worked as an Associate Attorney for a law firm in Oak Park, IL during this period, where she gained experience drafting pleadings, handling motion practice, and preparing for trial. Her tasks included conducting depositions, managing discovery, and reviewing legal agreements such as promissory notes. This role provided Lindsey experience with loss mitigation strategies for homeowners, as well as real estate contracts and closings. In addition to her legal practice, Lindsey served as an Athletic Compliance Extern at Northern Illinois University. She also held internships and worked at several law firms throughout law school in Los Angeles and Chicago. These roles helped shape her legal skills. Beyond her legal career, Lindsey has worked as a Flight Attendant with United Airlines since 2006 and was honored with the Hearts United Award in 2009.

Lindsey is also proficient in reading and writing Spanish, which allows her to serve a broader range of clients.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

Lisa E. McKnight is recognized across the Dallas area as a thoroughly knowledgeable family law attorney who is a fearless litigator and a compassionate advocate for her clients. Held by less than 1 percent of all the lawyers in Texas, this certification is based upon: years of practice; focus in a specialty area; trial experience; professionalism; continuing legal education; evaluations by judges and fellow lawyers; and a written examination.

Lisa was born into family law, following in the footsteps of famed Dallas divorce lawyer Mary McKnight. After earning her law degree from Texas Tech University School of Law in 1991, Lisa worked for and partnered with her mother before opening her own family law practice in 1995.

attorneys.firm_name: Skelton Slusher Barnhill Watkins Wells PLLC
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Lufkin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Becca McMahon is a partner in the law firm and a native East Texan who received her J.D. from Baylor Law School in 2013. Prior to law school, Becca attended Baylor University, where she graduated summa cum laude with a B.B.A. in finance. Becca's law practice is heavily focused on advising clients as to estate planning matters, the management of business, and real property assets. Becca practice has led to experience in the following types of transactions and cases: estate planning, asset preservation planning, incapacity planning and guardianship, estate and probate administration, estate and probate litigation, entity formation, business and corporate planning, breach of contract disputes, business sales, business succession planning, and commercial real estate transactions.

Becca has represented clients in all aspects of the probate process, from probating a will, navigating an intestate estate where no will can be found, administering a complex estate with issues involving the funding of testamentary trusts and estate tax implications, guiding clients through court-supervised administrations, and working with out of state clients remotely on all of these matters, as well as ancillary probates, when necessary. She also has experience in establishing guardianships and advising in contested estate matters such as will contests, trust and fiduciary litigation, and guardianship litigation.

Becca's experience in business matters includes forming new business entities, negotiating contracts of purchase and sale of business interests and assets, mergers, conversions, and the termination of entities, as well as drafting buy-sell agreements, pledges, independent contractor agreements, consulting agreements, employment agreements, noncompetition agreements, and other corporate documents. She is also experienced in negotiating commercial real estate contracts, commercial property lease, ground leases, option agreements and rights of first refusal personal guaranties and pledge agreements, restrictive covenants, loan agreements, security instruments, boundary line agreements, and easements.

Becca is married to Josh McMahon, who is also an attorney at Skelton Slusher Barnhill Watkins Wells PLLC. They have two children, Lee and Micah McMahon.

attorneys.name: Jason McMinn
attorneys.practice_type: Austin Car Accident Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jason McMinn, an aggressive trial attorney, founded the McMinn Law Firm in 2005. Jason was born and raised in central Texas, and after graduating from high school, he attended the University of Texas for a degree in Business Administration and Texas Tech University for a degree in law.

Jason began his legal career working for Decker, Jones, McMackin, McClane, Hall & Bates, P.C., a large established law firm in Fort Worth, Texas. His primary practice areas were business litigation, medical malpractice defense, and general insurance defense. Jason worked closely with some of the top defense attorneys in the State of Texas. He exercised a hands-on approach, and his employers allowed him more involvement with the litigation process than most of his peers. When tort reform took a toll on the defense work available, Jason saw an opportunity to start his own firm with the vast array of knowledge and expertise he had gained. He moved the firm to New Braunfels in 2006, intending to cater to this growing Texas community. Through his satellite office in Victoria, TX, he focused on the smaller Texas counties extending to the gulf coast.

In August of 2007, the McMinn Law Firm moved its main office to Austin after experiencing great success with its original New Braunfels office. Expanding to the Texas capital city allowed the law firm to extend its services to the urban populace while also maintaining the New Braunfels office for personal injury and selective criminal cases. The firm also decided to narrow its practice to personal injury and criminal trial law.

The McMinn Law Firm's common approach involves an exclusive focus on litigation areas of law, which require experience, innovation, and personable trial techniques. Jason has had significant trial experience in criminal law and personal injury cases since the formation of the firm.

The McMinn Law Firm uses its extensive experience on the defense side to represent plaintiffs in various personal injury cases. No case is too small for McMinn Law, and the McMinn attorneys are willing and able to assist their clients in battling large insurance companies who deny claims without merit.

The McMinn Law Firm and Jason have committed a significant portion of their practice to criminal law. Jason has tried numerous felony and misdemeanor cases to a jury trial with many acquittals. He has an enormous amount of trial experience in this area of law. Mr. McMinn genuinely enjoys helping people overcome their criminal charges by offering advice, legal representation, and trust. He ensures the system does not take advantage of a person's demographics or lifestyle.

The attorney rating company, Super Lawyers, selected Jason as a "Rising Star" for 2013. He is also acting president of the Las Hadas Homeowner's Association in Seguin, Texas. He is a member of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association and was president of the Tarrant County Young Lawyers Association.

Jason and his wife, Heather, who is the District Attorney for Guadalupe, Gonzales, and Lavaca counties, are happily married with four children. When he's not at the office, Jason enjoys spending his free time with his family and being outdoors.

attorneys.bio:
Austin Personal Injury Lawyer and Car Accident Attorney

Justin McMinn is a trial lawyer who aggressively represents personal injury plaintiffs throughout the state of Texas. He has a strong passion for seeking justice and helping his clients rebuild their lives after serious injury accidents.

Justin McMinn represents clients facing injuries after car accident, truck accident, and auto injury cases. As a personal injury attorney, he assists clients by negoating for the best possible financial outcome after an auto crash. Victims of reckless driving facing personal injury are entitled to cash settlement and tax free compensation in the state of Texas. Attorneys including Justin McMinn advocate for their interests against large insurance companies seeking to limit costs.

Austin 18 Wheeler Accident Lawyer and Commercial Litigation

Justin McMinn has extensive experience represnting clients who were injured at the hands of a reckless commercial driver. Commerical vehicle personal injury cases always involve more parties. Clients facing injuries caused by an 18-wheeler need professional help negotiating for financial compensation for their medical bills and pain and suffering. Commercial vehicle cases can require additional scrutiny and expert oversight in order to obtain adequate compensation.

Award Winning Austin Personal Injury Attorney

Justin was named "Rising Star" by the attorney rating company, Texas Super Lawyers beginning in 2013. Since then, Justin has been named among the top attorneys recognized by SuperLawyers as a Rising Star. Justin McMinn was named one of the "Top 100 Trial Lawyers" by The National Trial Lawyers for the years 2014 - 2021.

Justin McMinn - Education

While attending Texas Tech, Justin worked for a law firm which specialized in personal injury litigation. Here, Justin developed his passion for helping people seriously injured in accidents. Justin helped prepare hundreds of personal injury claims for litigation.

Justin was born and raised in Central Texas. After completing high school, Justin attended the University of Texas where he earned his Bachelor's degree in government. Justin then went on to earn his law degree from Texas Tech University School of Law.

When he is not at the office, Justin likes to spend his free time with his family and being outdoors. He and his wife, Kendall, are members of Lake Hills Church in Austin, Texas.

attorneys.name: Jacqueline (“Jacqui”) McNutt Attorney at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Weatherford, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jacqueline “Jacqui” McNutt is a dedicated family law attorney who is committed to providing compassionate yet strategic representation in all areas of family law. Her practice includes divorce, child custody, visitation, child support, modifications, enforcements, custody for non-parents, and grandparent visitation matters. With more than a decade of combined legal and paralegal experience, Jacqui offers clients both seasoned perspective and results-driven advocacy.

Jacqui graduated from Mississippi College School of Law in 2013, where she earned the Amjur Award in Children in the Legal System and gained valuable courtroom experience through her work in the Juvenile Clinic in Rankin County Youth Court. Before becoming an attorney, she spent over ten years as a family law and estate planning paralegal, a foundation that accelerated her success as a trial lawyer and gave her a deep, practical understanding of the legal system.

Clients value Jacqui’s realistic, solution-focused approach and her unwavering commitment to placing the needs of children first in every case. She has extensive experience representing parents who have been victims of parental alienation, successfully restoring rightful visitation and helping families rebuild healthier co-parenting environments. Her ability to recognize, prevent, and address parental alienation has been instrumental in protecting children’s best interests and preserving parent-child relationships.

While family law is her primary focus, Jacqui also practices in wills and estate planning, probate matters, corporate and LLC formation, and other areas of civil litigation. Across all practice areas, she is driven by a passion for justice, a commitment to due diligence, and a desire to secure long-term, meaningful results for her clients.

attorneys.practice_type: Mergers and Acquisitions Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Robert M. Mendell, Attorney at Law, P.C. is a mergers and acquisitions and tax law firm based in Houston, Texas. The firm's attorney, Robert M. Mendell, has over 40 years of experience representing Houston area clients and has handled a diverse range of legal matters over his career. In addition to being Board Certified in Tax Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Mr. Mendell is also a licensed Texas Certified Public Accountant (CPA) and has been very active in the Houston CPA community, having taught numerous tax and business law seminars in association with various local CPA professional organizations and holding various officerships and committee chairmanship positions through the years for the Houston CPA Society (the Houston Chapter of the Texas Society of Certified Public Accountants). Mr. Mendell has also received an AV peer review rating from Martindale-Hubbell, its highest rating.

The firm has substantial expertise in mergers and acquisitions, tax planning and tax law, family limited partnership formation and structuring, business organization formation, and related legal matters.

Robert M. Mendell, Board Certified Tax Attorney and Texas Attorney CPA

All matters coming before the firm are handled directly by Robert M. Mendell, a lawyer with more than 40 years of experience. The firm continuously endeavors to combine a high level of professional competence with a high standard of personal service. The firm concentrates on these areas of law:

Mergers and Acquisitions - business acquisitions, divestitures, mergers, asset purchase agreements, stock purchase agreements, merger agreements, seller warranties and representations, seller indemnification provisions, purchase price earnouts, purchase price holdbacks and escrow reserves, confidentiality agreements, letters of intent, noncompetition and nonsolicitation provisions

Tax Law and Tax Planning - entity selection tax planning, tax-advantaged structuring of business transactions, and tax planning for personal matters; tax controversy and tax resolution matters, including IRS tax audits and installment payment plans

Family Limited Partnerships - segregation of assets into one or more limited partnerships, asset protection, estate tax reduction, protection of assets against failed marriages, simplifying family transfers to junior generations

Business Organizations - entity selection, formations, acquisitions, divestitures, mergers, conversions, divisions, tax-free reorganizations, sales of businesses, purchases of business, succession planning, preparation and review of complex business contracts

Tax lawyer, Robert M. Mendell, has taught more than 200 tax and business law seminars.

The firm prides itself in handling complex legal matters and being responsive to clients' questions, concerns and problems. Contact the firm to speak directly with Robert M. Mendell concerning any substantial mergers and acquisitions (M&A), tax planning, tax law, family limited partnership (FLP), business organization, or business planning legal matter. Mr. Mendell can be reached by phone at 713-888-0700 or by e-mail.

attorneys.name: Jessica Mendez
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in El Paso, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jessica Mendez is a founding partner at Flores Mendez Law, who primarily practices in the area of personal injury cases. Jessica brings a well-rounded perspective to her legal work, having represented a variety of companies and assessed matters from multiple angles, including the management side. She is dedicated to advocating for individuals who have been mistreated and guiding them through complex and challenging legal situations.

Jessica was born and raised in El Paso, Texas who attended the University of Texas at El Paso. She received a Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting from UTEP and became a Certified Public Accountant. Prior to law school, Jessica worked for KPMG, a national accounting firm. She went to St. Mary’s University School of Law and graduated in 2004. After graduating from law school, Jessica returned home to El Paso and worked for a prominent defense law firm for nine years. In 2014, Jessica made a pivotal decision – to leave the security of a comfortable job and establish her own law office as a plaintiff’s lawyer. Her journey from a defense firm lawyer to a successful plaintiff’s trial attorney is a testament to resilience, passion, and the pursuit of justice. Her story is a reminder that with determination, passion, and a commitment to justice, one can carve out their own path and be a force for positive change. Driven by a shared vision and a desire to provide even more comprehensive legal services, Jessica joined forces with her esteemed colleague, Connie J. Flores, to form, Flores Mendez Law. This strategic move marked a significant milestone in Jessica’s career, where she could expand her impact and continue her unwavering commitment to her clients. She believes in giving back and actively participates in various community events. Her commitment to community engagement is a reflection of her dedication to making a positive impact inside and outside the courtroom.

attorneys.name: Priscilla Mendoza
attorneys.practice_type: Removal Defense Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Priscilla Mendoza is an attorney deeply committed to her clients and community. Growing up in the border town of El Paso, Texas, as a Mexican-American, Attorney Mendoza knew early on that she wanted to help others and advocate for immigrants. She graduated cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and Criminal Justice from Our Lady of the Lake University. She then earned her Juris Doctor, graduating magna cum laude from Thurgood Marshall School of Law.

While in law school, Attorney Mendoza served as a Student Attorney at the Immigration Law Clinic and completed multiple law clerkships with nonprofit organizations focused on civil rights litigation and immigration law. Additionally, she published an article in the Thurgood Marshall Law Review addressing the accountability of detention centers for safeguarding immigrant detainees' due process rights.

Attorney Mendoza is a member of the State Bar of Texas and the American Immigration Lawyers Association. She has extensive experience representing clients in removal defense proceedings in immigration court and handling a variety of cases before the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Attorney Mendoza is passionate about advocating for her clients and guiding them through the complexities of the U.S. immigration system.

attorneys.name: Mark L. Merrell
attorneys.practice_type: Eminent Domain/Condemnation Cases Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mark Merrell practices exclusively in the area of eminent domain and condemnation law. He began his career at an international law firm representing governmental and public-use entities acquiring property and rights of way for large scale infrastructure projects. Mark now focuses on representing the interests of property owners facing these issues, and his experience having been on the other side has proved invaluable in advising his landowner clients and positioning their claims for maximum recovery.

Immersed in every aspect of the eminent domain process, Mark advises clients during all stages of the condemnation journey, from evaluating an initial offer to preparing for and navigating a jury trial. He has handled hundreds of cases involving the full spectrum of public use projects: from TXDOT road widenings to oil and gas pipeline takings and everything in between.

Mark's clients are as varied as the projects he has worked on. Prior clients have included Fortune 500 companies; real estate developers with millions of square footage in their portfolio; special purpose entities, including multi-site churches; and countless small business owners. Regardless of the representation, Mark's goals remain the same: to maximize the client's recovery while, at the same time, relieving those clients of burdens that can often feel overwhelming. Mark's singular focus has resulted in the recovery of tens of millions of dollars in additional compensation for his clients.

A frequent speaker on the topic of eminent domain, Mark is an Affiliate Member of Owners' Counsel of America, the nation's preeminent association of eminent domain attorneys devoted to the representation of landowners.

sections.content:
Mark Merrell practices exclusively in the area of eminent domain and condemnation law. He began his career at an international law firm representing governmental and public-use entities acquiring property and rights of way for large scale infrastructure projects. Mark now focuses on representing the interests of property owners facing these issues, and his experience having been on the other side has proved invaluable in advising his landowner clients and positioning their claims for maximum recovery.

Immersed in every aspect of the eminent domain process, Mark advises clients during all stages of the condemnation journey, from evaluating an initial offer to preparing for and navigating a jury trial. He has handled hundreds of cases involving the full spectrum of public use projects: from TXDOT road widenings to oil and gas pipeline takings and everything in between.

Mark's clients are as varied as the projects he has worked on. Prior clients have included Fortune 500 companies; real estate developers with millions of square footage in their portfolio; special purpose entities, including multi-site churches; and countless small business owners. Regardless of the representation, Mark's goals remain the same: to maximize the client's recovery while, at the same time, relieving those clients of burdens that can often feel overwhelming. Mark's singular focus has resulted in the recovery of tens of millions of dollars in additional compensation for his clients.

A frequent speaker on the topic of eminent domain, Mark is an Affiliate Member of Owners' Counsel of America, the nation's preeminent association of eminent domain attorneys devoted to the representation of landowners.

Mark lives in Katy with his wife, Allison, and their four kids. He and Allison are past recipients of the Katy Elks Lodge Family of the Year. Mark was an inaugural inductee of the Katy ISD Athletics Hall of Honor and is on the board of the Athletic Booster Club for Tompkins High School.

attorneys.name: Tahira Khan Merritt
attorneys.practice_type: Sexual Abuse Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
The Law Office of Tahira Khan Merritt litigates cases of sexual abuse and sexual assault exclusively. For two decades, we have represented adult and child victims of sex crimes in civil cases against various corporations and institutions, including schools, colleges and universities, both public and private, religious organizations, such as the Catholic Church, the Baptist Church, the Greek Orthodox Church, the Episcopal Church, and the Presbyterian Church among others. We have also represented victims of rape in youth sports organizations, youth camps, daycares, and the like.

Ms. Merritt graduated from The University of Texas at Austin, cum laude and Baylor Law School in Waco. She was admitted to the State Bar of Texas in 1989. Prior to opening her own practice in Dallas in 1996, she was an Assistant Attorney General for the State of Texas, focusing on tort litigation. Since then Tahira has been representing victims of sexual assault and sexual abuse. To this end she has also served as a Special Prosecutor for Eastland County in a high profile pedophile priest case she had previously litigated civilly.

To achieve additional closure for her clients beyond civil remedies, she has contributed toward the incarceration of five pedophiles.

Ms. Merritt’s exceptional concern for compromised children has led her into an ancillary area of law: establishing Guardianships for children with learning differences in the Probate Courts. Her interest in their welfare is intense and personal, both as an attorney and as a parent.

She has given freely of her professional time and experience on a pro-bono basis particularly in the area of clergy sexual abuse of children.

Ms. Merritt has taken keen interest in the epidemic of Campus rapes of students, both female and male. She represents victims burdened with the daunting prospect of petitioning for justice before a University disciplinary panel and the University attorneys. Unrepresented, the outcomes for victims have sometimes been less than successful.

Ms. Merritt has recently presented for the National Crime Victims Bar Association on Civil Justice for Victims of Crime in Texas. She is a member in good standing of several professional associations, namely: American Association for Justice, Asian American Bar Association, Texas Women Lawyers Association, Texas Trial Lawyers Association, Dallas Women Lawyers Association and Dallas Trial Lawyers Association.

An enviable hallmark of Law Office of Tahira Khan Merritt continues to be Ms. Merritt’s face to face interaction with each of her clients.

attorneys.name: Christopher Meyer JD
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Sugar Land, TX
attorneys.bio:
Christopher Meyer is a dedicated family law attorney who is deeply committed to supporting his clients through some of the most challenging times in their lives. With a background as a U.S. Army veteran and a former foster child, Christopher brings a unique blend of empathy, resilience, and legal expertise to his practice. His life experiences have shaped his approach to law, where he prioritizes understanding, compassion, and mindfulness in every case he handles.

Christopher's legal journey began after earning his law degree from Thurgood Marshall School of Law, and he has since become a trusted advocate in the areas of divorce, child custody, domestic violence, and CPS court appointments. Licensed in all state courts of Texas, he has a reputation for fighting tirelessly for his clients while maintaining a calm, thoughtful demeanor that reassures those who rely on his guidance.

As a husband, father, and a Christian, Christopher understands the importance of family and strives to create outcomes that preserve the well-being of his clients and their loved ones. His personal experience with the foster care system has inspired him to advocate passionately for children, especially in cases involving abuse and neglect. Christopher is proud to use his platform to give back to the foster care community and regularly donates a portion of his firm's marketing budget to charities supporting foster youth.

In addition to his legal practice, Christopher continues to serve the veteran community. As a former Army Captain and disabled combat veteran, he draws on his military service to advocate for the rights of veterans, ensuring they receive the support they need. His advocacy efforts have resulted in meaningful contributions, including his work with Houston Metro to secure free transportation for disabled veterans.

Christopher's clients appreciate his straightforward yet compassionate approach. He listens attentively, offers practical legal solutions, and always seeks to empower his clients through understanding and empathy. Whether it's navigating the complexities of a divorce or protecting the rights of children in court, Christopher stands as a calm, guiding presence during what can often be turbulent times.

If you’re seeking an attorney who is both a strong advocate and a thoughtful advisor, Christopher Meyer is here to help you move forward with confidence and care

attorneys.name: Gregory T. Meyer
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation & Appeals Lawyers in Plano, TX
attorneys.bio:
Greg Meyer, Senior Partner of Meyer & Colegrove, PLLC was admitted to practice law in the State of Texas in 1988. He is admitted to practice law in all Texas state courts as well as the Northern, Southern, Eastern and Western federal districts of Texas.

Mr. Meyer earned his law degree in 1988 from the J. Reuben Clark law school at Brigham Young University. While in law school, he served as an editor of the law review and a member of the Board of Advocates. He is a graduate of Rice University in Houston, having earned his bachelor's degree in management studies and behavioral sciences in 1985.

Mr. Meyer's practice areas include civil litigation in state and federal court, commercial and residential lease enforcement, commercial collections, contract breach and enforcement, real estate litigation, creditors' rights and bankruptcy, corporate/transactional, and real property and foreclosures. He has practiced exclusively in Dallas since being licensed.

Mr. Meyer has first-chaired jury trials and conducted all pre-trial phases of complex business litigation. He has argued numerous pre-trial motions and appeared on numerous hearings in state and federal court in a variety of civil cases. He enjoys a good rapport with the judges he appears before.

Mr. Meyer is a member of the State Bar of Texas (member litigation, general practice, solo and small firm sections), Dallas Bar Association and the Apartment Association of Greater Dallas (member legal services panel). He is a contributing author for the AAGD Rooflines publication.

Mr. Meyer represents a variety of business entities from sole proprietorships to publicly held corporations and real estate investment trusts.

Mr. Meyer prides himself on being able to provide quality and timely legal services at competitive rates.

attorneys.practice_type: Family and Probate Lawyers in College Station, TX
attorneys.bio:
Excelling both as an undergraduate and graduate student, Randy Michel earned a commission in the United States Air Force. Then, as a young military officer, he proved his mettle through preparation, courage, and dedication, for which he was awarded the Air Force Commendation Medal and an Oak Leaf Cluster for heroism on the Arctic Circle. After completing his military service, Michel turned in a stellar performance in law school, and he continues to distinguish himself today in local, state, federal, and appellate courtrooms across Texas and beyond.

Randy Michel attributes much of his success to his tenacity and his willingness to outwork his adversaries. He is highly regarded by other lawyers because they know that when they enter the courtroom, Michel will have worked harder, will be better prepared, and will be better organized than anyone else in the room.

Judicial Experience

Appointed by College Station's City Council to serve as Presiding Judge of Municipal Court for the City of College Station (May, 1995 - January, 1997). Part-time position.

attorneys.name: Bernard Lincoln Middleton
attorneys.practice_type: Labor Lawyers in Beaumont, TX
attorneys.bio:
Bernard L. Middleton, a native of Centerville, Texas, graduated from Texas Southern University in 1969 with a B.A. in History. He earned his law degree from Thurgood Marshall School of Law at Texas Southern University in 1971. He is a member of the Litigation Section of the firm and practices in the areas of Labor and Employment Law. All of his practice is devoted to litigation. Middleton has extensive experience representing Labor Unions and employees in various labor and employment disputes. He is a member of the State Bar of Texas, including its Labor and Employment, Litigation and Alternate Dispute Resolutions Sections.

Middleton also is a member of the College of the State Bar of Texas, and he is a former member of the chairman of the District 4-B Grievance Committee for the State Bar of Texas. He currently serves on the Board of Directors for Crime Stoppers of Houston, Inc. and the United States Employees Credit Union. He is licensed to practice in the U.S. District Courts, Northern and Southern Districts of Texas, the U.S. Court of Appeals, 5th Circuit and the U.S. Supreme Court.

attorneys.name: Sheryl Miears
attorneys.practice_type: Family and Child Welfare Law Lawyers in Grapevine, TX
attorneys.bio:
I received my bachelors degree from Baylor University and my law degree from Texas Tech Law School. I was licensed in 1993. I began as a criminal prosecutor, handling misdemeanor and felony cases, as well as CPS cases. I worked for about 7 years for the Department of Aging and Disability Services, enforcing long-term care facility regulations in the state of texas, as well as handling enforcement of licensing regulations for Administrators and nurse aides.

I was an attorney for Child Protective Services for about 7 years, representing the department in actions involving alleged child abuse and neglect. I am very familiar with CPS policy and procedures, as well as policies and procedures regarding the foster care system.

Since I have been with my husband's firm, I have continued to concentrate on the area of Family Law and Child Welfare Law. I represent clients for any type of family law matter, including divorce, child custody, child support, grandparent rights, foster parent interventions, and adoptions.

I am a busy mother of 3, so I understand the importance of doing what is best for your child and doing all you can to keep them safe.

Following his 2001 graduation from Wheeling Jesuit University with a B.A. in Accountancy, Chris proceeded to Thomas M. Cooley Law School earning a law degree in 2005.

In 2008, Chris became a partner with Warren & Associates and the law firm was renamed Warren & Migliaccio, L.L.P.

Chris is passionate about helping individuals going through bankruptcy to find a path forward.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Since graduating from Oklahoma City University School of Law and passing the Texas Bar Exam in 2016, I have successfully represented personal injury victims ranging from motor vehicle accidents, to slip and falls, to black mold illnesses. My background in the medical industry as a sales representative has allowed me to hone in on my excellent negotiation skills and effectively advocate for my clients in their bodily injury claims. My competitive nature and straightforward approach to each and every case ensures my clients are rightfully compensated for their injuries.

Most importantly, I am extremely loyal and dedicated to my clients and will do everything I can to meet my client's needs. I am detail-oriented, friendly, and strive to fight for my clients thoroughly and be as transparent as possible about their case. I am also a proud member of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association, Dallas Trial Lawyers Association, and Hispanic Bar Association. As a native Puerto Rican, I am both fluent in English and Spanish. When not practicing law, you can find me avidly cheering my hometown teams, the Dallas Mavericks, Cowboys, Stars, and Rangers.

attorneys.name: Ann Kelleher Miller
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration and Nationality Law Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ann Kelleher Miller is certified as a specialist in United States Immigration and Nationality Law by the State Bar of California, Board of Legal Specialization. Mrs. Miller obtained her Bachelor's Degree in Political Science from California State University Long Beach and her Juris Doctorate from Whittier Law School.

Mrs. Miller was born in central California and grew up in Huntington Beach, California. Mrs. Miller began her career in the immigration field when she began working as a paralegal with a firm in Southern California. Mrs. Miller decided to pursue her law degree while working full-time and was admitted to the State Bar of California in 2006 and enjoyed representing clients on a wide range of immigration matters.

Mrs. Miller has extensive experience handling various immigration matters including family and employment-based immigration, asylum law and deportation defense. Mrs. Miller has also represented immigrants before the Board of Immigration Appeal and in litigation before the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California as well as the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.

As immigration law has rapidly changed over the years, Mrs. Miller enjoys the challenge of finding solutions for clients and providing professional guidance through the often confusing world of U.S. Immigration and Nationality Law.

Mrs. Miller recently relocated with her husband and two children to the Dallas area and enjoys exploring the area.

attorneys.name: Clay Miller
attorneys.practice_type: Catastrophic Injury Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Clay is Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Clay has practiced solely in the field of catastrophic injury and wrongful death since graduating from law school. His practice has been limited to the representation of victims. Over the past twenty-four years, Clay has successfully settled or tried to verdict cases in the areas of vehicular negligence, medical malpractice, construction site accidents, workplace injury, premises liability, and commercial trucking and a nationwide business loss case (suits filed in a dozen different states) involving defective truck engines sold to trucking companies.

Clay represented dozens of trucking companies in lost profit and diminished value claims against Caterpillar in 2010 through 2012. These cases were filed in over a dozen states with the bellwhether trial set in Federal Court in Davenport, Iowa. After intense litigation and trial preparation, a global confidential settlement was reached for all the clients.

Clay's most recent 2017 victories are a $30,800,000 jury verdict in Tennessee arising from fraud claims in the sale of heavy-duty truck engines an a $26,500,000 jury verdict in a construction accident, obtained within 60 days of each other.

Clay was raised in Lewisville, Texas and completed his undergraduate degree in Finance at

Texas A & M University. Following graduation from Southern Methodist University School of law, Clay worked for two Dallas firms representing victims. In 1998, Clay began his own practice before forming his current partnership. In addition to his law practice, Clay has lectured at seminars and published in the areas of construction accidents, jury selection techniques, medical negligence, trucking accidents and settlement tactics.

He is active in local and statewide trial lawyers' associations including serving as the Chair of the Advocates for the Texas Trial Lawyers' Association in 2002 and remains on the Board of Directors. Clay served as President of the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association from 2008-2009. He has also been a member of the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA) since 2014.

attorneys.name: Rachel Millicent Stern
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio: A native of Houston, Rachel brings both hometown roots and a wide-lens perspective shaped by early career experience in New York’s fast-paced media world. She earned her Bachelor of Science in Mass Communication from Boston University before pivoting to law, where she quickly proved herself as a standout litigator. At Southwestern Law School in Los Angeles, Rachel excelled in trial advocacy. She earned first place in the Trial Advocacy Honors Program Intramural and JEBS Trial competitions. She placed third in the highly competitive San Diego Defense Lawyers Trial Competition. She also received the prestigious CALI Award for Legal Writing II, given to the top-performing student in the class. Additionally, she served as a Teaching Assistant for her Legal Writing professor and was nominated by the law school’s Writing Center, where she supported students in editing and refining legal documents and argumentation. Rachel began her legal career in personal injury law, where she gained deep fluency in the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. That experience sharpened her procedural precision and courtroom readiness. She quickly carved out a niche in family law, where her blend of tenacity and empathy sets her apart. She now focuses exclusively on representing clients in divorce, custody, child support, and adoption matters, combining tactical skills with genuine client care. When not in court or advocating for clients, Rachel explores Houston’s culinary scene, dives into a good book, and travels with her beloved French Bulldogs.

attorneys.practice_type: Divorce and Family Law Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Stephanie is a native-born Texan, but grew up as an international nomad before returning to the best state and county in the U.S. to practice law.

She graduated magna cum laude from Drew University in New Jersey with a B.A. in Political Science and subsequently worked as patent litigation support at Jones Day in Dallas. While studying at Texas Wesleyan School of Law in Fort Worth, Stephanie was a Team Leader for the Texas Wesleyan Innocence Project, advocated for family law clients of the Texas Wesleyan Law Clinic, interned for criminal defense attorney Bradley Clark, and became a qualified mediator through the Texas Mediator Credentialing Association. She received her Juris Doctorate and was admitted to the Texas Bar in 2013.

In 2014, Stephanie joined Orange Energy as a project manager of a massive oil and gas leasing operation, then practiced as an associate attorney at Orange's sister law firm, Beckmen Law, P.C., in family law, contract and DTPA disputes, criminal defense, and complex commercial litigation. In 2016, she focused on criminal defense practice alongside Mike Goolsby at the Goolsby Law Firm. She relocated to Brewster County in 2017, where she became an assistant district attorney for the 83rd Judicial District before opening her own practice.

attorneys.bio:
Brian has a general business practice with an emphasis in the areas of estate planning, probate, trusts, guardianships, asset protection, business transactions and reorganizations, business entity formation, real estate, and taxation.

A native of Beaumont, Texas, Brian graduated from Monsignor Kelly High School in 1990 as salutatorian of his class. Brian then attended Baylor University in Waco, Texas, where he graduated in 1995 with a B.B.A. in Accounting, summa cum laude, and an M.B.A. in Accounting. While at Baylor, Brian was admitted as a member of Beta Gamma Sigma, a national honor society in business and management which is the highest honor a business student can receive in an undergraduate business program.

Brian received his J.D. degree with honors from the University of Texas School of Law in 1998 and was admitted to the Texas bar in 1998. While at UT, Brian was a member of the Texas Journal of Business Law, and he received the Best Brief award in the 1996 Gibbs & Bruns Moot Court Competition. Brian was also named to the Order of the Coif, an honor extended to law students ranking in the top 10% of their graduating class.

Brian is Board Certified in Estate Planning and Probate Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Brian was also named as a Texas Rising Star for 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2011 by Texas Monthly in the area of Estate Planning/Trusts.

Brian practices in the firm's Beaumont office.

attorneys.bio:
Stephanie N. Mills is an associate attorney at the Law Office of Joshua P. Murray, PLLC. She attended the University of North Texas and graduated Summa Cum Laude with a B.S. in Criminal Justice, minor in Psychology, and a Legal Studies certificate in 2019. During her undergraduate studies, she worked as a Legal Assistant at a law firm in Denton, Texas. In her free time, Stephanie enjoys rock climbing, reading fictional novels, and hiking with her dogs.

Raegan earned her Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from Louisiana State University, where she excelled academically and developed a passion for criminal law. During law school, she participated in trial advocacy competitions and a Juvenile Defense Clinic, honing her skills in advocacy and legal analysis. This early exposure equipped her with practical insights into the complexities of criminal cases and solidified her commitment to defending clients' constitutional rights.

She is also known for her compassionate approach and unwavering dedication. Raegan prioritizes building strong attorney-client relationships based on trust and open communication. She understands the stress and uncertainty that often accompany criminal charges and provides clients with the guidance and support needed to make informed decisions throughout the legal process.

In joining The Gertz Kelley Law Firm as an Associate Attorney, Raegan has swiftly established herself as a fierce advocate for clients facing a range of criminal charges. She approaches each case with meticulous attention to detail, conducting comprehensive legal research and crafting compelling arguments to achieve favorable outcomes. Since her addition to the firm, Raegan has been involved in a number of high profile and complex criminal trials. She is driven by a belief in the presumption of innocence and the principle that every individual deserves a vigorous defense. Raegan approaches her work with integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to upholding justice.

Raegan Defends People.

attorneys.name: Brian L. Mincher
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in McKinney, TX
attorneys.bio:
Brian is a partner with Burress Injury Law. Over the past 25+ years, he has tried over 150 jury trials in state and federal courts. Having previously represented insurance companies before dedicating his practice to helping victims over a decade ago, Brian has incredible insight on how insurance companies operate and how to force them to pay more money on injury and wrongful death claims.

When asked why he became a lawyer, he notes Atticus Finch, the attorney in To Kill a Mockingbird, as his inspiration. That idea of fighting for those who are not able to fight for themselves has always been important to Brian. As a young man he spent a good deal of time fighting in the ring and on the mats. Now, he spends all his professional time fighting for the rights of his fellow citizens who have been needlessly harmed thru the negligence, and sometimes even malice, of others.

In his spare time, Brian enjoys physical fitness and the outdoors in all forms – from boating and hiking to hunting and fishing. He has been a competitive marksman in several different disciplines since childhood. His is a state record holder in Oklahoma in equipped bench pressing, and holds the current Texas, U.S. and world record in bench press for men his age and weight. During college, he was a 3-time Oklahoma Karate Association divisional champion. He is an avid guitar player and performs regularly on the local music scene. Brian is married and has 3 wonderful children.

attorneys.name: Oliver Mintz
attorneys.practice_type: Military Administrative Issues And Discipline Lawyers in Gatesville, TX
attorneys.bio:
Oliver Mintz was born and raised in New York. He attended the United States Military Academy at West Point and graduated in 1996 when he commissioned as an infantry officer. His first assignment was to Fort Hood and the First Cavalry Division. In 2001, Oliver left active duty but joined the Texas Army National Guard immediately following the attacks of September 11, 2001. He went on to serve as an active-duty National Guard officer for 20 more years, holding two battalion commands and culminating his career as the 36th Infantry Division Chief of Staff. He served four combat deployments to Iraq, Afghanistan, Kosovo, and Kuwait, and retired in 2021 at the rank of Colonel.

In addition to a bachelor’s degree from West Point, he holds a Master of Business Administration from the University of Texas at Tyler, a Master of Strategic Studies from the United States Army War College, and a Juris Doctorate from St. Mary’s University School of Law.

Oliver has been active in the community for many years serving on the Finance Council at St. Joseph’s Catholic Church, as the PTO President at Trimmier Elementary School, an active Band Booster at Killeen High School, and served on the Killeen High School Site-Based Decision-Making committee. He is currently serving as an elected member of the Killeen ISD School Board

He has been married to his wife, Vicky, for over 25 years and they have two sons, both graduates of Killeen High School. Their son, Oliver, a 2022 graduate of Baylor University is currently a Second Lieutenant in the Texas Army National Guard. Their other son, Nicholas, is a member of the class of 2025 at the United States Coast Guard Academy in New London, Connecticut.

attorneys.bio:
My 25 years of significant legal experience give me the knowledge and capability to build the strongest defense for my clients. My goal is to do all I can to help my clients to achieve their goals.

Clients all over the Houston area come to me when they are facing charges ranging from misdemeanors to serious felonies. I am experienced in all areas of criminal law including DWI, violent crimes, narcotics charges, weapons charges, theft crimes, fraud, juvenile law, and much more.

I focus on defending the rights and freedom of each and every one of my clients. My goal is to vigorously defend my clients against any and all charges they face. They will always receive a clear assessment of the potential consequences of their charges so they can make informed decisions. Since plea negotiations are not always in the best interest of a client, I stand ready to vigorously prepare for all court appearances.

In addition to my criminal defense practice, I run a personal injury practice where I regularly address medical and forensic issues, accident reconstruction matters and insurance claims.

I offer free initial consultation and my firm accepts credit card payments. I look forward to helping your with your legal issues.

attorneys.name: María Uxía Miranda
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
María Uxía Miranda is a highly accomplished attorney whose diverse legal background and deep personal commitment have converged in the dedicated practice of Immigration Law. Born in Spain and raised on the Island of Puerto Rico, María brings a unique perspective and fluent bilingualism in Spanish and English to her clients.

She earned her Juris Doctor, Cum Laude, from the Universidad Interamericana de Puerto Rico. María began her career in Corporate Law, quickly gaining professional experience before establishing her own practice, Miranda & Navas Law Office, in her hometown of Guayama, Puerto Rico, where she served as Managing Partner from 2008 to 2022. As a highly experienced litigation attorney admitted since 2008, she successfully managed a diverse caseload and achieved positive results for clients.

Living in an impoverished part of the country quickly changed her professional goals. María began to expand her range by building alliances with non-profits to provide much-needed legal services, demonstrating her commitment to the community. This work led to her recognition by “Servicios Legales de Puerto Rico” and “Por Bono de Puerto Rico” for providing pro-bono legal services to marginalized Puerto Rican communities.

Following a life-changing event, her family relocated to Houston, Texas. Since then, her entire focus has been on Immigration Law. In this field, her true callings have merged: leveraging her extensive legal expertise and litigation skills to help people who need her most, making a tangible difference in the world.

attorneys.name: Jim Mitchell
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jim Mitchell has extensive experience in representing clients seeking to recover damages in significant personal injury and wrongful death cases. Before joining Andy Payne in 2007, Jim was a partner in other major personal injury firms in the Dallas area. He started his career at a large defense firm, but quickly found that his passion was in helping injured claimants rather than insurance companies, so he began representing victims in 1991. Jim’s practice areas include product liability, medical malpractice, general negligence, nursing home negligence and class actions. His years of experience have made him adept at helping clients deal with not only the legal issues but also the personal challenges that come with a life-changing event.

Over the course of his 30 years as a trial lawyer, he has handled all types of catastrophic injury and death cases and tried dozens to jury verdict. He has achieved several landmark verdicts including a 38 million dollar verdict against General Motors for a defective airbag case — the first of its kind in the country. And, another monumental case against Honda for a defective seatbelt that resulted in his client being a quadriplegia. Jim received a 36 million dollar verdict against Honda which was the first ever verdict with a roof mounted retractable double latch seatbelt system. Jim has proved that he is willing to take a case to court in order to bring justice to injured victims, and has helped hundreds of families in serious cases over his profession.

Jim is Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law, a designation only a small number of lawyers achieve by taking cases to court. He is also licensed in Oklahoma and Arkansas. He is a statewide leader of the Plaintiff’s trial bar, previously serving as the president of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association and as president of the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association. TTLA exists to protect the 7th Amendment and the right to trial by jury with a vision that everyone deserves access to our courts. Jim is also a member of the prestigious national trial lawyer organization, American Board of Trial Advocates. His leadership in the trial bar is unmatched.

Jim is a member of the Dallas Bar Association, the American Bar Association, the American Board of Trial Advocates, and the American Association for Justice. He has been a Director of the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association (1998-2014) and a Director and Fellow of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association (1999-2014). Jim has been elected President of the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association (2015), Treasurer of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association (2014-2015), has been on the TTLA Executive Committee for the last several years, and has been Chair of Continuing Legal Education for TTLA since 2011. He is a highly regarded speaker and has made influential presentations at universities, foundations and other legal organizations, as well as publishing articles in a number of professional journals. He has served on the State Bar Grievance Committee and as Chair for numerous Bar Association committees. Jim has been selected as a Texas Monthly Texas Super Lawyer every year since its inception in 2003, an honor less than 5% of lawyers statewide receive. He has also been selected as one of the best lawyers in Dallas by D Magazine several years and for inclusion in Best Lawyers in America®. Over the last three years, Jim has served as the Chairman of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association Continuing Legal Education Committee. In that position, Jim is in charge of organizing all legal education for members of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association statewide and has chaired and moderated numerous legal seminars and conferences across the country.

attorneys.bio:
Tim Molina graduated from the Southern Methodist University, Dedman School of Law in 2001, and he is licensed to practice in both Federal and State courts. With more than 130 jury trials tried to verdict, Tim has established himself as a well-respected trial attorney whose true office has always been courtrooms across the State of Texas.

Tim truly believes that a person charged with a crime, minor or major, needs an attorney with an in-depth knowledge of how a courtroom works, because all criminal accusations and their collateral consequences have potentially devastating and lasting impacts.

Trial skills cannot be taught – they must be learned first hand, and Tim Molina is ready to utilize his skills to protect your interests and freedoms.

attorneys.bio:
Cassidy Monska is a dedicated licensed trial attorney at Rob Wiley, P.C., in Dallas, Texas where she passionately advocates for her clients' rights in employment law. Ms. Monska's journey into law was inspired by her undergraduate studies at Texas Tech University, where she graduated cum laude, earning a Bachelor of Psychology with a minor in Spanish.

Driven by a profound desire to make a meaningful impact, Ms. Monska pursued her legal education at Texas Tech University School of Law, graduating with a Doctor of Jurisprudence. Her academic excellence was recognized with the prestigious Runge/Howard Endowed Presidential Scholarship. Additionally, Ms. Monska graduated with the Pro Bono Honors Award, reflecting her significant commitment to providing services to those in need.

Ms. Monska's dedication to advocacy was evident through her exceptional performance in competitive legal settings. She excelled in advocacy competitions, as she competed in the finals of both the Board of Barristers' First Year Mock Trial and Advanced Negotiations competitions. In her third year Ms. Monska served on the Board of Barristers as Director of Competitors. Her advocacy skills were further sharpened through national moot court and mock trial competitions, including the ABA Arbitration Competition and the Billings, Exum & Frye Moot Court Team.

At Rob Wiley, P.C., Cassidy Monska brings a client-centered approach to her practice, combining empathy with a thorough understanding of employment law. Her commitment to providing thoughtful, effective representation ensures that every client receives the dedicated advocacy they deserve. Ms. Monska is resolute in her mission to champion employee rights and make a positive difference in her clients' lives.

attorneys.name: Valeria Montalvo
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Law Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Valeria Montalvo practices immigration law exclusively. She has experience with all types of family-based immigration, as well as deportation defense. Mrs. Montalvo was a legal assistant at our firm, which led her to want to pursue a career in immigration law and go to law school. Prior to joining Chavez and Valko, Mrs. Montalvo worked at the Mexican Consulate in Dallas in both the Department of Documentation, and Protection and Legal Services.

Mrs. Montalvo obtained her Juris Doctorate from St. Mary’s University School of Law. During law school, she clerked at the San Antonio Immigration Court, and the LaSalle Immigration Court in Jena, Louisiana, writing decisions for Immigration Judges. She was a Student Attorney at the Immigration and Human Rights Clinic, where she represented detained immigrants at detention centers in South Texas, as well as asylum seekers in Mexico a part of the Migrant Protection Protocol Program (MPPP). She was a part of The Scholar: Law Review on Race and Social Justice as a Staff Writer and Associate Editor, and was Research Assistant to Professor Roberto Rosas, who focuses on U.S.-Mexico comparative law. Mrs. Montalvo also holds a Bachelor of Science in International Political Economy from the University of Texas at Dallas.

Mrs. Montalvo is a native Spanish speaker who grew up in Monterrey, Mexico. Mrs. Montalvo lives in Dallas, and in her free time likes watching movies and going on walks with her husband and son.

attorneys.name: Rachel E. Montes
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Irving, TX
attorneys.bio:
A veteran Dallas trial lawyer, Rachel Montes has one goal in mind when she begins work for a new client, simply to level the playing field. This approach to dealing with negligent individuals and big business has earned Montes the respect of her peers and the gratitude of people and their families who have suffered injuries or loss at the hands of others. Ms. Montes has had the privilege of representing many families who have lost loved ones or suffered life-changing injuries, and she has enjoyed a successful history of fighting for people victimized by trucking negligence, fraternity hazing, insurance bad faith claims, defective products, wrongful death and workplace negligence.

"Trial lawyers are the voice for those who otherwise would not be heard. I'm proud to be in a profession that helps hard-working people stand up to the corporate and insurance giants who use fear and intimidation as their front line weapons of defense. I consider a successful case one that combines fair compensation with policy and procedural changes that create permanent safety upgrades that benefit everyone."

Ms. Montes has earned a reputation as a relentless, no non-sense lawyer who combines modern legal strategies with an old-school approach that truly does put her client on a level playing field. Ms. Montes has earned the respect and trust of other lawyers who have referred clients, friends and family members to her for representation.

Ms. Montes began her legal career after accepting a coveted position with one of Texas' largest personal injury law firms. Client success, along with a highly competitive personal drive led Montes to open her own law firm in 1998.

Since that time, Ms. Montes has had settlements and verdicts representing millions of dollars for her clients. Ms. Montes is the 2006 president of the Dallas Women Lawyers Association, and sits on the board of that organization today. Additionally, Ms. Montes is on the board of directors of the Dallas Trial Lawyers Association, a group that is dedicated to opening the courthouse to any aggrieved person and ensuring that people have justice in the face of powerful big-money insurance companies and their wielded power. Ms. Montes sits on the board of directors for the Texas Trial Lawyers Association, and most recently was nominated for a coveted position on the Texas Trial Lawyers Advocates Board. Ms. Montes is a member of, and active in, the American Association for Justice, and is a member of the Christian Lawyers Association.

Ms. Montes was recently voted one of Dallas’ “Best Lawyers Under 40”, recognizing her for her tireless work for injured victims and their families.
