attorneys.name: Thomas H. Padgett Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Padgett discovered that he wanted to be a trial lawyer in high school. Two events were critical to this discovery. The first was when he read a book about the United States Supreme Court and became fascinated by its history and impact on American society. The second event was: he joined the debate team.

Mr. Padgett debated both in high school and college. Through that activity, he found a talent in public speaking, argument, and persuasion. Practicing law became the way Mr. Padgett combined his passion for civil rights with the skills he acquired debating.

Mr. Padgett has been a civil rights lawyer for over 28 years. He truly believes that his calling is to help ordinary people get justice in civil courts and by doing so, to make the community safer. Mr. Padgett believes he is saving and changing the world one case at a time.

To accomplish that task, Mr. Padgett has a simple goal: he puts his client in a better place than they were before he met them. The people Mr. Padgett represents frequently express a feeling of powerlessness. It is common for an employee who has been discriminated against to feel guilt and failure because they were terminated or retaliated against. Mr. Padgett addresses those feelings head on and brings out the best in his clients by giving them a voice to tell their stories. Those stories are what makes the community safer. Every time Mr. Padgett and his clients expose another discriminating or harassing employer, his community is a little safer. Every time Mr. Padgett and his client expose a cheating employer who pays his employees less than the law requires, another threat to safety is eliminated.

In 28 years as a trial lawyer, Mr. Padgett has represented thousands of clients and tried over 55 cases to verdict in state and federal courts. Mr. Padgett is a passionate believer in the jury trial process. Jurors, ordinary citizens who become a part of our nations’ judicial system by virtue of their service, enforce the laws that make America a better place to live and keep the community safe.

Mr. Padgett grew up in Bellaire, Texas, just a block from his grandparents’ home. Mr. Padgett is an avid reader of history, non-fiction, and science fiction. Mr. Padgett is also a gamer who enjoys everything from the Ancient game of Go to modern computer games.

Mr. Padgett was seriously injured as a child and could have lost the use of his right arm. Instead, he made a full recovery and therefore, considers each day a miracle and a gift. As a result, he focuses his life on accepting that gift and giving to others. Mr. Padgett has been with his long-term girlfriend, Catherine, for over 15 years. He spends time with his two sons, Tommy and Charlie, and his dog, Sammy.

At the end of the day, Mr. Padgett is here to bring his talents and skills to bear on employers and companies that cheat and expose the community to danger. He relentlessly pursues justice for employees and safety for the community.

attorneys.name: Henry C. Paine Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Denton, TX
attorneys.bio:
Hank is a partner with Marsh & Paine, P.C. He is Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and has been practicing law for over 30 years. A native of La Grange, Texas, Hank is a graduate of Texas A&M University where he was President of the Class of '73 and also served as Head Yell Leader. Hank has extensive experience in criminal defense, including experience in the most serious criminal trials as well. He has prosecuted and defended 12 Capital Murder or Attempted Capital Murder cases during his career.

Prior to attending law school at St. Mary's University School of Law, he worked for Fayette County, Texas as an assistant to the Commissioners Court. His primary duties were assistance in county government administration and serving as a lobbyist for Fayette County in both Austin and Washington, D.C.

Hank began his legal career as an Assistant District Attorney in Brazos County, Texas and was a Chief Felony prosecutor. After leaving the District Attorney's office Hank was engaged in the private practice of criminal defense until being asked to join the staff of the United States Attorney for the Eastern District of Texas as an Assistant United States Attorney.

Hank has been asked to serve as a Special Prosecutor in several Texas counties. He has prosecuted complex bank and insurance fraud cases for the State as a Special Prosecutor.

Hank has defended physicians in both State and Federal Court who have been accused of Medicare Fraud and fraudulent prescription of narcotics as well as medical professionals accused of assault.

Hank has represented individuals charged with all types of drug possession, manufacturing and delivery. He has successfully prevented Governmental overreaching and violation of individuals 4th Amendment protections on many occasions.

Law enforcement agencies from across the State have turned to Hank for instruction in Criminal Law, Evidence and Procedure. He is a regular lecturer to the Law Enforcement Management Institute sponsored by Texas A&M University, Sam Houston State University and Texas Woman's University. He has also assisted in training local police at seminars. Hank is an adjunct professor in Criminal Law and Procedure at Texas Woman's University.

Being active in the profession away from the Courtroom is important at Marsh & Paine, P.C. Hank has served as a State Director for the Texas Young Lawyer's Association in 1984-86. He is also a Past President of the Brazos County, Texas Criminal Lawyer's Association and the Denton County, Texas Criminal Lawyer's Association.

Hank is one of 10 lawyers in the state to be both Criminal and Juvenile Board Certified.

attorneys.name: Catherine Palmore
attorneys.practice_type: Family Lawyers in The Woodlands, TX
attorneys.bio:
Catherine grew up in The Woodlands and attended elementary through high school here in the community. After graduating from high school, she attended Texas A&M University where she majored in Psychology and Spanish. While at A&M, Catherine earned the Distinguished Student Award. After graduating A&M, and before attending law school, Catherine took a year to teach high school Spanish at Willis High School in Willis, Texas.

Catherine attended law school in Birmingham, Alabama at Samford University’s Cumberland School of Law. While there, Catherine was a member of the Christian Legal Society, a member of Cumberland’s Moot Court Team, and a Cordull Hull Teaching Fellow. Also during her tenure as a law student, Catherine earned a Dean’s Scholarship, the Scholar of Merit Award in Secured Transactions, and was invited to join the Cumberland Law Review. As a member of the Law Review, Catherine was voted Outstanding Junior Member and was ultimately named Articles Editor for the 2001-2002 publication year.

After graduating law school in 2002, Catherine returned to The Woodlands and began working for a local firm, Gauntt & Kruppstadt. At Gauntt & Kruppstadt, Catherine practiced as a civil litigator, representing both plaintiffs and defendants in a variety of matters such as personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful termination, consumer protection, business disputes, breach of contract, and civil appeals. During her time at Gauntt & Kruppstadt, Catherine served as President of the Montgomery County A&M Association, founded The Woodlands Young Lawyers Association, and was a founding member of The Woodlands Bar Association.

In 2008, Catherine joined the Special Prosecution Unit as a Senior Attorney. As a Special Prosecutor, Catherine helped the state civilly commit sexually violent predators who were deemed to present a continued threat to the community upon their release from prison. During her time at the SPU, Catherine took over 30 cases to trial, authored appeals, and argued before the 9th Court of Appeals and the Texas Supreme Court.

Catherine now brings her many years of experience as a civil litigator to The Palmore Law Firm. She is happy to be assisting folks from her hometown and surrounding areas with their legal issues.

His dedication and steady pursuit of professional growth allowed him to rise through the ranks, ultimately earning his position as an Associate Attorney.

Julio focuses his practice on Estate Planning and Probate. In estate planning, he works with clients to safeguard their assets, care for their families, and ensure their wishes are carried out through carefully crafted wills, trusts, and related strategies. In probate, he assists families as they navigate the court process of administering a loved one’s estate, offering both clarity and compassion at each step.

Beyond the office, Julio is a dedicated family man who enjoys time with loved ones and draws inspiration from his passion for sports, especially baseball and soccer. He also has a lifelong love of history and theatre, which has led to many trips to local museums and playhouses with his Wife.

attorneys.name: Jacob Paschal
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Huntsville, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jacob Paschal, a graduate of Huntsville High School, obtained his Bachelor of Arts with highest honors from the University of Texas at Austin. While at the University of Texas at Austin, Jacob also completed the Business Foundations Certification Program, with highest distinction. After college, Jacob received a scholarship and attended law school at Baylor University. Jacob graduated from Baylor University School of Law and was licensed to practice law in Texas in 2008.

After graduating from law school, Jacob practiced law in Houston, Texas for five years. Jacob's practice focused on litigation, representing clients in disputes involving catastrophic personal injuries, products liability, construction defects, real estate, employment, premises liability, wrongful death and commercial litigation in counties throughout Texas and some cases outside of Texas. Jacob represented a wide variety of clients ranging from individuals and small businesses to fortune 500 companies.

Jacob handles personal injury cases (car accidents, 18-wheeler accidents, wrongful death cases, product liability cases, and catastrophic injury cases) on a contingency fee basis throughout Texas. The initial consultation for personal injury cases is free. As a client, you pay no fee if there is no recovery. Jacob prides himself on making sure that each client and each case, regardless of how big or how small, get the same dedication and attention.

Jacob handles all types of litigation, including business disputes and actions to collect debt. Jacob drafts wills and handles probate matters. He also handles family law matters (divorces and custody disputes). Additionally, Jacob handles criminal law matters.

Jacob and his wife Aubree (also a graduate of Huntsville High School and the University of Texas at Austin) live in Huntsville. They have four daughters, ranging in ages from 8 years to 1 year old. Jacob enjoys spending time with his wife and daughters when he is not working. Jacob also likes spending time on the lake, playing basketball when time permits, and watching football.

attorneys.name: RC Pate
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
The first-born son of a Texas District Court Judge, you could say RC was destined to end up in the legal system. He grew up the eldest of three in Corpus Christi, Texas, where he achieved the rank of Eagle Scout. His pre-law school days saw him take jobs from Episcopal youth-group leader to Dillard’s gift-wrap, mall security to Rock guitarist. Eventually, those didn’t pan out, so he went to law school.

In law school he was selected for traveling mock trial teams that placed third in the National Trial Competition. After law school, he joined the Bexar County District Attorney’s Office where he was eventually appointed to first chair of County Court number 1. After two and a half years with the bad guys, RC realized his actual calling was representing those accused of crimes.

For the next 15 years, RC owned and operated the Law Office of RC Pate, a criminal defense firm dedicated to high-quality representation. In this time, he was appointed to the editorial board of the San Antonio Criminal Defense Lawyers Association’s magazine; became a Founding Member of the DUI Defense Lawyers Association; and a member of both the Texas DWI Lawyers Association and the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association.

In 2015, RC was designated by the American Chemical Society as a Lawyer Scientist. RC has completed the NHTSA/IACP Standardized Field Sobriety Practitioner’s course twice. He has also been honored to teach at educational seminars relating to criminal defense.

RC has tried numerous criminal trials all over the State of Texas. He has appeared in counties from Midland to Laredo. He’s looking forward to putting a life full of those skills to use defending you or a loved one.

attorneys.name: Pete T. Patterson
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
I, Pete T. Patterson, am a managing partner of Patterson, PC, a business litigation law firm here in Houston Texas. I am also the founder and former President of Capital Recovery Group, a real estate consulting business that served clients nationwide. I am Board Certified in Civil Trial PI Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Less than 5% of practicing attorneys achieve board certification and fewer hold certification in multiple areas. As of 2024, only 241 attorneys in the state of Texas were board certified in both fields.

I am double board-certified in both civil trial and personal injury trial law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Additionally, I have been a proud member of the American Board of Trial Advocates since 2008, having achieved the level of Associate. As of 2026, of 100,000 attorneys across Texas, I am one of 118 who are double board certified and a member of ABOTA. That is roughly one tenth of one percent of all attorneys in Texas.

I have been a perennial selection for inclusion in Texas Super Lawyers for 20 years. I have also been named to the Super Lawyers Top 100 list in Houston for 8 straight years. In addition, Best Lawyers in America include both my firm and me on its Best Law Firm and Best Lawyers list.

I received my undergraduate degree along with a double minor from the University of Texas at Austin, and my J.D. from the University of Houston Law Center where I was inducted into the Order of the Barristers. I was admitted to the State Bar of Texas in 1990 and qualified in the United States Court of Appeals, Fifth Circuit, the United States District Courts for the Northern, Southern, Eastern, and Western Districts of Texas, and multiple District Courts throughout the United States.

During my career, I have had numerous substantial trial verdicts in favor of my clients, in matters as diverse as a $20MM Oil & Gas verdict to the reversal of a $57MM verdict in the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals. I have demonstrated my abilities in many ways, earning numerous awards and legal distinctions for my advocacy as a business litigation attorney in Houston.

I was the recipient of the Entrepreneur of the Year Award 2001, and President's Circle Award 2003, as well as, the 1996 PIP Award from then Governor George W. Bush.

I have a long history of engagement with law, business, and civic associations. I am the Past President of the Entrepreneur's Organization, Neartown Association, and the Park Civic Association. I have served on several boards appointed by the Houston Mayor and City Council.

If you are looking for industry-leading representation from a business law attorney who adheres to the highest professional and ethical standards - always with a view toward winning your case - Patterson PC is the law firm to choose.

I am married to Martine Patterson, and we have one son for whom there is not enough hours in the day to swim at the Briar Club.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
I, Pete T. Patterson, am a managing partner of Patterson, PC, a business litigation law firm here in Houston Texas. I am also the founder and former President of Capital Recovery Group, a real estate consulting business that served clients nationwide. I am Board Certified in Civil Trial PI Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Less than 5% of practicing attorneys achieve board certification and fewer hold certification in multiple areas. As of 2024, only 241 attorneys in the state of Texas were board certified in both fields.

I am double board-certified in both civil trial and personal injury trial law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Additionally, I have been a proud member of the American Board of Trial Advocates since 2008, having achieved the level of Associate. As of 2026, of 100,000 attorneys across Texas, I am one of 118 who are double board certified and a member of ABOTA. That is roughly one tenth of one percent of all attorneys in Texas.

I have been a perennial selection for inclusion in Texas Super Lawyers for 20 years. I have also been named to the Super Lawyers Top 100 list in Houston for 8 straight years. In addition, Best Lawyers in America include both my firm and me on its Best Law Firm and Best Lawyers list.

I received my undergraduate degree along with a double minor from the University of Texas at Austin, and my J.D. from the University of Houston Law Center where I was inducted into the Order of the Barristers. I was admitted to the State Bar of Texas in 1990 and qualified in the United States Court of Appeals, Fifth Circuit, the United States District Courts for the Northern, Southern, Eastern, and Western Districts of Texas, and multiple District Courts throughout the United States.

During my career, I have had numerous substantial trial verdicts in favor of my clients, in matters as diverse as a $20MM Oil & Gas verdict to the reversal of a $57MM verdict in the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals. I have demonstrated my abilities in many ways, earning numerous awards and legal distinctions for my advocacy as a business litigation attorney in Houston.

I was the recipient of the Entrepreneur of the Year Award 2001, and President's Circle Award 2003, as well as, the 1996 PIP Award from then Governor George W. Bush.

I have a long history of engagement with law, business, and civic associations. I am the Past President of the Entrepreneur's Organization, Neartown Association, and the Park Civic Association. I have served on several boards appointed by the Houston Mayor and City Council.

If you are looking for industry-leading representation from a business law attorney who adheres to the highest professional and ethical standards - always with a view toward winning your case - Patterson PC is the law firm to choose.

I am married to Martine Patterson, and we have one son for whom there is not enough hours in the day to swim at the Briar Club.

Kristen Ann Paulsen joined Link & Associates in early 2024. Before joining Link & Associates, Kristen worked at a small boutique personal injury defense firm. Originally from Indiana, Kristen attended Purdue University Northwest where she graduated summa cum laude in 2020 with a degree in Sociology and an emphasis in Criminal Justice. She was an active member in her sorority, Environmental Club, Criminal Justice Club, National Society of Leadership and Success, Alpha Phi Sigma, and Alpha Kappa Delta.

She moved to Texas to attend Texas A&M School of Law where she earned her J.D. with a concentration in Intellectual Property in 2023. She was founder and President of the Life, Law, and Pursuit of Happiness Club and a zealous advocate for the importance of mental wellness in the legal profession. While obtaining her degree, she completed internships at the Thirteenth District Court of Appeals, an intellectual-property firm, and an estate planning firm.

Outside of the office, Kristen enjoys inline skating, hiking, board games, and reading. She also enjoys spending time with her husband Jacob and their two cats Freddie and Sir Purrs-a-lot.

We are proud to have Anthony R. Pax as an attorney associated with Coker, Robb & Cannon, Family Lawyers. He earned his law degree from Texas A&M University School of Law, where he graduated in the top 18% of his class and was a member of the Phi Delta Phi Legal Honor Society. He is very dedicated to helping his clients with all matters of family law and brings a wealth of talent to our Denton office. He understands the contentious and emotional nature of many family law concerns, and he takes a compassionate, understanding approach to helping his clients achieve the optimal outcome in any issues they face. Attorney Pax’s clients are in good hands when they turn to him, as he is a very capable, knowledgeable family lawyer.

Prior to joining Coker, Robb & Cannon, Family Lawyers, Attorney Pax practiced law at Jim Ross Law Group, P.C., in Arlington, Texas. There, he represented clients in a wide variety of family law matters, from divorces to SAPCRs, modifications, adoptions, and CPS cases. He was responsible for all aspects of representation, from client intake to final resolution, including drafting of original pleadings, motion practice, discovery, settlement negotiations, mediation, and trial.

His legal internships included working at the Collin County District Attorney’s Office in McKinney, Texas, and an internship at Shanklin & Cox, LLP, in Denton, Texas.

attorneys.name: Andrew Payne
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Andrew Payne graduated at the top of his class in law school and started his career working for a prestigious international firm representing large insurers and corporations. But it did not take long for Andy to realize that he wanted to help people who had suffered harm through no fault of their own, not protect negligent corporations whose actions harmed people. Andy’s passion for handling significant personal injury cases stems from his desire to help people who truly need justice. And on a larger scale, together with his clients, Andy’s pursuit of these claims effects positive safety changes so that more families do not have to suffer. Through his work on his clients’ cases, products have been redesigned, policies changed and lives saved.

As an experienced and effective trial lawyer, Andy routinely handles significant, newsworthy personal injury cases across the country. He has been lead counsel on numerous aviation and product defect cases, commercial vehicle collisions, medical malpractice and other general personal injury matters.

Andy is double Board Certified in both Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and Civil Trial Law by the National Board of Trial Advocacy. He serves as President for the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA), and he’s a Fellow of the American College of Trial Lawyers. Induction in both organizations is by invitation only, and is limited to the top trial lawyers in the country who exhibit exemplary character, ethics and professional standards. Additionally, Andy was elected to the AIEG Board of Directors. AIEG is an organization of top trial lawyers who handle Product Liability and other complex cases throughout the country. These organizations are highly selective and only a small percentage of practicing lawyers are invited to join.

Andy is one of the few trial attorneys inducted in the D Hall of Fame, earning recognition as one of the best lawyers in Dallas by D Magazine for 17 consecutive years. He has also been named repeatedly as a Top 100 Lawyer in D/FW and a Top 100 Lawyer in Texas by Texas Monthly’s Super Lawyers. In addition, he has been selected for inclusion in Best Lawyers in America® multiple times and has been named “Lawyer of the Year” (2015, 2019, 2021) by his peers in Product Liability Litigation/Plaintiffs in Dallas/Fort Worth. He has also earned Martindale-Hubbell’s highest rating (AV) through a peer-review evaluation. Andy is licensed in Texas, Oklahoma, and Arkansas, but routinely handles complex litigation across the nation. He has successfully tried numerous cases to jury verdict in state and federal courts.

Andy’s drive to help people goes beyond his cases with his deep commitment to pro bono representation. Each year he represents several clients without charging a fee, as a way to give back and to make a difference where it is needed most. Moreover, his firm has been a cornerstone donor to Equal Access to Justice campaigns over the last decade. Through the years, Andy and his partner have given hundreds of thousands of dollars to help individuals in crisis obtain legal services and much-needed access to the justice system.

Andy serves on the State Bar Pattern Jury Charge Committee, which drafts form jury charges in products liability cases used by all trial courts in the State of Texas. He is also on the Board of Directors for the State Bar of Texas Litigation Council. He has served on the State Bar Grievance Committee and has chaired Personal Injury seminars for both the State Bar and the Texas Trial Lawyers Association. A former Adjunct Professor of Products Liability at the SMU Dedman School of Law, Andy is a frequent lecturer at professional meetings both in Texas and nationally.

Outside of practicing law, Andy enjoys flying airplanes, riding dirt bikes, traveling and spending time with his wife and daughters.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Jason E. Payne is a native of Port Arthur, Texas who attended University of Houston and earned a Bachelors Degree in Political Science. While attending the University of Houston, Mr. Payne interned in the offices of State Representative Garnet Coleman and then State Representative Sylvester Turner. After graduating from the University of Houston in 1999, Mr. Payne attended law school at the University of Houston Law Center. While at the University of Houston Law Center, Mr. Payne was a member of the law school’s Interscholastic Mock Trial Team. Mr. Payne graduated from the University of Houston Law Center in 2002 and later attended Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University in Evanston Illinois, where he received his Master of Business Administration degree in 2011.

After graduating from the University of Houston Law Center, Mr. Payne began practicing law at the prestigious law firm of Hays, McConn, Rice & Pickering, P.C. Mr. Payne resigned from his position at Hays, McConn, Rice & Pickering, P.C. in 2004 and founded, Payne Law Firm, P.C., in Houston, Texas. Mr. Payne’s legal practice primarily consists of personal injury and wrongful death matter, and Mr. Payne has also represented a number of Fortune 500 clients. Mr. Payne is licensed to practice law in the State of Texas and the State of New York, and is a Board Certified Personal Injury Trial Attorney. Texas Super Lawyer Magazine has also selected Mr. Payne as a Rising Star for many of its publications as well as a Super Lawyer in 2019. In addition to his legal career, Mr. Payne has successfully advised countless small business and served as a political consultant to elected officials. Mr. Payne is a member of Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. and a member of Texas Boys State.

attorneys.name: Jack B. Peacock Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance and Banking Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
It's been my good pleasure during the past few years to represent numerous homeowners that have suffered various problems with mortgage companies that wrongfully attempt to foreclosure. Very often lenders fail to follow the FHA regulations concerning foreclosures or they fail to properly follow the terms and conditions of the mortgage documents. Therefore, very often they are wrongfully attempting to foreclose.

When that happens and a client comes to see us, our usual routine is to file a lawsuit against the lender and ask the Court for a restraining order to stop the foreclosure. The district judges in Dallas, Fort Worth, Denton, McKinney, and the surrounding counties will, almost always, grant restraining orders to stop wrongful foreclosures.

In addition, it has been our good pleasure to represent clients that have been defrauded by car dealers. Very often car dealers sell cars that have previously been badly damaged in motor vehicle accidents to such an extent that the frame of the vehicle is no longer properly aligned, and occasionally the frame alignment can never be properly repaired. In such cases, the vehicles are a danger for a person to drive. A dealer commits fraud when a buyer inquires about whether the vehicle has ever been in a serious accident and the sales person denies it or otherwise states that the vehicle had slight damage but has been fully repaired.

Our law firm has recovered judgments of over $200,000 against unscrupulous car dealers and lenders.

Recently, our firm has expanded to do more personal injury cases, including premises liability. Before tort reform took full effect in 1997 and 1998, I conducted and participated in numerous jury trials involving injured persons, with some jury verdicts over $1,000,000.

Recently, we settled a lawsuit involving personal injuries for $940,000, without ever having to go to trial.

In addition to representing the injured and defrauded in their real and personal property, our law firm has recently expanded to represent those injured in their intellectual property. I have combined my decades of litigation experience in state and federal courts to protect and defend our clients' rights in their patents, trademarks and copyrights in court. Our litigation attorneys team up with our patent attorney to produce strong and aggressive legal strategies.

It's been a real pleasure to represent injured persons and consumers who have been defrauded since I began practicing in 1974. Prior to attending law school at Baylor University, I was in the U.S. Army during the Vietnam War. I was a paratrooper and earned a Bronze Star for meritorious service in combat operations in the Republic of Vietnam in 1968 and 1969. When I left the military to return to college, I was a first lieutenant. My family has a history of military service in the United States Army for which I am very proud. My great-grandfathers on both sides of my family served during the Civil War. My paternal great-grandfather served with the Alabama Volunteers for the Confederacy, while my maternal great-grandfather served in the Union Army with the Missouri Volunteers. After the war, my great-grandfather, Jacob Levi Peacock, came to Dallas from Alabama and started the Peacock & Shirley Paint and Paper Company on Main Street in 1875. We have had family in Dallas ever since that day. My father served during World War II, during the invasion of Normandy, and at the Battle of the Bulge in Europe. He earned a Silver Star for service in Europe during World War II.

As my family history shows, we are fighters.

In 1975, shortly after graduation from law school at Baylor University, I became a Christian and went to Gordon Conwell Theological Seminary in South Hamilton, Massachusetts, to obtain a foundation in the faith. There I met my wife to be, Doli Gagnon, who is also a partner in our law firm. We have been married for 35 years and have two grown children and two grandchildren. Our son, Aaron, is also an attorney at Gagnon, Peacock & Vereeke, P.C. Our daughter, Sarah, is involved at Covenant Church in Colleyville.

It's been our privilege and good pleasure to serve the people of Dallas and Fort Worth and the surrounding communities since we came to Dallas in 1998.

We lived and practiced law in South Texas near the Rio Grande River Valley for approximately 21 years before coming to Dallas in 1998. We relocated to Dallas after our children were grown and we were "empty nesters."

Dallas and the surrounding area is a great place to live and work, as my great-grandfather learned when he came here from Alabama in 1875.

As our record representing clients in difficult situations shows, we enjoy representing our clients and always expect to achieve, and usually do achieve, great results for our clients.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Bronze Star, U.S. Army, Vietnam War, 1969

Scholarship, Baylor School of Law, 1971

Elder at New Covenant Church

attorneys.name: Aaron P. Peacock
attorneys.practice_type: Intellectual Property Law Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Aaron Peacock, a registered patent attorney, is an associate at the firm, having earned a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with emphasis in Computer Science graduating summa cum laude, a Master's degree in Business Administration and a Juris Doctorate degree in law. His legal practice encompasses all aspects of intellectual property law including patent, trademark and copyright law and emphasizes the advocacy and protection of intellectual property at the prosecution and litigation stages. He has experience in prosecuting patent and trademark applications before the United States Patent and Trademark Office as well as copyright applications before the United States Copyright Office. In addition, he has participated in intellectual property litigation before various courts. As a lawyer with an engineering and business background, he has the knowledge and capability to advise and counsel clients in a multifaceted marketplace to best protect their intellectual property.

Before joining the firm, Aaron was an associate attorney at Michael A. O'Neil, P.C., a small intellectual property law boutique. By joining forces with the litigation attorneys at Gagnon, Peacock & Vereeke P.C., Aaron believes that clients, especially intellectual property clients, can have peace of mind knowing that the firm can provide assistance in all aspects of intellectual property law - whether at the prosecution or litigation stages.

Schooled in business and an advocate of a free-market economy, he is a strong believer in that ol' tried and true slogan: the customer is always right. As a lawyer at Gagnon, Peacock & Vereeke P.C., he strives to go the extra mile for clients, providing excellent, effective service. He understands that clients are the life-blood of the firm. As a result, he believes in not just meeting but surpassing client expectations.

Away from the office, Aaron enjoys spending time with Jennifer, his girlfriend, and her big, rowdy dog, Bubba.

attorneys.name: Kevin Michael Peery
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of Tyler & Peery
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
My legal career began in the fall of 2018 after graduating from St. Mary’s Law School that spring and completing the Texas Bar Exam at the first available opportunity. I immediately began working as a criminal defense attorney, representing indigent clients charged with crimes. Shortly thereafter the newly elected District Attorney of Bexar County called and personally invited me to join his office. From January 2019 until August 2024, I represented the State of Texas in numerous criminal cases at a time when the Bexar County DA’s office struggled with unprecedented staffing shortages and an enormous backlog of cases due to the pandemic delaying in-person trials. During my time as an Assistant District Attorney I was assigned to multiple divisions, including but not limited to misdemeanor trial, felony intake, civil rights, felony family violence trial, and felony criminal trial division. I participated in or took the lead role in dozens of trials, some of which were against defendants charged with first degree felonies.

I was born in San Antonio and have lived in South Texas my entire life. My first job title was ranch hand. Between high school and college summers I worked on multiple cattle ranches, and I would estimate I’ve spent well over 1,000 hours running a chainsaw in the heat. I know the value of a strong back, that’s how I know that no amount of money will ever fully compensate our clients after a serious injury. When I meet with clients, I let them know the limits of my representation, we can never guarantee you your life quality from before the accident, but we can guarantee that we will leave no stone unturned when it comes to securing the largest possible settlement in each case. I’ve acquired the skills to successfully bring a case to trial and I understand how to frame even minor injuries to other people to make them understand how a person’s life may be permanently changed. As a firm, where we go one, we go all. Any client at the Law Offices of Tyler and Peery is represented not just by the lead attorney on their case but by the entire staff and all five attorneys. We excel at expanding our individual specialties and working together as a team. I’m proud to be a part of a firm that has not only achieved great results for injured clients over the past 34 years but has built a legacy doing so, known for treating people with respect and always having our client’s back. I look forward to continuing this legacy. If you have been injured due to someone else’s negligence, whether it be on the road, in the workplace or a dangerous premise, I will get to work on you case immediately to insure you receive every ounce of compensation you are entitled to.

attorneys.name: Dennis Peery
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of Tyler & Peery
attorneys.practice_type: Products Liability Lawyers in San Antonio, TX
attorneys.bio:
I am a managing partner of a personal injury law firm that practices throughout South Texas, representing people and families who have been injured or killed because of the negligence of others. Our firm is involved in all aspects of civil litigation involving the trial and settlement of personal injury and wrongful death claims. Our firm is composed of a team of trial lawyers and experienced support staff. We have tried cases throughout most of South Texas and the Texas Hill Country as well as many other parts of Texas. My partner, John Tyler, and I started this firm in 1990, some 30 years ago. Since then, we have grown from 2 attorneys to 6 with the focus on personal and professional representation of each client. Our mission is to take the load off of your shoulders during difficult times so that you can focus on your family and your recovery.

I am a native Texan who graduated from Texas A&M University in 1983 before enrolling in law school at St. Mary's University in 1985. Upon graduation from law school in 1988, I began my legal career as a prosecutor with the Bexar County District Attorney's office. I left government service in 1990 to start private practice. I have been board certified in personal injury trial law since 1996. I am licensed to practice in all state, district and county courts as well as the Federal Court for the Western District of Texas. I have earned an AV rating by my peers, which is the highest ranking available for both ethical conduct and legal ability.

My practice is devoted to representing injured people and their families in the most difficult times of their lives. We never lose sight of the fact that our clients are real people who have been placed in a very difficult position through no fault of their own. Usually my clients are at a disadvantage before they hire an attorney because the negligent defendant is represented by attorneys, insurance companies and large corporations whose sole objective is to save the company money. I have tried cases against the largest companies in the United States and I have taken on the government at the city, state and federal level. We battle some of the largest insurance companies and corporations in the world to make sure that each individual client receives a fair shake. Our trial attorneys are no strangers to the courtroom because we believe that you and your attorney must be ready to try each case if you want to receive a fair settlement. The insurance companies know which firms will go to trial and which ones will not. Our AV rating indicates that both sides of the bar appreciate our legal abilities as well as our ethical conduct.

My practice involves all aspects of personal injury and wrongful death litigation including medical malpractice, automobile accidents, trucking accidents, products liability, pharmaceutical liability, defective products, rail road crossing accidents, explosions, burns, catastrophic injuries, brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, paraplegia, quadriplegia, paralysis, herniated discs, birth injuries, nursing home neglect, construction accidents, boating accidents, drunk driving accidents, dram shop liability, rollovers, seatbelt cases, airbag cases and crashworthiness cases.

I believe that we should all try to make this world a better place than we found it. To this end, I have been active in my church, St. Joseph's Catholic Church of Devine, Texas having served as President of the Finance Council and as a team member for the Life Teen program. I have volunteered time in my community by coaching Little League, coaching youth sports and helping disadvantaged families. I am a member of the Texas Trial Lawyer's Association, the American Association for Justice, the San Antonio Bar Association, the San Antonio Bar Foundation, the San Antonio Trial Lawyers Association, and ABOTA, American Board of Trial Advocates. I have served as President of the San Antonio Trial Lawyer's Association and as the President of the San Antonio Chapter of the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA).

I have personally tried cases in Bexar County, Travis County, Medina County, Jim Wells County, La Salle County, Bandera County, Gonzales County, Atascosa County, Kerr County, Uvalde County and Guadalupe County while having filed or settled cases in many cases throughout Texas including, Harris County, Mason County, Brazos County, Denton County, Dallas County, Nueces County, Aransas County, Webb County, Real County, Tom Green County, Maverick County, Val Verde County, Kinney County, Dimmit County, Victoria County, Nueces County, Live Oak County, Karnes County, Wilson County, Bee County, Goliad County, Frio County, Gillespie County, Kendall County, Smith County, Starr County, Hidalgo County and Kimble County to name a few.

attorneys.name: Richard A. Pelley
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Sherman, TX
attorneys.bio:
Richard received his B.A. in Political Science from Baylor University in 1973 and his doctorate of jurisprudence from Baylor Law School in 1974. Mr. Pelley has practiced law for over 45 years in North Texas.

A former Bankruptcy Trustee, his practice now solely concentrates on representing debtors in Bankruptcy. Mr. Pelley is well recognized and respected for his skill and knowledge in Bankruptcy proceedings under Chapters 7, 11, and 13.

Mr. Pelley was a member of Delta Theta Phi legal fraternity at Baylor Law School. Since graduating Summa Cum Laude in 1974, he has served on the U.S. Panel of Trustees and as Bankruptcy Trustee in the Eastern District of Texas. He has also taught Business Law and served as President of the Grayson County Bar Association.

Richard has memberships in both Federal and State Bar Associations, including the United States Bankruptcy Court in the Eastern District of Texas, the United States District Court in the Eastern District of Texas, the State Bar of Texas, National Association of Consumer Bankruptcy Attorneys, and the Bankruptcy Bar for the United States District Court in the Eastern District of Texas.

Richard is admitted to practice in Texas, the United States District Court in the Eastern District of Texas, the United States District Court in the Northern District of Texas, the United States Court of Appeals in the 5th Circuit, and the Texas Supreme Court.

Mr. Pelley has successfully represented thousands of clients over five decades. In addition to individuals, his representative clients have included banks, title companies, insurance companies, cities, municipalities, and other corporate clients. He is an approved attorney for Stewart Title Company and Lawyers Title Company.

Mr. Pelley was the keynote speaker at the retirement ceremony of the United States Bankruptcy Court Judge Honorable Donald R. Sharp, and an invited speaker to the State Bar of Texas Continuing Legal Education program. He has spoken at and served with several local organizations including Lions Club, Kiwanis, and other charities.

attorneys.name: Charles A. Pelowski
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Charles is a seasoned criminal defense attorney with a rich career spanning over a decade. He currently holds the position of Senior Trial Attorney at Michael & Associates. His journey in the legal field began as a Public Defender, eventually leading him to oversee the Houston office of a prominent state-wide Texas criminal defense firm before joining Michael & Associates.

With a proven record in handling criminal cases across the state, from minor infractions to high-profile murder cases, Charles has demonstrated his prowess in dozens of jury trials and successful appeals. His approach to defense is marked by intense preparation, creativity, a deep commitment to the jury trial system, and an unwavering pursuit of justice. Charles firmly believes that sound investigations are the cornerstone of preparing a defense.

Charles believes American freedom is rooted in the country’s commitment to trial by jury. He will always fight for the underdog if their cause is just. Outside the courtroom, Charles is an avid practitioner of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, a discipline that reflects his tenacity, strategic thinking, and love for the fight.

Dedicated to the principles of freedom, his extensive trial skills and strategic insights make him a formidable advocate for those accused of a crime in the Greater Houston area.

attorneys.bio:
Steven M. Peña, Sr. is a member of the Firm's Public Law Section. He joined the firm in 2007 after having worked for a Fortune 200 insurer. Mr. Peña brings to the firm a wealth of knowledge in insurance, insurance defense, and complicated claims management. He was educated at Southwest Texas State University [now Texas State University] (B.B.A. 1984), Our Lady of the Lake University (M.B.A. 1989), and received his law degree from St. Mary’s University School of Law (J.D. 1994). While at St. Mary’s Mr. Peña was a member of Phi Delta Phi legal scholastic honor fraternity and the Hispanic Law Students Association. He was admitted to the Texas bar in 1994 and is licensed in the United States District Court for the Western District of Texas.

Mr. Peña’s practice is focused on providing general legal services in the representation of local municipal governments. He currently serves as the City Attorney for the Cities of Helotes, Cotulla and Sabinal, Texas where he provides general counsel and municipal court prosecution services. Mr. Peña is General Counsel to the Cotulla and Helotes Economic Development Corporations and has recently been retained by the City of Cuero to advise and assist in the creation and implementation of a Buildings & Standards Commission. Mr. Peña has significant experience in multi-jurisdictional property & casualty insurance matters and has represented clients in criminal law, personal injury, family law cases, real estate transactions, as well as the acquisition and sale of water rights.

attorneys.name: Chase Russell Pembroke
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law (Divorce / Child Custody & Support / Protective Orders / Enforcements) Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Driven by a passion for helping families to find healthy solutions during challenging times, Chase Pembroke brings a blend of legal acumen, practical experience, and genuine empathy to his role as an Associate Attorney with Ramos Law Group. From drafting pleadings and making oral arguments to guiding clients step-by-step through the legal process, Chase prioritizes client well-being and results oriented legal representation. Chase’s practice focuses on the issues Texas families face every day, including divorces and child custody disputes, and he is committed to achieving the best possible outcomes in each case.

Chase’s path to family law began at the University of Houston Law Center, where he immersed himself in competitive mock trials, moot court tournaments, and negotiation competitions. These experiences sharpened his courtroom skills, molded him into a persuasive advocate, and cultivated his talent for negotiating high-stakes disputes under pressure. Before joining Ramos Law Group, Chase worked in a variety of legal areas, tackling a broad spectrum of litigation from probating wills to litigating business disputes. Although he developed a diverse legal background, his true calling has always been family law. He now dedicates his career exclusively to family law matters, helping clients navigate important life transitions with confidence and peace of mind. Chase diligently guides his clients through each phase of the legal process with the ultimate goal of restructuring healthier family dynamics and healing family relationships.

Chase’s educational background in both psychology and business administration shaped his appreciation for the human and financial factors at the core of almost every family law matter. He understands that no two people are alike and every family is unique, so even the strongest legal strategy must be tailored to the individual circumstances of each client. At Ramos Law Group, Chase’s mission is simple: to deliver life-improving solutions for his clients as they work through life’s challenges, and to help Texas families emerge from their legal disputes in a healthier place than where they started. In every case, he combines tenacity with empathy, practical problem-solving with legal expertise, and client-centered service with result-driven advocacy.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Jacksonville, TX
attorneys.bio:
A mother and wife, Jill was born in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. She received her Bachelor of Science in Marketing with a minor in Business Administration from Louisiana State University in December 2001. In 2005, she graduated from LSU’s law school, where she received various honors including Dean's List and Order of the Coif. She was a member of the Louisiana Law Review and Vice-President of the Legal Association of Women. After law school graduation, she and her husband moved to Dallas, Texas, where she practiced law for 6 years at one of the state's largest law firms. In 2011, she and her husband decided to move their family down to East Texas, where her husband grew up, to be closer to family and to begin a trial-intensive law practice.

Jill has prosecuted and defended numerous types of lawsuits. She has represented Fortune 500 companies, small businesses, and individuals in cases involving everything from securities fraud class action to probate litigation, from car accidents to construction defect litigation, and from divorce and child support issues to partnership disputes. She is admitted to practice in all state courts in Texas as well as all four U.S. District Courts of Texas.

attorneys.bio:
For more than a decade, the Law Offices of Deborah S. Perry, PLLC, has provided experienced family law and criminal defense representation to clients in Kerrville and the surrounding parts of Texas.

When you are faced with a family law or criminal defense case, you want an attorney who will work hard to protect you. When you choose the Law Offices of Deborah S. Perry, PLLC, you will receive aggressive representation from attorney Deborah S. Perry. Attorney Perry will work with you personally. You will never be handed off to a junior attorney or paralegal. You will have the confidence that comes with knowing your case is in good hands at all times.

During your free, no-obligation initial consultation, attorney Perry will take the time to learn about your situation. If you have a family law case involving divorce, child custody or any other matter, she will ask questions about your circumstances and your goals for the future. If you have been charged with a crime, she will listen to your side of the story. Once she has all of the necessary information, she will work with you to design a customized legal strategy.

While many cases are resolved through negotiation, Deborah S. Perry is a trial lawyer. If an opponent is unwilling to concede, she will go to trial. She knows how to build cases with the strength to hold up during a courtroom argument. She knows how to find the weaknesses in an opponent's case.

attorneys.name: Julie Peschel
attorneys.practice_type: Admiralty & Maritime Law Lawyers in Temple, TX
attorneys.bio:
Julie Peschel is a partner at The Carlson Law Firm who recognizes that navigating a personal injury claim is an emotional rollercoaster. That is why for more than a decade, she has dedicated herself to her clients and to The Carlson Law Firm. When the people of Temple need a knowledgeable and qualified personal injury lawyer, they turn to Julie Peschel.

Experience on your side

Julie followed in the footsteps of her cousin and older brother when she decided to obtain her Juris Doctor. She knew that she wanted to get an education past her undergraduate degree in psychology that would allow her to help others. Julie has excelled in her career and her education because she doesn't view practicing law as a job. Instead, she recognizes that the primary function of her role is providing her community with a necessary service. Julie has compassionately helped clients through injuries from car wrecks, 18-wheeler and commercial vehicle crashes, dog bites, dram shop, premises liability cases and daycare injury. She has also helped families through wrongful death cases.

Clients who turn to Julie during their time of need can rest assured that they will get an attorney who cares about the details. She recognizes that each case is different and requires a unique approach. Clients appreciate Julie's tireless work ethic and knowledge. She strives to get clients the best possible resolution.

Her most notable case to date was out of the 146th Judicial District Court of Bell County. A rear-end collision caused her client to sustain a traumatic brain injury, as well as a neck and back injury that required surgery. Because of the expertise of Julie and another Carlson Law Firm attorney, the jury awarded nearly $1 million to assist our client with medical bills and other expenses stemming from the collision. Since this case, Julie has settled several million dollar cases on behalf of her clients.

Julie graduated from Baylor University School of Law in 2006; she earned her Bachelors of Science in Psychology from Texas A&M University in 2003. Julie is a member of some of the best professional associations including the Bell County Bar Association, Bell County Young Lawyers, and serves as the Sustainer of the Junior League of Bell County.

When she isn't serving the community through law, she's serving the community in other ways. She is passionate about learning about issues surrounding special needs education and special needs advocacy. As the mother of special needs child, she feels strongly that children and adults of all abilities are entitled to a life of choice, independence and equality.

She enjoys spending time with her family, traveling and reading.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Million Dollar Advocates Forum, Life Member

attorneys.name: Joan Peterson
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Buda, TX
attorneys.bio:
Joan is an attorney at Key Law Office. Her primary practice area is family law.

Joan represents clients in all areas of family law. Joan is committed to a family law practice that focuses on seeking positive resolutions that are in the best interest of children and families. She is an experienced attorney and litigator with a strong record of public service. Joan worked at the Travis County District Attorney’s office for 18 years, where she led a team of attorneys representing the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services in cases involving abuse and neglect of children and worked as a prosecutor in juvenile court. She has worked with social work and therapeutic professionals to present testimony in complex termination of parental rights and custody issues while focusing on the best interest of the child.

Joan works to bring balance and provide clear judgment in emotionally complex cases. Joan has experience negotiating difficult cases as an attorney and a mediator. She is committed to providing compassionate representation and helping clients find the best solutions for their cases.

She a native of Montana, went to Law School at Lewis and Clark Northwestern Law school in Oregon and moved to Texas, where she raised her family. She loves to travel, practice yoga and spend time with her family and her sweet dog, San.

attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy, Restructuring and Insolvency Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mark Petrocchi maintains a Fort Worth bankruptcy, reorganization and creditors' rights practice, representing clients in bankruptcy related cases and in out-of-court workouts primarily in the Dallas/Fort Worth area, but also in other jurisdictions in and out of Texas. He has extensive knowledge and experience representing many types of participants in bankruptcy cases, state court cases, debt restructuring, liquidations, workouts, asset sales, business sales and related types of representations, including debtors, secured and unsecured creditors, financial institutions, trustees, committees, asset purchasers and sellers.

His representations include creditors, trustees and debtors in large cases to mom & pop types of businesses. He has substantial experience in litigation and is regularly involved in contested adversary proceedings in bankruptcy court, including actions for recovery of preferences, fraudulent transfer actions, valuation motions, stay proceedings, plan confirmations and an array of motions related to bankruptcy cases. Because Mark Petrocchi is fortunate enough to enjoy a broad bankruptcy practice, he is required by BACPA 2005 to state "We are a debt relief agency. We help people file for bankruptcy relief under the bankruptcy code."

attorneys.bio:
For more than a decade, Tara has dedicated her legal career to advocating for individuals and families who have been mistreated by insurance companies. Her practice spans personal injury, workers’ compensation, and first-party insurance disputes. What sets Tara apart is her insider’s understanding of the insurance industry – earned through several years spent representing a major insurance carrier. This experience equips her with valuable insight into how insurers operate and how to challenge their tactics effectively.

Tara leverages this knowledge to give her clients a strategic advantage. Her advocacy is hands-on and client-centered, rooted in the belief that injured and hardworking people deserve more than just promises- they deserve results.

A proud graduate of Louisiana State University’s Paul M. Hebert Law Center, Tara is licensed to practice law in Texas and Louisiana and is admitted to all Texas federal district courts.

Clients and colleagues describe Tara as a strong, practical advocate who listens closely, prepares thoroughly, and litigates with professionalism and integrity.

Outside the courtroom, Tara enjoys traveling and spending time with her family. She is also deeply committed to pro bono work, providing legal assistance to Brazoria and Harris Counties’ underserved individuals.

attorneys.name: John J. Pfister Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Frisco, TX
attorneys.bio:
John Pfister is an experienced and highly regarded Frisco family law attorney and the founder of Pfister Family Law. With every case he takes on, John Pfister works to understand his clients’ goals and priorities; then, he uses this information to build powerful and effective cases aimed at achieving his clients’ objectives. At the firm, he represents clients in everything from contested and high-net-worth divorces to child custody battles and visitation disputes. He has successfully taken on Child Protective Services (CPS) and helped stepparents and grandparents through the adoption process. With a firsthand understanding of what his clients are going through and the challenges they face, John Pfister is a compassionate, dedicated, and aggressive advocate for those navigating tough family law issues.

John Pfister always knew he wanted to be a lawyer. He attended Texas A&M University, where he obtained a degree in Management Information Systems in 1989 before going on to earn his Juris Doctor degree from the Southern Methodist University School of Law in 1992. He was admitted to the State Bar of Texas that same year.

Throughout his career, John Pfister has experienced numerous defining moments, including winning his first contested trial, successfully helping a client who didn’t expect to win custody, and, most recently, arguing a case before the Texas Supreme Court. Above all else, however, John Pfister is most proud of the opportunities he has had to make a difference in the lives of his clients. He approaches each case in the most efficient and cost-effective manner possible. With every client, he offers personalized legal strategies and solutions, whether that means litigating aggressively on his client’s behalf at trial or seeking a resolution through mediation.

John Pfister is Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, a distinction that earns him the right to call himself an “expert” in the area of family law. He is one of only about 8% of all attorneys across all areas of practice in the state of Texas to have this distinction. Additionally, John Pfister is a member of the Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists and the Frisco Bar Association. He has been selected for inclusion in the Texas Super Lawyers® Rising Stars list every year from 2014 to 2019. He was also named Collin County Litigator of the Year in 2011.

Click here to view John Pfister's oral argument at the Texas Supreme Court.

sections.content:
John Pfister is an experienced and highly regarded Frisco family law attorney and the founder of Pfister Family Law. With every case he takes on, John Pfister works to understand his clients’ goals and priorities; then, he uses this information to build powerful and effective cases aimed at achieving his clients’ objectives. At the firm, he represents clients in everything from contested and high-net-worth divorces to child custody battles and visitation disputes. He has successfully taken on Child Protective Services (CPS) and helped stepparents and grandparents through the adoption process. With a firsthand understanding of what his clients are going through and the challenges they face, John Pfister is a compassionate, dedicated, and aggressive advocate for those navigating tough family law issues.

John Pfister always knew he wanted to be a lawyer. He attended Texas A&M University, where he obtained a degree in Management Information Systems in 1989 before going on to earn his Juris Doctor degree from the Southern Methodist University School of Law in 1992. He was admitted to the State Bar of Texas that same year.

Throughout his career, John Pfister has experienced numerous defining moments, including winning his first contested trial, successfully helping a client who didn’t expect to win custody, and, most recently, arguing a case before the Texas Supreme Court. Above all else, however, John Pfister is most proud of the opportunities he has had to make a difference in the lives of his clients. He approaches each case in the most efficient and cost-effective manner possible. With every client, he offers personalized legal strategies and solutions, whether that means litigating aggressively on his client’s behalf at trial or seeking a resolution through mediation.

John Pfister is Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, a distinction that earns him the right to call himself an “expert” in the area of family law. He is one of only about 8% of all attorneys across all areas of practice in the state of Texas to have this distinction. Additionally, John Pfister is a member of the Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists and the Frisco Bar Association. He has been selected for inclusion in the Texas Super Lawyers® Rising Stars list every year from 2014 to 2019. He was also named Collin County Litigator of the Year in 2011.

When not practicing law, Brent enjoys spending time with his family, playing lacrosse, and golfing.

attorneys.name: Mark T. Phelps
attorneys.practice_type: Physician Employment Counseling and Contract Negotiation Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Phelps received his undergraduate degree from Baylor University in 1977 and a Master of Science in Health Care Administration from Trinity University in 1979. Mr. Phelps spent five years working in the field of Healthcare Administration before attending South Texas College Law, where he graduated in 1988.

His experience in Healthcare Administration included progressive management and health care positions during a six (6) year period attaining the positions of Vice President for General Services of a 400+ bed acute care facility. He managed 10 department heads and a total of 456 employees.

He practiced with several insurance defense law firms rising to the level of Shareholder before starting his own firm in 2001. Mr. Phelps’s legal practice has focused on Health Law issues, where he has utilized his years of experience in Healthcare Administration and his Masters degree in Health Care Administration. The addition of arbitration and mediation services has provided yet another facet for clients in the health care and employment arenas. He has provided administrative and corporate health law services for a variety of health care entities in the Greater Houston area on issues including managed care contracts; various Houston health care contracts; compliance issues, Stark laws, Fraud and Abuse, Anti kickback laws; EMTALA, HIPAA; and representation of health care providers on credentialing and licensure issues before state regulatory agencies. Mr. Phelps is a proponent of advising his health care clients, large and small, to expand their compliance programs to voluntarily include Sarbanes Oxley compliance. He has given numerous seminars and written articles published on many of these issues, including issues before the TMB; Physician Advertising; the Medical Standard of Care; Arbitration; CMS Bundled Payments; Hospital Readmission Reduction Program; Managed Care and Ethics; Human Resource Issues for Physician Practices.

At Texas Woman’s University, Mr. Phelps serves as a Clinical Associate Professor and teaches Houston Health Law, Ethics, Human Resources, Marketing, Managing the Hospital, Managing the Outpatient Setting, Long Term Care, and Capstone. He has also been an Instructor at the University of Texas Health Science Center Medical School at Houston.

Mr. Phelps is admitted to practice before the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas. Mr. Phelps is a member of the State Bar of Texas, the Houston Bar Association, and their corresponding Health Law Sections. Additionally, Mr. Phelps is a member of the American Health Lawyers Association. He is the Secretary/Treasurer of the Foundation of the Southeast Texas Chapter of the American College Healthcare Executives.

attorneys.name: Michael L. Phifer
attorneys.practice_type: Bad Faith Insurance Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Michael L. Phifer graduated from Vanderbilt Law School in 1983 after receiving his undergraduate degree from Vanderbilt University in 1979. He began his career practicing civil trial law in Houston, Texas with Vinson & Elkins, where he primarily represented corporate defendants and Fortune 500 companies in commercial, oil and gas, aviation, products liability, and other personal injury cases.

In 1992, Mike made a significant change. Because he sympathized with those who had been injured, he stopped representing corporate defendants. For the past 15 years, he has exclusively represented the victims of negligence and defective products.

In his first medical malpractice case as a plaintiff's attorney, the jury awarded more than one million dollars against the defendant surgeon; this case was later profiled in a New York Times article discussing problem physicians.

In 2001, Mike spearheaded the efforts of Texas lawyers to bring Ford and Firestone to justice for the tragic deaths and injuries caused by the Ford Explorer and Firestone tires.

Heading the Plaintiff's Steering Committee for the Texas Consolidated Cases, he led discovery efforts against Ford and Firestone on behalf of several hundred Texas cases, argued before the Texas Supreme Court on corporate trade secrets, and traveled throughout the United States to question corporate and engineering witnesses.

The deposition testimony he elicited from Ford and Firestone has been successfully used by Plaintiff's lawyers throughout the United States in support of their cases. For his efforts, Mike Phifer was one of a group of lawyers from across the United States honored by the American Association for Justice with the Steven J. Sharp Public Service Award. In 2002, having built an established practice, he opened the offices of Michael L. Phifer, P.C. In one of his first cases, he reached a multi-million dollar settlement with a Fortune 500 company and its franchisees for the young victim of a sexual assault.

He has obtained multi-million dollar recoveries for his clients in the areas of medical negligence, products liability, automobile and tire defects, sexual assault, brain injury, electrocution, toxic exposure and industrial death.

His current practice is concentrated in the areas of defective automobiles and tires, medical negligence, wrongful death, drug and products liability, brain injury and rollover/stability litigation. He has successfully represented Plaintiffs throughout Texas, including the cities of Abilene, Beaumont, Corpus Christi, El Paso, Dallas, Fort Worth, Galveston and San Antonio. Although he is not licensed in Massachusetts or Florida, he has been retained by attorneys in Boston and Miami to assist them with wrongful death cases arising from defective automobiles and tires.

Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Mike has served as an Adjunct Professor of Law at Vanderbilt School of Law and has lectured on litigation matters at various CLE programs sponsored by the University of Houston School of Law, the State Bar of Texas and South Texas College of Law. He has also served as a member of the Vanderbilt Law School Alumni Board, and he has been elected to membership in the American Board of Trial Advocates.

Mike Phifer has performed volunteer legal work with the Houston Volunteer Lawyers Program, representing indigent clients in family law cases, and has also done volunteer work with the Houston Bar Association and the Houston Trial Lawyers Foundation. Continuing his commitment to legal education, he has endowed the Phifer Scholarship at Vanderbilt Law School in honor of his parents.

attorneys.name: Shane Phelps
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Bryan, TX
attorneys.bio:
Shane Phelps is regarded by many to be one of the best trial attorneys in Central Texas. In his 26-year legal career, he has tried more than 100 jury trials, including misdemeanors, felonies, white collar crimes, public corruption cases, murder and capital murder. He is well-known for his meticulous preparation, legal research skills, and courtroom ability. For ten years, Shane served as the First Assistant District Attorney in one of the most effective and successful prosecution offices in Texas. After leaving the DA's office, Shane entered private practice concentrating exclusively in Criminal Defense work.

A former United States Marine, Shane graduated from two of the finest universities in the country, Rice University in Houston, Texas (B.A. English, 1983) and The University of Texas School of Law in Austin, Texas (J.D., 1987). Since graduating from law school, Shane has served as an assistant district attorney in Houston, as chief special prosecutor for the Texas Office of the Attorney General, and was appointed Deputy Attorney General for Criminal Justice in 1999 by John Cornyn.

Having tried numerous high profile cases over the years, Shane has been featured on Dateline NBC, NPR, and on the covers of the Texas Lawyer and Austin Chronicle magazines, as well as scores of newspapers across Texas.

Shane has been board certified in criminal law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization since 1992. Becoming board certified is a rigorous process that requires years of experience in trial and appellate work, the recommendations of attorneys and judges, and a six-hour exam in the specialty sought. Only a small percentage of attorneys in Texas are board certified. Shane is also a member of the College of the State Bar, an elite legal fraternity that recognizes attorneys who exceed the minimum requirements for continuing legal education each year.

Because of his expertise in the law, Shane has been called upon repeatedly to lecture on trial advocacy, search and seizure law, white collar crime, ethics, the death penalty, and public corruption to prosecutors, peace officers, police cadets, and community groups across Texas. Shane was twice the course director for the Texas District and County Attorneys Association's Advanced Trial Advocacy Course, where experienced prosecutors studied a case scenario based on a murder case Shane successfully tried. He has also published articles on the death penalty, public corruption, and environmental law.

Shane has argued cases before several Texas Courts of Appeal and the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals, the highest criminal court in Texas.

attorneys.name: James Phillips
attorneys.practice_type: Appellate Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
James T. Phillips is a member of the Firm's litigation section. He has been practicing law in Dallas since 1995. His experience includes representing both plaintiffs and defendants in litigation, appellate and administrative matters involving insurance, construction defects and injuries, engineering errors, OSHA violations, environmental remediation, aviation, products liability, real estate disputes, landlord-tenant disputes and commercial disputes.

Prior to entering law school in 1992, Mr. Phillips spent four years as an aerospace structural engineer. After receiving his undergraduate degree in engineering from Southern Methodist University in 1988, Mr. Phillips was employed by Bell Helicopter Textron in Fort Worth, Texas, as a structural fatigue engineer. There he was responsible for analyzing the effects of fatigue stresses on helicopter rotor and airframe components, and determining safe retirement lives for those components. Mr. Phillips then joined The Boeing Company in Seattle, Washington, as a structural engineer in its damage tolerance group. There he worked on fatigue and structural analysis of Boeing's 747 and 767 product lines, as part of Boeing's "Aging Fleet" program, a program committed to the safe operation of jets during the later years of their design lives and beyond. Mr. Phillips' engineering experience is particularly valuable to his practice in the areas such as products liability, aviation, engineering and construction litigation.

In his free time, Mr. Phillips enjoys a variety of spectator sports, reading, golf, creative writing, snow skiing, cooking and enjoying the occasional bottle of good wine with his wife, Laura.

attorneys.name: Robert M. Phillips III
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Georgetown, TX
attorneys.bio:
Robert M. Phillips III was a legendary criminal lawyer, both as a prosecutor and a defense attorney. He began his legal career in the Dallas County District Attorney's Office, where he tried hundreds of cases. He then relocated to Williamson County as the first assistant District Attorney and continued in that role for a number of years. Since the 1980s up to his untimely passing in 2021, Bob was a prominent defense attorney, defending the rights and freedom of thousands of people throughout Central Texas.

Bob was known for is big personality and his drive to get the best outcome for his clients. He was known throughout courthouses as an honorable, sometimes bombastic, and highly aggressive defense attorney.

Bob had several associate attorneys throughout the years, with the last and most long tenured being Douglas N. Ranney. In 2019, for the first time in his career, Bob made Mr. Ranney a named partner and thus was born Phillips & Ranney.

Bob was known throughout the Austin and Georgetown communities for his civic service, extreme adoration of baseball, and his work with Redeemer Presbyterian in service of the Almighty. In 2021 Bob unexpectedly passed away, leaving our physical presence but never leaving our memories.

Ranney Law LLC was formed after Bob's passing, yet we continue the same tradition of aggressive representation, seeking only the best results, with the highest possible ethics. I consider my practice a testament to Bob and hope that he is looking down from heaven favorably on our work.

attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation and Appeals Lawyers in Fort Worth, TX
attorneys.bio:
Having handled hundreds of criminal matters, tried over 50 civil and criminal cases to judge and jury, handled countless civil and criminal appeals, and worked as counsel to firms in the oil and gas industry, Scott understands how to advocate and represent his clients in all phases of business and litigation. But Scott also understands that the law and legal disputes don’t happen in a vacuum. Often personal and business issues can intersect with cases to complicate an already challenging environment.

Scott was selected by his peers as a Top Attorney in Fort Worth, Texas from 2015 to present. He is also a member of the College of the State Bar of Texas, an honorary society of lawyers who are among the best trained attorneys in Texas. Scott earned his law degree from Texas Wesleyan School of Law (now Texas A&M School of Law).

Before law school, Scott worked for 15 years in the computer industry as an IT consultant where he advised enterprises on how to secure and manage their network assets. During this time he also earned several industry certifications and routinely gave lectures on organizational security.
