attorneys.name: JoAl Cannon Sheridan
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
JoAl Cannon Sheridan is a well-known and experienced trial lawyer in the area of family law. Board Certified in Family Law since 2008 by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, JoAl is recognized both statewide and nationally as a frequent speaker to both lawyers and judges on complex family law topics, including third-party and grandparent cases, conservatorship, interstate and international jurisdictional issues, complex marital property law, and professionalism and ethics.

JoAl relocated to Austin in 2008 after a successful 14-year practice in East Texas. After becoming extremely involved in the Central Texas legal community, she was honored in 2019 to found Sheridan Family Law PLLC.

JoAl’s commitment has led her to assume numerous leadership positions in notable organizations and initiatives throughout the state and country, and has provided her the opportunity to cultivate her heart for service, both to her clients, her profession and the community. JoAl currently serves as President of the Texas Family Law Foundation, which promotes sound public policy and legislation during the Texas Legislative Session. JoAl testifies frequently before State Senate and House committees on issues of family law, and is considered a valuable resource on family law matters by many lobbyists and Legislators.

Additionally, JoAl is the Immediate Past-President of the Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists, Immediate Past-President of the Austin Bar Association Family Law Section, former Council member of the State Bar of Texas Family Law Section from 2001-2011, where she has served on its Legislative Committee since 2001. Prior to that time, JoAl was the youngest ever elected Director to the State Bar of Texas Board of Directors, where she served as Chair of the Legislative Committee, Co-Chair of the Legal Services to the Poor committee, and on the Executive Committee.

Professionalism has always been the core of how JoAl practices law, which manifests itself not only in how she deals with her clients and colleagues, but also in her service to the legal community and public. Appointed by the Texas Supreme Court to the Board of Disciplinary Appeals from 2008-2014, she served as Vice-Chair of the board from 2009-2013, and Chair of the Board from 2013-2014, presiding over many appeals of attorney grievance matters. She currently serves as the Chair of the Professionalism Committee of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, a national elite organization of highly skilled, leading practitioners in the area of family law. Only approximately 1,650 family lawyers throughout the United States are accepted as Fellows in the Academy. JoAl also serves on the Legislation, Membership, and Public Service committees.

Recognized as a Texas Super Lawyer every year since 2004, JoAl is also listed in the 2014-2018 editions of the Best Lawyers in America in the area of Family Law. JoAl holds an AV Rating from Martindale Hubbell, which is the highest lawyer rating for both ability and ethics. In 2017 she was named a Top 50 Lawyer in Central and West Texas.

JoAl has developed a reputation for being a direct, skilled and zealous advocate who also understands the often emotionally charged issues that arise in a family law matter. She is known for being reasonable, articulate, prepared and courteous, while being sensitive to the needs of families to be able to move forward in a positive way in an atmosphere of meaningful co-parenting relationships.

JoAl’s practice focuses on complex custody and property cases, with a particular affinity for third-party custody, grandparent issues, and interstate jurisdictional matters. JoAl feels strongly that the representation of her clients during these most difficult, emotional times is a calling as much as a profession, and that the tone that is set from the outset of the matter is key to promoting constructive familial relationships throughout the case and beyond.

In her spare time, JoAl is active in St. John’s United Methodist Church, where she sings in the choir and plays in the Jones Memorial Handbell group, as well as serves on the Endowment Fund Committee. JoAl and her husband, Dirk, hold professional level Dive Master certifications, and enjoy tennis and cross-fit training.

attorneys.name: James E. Sherry
attorneys.practice_type: Appellate Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
McCathern partner James "Jim" Sherry is an experienced civil and criminal litigator who has guided corporate and individual clients through every stage of litigation, from pre-suit investigation through successful merits appeal to the United States Supreme Court.

Jim regularly represents clients in complex business disputes involving diverse areas of law, with a particular focus on litigation involving commercial real estate leasing and landlord/tenant relations, oil and gas construction, leasing, and finance, director and officer liability, securities fraud and compliance, and employment disputes. Over the course of his career, Jim has tried civil and criminal cases to victory before state and federal judges and juries, and has taken numerous cases through successful appeal in state and federal court, including the United States Supreme Court (Filarksy v. Delia, 566 U.S. 377 (2012)). Jim has also guided corporate and individual clients through delicate internal investigations involving issues of employment discrimination, securities fraud and compliance, and international export controls.

Jim's uniquely varied professional experience has given him the opportunity to represent both plaintiffs and defendants in cases involving everything from slip and fall injuries and motor vehicle accidents to complex financial and real estate transactions, multi-billion dollar securities fraud and insider trading schemes, commercial bribery, corporate internal investigations, and public corruption matters involving parallel civil and criminal proceedings. He has also successfully represented clients before administrative agencies and state bar disciplinary authorities.

Jim graduated summa cum laude from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor in 2002, and earned his J.D. cum laude from the George Washington University Law School in 2005. In 2009, Jim returned to GW Law as an Adjunct Professor of Legal Research and Writing, and since 2016 has taught the same course at the University of North Texas - Dallas School of Law. Jim is also a referring attorney for Lambda Legal and Immigration Equality, and has represented several clients pro bono in successful applications for asylum in the United States.

Jim offices in the McCathern Dallas office and is a member of the bars of Texas, Massachusetts, and the District of Columbia. He is admitted to practice before the United States Supreme Court, the First, Second, Third, Fifth, and Federal Circuit Courts of Appeals, and federal district courts around the country.

Jim was named to the Texas "Rising Stars" list by Super Lawyers in 2015 and 2016.

Mr. Shipman’s practice focuses on the resolution of complex business disputes through negotiation, mediation, arbitration and litigation. As a result, Mr. Shipman’s practice emphasizes the representation of clients engaged in construction, manufacturing, engineering and other technical disciplines.

His recent representations include:

Representing clients in the construction industry in construction defect claims, lien/bond claims, back charge and bid disputes, and collection actions.

Representing clients in the engineering industry in design defect claims, negligence and/or breach of warranty claims, contract negotiations, and easement disputes.

Representing both industrial facilities and property developers in land use and zoning disputes.

Representing a major industrial operation in a common law nuisance lawsuit brought by an adjoining community.

Mr. Shipman also has extensive experience representing clients in disputes related to the enforcement of covenants not to compete.

Charles Shipman is not certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.

attorneys.name: Les Shireman
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Les Shireman is a licensed attorney who is Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. He graduated with honors from South Texas College of Law. Before turning to the practice of law, Les worked in the mental health field as a Licensed Clinical Social Worker and a Licensed Chemical Dependency Counselor. Les’ practice is devoted entirely to family law matters, both trial and appellate.

His past experience as a therapist provides Les with a distinctive skill set uniquely suited to family law. Because family law cases are generally charged with a great deal of emotion, Les’ awareness of psychological and emotional issues gives him an advantage in analyzing cases and developing a negotiation and litigation strategy to get the best possible result for his clients. This results in the development of negotiation strategies that have a high likelihood of success. Les’ experience as an appellate lawyer gives him the knowledge and skill to ensure that, if an appeal from an adverse ruling is necessary, all procedural and evidentiary burdens are met so that the appeal can go forward.

In addition to his law degree, Les has a Bachelor of Science Degree and a Master’s Degree in Social Work from the University of Houston. He is a member of the Family Law Section of the State Bar of Texas, the Houston Bar Association, the College of the State Bar of Texas, and Gulf Coast Family Law Specialists.

attorneys.name: Arnold Shokouhi
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Arnold Shokouhi is an equity owner and Managing Partner for McCathern. His practice focuses on complex civil litigation, with a particular focus on business disputes, real estate, director and officer liability, health care litigation, and cannabis law.

Arnold leads the firm’s Banking & Mortgage Section utilizing his extensive experience in the mortgage banking industry. This practice group handles everything from drafting mortgage documents, to dealing with state and federal compliance matters, to representing financial institutions, land developers, and others in litigation involving commercial real estate transactions, judicial and nonjudicial foreclosure, and commercial leasing.

Arnold’s experience handling transactional matters has given him the unique ability to filter through the intricacies of complex commercial litigation matters. He has played a critical role in the litigation of multi-million dollar disputes between billion dollar corporations. For example, Arnold took the lead role for Cowboys Stadium, L.P. in the litigation involving highly publicized suite lawsuits at Cowboys Stadium. His experiences enable him to represent both small and large clients in the commercial and employment litigation arenas. Arnold follows the belief that there is no small client or matter, and he handles all client matters with the utmost diligence and importance.

Arnold was raised in Austin, Texas and moved to the Dallas area in 1999 to attend Southern Methodist University. Arnold received his Bachelor of Business Administration in Financial Consulting (a hybrid finance/accounting degree) from the Cox School of Business in 2003. He received his law degree from Michigan State University College of Law, where he earned a certificate of concentration in corporate law. Arnold was licensed to practice law by the state of Texas in 2006 and the state of California in 2011. He is licensed to practice law in all of the United States District Courts in both Texas and California. He is a member of the Mortgage Banking Association (MBA), Dallas Bar Association (DBA), and Dallas Young Lawyers Association (DYLA).

He has been named to the Texas Super Lawyers Rising Stars® list from 2013 to 2019. Additionally, Arnold was named by D Magazine as a Dallas Best Lawyer from 2014 to 2017 for Banking & Finance and Business Litigation. He was also selected by Texas Lawyer as one of 20 Texas attorneys named to 2015 Extraordinary Minorities in Texas Law. In 2017, Super Lawyers magazine featured Arnold in an article that told his remarkable story.

Board Certified Personal Injury and Board Certified Criminal Trial Lawyer Patrick Short is a trial lawyer based in Rockwall County, Texas, the county east of Dallas County with over 32 years of experience representing clients in East and North Texas in personal injury, wrongful death, criminal defense, and selected civil litigation matters. Patrick is Board Certified in Criminal Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and in Criminal Trial Advocacy by the National Board of Trial Advocacy. He is also Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Patrick is one of eight lawyers in the State of Texas that are double Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in both Personal Injury Trial Law and Criminal Law. Patrick has been selected as a Texas Super Lawyer every year since 2006 in addition to his invitation-only selection of the American Trial Lawyers Association’s Top 100 Trial Lawyers in 2009 and 2011. He has been selected to the invitation-only Best Attorneys of America. Patrick is admitted to practice law before the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, and the U.S. District Court for the Northern and Eastern Districts of Texas, as well as Texas state courts. He earned his J.D. (Juris Doctorate) from California Western Law School in 1982 and his B.A. in psychology from Baylor University in 1979. He graduated from the Gerry Spence Trial Lawyers College in Dubois, Wyoming in July 2009. Currently, Patrick is serving his fourth two-year term on the McLendon-Chisholm City Council, Place 3. A Spanish-speaker, he served as interim Hispanic pastor from 2004 to 2007 at Lake Pointe Church, where he has remained a member since 1985. Prior to starting his own law firm, Patrick served as the Assistant Criminal District Attorney in Rockwall County, Texas from 1985 to 1986. He is a member of many associations, including: Texas Trial Lawyers Association, Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the Association of Trial Lawyers of America, The National Trial Lawyers, the Christian Legal Society, the Christian Trial Lawyers Association, the Rockwall County Bar Association, Rockwall County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, Collin County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, the Dallas County Bar, and the Texas Bar Association. Patrick represents injured persons in personal injury and wrongful death claims in the North Texas and East Texas area and throughout the entire state of Texas. Defense of citizens accused, investigated or arrested for criminal law violations in Texas counties, such as: Rockwall, Dallas, Collin, Denton, Kaufman, Hopkins, Hunt, Tarrant, Grayson, Ellis and all counties in Texas. Patrick believes in the right to trial by jury. Texas Super Lawyer, every year since 2006 to present. Top 100 Trial Lawyers, 2009, 2011 American Trial Lawyers Association Top 100 Trial Lawyers. Board Certified Personal Injury and Board Certified Criminal Trial Lawyer Patrick Short is a trial lawyer based in Rockwall County, Texas, the county east of Dallas County with over 32 years of experience representing clients in East and North Texas in personal injury, wrongful death, criminal defense, and selected civil litigation matters. Patrick is Board Certified in Criminal Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and in Criminal Trial Advocacy by the National Board of Trial Advocacy. He is also Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Patrick is one of eight lawyers in the State of Texas that are double Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in both Personal Injury Trial Law and Criminal Law. Patrick has been selected as a Texas Super Lawyer every year since 2006 in addition to his invitation-only selection of the American Trial Lawyers Association’s Top 100 Trial Lawyers in 2009 and 2011. He has been selected to the invitation-only Best Attorneys of America. Patrick is admitted to practice law before the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, and the U.S. District Court for the Northern and Eastern Districts of Texas, as well as Texas state courts. He earned his J.D. (Juris Doctorate) from California Western Law School in 1982 and his B.A. in psychology from Baylor University in 1979. He graduated from the Gerry Spence Trial Lawyers College in Dubois, Wyoming in July 2009. Currently, Patrick is serving his fourth two-year term on the McLendon-Chisholm City Council, Place 3. A Spanish-speaker, he served as interim Hispanic pastor from 2004 to 2007 at Lake Pointe Church, where he has remained a member since 1985. Prior to starting his own law firm, Patrick served as the Assistant Criminal District Attorney in Rockwall County, Texas from 1985 to 1986. He is a member of many associations, including: Texas Trial Lawyers Association, Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the Association of Trial Lawyers of America, The National Trial Lawyers, the Christian Legal Society, the Christian Trial Lawyers Association, the Rockwall County Bar Association, Rockwall County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, Collin County Criminal Defense Lawyers Association, the Dallas County Bar, and the Texas Bar Association. Patrick represents injured persons in personal injury and wrongful death claims in the North Texas and East Texas area and throughout the entire state of Texas. Defense of citizens accused, investigated or arrested for criminal law violations in Texas counties, such as: Rockwall, Dallas, Collin, Denton, Kaufman, Hopkins, Hunt, Tarrant, Grayson, Ellis and all counties in Texas. Patrick believes in the right to trial by jury. Texas Super Lawyer, every year since 2006 to present. Top 100 Trial Lawyers, 2009, 2011 American Trial Lawyers Association Top 100 Trial Lawyers. Best Attorneys of America. Board Certified Personal Injury Trial Law, by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in Criminal Law, Board Certified by the National Board of Trial Advocacy in Criminal Law. In 2014 of 97,000 active attorneys in Texas, there are 7,225 who are board certified in one of the twenty-three specialized areas of law in Texas. Patrick Short is one (1) of eight (8) lawyers in Texas who are Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in Personal Injury Trial Law and Criminal Law. Less than 1.5% of active lawyers in Texas are Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law and less that 1% is Board Certified in Criminal Law. Patrick believes in the right to trial by jury as afforded to all citizens under the 6th and 7th Amendments to the United States Constitution.

attorneys.name: J. Lindsey Short Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
For over 40 years, founding partner of Short Carter & Morris, L.L.P., J. Lindsey Short, Jr. has devoted his considerable legal talents and skills to the practice of family law. A native Houstonian, Lindsey graduated from St. Johns School and received his Bachelor of Arts from Washington & Lee University. He earned his Doctorate of Jurisprudence from the University of Texas School of Law and was admitted to the State Bar of Texas in 1967. Lindsey also served shipboard in the United States Navy as a Lieutenant during the Vietnam era. After completing his military service, Lindsey returned to Houston to begin his law practice. Initially focusing on real estate and oil and gas law, he turned his attention to family law in 1973 where he has concentrated his practice ever since.

Lindsey has been board-certified in family law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization since 1980, shortly after the inception of the certification process for family law. He is still considered by many to be one of Houston's top child custody attorneys, although the majority of his practice is now devoted to complex marital property issues. He has represented several high profile cases over the years and has appeared both on satellite and national television programs, including the Today Show with Jane Pauley. Throughout his career Lindsey has represented many high profile Houstonians; yet he understands and appreciates the necessity for discretion and a client's need for zealous representation without undue notoriety.

Lindsey has been married to Agnes May Short for over 40 years and they are the parents of three adult daughters. As a family man, he understands the dynamics of the family and the emotional trauma that often accompanies a divorce or custody situation. He has the ability to communicate truthfully about the possible outcome of a situation and does not attempt to gloss over hard details to fit the client's desires. He also knows how to balance the legal implications of a complex family litigation with the emotional concerns of the client and can draw from that knowledge and experience to resolve his cases, be it through litigation to a Judge, jury, collaborative law or settlement at mediation.

In the early years of his practice, Lindsey maintained many associate lawyers and then in January of 2008, Lindsey and four lawyers who had practiced with him for a number of years formed Short Carter Morris, L.L.P. He has served as a source of encouragement to his "team" and he continues to develop the firm's commitment to the community, both in the area of legal services and volunteer services.

Lindsey is active in state, national, and international organizations that are dedicated to the practice of law. He has played an integral part in the development of the high standards to which today's family law attorneys aspire. Lindsey served as a Director of the State Bar of Texas, Chair of the Family Law Council of the State Bar of Texas, Chair of the Family Law Advisory Commission, and as President of the Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists. He has also served as director of the Gulf Coast Family Law Specialists, president of the Family Law Forum, and Chairman of Family Law Committee of the Texas Trial Lawyers Association. He is currently also a member of the Texas Bar Foundation, the Houston Bar Foundation and the State Bar College. He has also served on the State Bar Grievance Committee.

Lindsey served as President of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML) in 2002, a national organization which is dedicated to the same principals of professionalism and competence to which Short adheres. He is also past President of the Texas Chapter of the AAML and a founding fellow of the International Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, the Family Law Council on Community Property States, and the American College of Family Trial Lawyers, a national organization limited to one hundred members.

Lindsey is dedicated to the development of the profession through education and has been a visiting law professor for a full semester at the University of Texas School of Law, Washington & Lee University School of Law, and the University of Houston Law Center. He has numerous publications to his name and has served as the Editor-in-Chief for the Journal of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. Lindsey is also a frequent lecturer at continuing legal education seminars across the country as well as for the State Bar of Texas and has served as the Course Director for many seminars presented by the State Bar and other professional organizations. Lindsey has delivered over 80 speeches during his career to the legal profession.

Over the course of his career, Lindsey has consistently been honored for his commitment and contributions to the practice of family law. In 1990, he was named Outstanding Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers and received the AAML Certificate of Appreciation for Outstanding Service in 1988, 1990 and 1998. In 1998 he was also the recipient of the Sam Emison Award presented by the Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists for outstanding contributions to the profession, and was chosen by his peers to be included among The Best Lawyers in America, published throughout the country for over twenty years, Texas Super Lawyers every year since its inception and H Texas Magazine.

He has been recognized in the Bar Register of Preeminent Lawyers and was named by Worth Magazine as one of The Top 10 Divorce Lawyers in the United States. He is well respected nationally, statewide, and locally by his peers and the judiciary. He has served as a mentor and role model for many young lawyers during his career. Although the majority of hi cases have been situated in Harris and surrounding counties, Lindsey has litigated family law cases throughout the State of Texas.

Lindsey is licensed to practice before the United States Supreme Court, the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas, and by the Supreme Court of Texas.

On a lighter note, Lindsey is an avid waterfowler and upland game hunter and has the appropriate wall mountings to prove it. He is also a gourmet cook and frequently provides cooking tips and samplings to friends, colleagues and staff.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Spring, TX
attorneys.bio:
Sarah Shoulton earned her undergraduate degree from John Jay College of Criminal Justice in Manhattan and later obtained her Juris Doctor from Thurgood Marshall School of Law in Houston, Texas. Her legal experience spans probate law, personal injury, contracts, and construction law, allowing her to offer comprehensive and compassionate representation across a range of complex matters.

A proud New York native, Sarah brings passion, dedication, and a deep sense of purpose to every client she serves. Inspired by her younger brother, who is autistic, she has developed a lifelong commitment to advocating for individuals with special needs and their families. Outside of her legal career, Sarah is an active member of her church and local community. She has a love for travel—having visited 24 countries—and enjoys baking and cooking in her free time.

With both personal and professional roots grounded in service, Sarah is committed to providing thoughtful, effective counsel tailored to each client’s unique needs.

Outside of the office Kyle enjoys spending time with his wife and four boys – his time is spent coaching and attending various sporting events of his children (football, baseball, soccer, lacrosse, competitive cheer, and basketball). When time permits, he enjoys family vacations.

attorneys.name: Russell J. Shrauner
attorneys.practice_type: Admiralty & Maritime Law Lawyers in Midland, TX
attorneys.bio:
Russell is a West Texas injury attorney dedicated to defending the rights of the injured in his community. Russell started as a clerk for The Carlson Law Firm and is now a full-time attorney. Since being licensed in 2018, Russell has represented clients in 26 West Texas counties and counting. He takes pride in helping people-whether they're down the street or 100 miles away. He has significant experience in representing clients injured in wrecks involving commercial and oilfield trucks, as well as on-location injuries in the oilfield.

Experience on your side

Working with The Carlson Law Firm team, Russell has recovered over $13.4 million on behalf of clients

Russell grew up in Midland, Texas. From an early age, he's known the importance of standing up for people and being a voice for those in need. Russell has worked in the oilfields helping to rebuild wellheads, and on-location doing flowback work. He's seen firsthand how unforgiving the vehicles, equipment, chemicals, and materials associated with the production of oil and gas can be. After putting his time in the oil patch, Russell decided to go to Law School to create an opportunity for himself to help others. He has worked in other areas of law, however, Russell ultimately found his calling in personal injury.

Seeing clients recover from their injuries and get their lives back on track makes this profession rewarding for Russell. If you want an attorney who cares, who will pursue your case professionally, and aggressively when the need arises, contact Russell now.

Russell earned a B.A. in Philosophy at Texas A&M and got his J.D. at the Texas Tech University School of Law. He was sworn into the Texas Bar in April 2018. Outside of the office, Russell is usually making plans with his family and friends. He enjoys travel, cooking, football, and going out with friends. Ask him about winning a Chili Cook-Off or building a sailboat!

A quote Russell lives by, "Your sword can be a sermon or the power of the pen... Make them hear you." - "Make Them Hear You" from Ragtime

attorneys.name: Matthew Shrum
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Matthew Shrum, PLLC
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
I’m Matthew Shrum, an Austin attorney whose practice is focused on helping people after serious injuries – especially those caused by car, truck and other motor vehicle accidents. When someone else’s carelessness turns your life upside down, you deserve an advocate who can move quickly, build a strong case and push back when an insurance company tries to minimize what you’ve been through.

I earned my law degree from The University of Texas School of Law and began my legal career as a prosecutor in Travis County. That courtroom experience matters in personal injury cases. I learned how to investigate claims, evaluate evidence, work with law enforcement and witnesses, and prepare cases to be proven – not just argued. Insurance companies know the difference between a lawyer who negotiates and a lawyer who is ready and able to take a case to trial, and I bring that trial-tested mindset to every injury claim I handle.

My goal is straightforward: to guide you through the process, keep you informed, and pursue the full compensation you need for medical care, lost income, and the impact your injuries have had on your daily life.

attorneys.name: Kody C. Silva
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Kody C. Silva, a Founding Partner of Deyerle Silva Smith, PLLC, is a highly skilled and experienced family law practitioner with over a decade of family law experience. Kody is dedicated to providing comprehensive and personalized legal solutions to clients facing complex family law matters.

With a practice focused on divorce, custody, premarital and post marital agreements, pre-litigation consulting, protective orders, and LGBTQ+ family law issues, Kody has gained a reputation as a compassionate and fierce advocate for his clients.

Kody received his Juris Doctorate from Baylor Law School and a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology and Sociology from the University of Nebraska – Lincoln. After law school, Kody worked for the Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia and then as an Associate Attorney at the law firm of Ackerman Brown. In 2015, Kody returned to his home state of Texas and began working as an attorney at an Austin-based family law firm, where he became a Partner in 2019.

In 2023, Kody and his fellow Partners, Candice Deyerle and Lianna Garza Smith, founded Deyerle Silva Smith, PLLC to provide excellent family law representation to Austin and the surrounding communities of Central Texas under a shared vision.

Kody is admitted to practice law in the State of Texas and in the District of Columbia.

In addition to his legal practice, Kody is a member of the Austin and Williamson County Bar Associations and he recently finished a six-year term as a member of the Board of Directors for a local non-profit organization, Out Youth.

Kody has been recognized for his excellence in family law as a SuperLawyer Rising Star

At Deyerle Silva Smith, PLLC, Kody is committed to providing personalized attention and tailored legal solutions to every client. His extensive experience and unwavering dedication to his clients make him a trusted and respected attorney in the family law community.

Michael grew up in Carrollton before moving to Waco to attend High School. While in high school, Michael worked part-time at his stepmother’s law firm in Waco, where he became interested in the law and decided he wanted to become an attorney. After graduating from high School, he attended Texas State University in San Marcos, where he graduated Summa Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Science in Agriculture Business Management. Michael then attended Texas A&M University School of Law in Fort Worth, where he obtained his J.D. Michael is licensed with the State Bar of Texas.

Michael previously practiced criminal defense in Waco and its surrounding counties, as well as corporate and family-based immigration in Dallas. Now, he mainly practices medical malpractice defense, health law, and small business representation. Michael is an active member of the Texas Bar.

While he is not working, Michael enjoys playing music, video and board games, and spending time with his family and friends. He is a proud husband, and the father of twins.

Mr. Simmons joined Curnutt & Hafer, L.L.P. in 2007. Mr. Simmons concentrates his practice in business, oil and gas, and franchise litigation. attorneys.name: Christopher J. Simmons
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Chris Simmons is one of the founding partners of Lyons & Simmons. He focuses his practice on representing plaintiffs in catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death cases. He has developed a reputation as a highly-skilled warrior who combines a tireless work ethic with a creative and innovative approach to achieve results for the people that matter most—his clients. Simmons treats his clients’ problems as his own. Simmons wants his clients to know that he will stand up for them against their opponents. Anytime. Anywhere.

Simmons is a firm believer that results speak louder than words and with that mindset he pursues justice for his clients. His pursuit of justice has resulted in him trying cases to verdict throughout the state of Texas and obtaining multimillion-dollar results for his clients in states across the country. Simmons, along with firm Co-Founder Michael Lyons, has assembled a team of lawyers that has been consistently recognized as leaders in their field. Simmons and his team have recovered hundreds of millions of dollars in judgments, awards, and settlements on behalf of their clients.

In 2025, Simmons was part of the trial team that secured a $109.5 Million jury verdict for two victims of a home explosion that resulted from leaks in a utility company’s natural gas system in San Antonio, Texas. The verdict is believed to be the largest negligence verdict in the history of Bexar County. The verdict has received national attention. Simmons was named to the Plaintiffs’ Executive Committee in In Re: Astroworld Festival Litigation related to the tragic events involving the deaths of 10 people at the Astroworld Festival Concert in 2021 created by Travis Scott and promoted by Live Nation. Simmons was among a handful of attorneys selected for the Plaintiffs’ leadership of this mass casualty litigation.

Simmons has obtained exceptional results for clients in just the recent past:

$109.5 Million – Burn Injury, Fire / Gas Explosion

$70 Million – Wrongful Death, Negligent Security/Operations

$60 Million – Burn Injuries, Home Explosion

$33 Million – Wrongful Death, Fire / Explosion

$2.75 Million – Spine Injuries, Commercial Vehicle Accident

$2 Million – Spine Injuries, Trucking Accident

$2 Million – Burn Injuries, Apartment Fire

$1.7 Million – Wrongful Death, Trucking Accident

$1.3 Million – Catastrophic Injuries, Trucking Accident

Simmons has extensive experience in cases involving catastrophic personal injuries and wrongful death arising from: oilfield explosions, blowouts, and rig fires; aviation disasters involving planes and helicopters; industrial accidents involving machines, vehicles, fires, and chemicals; defective products; electrocutions; and commercial trucking accidents. Additionally, Simmons has handled large, “bet-the-company” business disputes on behalf of plaintiffs involving breach of contract, fraud, and breach of fiduciary duties.

Simmons’ results-oriented mindset has gained the recognition of his peers. He has been recognized by National Law Journal as one of the top lawyers in the country as a “Trailblazer” award recipient. Simmons is a Life Member of the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum. He has been recognized on the Lawdragon 500 Leading Plaintiff Consumer Lawyers (2020-2025). Simmons has earned Best Lawyers in America (2021-2025) and D Magazine Best Lawyers in Dallas (2019, 2021-2023), recognition. He also was honored as a “Best Lawyer in Dallas under 40” by D Magazine (2018 - 2020), and was named one of the Top 40 Under 40 by the National Trial Lawyers (2015). In 2019, Simmons was recognized in the prestigious “On the Rise” Texas Lawyer Professional Excellence Awards. Simmons has been named to the Thompson Reuters Super Lawyers listing (2022-2024) as well as the companion Texas Rising Stars listing (2014 - 2020). He was also repeatedly honored as one of the “Up-and-Coming 100” Rising Stars in Texas (2017 - 2021).

In addition to his efforts to obtain results for his clients, Simmons has consistently worked to support community members and peers by working on multiple committees within the Dallas Bar Association and other associations in Texas. With the help of his peers, he has raised significant amounts of money for charitable causes benefitting the citizens of Texas. In 2013, the Dallas Association of Young Lawyers honored Simmons by presenting him with the “Outstanding Committee Chair Award” for his efforts to support his community and peers.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Frisco, TX
attorneys.bio:
Kacey Simmons is an associate attorney at Barbieri Law Firm, where she practices exclusively in criminal defense. She brings nearly a decade of advocacy and mock-trial experience to her work, with a background rooted in trial strategy and courtroom preparation.

Kacey earned her J.D. from the University of Texas School of Law in 2025, where she distinguished herself as one of the school’s top advocates. She helped lead Texas Law to multiple national championship titles, including first-place finishes at the Georgetown White Collar Crime Invitational and the Martin Luther King Jr. National Civil Rights Trial Competition. She was awarded the Niemann Cup for best overall advocate in her graduating class and inducted into the Order of Barristers.

Before law school, Kacey graduated summa cum laude from Texas A&M University, where she served as president of the university’s mock-trial program. During law school, she served as Mock Trial Director on the Board of Advocates and represented clients through the Disability Rights Clinic.

Kacey has professional experience with the Collin County and Dallas County District Attorney’s Offices and previously served as a law clerk at Barbieri Law Firm. She is licensed to practice law in Texas and is a member of the Texas Criminal Defense Lawyers Association.

attorneys.name: Nathan Simmons
attorneys.practice_type: Federal Employment Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Nathan Simmons is an associate attorney at the office in Austin, TX. Born and raised in Dallas, Texas, Nathan has lived almost entirely in Texas, spending time over the past decade living in Austin and Houston. Nathan calls Texas his home, and it is for that reason that he has dedicated his career to fighting for the rights of Texas workers. He received his Bachelor of Arts in Plan II Honors and his Bachelor of Science in Architectural Engineering from the University of Texas at Austin in 2015. After graduating, Nathan worked as an engineer-in-training for a year before deciding to pursue a career in law. Nathan then served as a community organizer in Austin and helped form a hiring hall union. Through the union, Nathan helped unionize political campaigns, served as a union steward, and represented workers in disputes with management.

He then received his Juris Doctorate from the University of Texas School of Law in 2021. During his time at Texas Law, Nathan served as a pro bono scholar for the Supported Decision-Making Agreement (SDMA) clinic, attended the 2019 Peggy Browning Fund Workers’ Rights Conference, and worked for multiple local organizations and law firms dealing with workers’ rights violations, immigration issues, impact litigation, accessibility needs, and family law. He also placed third nationally as part of the Texas Law team that competed in the 2021 Jeffrey Moorad Game Day Case Competition.

Nathan primarily handles plaintiff-side employment law litigation, focusing on Title VII (race, color, sex, national origin, religion, sexual orientation) discrimination, disability rights, age discrimination, wage issues, and other employment law issues. Additionally, he focuses on labor law and has dealt with the NLRB on behalf of workers. He is also conversational in Spanish. In his free time, he enjoys movies, trivia, creative writing, and spending time with friends and family.

attorneys.name: Sharon Simmons
attorneys.practice_type: Products Liability Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Sharon Simmons-Cantrell--Caring. Attentive. Warm.

"I'm a people person," says Sharon. "That's my biggest asset. I feel for the clients, and I listen to them--whether it's ten minutes or 45 minutes. Some of my clients have no family or friends. I spend as much time as necessary helping them find ways to get their needs met."

Sharon litigated cases at Simmons & Fletcher, P.C. from 1991-1995. Since then, she has taken over the handling of the pre-litigation division of the firm and has successfully resolved 80% of all pre-litigation files. Whether they have physical disabilities, little education, or just need someone to listen, she gives each one the attention and care they deserve.

"Many of our clients are afraid and don't know who to trust," she says. "We let them know they can trust us."

Sharon says that she learned a lot about dealing with people from her uncle, Bob Simmons.

"Twenty years ago, when I began working here as an intern, I watched the way he handled clients and respected the sensitivity and concern he showed them. That's how I am, too."

Although lawyers don't have a reputation for being accommodating and patient, Sharon believes that Simmons & Fletcher, P.C. is unique in that they go far beyond providing basic legal services.

"Some of what we do isn't related to what you learn in law school. My work is more of a ministry. You'd be surprised at how many people need help beyond legal services. We help our clients obtain the social services they need--whether it's access to food banks, getting to the right doctor, emergency funding, or childcare. Sometimes it's a matter of fine-tuning what their needs are to be able to help them. If we can't help them, we point them in the right direction. We never shut a door in someone's face."

"Some of my female clients have never met with a lawyer and are intimidated by the process. Many times a woman's touch can be helpful."

Sharon graduated from A&M in 1988 with a degree in psychology and had planned to attend graduate school in the same field. However, the Lord opened the door for her to go to law school.

"I love what I do," Sharon says. "I'm a fast-paced person, and every case, every day, every client is different. That keeps my work exciting. Being able to help and guide people as they resolve their problems gives me the greatest satisfaction. That's what we want."

Sharon received her law degree from the University of Houston Law School in 1991. Sharon and her husband Kent married in 1994 and have 3 children. They are active members at Willow Meadows Baptist Church, where Sharon teaches children's Sunday school.

We're not ashamed to admit that we're a different kind of law firm offering a high quality of service you won't find anywhere else. We're different by design. If you need legal assistance for a situation resulting from personal injury, please call us at 1-800-298-0111.

"I love what I do," Sharon says. "I'm a fast-paced person, and every case, every day, every client is different. That keeps my work exciting. Being able to help and guide people as they resolve their problems gives me the greatest satisfaction. That's what we want."

Sharon received her law degree from the University of Houston Law School in 1991. Sharon and her husband Kent married in 1994 and have 3 children. They are active members at Willow Meadows Baptist Church, where Sharon teaches children's Sunday school.

attorneys.practice_type: Civil Rights Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Noelle grew up in Houston, Texas. She attended the University of Texas at Austin, where she earned her bachelor’s degree in English literature, and participated in the Plan I thesis program. While at UT, Noelle interned at South by Southwest, and found she had a passion for the production industry.

Following that passion, Noelle accepted an offer to attend Chapman University Fowler School of Law in Southern California with hopes to pursue a legal career in the entertainment industry. Once Noelle began her law school classes, however, she realized that she had an undiscovered passion for civil litigation. During her time at Chapman Law, Noelle participated in the student fellowship program, allowing her to teach weekly lessons on the topics of Torts and Constitutional Law to other law school students. Noelle also clerked for a boutique Plaintiff’s firm where she assisted on civil rights cases and class action suits.

While Noelle enjoyed her time in California, she has always been a Texan at heart. After graduating law school in 2024, Noelle moved back to Texas to take the bar exam and begin her legal practice. Noelle joined the Wright & Greenhill team in 2025, and is excited for the opportunity to advocate for her clients inside and outside of the courtroom.

attorneys.name: Megan E. Simpson
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Linda Risinger
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Frisco, TX
attorneys.bio:
A graduate of Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law and second-generation family law attorney, Megan knew she wanted to help her neighbors in the DFW community navigate some of the most confusing and difficult times in their lives.

Megan takes pride in taking the time to understand each client's unique situation. More importantly, she takes to time to ensure the client understands the situation every step of the way so that she can combine her legal experience with the client's personal experiences to produce a clear plan of action in their case.

Megan understands that taking your case to court can be a gamble. She seeks to avoid that instability early on by avoiding unprofessional "mud-slinging" with other attorneys and by seeking alternative means to resolve your dispute. She has experience with informal and formal settlement processes and will ably negotiate for a client's interests and rights.

In law school, Megan dedicated herself to family law. She interned for the Texas Attorney General's office, a District Court Judge in Collin County, Court Appointed Special Advocates of Dallas County, and the Collin County District Attorney's Office Family Justice Division. She also served as chief counsel at SMU's Child Advocacy Clinic advocating for children in CPS cases. She served in the SMU Family Law Association first as vice president, then as president, while taking every family law course offered by SMU at the time. After graduating in the top 15% of her class, she honed her skills as a litigator and settlement negotiator working for her mother, Linda Risinger. She remains a proud and dynamic part of that mother-daughter team today. Megan has grown up in the courtrooms of Dallas, Denton, and Collin Counties. She understands that court appearances can be uncomfortable and even scary for many clients. If early resolution is not possible, she will take the time to prepare the client and the facts to make the process as comfortable as possible while she fights for your voice to be heard and your situation to be understood by the court.

attorneys.name: Daryl J. Sinkule
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Daryl J. Sinkule is a Member-Attorney at Kilgore & Kilgore PLLC. He is Board Certified in Labor and Employment Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and focuses his law practice on employment law civil litigation in state and federal courts and in administrative proceedings. Mr. Sinkule has handled a number of cases-across the State of Texas and the nation-involving wage and hour issues under the Fair Labor Standards Act, successfully representing numerous employees against their current and/or former employers in recovering unpaid wages and overtime wages. He also represents both employees and employers in matters involving Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Family and Medical Leave Act, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act, and other employment-related federal and state statutes. Additionally, he represents individuals, executives, and employers in negotiating employment contracts and severance agreements, and before administrative agencies such as the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and the Texas Workforce Commission.

A graduate of Texas A&M University and the University of Houston Law Center, Mr. Sinkule is admitted to practice before the United States District Courts for the Southern, Northern, Eastern, and Western Districts of Texas, the United States Courts of Appeals for the Fourth and Fifth Circuits, and all Texas state courts. He is an active member of professional organizations, including the Dallas Bar Association, He is a panel member of the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, Labor and Employment Law, which evaluates candidates for Board certification. He is also a member of the Houston Bar Association, the Labor & Employment Law Section of the State Bar of Texas, and both the Houston and national chapters of the National Employment Lawyers Association. Between 2009 and 2012, Mr. Sinkule served on the Labor & Employment Law Section Council of the Houston Bar Association, where he co-chaired the Section's Scholarships/Grants Committee. Mr. Sinkule also formerly served on the Lawyers Against Waste Committee of the Houston Bar Association. In 2009, Mr. Sinkule was named a "Professional on the Fast Track" by H Texas magazine, and in 2013 and 2014, H Texas magazine named Mr. Sinkule one of "Houston's Top Lawyers." Moreover, each year between 2006 and 2013, Mr. Sinkule received the honor of being named a Texas Rising Star® by Law & Politics and the publishers of Texas Monthly magazine, and each year between 2013 and 2015, Mr. Sinkule was named a Super Lawyer® by Law & Politics and the publishers of Texas Monthly magazine. Finally, each year between 2013 and 2015, Houstonia magazine named Mr. Sinkule to its "Top Lawyers" list.

attorneys.name: Theodore G. Skarbowski
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Skarbowski knows that hard work and determination pay off. He worked his way through college and law school as a truck driver, putting in many working and studying hours. Despite this trying schedule, Mr. Skarbowski was recognized as the Outstanding Senior Man in Political Science in 1986 at Sam Houston State University, being on the Dean's List numerous semesters and graduating cum laude. While still working as a trucker once in law school, Mr. Skarbowski also made the Dean's List during 3 semesters and wrote the Top Paper in his 1991 Insurance Law Seminar (Professor Anthony Hall).

Mr. Skarbowski was first licensed to practice law in 1992. He has worked for more than 28 years as a civil litigation attorney involving many different practice areas. These areas include complex obstetrical and neonatal birth injury medical malpractice; commercial litigation and insurance defense. Skarbowski has represented individuals, families, large and small business entities on both sides of the docket.

Mr. Skarbowski has conducted hundreds of depositions, including numerous experts, physicians, nurses, as well as both plaintiffs and defendants in lawsuits over his legal career.

Mr. Skarbowski has also been involved in more than 25 trials during his career with favorable results achieved for many of his clients. Additionally, Mr. Skarbowski has successfully settled numerous cases for plaintiffs he has represented, the total of which represents millions of dollars. attorneys.name: Brooke Skiles
attorneys.firm_name: Skillern Firm Divorce & Child Custody Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Originally from Arkansas, Brooke Skiles earned her Bachelor’s degree in Psychology with minors in Legal Studies and Philosophy from the University of Arkansas at Fayetteville. Her interest in family law began early, during her undergraduate internship at a family law firm, where she witnessed firsthand the impact compassionate advocacy can have on clients navigating some of the most difficult chapters of their lives.

Brooke moved to Houston to attend South Texas College of Law, drawn by both the city’s vibrant culture and the school’s renowned advocacy program. While in law school, she immersed herself in hands-on learning through numerous advocacy courses and an internship with Skillern Firm Divorce & Child Custody Lawyers during and after her 2L year, gaining practical courtroom and client experience.

During her 3L year, Brooke served as President of the Family and Probate Legal Society, organizing seminars and luncheons with prominent family law attorneys across Houston. She also participated in the Estate Clinic, assisting clients with probate document preparation, and completed a seminar in Marital Property, further strengthening her foundation in Texas family law.

Brooke is an active member of the Family Law Section of the State Bar of Texas and a proud alumna of Delta Delta Delta Sorority. Outside of the office, she enjoys baking desserts from scratch, walking through Memorial Park, and traveling to explore new places.

Brooke approaches every case with empathy, preparation, and dedication committed to helping clients protect their families and move forward with confidence.

attorneys.name: Matthew Skillern
attorneys.firm_name: Skillern Firm Divorce & Child Custody Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Matthew A. Skillern is the founder and lead family law attorney at Skillern Firm Divorce & Child Custody Lawyers. He is Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, an accomplishment that only 1% of family lawyers in Texas have achieved. Matthew is a strong trial lawyer with a record of success. He doesn’t back down, even when faced with difficult child custody issues or contentious divorces.

Matthew believes that being an effective advocate requires being forceful when it comes to defending his clients’ interests but also compassionate when helping them through the legal system. Although Matthew has been successfully litigating family law cases for years, he believes the courtroom is not the only place to resolve the complex and sensitive issues commonly found in family law matters. Recognizing that every client and case is different, Matthew advocates the use of negotiation and mediation to resolve marital and child custody disputes. If negotiation or mediation fail to resolve the issue, Matthew is more than willing to take the matter to trial.

Matthew grew up in Stafford, Texas, with humble beginnings. Upon graduation from high school, Matthew played football at Tyler Junior College and went on to graduate from Baylor University with a degree in political science. He obtained his Juris Doctor from South Texas College of Law Houston. Matthew is a first-generation college graduate and often worked three jobs at once to finance his education. His tenacity, work ethic, and drive are evident in his firm, case management and advocacy skills. While Matthew started his legal career as a prosecutor for the Smith County District Attorney’s Office in Tyler, Texas, handling a wide range of criminal matters and trying cases to juries, upon moving home to Houston, Matthew switched to the other side of the courtroom, honing his trial and courtroom skills at one of Houston’s premier criminal defense firms.

Matthew is dedicated to his family and passionate about children and child-related issues. Clients, colleagues, and friends respect him for his dynamic courtroom skills and presence, all the while recognizing his kind heart and compassionate nature. Thus, Matthew founded Skillern Firm Divorce & Child Custody Lawyers with the idea that he could utilize his strong advocacy skills for the good of others – because it is not just “family law,” it is someone’s life.

attorneys.name: Amber Stryk Skillern
attorneys.firm_name: Skillern Firm Divorce & Child Custody Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Amber is an accomplished Houston family law attorney who brings decades of courtroom experience and a compassionate approach to every case. As Of Counsel at Skillern Firm Divorce & Child Custody Lawyers, she focuses on representing clients in divorce, child custody disputes, high-asset property division, and cases involving domestic violence. Known for her fierce advocacy in court and her empathetic guidance outside of it, Amber is trusted by clients across Houston, Sugar Land, Katy, and the surrounding areas.

Amber began her legal career as a domestic violence prosecutor, where she developed her ability to handle emotionally charged cases with both strength and sensitivity. That early work instilled in her a client-first philosophy: break down complex legal issues into clear strategies, empower clients with knowledge, and pursue results with relentless dedication. Whether handling custody battles, spousal support claims, or protecting clients from financial and emotional abuse, Amber is methodical, thorough, and unyielding in her preparation.

Her extensive background in civil litigation and complex trial work sets her apart in family law cases involving business ownership, real estate, and high-value marital assets. Amber has represented clients in both state and federal courts, giving her a strategic edge when handling property division in divorce cases and protecting her clients’ financial future. Her prior experience in insurance defense and product liability litigation also provides valuable insight into anticipating opposing counsel’s strategies, an advantage she now uses to advocate for families.

At Skillern Firm, Amber combines her litigation skills with her passion for helping families rebuild their lives after divorce or custody disputes. Clients know her not only as a powerful advocate in court, but also as a steady, compassionate ally who protects their children, assets, and peace of mind. With her deep legal knowledge and unwavering commitment, Amber ensures her clients receive the clarity, confidence, and fierce representation they deserve in Texas family law matters.

Since graduation, Hannah has worked exclusively in the practice area of Family Law here at Skillern Firm. Whether you’re facing a divorce, child custody dispute, or any other family law matter, Hannah is here to provide the guidance and advocacy you need to move forward with confidence.

Hannah received her J.D. from the University of Houston Law Center where she was a dean’s list recipient almost every semester. Although newly licensed, Hannah’s passion for family law was something she came into law school with. After her first year of law school, she spent her summer working for the non-profit Aid for Victims of Domestic Violence (AVDA) representing and advocating for victims of domestic violence. This confirmed Hannah’s passion for family law and desire to help people during the vulnerable chapter of life that is custody and marital issues.

During the remaining years at the University of Houston Law Center, Hannah worked as a research assistant to the Family Law professor, interned at a law firm, clerked for Judge Heppard in the 387th Judicial District Court, clerked for Judge Peake in the 257th Judicial District Court, and received her basic mediation certification and advanced family law mediation certification. It was important to Hannah that while receiving her education, every avenue available to view and study the practice area of Family Law was explored.

Since graduation, Hannah has worked exclusively in the practice area of Family Law here at Skillern Firm. Her dedication, creativity, and ability to view complex issues from multiple angles is an invaluable asset to this firm. Whether you’re facing a divorce, child custody dispute, or any other family law matter, Hannah is here to provide the guidance and advocacy you need to move forward with confidence.

attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Lufkin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Aimee C. Slusher is a founding partner in Skelton Slusher Barnhill Watkins Wells PLLC and is a native of Lufkin, Texas. Ms. Slusher has been practicing law in the areas of estate planning and probate, real estate and business law since 1994. She has prepared estate plans for individuals with taxable and non-taxable estates, and she has represented families in the probate of wills and administration of estates, both taxable and non-taxable. Ms. Slusher has also completed numerous commercial real estate transactions, including the representation of shopping center developers in the sale, purchase and development of real property. She has extensive experience in the formation of business entities, including corporations, limited partnerships, limited liability companies, professional associations and professional corporations, as well as Establishing non-profit organizations, including assisting in the preparation of applications for exempt status with the IRS. Ms. Slusher was previously a partner in the Zeleskey Law Firm for 13 years and previously worked as an associate at Walsh, Akins & Davis in Round Rock, Texas. Ms. Slusher and her husband, Scott, have two daughters, Lauren and Hannah.

attorneys.name: Bruce A. Smith
attorneys.practice_type: Auto Accidents Lawyers in Longview, TX
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Smith spent the first twenty years of his practice defending insurance carriers and corporations. In 2006, Johnny Ward decided to expand his practice which, at the time, was focused primarily on patent litigation. Looking to develop a complex litigation/commercial litigation presence, the Law Offices of T. John Ward, Jr. became Ward & Smith and the two together expanded the firm’s practice and identity.

There are many lawyers who claim to be “trial lawyers,” but few of them truly have trial experience. Since 1986, Mr. Smith has tried in excess of 50 cases to verdict. Most of those cases were tried while Mr. Smith was working for insurance carriers and corporations. He was highly successful in those cases, many resulting in complete defense verdicts for his client. This success has continued with Ward & Smith as Mr. Smith has continued to try cases for the firm’s clients with great success. In 1992, Mr. Smith became board certified in personal injury trial law. In order to qualify to become board certified, a lawyer is required to have a minimum of 5 years of legal experience with a required number of actual trials. Mr. Smith qualified to sit for the board certification examination immediately upon completion of his 5th year of practice and passed the written examination at the first opportunity offered by the State Bar upon being qualified to sit for the examination. He has been re-certified in 1997, 2002, 2007, and 2012. The distinction of board certification in personal injury trial law is held by fewer than 3% of licensed attorneys. Mr. Smith was further recognized and selected by his peers to the Texas Super Lawyers list in 2008, 2009, 2010, and 2013, and he maintains an “AV” rating from Martindale-Hubbell. Ward & Smith is qualified to handle all of your litigation needs, big or small. If you are in need of a trial attorney, you should take advantage of the unique skills and perspectives of Bruce Smith and the attorneys of the Ward & Smith Law Firm.

attorneys.name: James D. Smith
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
A native Texan with a splash of California, Jim earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Southern California, School of Business in 1988 with an emphasis in real estate/finance. He received his Juris Doctorate degree from Whittier College School of Law in Costa Mesa, California in 1992, where he was awarded the American Board of Trial Advocates for Moot Court and Trial Advocacy. After law school, Jim returned to Houston where he became a shareholder in a Houston based litigation law firm. In early 2000, Jim opened a Houston office for a Louisiana based litigation law firm while simultaneously becoming General Counsel to a Houston based pipeline company via the Smith Law Firm.

In early 2007, Jim consolidated his legal representation into the Smith Law Firm; in 2008, he joined forces with a former partner to create Smith & Adams, Ltd.; and on August 1, 2010, with the addition of a new partner, the Firm's name changed to Smith Adams Law LLP. Jim's law practice has an emphasis in business litigation, commercial and real estate transactions, product liability, toxic tort, and insurance defense. Licensed to practice law in the state of Texas, Jim is admitted before the U.S. Supreme Court, U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals, and all U.S. Federal District Courts in Texas. He is a member of the U.S. Supreme Court Bar and the State Bar of Texas, as well as the Defense Research Institute, American Bar Association and Houston Bar Association. As a way to give back to the community, Jim has volunteered his time as an attorney for the Harris County Child Protective Services and the Houston Volunteer Lawyers Association.

attorneys.name: Jon Michael Smith
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Claims Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
We purchase insurance to guard against the unexpected. As policyholders, we are reassured that our needs will be met following a home fire, untimely death or other traumatic event. But when an insurance company fails to recognize a valid claim, our personal tragedy is only compounded.

Often, people have neither the money nor the energy to fight coverage denial or delayed payment. They may feel forced to settle for less than what is owed, or nothing at all. At my Austin law firm, I am committed to assisting families, individuals and businesses receive fair treatment under the law.

If your Texas insurance claim has been wrongfully denied, contact Jon Michael Smith, Attorney. I have over 30 years of legal experience, and am prepared to advocate for you every step of the way.

Personal Service From an Austin Insurance Bad Faith Lawyer

Insurance companies promise to be there for you when times are hard. They sell you a policy and collect premiums, but sometimes do not deliver on the policy's assurances. This is known as insurance bad faith.

At my firm, I will help you accurately evaluate your bad faith insurance claim and forcefully pursue justice on your behalf. I am always responsive to your needs, and make it a point to return phone calls within one business day. Because I am a solo practitioner, your case will never be passed to a paralegal or junior associate but will receive the personal attention it deserves.

Affordable, Experienced Advocacy

Denied insurance claims can have a profound and lasting effect on financial stability. For this reason, I strive to make my practice accessible. You will not be charged for an initial case evaluation, and are always considered for flexible compensation arrangements. Should I discover that your matter does not merit legal action, I will provide you with a thorough explanation and assist you in understanding your position.

Since my early days as a law clerk, insurance has been the focus of my practice. Over the years, I have successfully handled hundreds of claims on behalf of policyholders and am committed to favorably resolving your matter.

Jon Michael Smith represents clients in a variety of arenas. Jon’s experience includes consumer and commercial disputes, including insurance claims as well as personal injury and probate matters. Jon handles disputes from cradle to grave, including the filing and handling of lawsuits, through jury trial and appeal, if necessary. Jon is board certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization in Consumer and Commercial Law. He has also received the highest rating from his peers through the Martindale Hubbell rating system.

attorneys.bio:
Kim Smith, born in South Vietnam, fled her homeland as a toddler during the fall of Saigon in 1975. After settling in the U.S., she overcame language barriers, later earning a degree in English Rhetoric from Texas A&M and a law degree from Thurgood Marshall School of Law.

Specializing in Workers' Compensation, Kim began her legal career in Houston, expanded to Dallas-Fort Worth, and eventually managed her own practice. A mother of six, she joined Bailey & Galyen in 2013, where she now leads the Workers’ Compensation Department in Arlington.

attorneys.name: Lianna Garza Smith
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Austin, TX
attorneys.bio:
Lianna Garza Smith is a founding Partner of Deyerle Silva Smith, PLLC and has over 10 years of experience handling high-stakes family law cases including complicated divorces and contested child custody matters. Lianna regularly serves high net worth individuals and professionals in the Austin, Texas area and understands the unique challenges and complexities that come with high net worth divorces. Lianna’s extensive experience allows her to navigate even the most complex legal issues with ease, providing clients with the guidance and support they need during what can be an incredibly emotional and challenging time.

As an accomplished family law litigation attorney, Lianna has built a reputation for achieving exceptional results for clients through a deep understanding of the law, an unwavering dedication to excellence, and a fierce commitment to achieving the best possible outcome for every client. Lianna takes the time to fully understand each client’s unique situations and crafts a legal strategy that is tailored to their specific needs and goals. Lianna is highly skilled in negotiation and mediation, but also has a proven track record in the courtroom, making her a formidable advocate for her clients both in and out of court.

In addition to her legal expertise, Lianna is highly regarded for her professionalism and integrity in the legal community. She is committed to providing ethical and transparent representation to her clients, always keeping their best interest at the forefront.

Lianna was born in San Benito, Texas located in the Texas Rio Grande Valley. She lived there until moving to Austin to attend the University of Texas at Austin. She graduated with a B.A. in Philosophy, a B.A. in Sociology and a minor in English. She is a second generation Mexican-American and the first member of her family to graduate from college. After graduating, Lianna moved to Houston where she earned her Doctor of Jurisprudence from South Texas College of Law Houston in 2012 and was admitted to the State Bar of Texas that same year.

From 2012 to 2018, Lianna worked at two prestigious family law firms in Houston, Texas. During her time in Houston, she handled divorces involving family-owned businesses, multi-million-dollar estates, and contested child custody disputes. In 2018, Lianna moved back to Austin to continue to grow her stellar reputation in the Texas family law community as a trial attorney with her trademark client-focused approach and unparalleled work ethic. Prior to co-founding Deyerle Silva Smith, PLLC, Lianna was a Partner at Kirker Davis, a family law firm in Austin, Texas.

Lianna Garza Smith provides concierge-level legal services to clients across Texas and most often the following areas: Travis County, Williamson County, Hays County, Bastrop County, Bell County, Austin, Westlake, Lakeway, Round Rock, Georgetown, Leander, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Lago Vista, Bee Cave, Buda, Kyle, and San Marcos.

attorneys.name: Zachary Smitherman
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Bryan, TX
attorneys.bio:
Zachary Smitherman is a Bryan injury attorney dedicated to preserving the rights of injured Texans. Zachary began his career with The Carlson Law Firm as a law clerk but is now a full-time attorney. Since being licensed, Zachary is representing clients who have been injured in car crashes, slips and falls, and other personal injuries.

Experience on your side

Originally from Garland, Texas, Zachary was driven to attend law school because he knew early on that he wanted to set a good example for not only his peers but others in his community. His affinity for solving problems through creative thinking coupled with his leadership skills are what set him apart from other lawyers.

Zachary is a recent Baylor Law School graduate and represents injured clients in both district and state courts. He is a member of the Brazos County Bar Association.

Seeing clients through recovery is one of the highlights of practicing law for Zachary.

When he's not representing clients, Zachary enjoys brewing craft beers, disc golf, basketball and biking.

attorneys.bio:
Paula Lock Smyth Law Offices, located in Dallas, Texas, providing Litigation and Local Counsel Services in State and Federal Courts, as well as Mediation and Arbitration Services since 1985 and Collaborative Law Services since 2002.

Legal Practice:

Senior Attorney, Paula Lock Smyth, Attorney and Counselor at Law, Mediator and Collaborative Lawyer. Full range of family law practice, including pre- and post-marital agreements, divorce, child custody, visitation, child support, grandparent access, name change and termination and adoption. Also providing probate, wills, powers of attorney and guardianship services. Extensive litigation experience, with favorable results in both jury and non-jury cases. Experienced as mediator and in collaborative law. Serving Dallas, Denton, Collin, Tarrant, Rockwall and other Texas Counties.

Principal, Paula Lock Smyth Mediation Services, Attorney-Mediator. Trained as neutral mediator and facilitator of negotiated settlements in all civil cases by the American Academy of Attorney-Mediators, Inc.

Practiced in all civil areas, including drafting & enforcing contracts, preparing incorporation documents and buy-sell agreements, and handling probate, general civil litigation and family law matters. attorneys.name: Jonathan D. Sneed
attorneys.firm_name: Abraham, Watkins, Nichols, Agosto, Aziz & Stogner
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Houston, TX
attorneys.bio:
Jonathan D. Sneed has dedicated his law practice to helping injured people obtain the justice they deserve. As a fifth-generation Texan, Jonathan's practice is based on the same values passed down by his family: hard work, integrity, and discipline.

Over his career, Jonathan has represented numerous clients on a variety of personal injury and complex commercial litigation matters in both state and federal courts. He has successfully litigated wrongful death, workplace injuries, construction accidents, trucking and automobile accidents, medical malpractice, premises defects, products liability, and toxic chemical exposure cases.

Jonathan graduated from South Texas College of Law Houston where he received both state and national recognition for his skills in trial advocacy. During law school, Jonathan was honored as one of the country’s leading legal brief writers and was selected to serve on the school’s Board of Advocacy. He also had the privilege of interning for the Harris County District Attorney’s Office.

Prior to law school, Jonathan attended Texas A&M University where he studied Construction Science, Business, and Spanish. During his education, Jonathan served as President of the Construction Science Honor's Society and was an active contributor to community housing projects in the Bryan/College Station area. Jonathan also participated in the university's international exchange program where he studied international business and negotiations at the Instituto Tecnológico in Monterrey, Mexico.

Jonathan is actively involved in the legal community and is a proud member of the American Association for Justice, Texas Trial Lawyers Association, Houston Trial Lawyers Association, Houston Young Lawyers Association, and Houston Bar Association.

He is admitted to practice law in Texas, including the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas and the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Texas.

Third Best Brief in the Nation, Scribes Brief-Writing Award, 2012

Finalist, Wagner Labor Law Moot Court Tournament, 2012

Best Oral Argument, Mack Kidd Administrative Law Moot Court Tournament, 2011

attorneys.name: Shirlyn Solas
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration and Nationality Lawyers in Dallas, TX
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Solas-Edwards was born and raised on the Eastern Caribbean island, Nevis. She attended Midwestern State University in Wichita Falls, Texas, from which she graduated with honors in May 2004 earning a Bachelor’s degree in international studies and Spanish.

That same year, she received an award for academic excellence in international studies and was recognized as the most outstanding International Studies student for that year. In May 2007, she graduated with honors from Texas Tech University School of Law, in Lubbock, Texas.

Ms. Solas-Edwards joined Reina & Associates in March 2008. She became a member of the State Bar of Texas in June 2008. Since joining the firm, Ms. Solas-Edwards has successfully litigated removal cases before the Dallas Immigration Court and the San Antonio Immigration Court, including adjustment of status with section 212(h) waivers for crimes, section 212(i) waivers for fraud, as well as asylum and withholding of removal cases. She has also successfully completed an array of family-based immigration cases, including consular processing cases with waivers for unlawful presence and fraud.

Ms. Solas-Edwards takes a particular interest in cases involving immigrants who are the victims of violent crimes; and she has obtained lawful permanent residence for survivors of domestic violence and U non-immigrant visas for victims of certain crimes.
